entries.body:
显示元件

显示元件可过滤终端的显示，需在元件工作台中为其分区。

例如，也许你会想让某个终端只显示一部分石制建材。将显示元件分区为这些材料并装入终端，终端就只会显示这些物品了。

显示元件的效果会叠加，比如装入分区为橡木木板和分区为圆石的显示元件，相应设备两者都会显示。
entries.bodyEn:
View Cell

View Cells are used to filter the display of terminals. You partition them in a Cell Workbench.

For example, say you want a terminal to only display a selection of stone building materials. Partition the view cell to those materials and place it in a terminal, and only those items will be shown.

View cells are additive, if you have a view cell for oak planks and a view cell for cobblestone, putting both in will show both planks and cobblestone.

entries.body:
无线访问点

允许从无线终端无线访问网络。其工作范围与能量消耗由其中安装的无线信号增幅器的数量决定。

单个网络可有任意个无线访问点，每个其中可装有任意个无线信号增幅器，可通过更改这些来优化工作范围和能量消耗。

需占用1个频道。

也用于绑定无线终端。

无线信号增幅器

用于增加无线访问点的工作范围。
entries.bodyEn:
The Wireless Access Point

Allows wireless access via a Wireless Terminal. Range and power usage is determined based on the number of Wireless Booster installed.

A network can have any number of wireless access points with any number of Wireless Booster in each one, allowing you to optimize power usage and range by altering your setup.

Requires a channel.

Also used to bind wireless terminals

Wireless Booster

Used to increase the range of the wireless access point.

Recipes

entries.bodyEn:
Wireless Receiver

无线终端是普通有线终端的便携版本。它们的UI完全一致，不过无线终端只有升级卡槽，而无显示元件槽。

可将终端放入ME无线访问点右上角槽位（带有无线终端图标且下方有箭头）以与访问点所在的网络配对。

只有在ME无线访问点范围内才能工作。

可在充能器中为其充能。

基础终端，但是是便携版！可在ME无线访问点范围内任何地方访问网络存储，或是向自动合成设施发送请求。

界面

entries.bodyEn:
Wireless Terminals

Wireless terminals are portable versions of the regular wired terminals. They have the exact same UIs as their wired counterparts, except instead of slots for View Cells, they have slots for upgrade cards

In order to pair them with a network, insert the terminal in the top-right slot of a ME Wireless Access Point connected to that network. (The slot with a picture of a wireless terminal on it and an arrow below it)

They must be within range of a ME Wireless Access Point to function.

Their energy can be recharged in a Charger.

Wireless Terminal

Your basic terminal, now portable! View and access the contents of your network's storage and request things from your autocrafting setup from anywhere within the range of a ME Wireless Access Point.

The UI

See terminals

Upgrades

The Wireless Terminal supports the following upgrades:

*   Energy Card in order to increase the battery capacity

Wireless Crafting Terminal

The Wireless Crafting Terminal is similar to a regular wireless terminal, with all the same settings and sections, but with an added crafting grid that will be automatically refilled from network storage. Be careful when shift-clicking the output!

The UI

See terminals

Upgrades

The Wireless Crafting Terminal supports the following upgrades:

*   Energy Card in order to increase the battery capacity

Wrenches

Many ae2 blocks can be rotated, so just because this guide doesn't say you can rotate something doesn't mean you can't.

entries.body:
ME主动成型面板

ME主动成型面板的性质与ME成型面板相同，但可以主动放置方块和丢出物品。

无需为其设置子网络。它相当于不会输出至箱子、而是会放置方块的ME输出总线。
entries.bodyEn:
ME Active Formation Plane

ME Active Formation Plane is a ME Formation Plane that can actively place blocks or drop items.

You don't need to set up a subnet for it. It works like an ME Export Bus but places blocks instead of outputting them to a chest.

entries.body:
装配矩阵

装配矩阵是一个多方块结构，同时有分子装配室与ME样板供应器的功能。它能同时进行大量的合成作业（ME网络中需有足量并行处理单元），还可节省频道。

结构

其构造需为长方体，且各棱长在3到7之间。

- 棱应由装配矩阵框架组成。

- 面应由装配矩阵墙壁/玻璃组成。

- 内部应由装配矩阵样板/合成/速度核心组成。

装配矩阵必须包含至少一个样板核心和至少一个合成核心，结构内部不允许存在空洞。装配矩阵的搭建方式正确且有供能时，装配矩阵框架上的线会变为蓝色。

装配矩阵核心

装配矩阵核心共有3种变种。

- 装配矩阵样板核心

装配矩阵只会从其样板核心处取用样板，每个样板核心都有36个样板槽位供使用。

- 装配矩阵合成核心

装配矩阵会将收到的合成请求分配到其合成核心，每个合成核心都可同时进行8个合成作业。

- 装配矩阵速度核心

速度核心是装配矩阵的加速卡。5个速度核心可让装配矩阵全速运转。装入超出5个速度核心并不会提供更多速度加成。

界面

右击已构成且在线的装配矩阵可打开其界面。

界面中可放入和搜索样板，也可查看正在运行的合成作业的数量。
entries.bodyEn:
Assembler Matrix

Assembler Matrix is a multiblock structure. It is a combination of Molecular Assembler and ME Pattern Provider. It can run many crafting jobs at the same time (with enough Crafting Co-Processing Units in your ME network) and save channels for you.

Structure

It is a rectangular prism, with edge lengths between 3 and 7.

- Edges are composed of Assembler Matrix Frame.

- Faces are composed of Assembler Matrix Wall/Glass.

- The interior is composed of Assembler Matrix Pattern/Craft/Speed Core.

A valid Assembler Matrix must contain at least one Pattern Core and one Craft Core. It must be completely filled and can't be hollow. When Assembler Matrix is correctly formed and powered, the lines on Assembler Matrix Frame will turn blue.

Assembler Matrix Core

There are 3 different Assembler Matrix Cores.

- Assembler Matrix Pattern Core

Assembler Matrix only takes patterns from its Pattern Core. Each Pattern Core provides 36 pattern slots for Assembler Matrix.

- Assembler Matrix Craft Core

Assembler Matrix assigns received crafting jobs to its Craft Cores. Each Craft Core can run 8 crafting jobs at the same time.

- Assembler Matrix Speed Core

It is the Acceleration Card for Assembler Matrix. 5 speed cores allow the Assembler Matrix to run at full speed. Installing more than 5 speed cores won't give an extra speed boost.

GUI

Right-clicking a formed and online Assembler Matrix opens its GUI.

You can add or search for patterns in it and view how many crafting jobs it is running.

entries.body:
配置修改器

配置修改器是用于批量修改容器配置的工具。

手持右击可打开其GUI。

使用方法

配置修改器能通过修改设置迅速修改多种容器，如接口配置物品栏等；可以将配置的物品改为最大值，也可选择全部清除。

使用配置修改器点击目标设备（方块型和子部件型均可）即能修改其配置。

设置

配置修改器有两个主要设置：修改模式和修改量（X）。

点击按钮可切换模式。

- 加/减/乘/除：将配置值改为其加上X的和/减去X的差/乘以X的积/除以X的商。

- 最大：将配置值设为最大值。

- 最小：将配置值设为最小值。

- 设置：将配置值设为X。

- 清除：清除所有配置。
entries.bodyEn:
Config Modifier

Config Modifier is a tool for bulk modification of configuration inventories.

Right-click it to open its GUI.

Usage

Config Modifier can quickly modify configuration inventories, such as an Interface's, according to its settings; for example, by setting configured item quantities to the maximum value or removing them all.

You can click a target device (block or subpart) in the world with Config Modifier to modify its configuration.

Settings

It has two main settings, the modification mode and modification amount (X).

You can click a button to change the mode.

- Add/Subtract/Multiply/Divide: Add, subtract, multiply, or divide the configured amount by X.

- Maximize: Set the configured amount to the maximum value.

- Minimize: Set the configured amount to the minimum value.

- Set: Set the configured amount to X.

- Clear: Clear all configured items.

entries.body:
恩特罗水晶

*“将末影粉注入福鲁伊克斯水晶后，所得的恩特罗水晶表现出了极强的维度亲和性，还会与时空产生共振。”*

AE2扩展中大部分物品与机器的主要合成材料。需使用恩特罗种子将福鲁伊克斯块转变为恩特罗化的福鲁伊克斯母岩，再破坏恩特罗簇以获得恩特罗水晶。
entries.bodyEn:
The Entro Crystal

*"Entro Crystals show an extremely strong dimensional affinity after Ender Dust is injected into Fluix Crystals and can resonate over space-time."*

It is the main crafting ingredient for most ExtendedAE items and machines. You need to use Entro Seed to turn Fluix Block into Entroized Fluix Budding and harvest Entro Cluster to get Entro Crystals.

通过粉碎恩特罗水晶或破坏恩特罗化的福鲁伊克斯母岩获得。

它可用于合成部分AE2扩展的机器，以及恩特罗融注锭。
entries.bodyEn:
Entro Dust

You can get it by crushing a Entro Crystal or breaking Entroized Fluix Budding.

It is used to craft certain ExtendedAE machines and Entro Infused Ingot.

entries.body:

*“恩特罗水晶的结构较为松散，不适合用来制造机器框架，但可将其与金锭融合以增强其延性。”*

用于合成扩展机器框架和其他几种AE2扩展的机器。
entries.bodyEn:
Entro Ingot

*"Entro Crystal is too friable to use in a machine frame, but we can fuse it with a gold ingot to improve its ductility."*

It is used to craft Extended Machine Frame and a few other ExtendedAE items.

entries.body:
恩特罗种子

这些种子带有强大的恩特罗能量。以恩特罗种子右击福鲁伊克斯块可将其变为恩特罗化的福鲁伊克斯母岩；也可选择借助水晶装配器注入种子，但产出的恩特罗化的福鲁伊克斯母岩比手动操作得来的品级低。
entries.bodyEn:
Entro Seed

These seeds contain strong Entro energy. Right-click Fluix Block with an Entro Seed to turn it into Entroized Fluix Budding. Alternatively, you can use Crystal Assembler to inject the seed, but it produces lower-grade Entroized Fluix Budding than the manual method.

entries.body:
恩特罗碎片

破坏未长成的恩特罗芽会掉落恩特罗碎片。8个恩特罗碎片可合成回恩特罗水晶。
entries.bodyEn:
Entro Shard

You will get an Entro Shard if you break an Entro Bud when it is not fully grown. Eight Entro Shards can be crafted back into Entro Crystal.

ME Extended Import/Export Buses work faster than the normal ME Import Bus and ME Export Bus (the default speed multiplier is 8; it is configurable).

They also have more upgrade slots than the normal ones.

相比ME样板管理终端而言，ME扩展样板管理终端新增了3种额外功能。

更好的样板搜索

可按照输入与输出材料的名称搜索样板。

样板突出显示

有些时候，想找的样板可能还是很难找到，因为样板总是按组显示的。扩展样板管理终端可在界面中突出显示匹配的样板。

世界中样板供应器突出显示

进行大型合成作业时，排查卡住的样板供应器会是桩磨人的差事。扩展样板管理终端能突出显示世界中的样板供应器，以便定位。
entries.bodyEn:

ME Extended Pattern Access Terminal provides three additional features compared with ME Pattern Access Terminal.

Better Pattern Search

You can search for patterns by the names of their input/output ingredients.

Pattern Highlight

Sometimes it is still difficult to find the desired pattern because patterns are always displayed in groups. The Extended Pattern Access Terminal can highlight the matched pattern in the GUI.

Pattern Provider In-World Highlight

It can be difficult to determine which Pattern Provider is stuck during large crafting jobs. Extended Pattern Access Terminal can highlight the Pattern Provider in the world, so you can locate it easily.

entries.body:

ME封装胶带可将世界中的ME设备打包成“封装设备”。

封装

手持胶带潜行右击ME设备，即可将其打包成“封装设备”。该设备的所有设置和其中物品等都会保留。在搬迁ME设施的时候很有用。

注意，ME封装胶带只可封装列表中的设备，此列表可配置。

默认列表

拆封

手持“封装设备”右击放置⸺与放置普通的方块型或线缆子部件设备类似⸺即可拆出包裹中的设备。

ME Packing Tape can pack an in-world ME Device into a Packaged Device item.

Packing

Sneak + right-click an ME Device with the tape to obtain a package item from it. All device settings and inventory will be retained. It can be very useful when you are moving your ME setup.

Note that ME Packing Tape supports only the devices on the list; the device list is configurable.

Default List

Unpacking

Right-click with the package item as if it were the device block or part; the packaged device will be recovered from the package.

entries.body:
样板修改器

样板修改器能批量修改样板。

手持右击可打开其界面。

乘数模式

此模式下，按下对应按钮即可将处理样本的输入与输出统一乘或除以某数、

原本的样板：

乘10之后：

也可按下“清除”按钮，以清空所有样板的配方，将它们变为空白样本。

注意事项

- 除法按钮只在原数量可被整除时有效。比如，“÷2”按钮对需要输入3个圆石的样板无效，因为3除以2为1.5。

- 乘法按钮有数量上限（999999）。单种材料的数量无法超过此值。

替换模式

将样板的某些输入和输出替换成其他物品。

槽位A是将被替换的事物，槽位B则是将要替换为的事物。

比如，下方的配置可将木板替换为煤炭。

点击“替换”按钮即可进行替换。

属性模式

复制模式

entries.bodyEn:
Pattern Modifier

Pattern Modifier is a tool for bulk pattern modifications.

Right-click it to open its GUI.

Multiply Mode

You can multiply or divide a processing pattern's input and output quantities by a factor of x by clicking the corresponding button.

Original Pattern:

After ×10:

It can also clear the contents of all patterns and turn them into blank patterns by clicking the Clear button.

Notes

- The division button only works when the relevant amount is evenly divisible. For example, the ÷2 button will not work when a pattern requires 3 cobblestones as input, because 3 ÷ 2 is 1.5.

- The multiplication button has a cap of 999999. It cannot increase a single ingredient's amount beyond this number.

Replace Mode

Replace a specific input or output ingredient in a pattern with another item.

Slot A is the item to be replaced, and slot B is the replacement item.

For example, the following setting will replace the plank with coal.

Click the Replace button to perform the replacement.

Property Mode

Modify a crafting pattern's Substitutions and Fluid Substitutions modes.

Clone Mode

You can make a copy of any given pattern in this mode.

entries.body:
ME精确输出总线

ME精确输出总线能以规定的数量输出物品与流体。只有在目标容器能存下所有输出产物时，它才会进行输出。

示例

此例中每次操作输出3个圆石。网络中圆石的数量小于3即停止输出。

目标容器若无法容纳所输出的物品，则也会停止输出。此例中的箱子只能再装下2个圆石，输出总线便停止运作。
entries.bodyEn:
ME Precise Export Bus

ME Precise Export Bus exports items or fluids in specified quantities. It only exports if the container can fully accept the entire output.

Example

This exports 3 cobblestones per operation. It stops exporting when the amount of cobblestone in the network is less than 3.

It also stops exporting when the target container cannot hold the entire output. The chest can hold only 2 more cobblestones, so the export bus stops.

entries.body:
ME精确存储总线

ME精确存储总线的性质与ME存储总线相同，但可以按照数量进行过滤，且它只会向容器输出最多给定数量个物品。
entries.bodyEn:
ME Precise Storage Bus

ME Precise Storage Bus is a ME Storage Bus that can be configured with a numerical limit and inserts items only up to that limit.

entries.body:
石英混合物

石英、煤炭、沙子组成的混合物。相比于直接烧炼赛特斯石英粉而言，烧炼此混合物产出的硅更多。
entries.bodyEn:
Quartz Blend

A mixture of quartz, coal, and sand. It can be smelted into more Silicons than can be obtained by directly smelting Certus Quartz Dust.

entries.body:
ME智能破坏面板

ME智能破坏面板是能根据配置栏破坏方块或吸收物品的ME破坏面板。

智能破坏面板不需要专门设置子网。它类似于不从箱子里输入、而是会破坏方块的ME输入总线。
entries.bodyEn:
ME Smart Annihilation Plane

ME Smart Annihilation Plane is a ME Annihilation Plane that can break blocks or absorb items according to its configuration inventory.

You don't need to set up a subnet for it. It works like an ME Import Bus but breaks blocks instead of importing them from a chest.

entries.body:
ME标签输出总线

ME标签输出总线的性质与ME输出总线相同，但可以按照物品和流体标签进行过滤。

过滤规则与ME标签存储总线相同。
entries.bodyEn:
ME Tag Export Bus

ME Tag Export Bus is a ME Export Bus that can be filtered by item or fluid tags.

Its filter rule is the same as that of ME Tag Storage Bus.

entries.body:
ME标签存储总线

ME标签存储总线的性质与ME存储总线相同，但可以按照物品和流体标签进行过滤，还支持一些基础的逻辑运算符。

示例见下：

- 只接受粗矿

c:raw_materials

- 接受所有铸锭和宝石

c:ingots/* | c:gems/*
entries.bodyEn:
ME Tag Storage Bus

ME Tag Storage Bus is a ME Storage Bus that can be filtered by item or fluid tags and supports some basic logical operators.

Here are some examples:

- Accept only raw ore

c:raw_materials/*

- Accept all ingots and gems

c:ingots/* | c:gems/*

entries.body:
ME阈值输出总线

只有在ME网络中某物品的数量高于/低于阈值时，ME阈值输出总线才会运作。

示例

铜的阈值设为128，所以只会在网络中的铜多于128个时输出。

同上，将模式设为“低于阈值时工作”，此时网络中的铜会在少于128个时输出。
entries.bodyEn:
ME Threshold Export Bus

ME Threshold Export Bus operates when the quantity of an item stored in the ME network is above or below the threshold.

Example

The copper threshold is set to 128, so it exports copper when the amount of copper stored in the network exceeds 128.

The threshold is the same as above, but the mode is set to BELOW. It exports copper when the amount of copper stored is below 128.

entries.body:
ME阈值发信器

阈值发信器的机制与RS锁存器类似。网络中某物品的数量低于下限时，其会关闭红石信号；而在高于上限时，则会重新发出红石信号。

例如，某发信器的下限为100，上限为150。

初始时网络为空，发信器不激活。

物品增多到超出150个后，发信器即开始发出红石信号。

而当数量降至低于150时，发信器仍会发出信号。

最后在数量降到100以下后，发信器才会关闭。
entries.bodyEn:
ME Threshold Level Emitter

It works like a reset-set latch. It turns the redstone signal off when the quantity of an item in the network is less than the lower threshold and turns it on when the quantity is greater than the upper threshold.

For example, suppose the lower threshold is set to 100 and the upper threshold is set to 150.

Initially, the network is empty, so the emitter is inactive.

As the quantity of the item increases past 150, the emitter sends a redstone signal.

When the quantity declines below 150, the emitter still sends a signal.

Finally, when the quantity falls below 100, the emitter turns off.

ME虚空元件

能放到驱动器里的便携式聚合器。

虚空元件使用前需在元件工作台处分区。它会销毁所有匹配过滤的事物；或是像物质聚合器那样，将它们聚合为物质球或奇点。

entries.bodyEn:
ME Void Cell

A pocket condenser for use in a drive.

The Void Cell needs to be partitioned on Cell Workbench before use. It deletes everything that matches its filter or condenses matching items into Matter Balls or Singularitys like Matter Condenser.

Right-click it to open the configuration GUI.

entries.body:
ME无线连接器

ME无线连接器能和ME量子链接仓一样连接两个网络，但距离有限，也不可跨维度连接。ME无线连接器仅支持一对一的连接，如需建立多对多连接，应使用ME无线集线器。

连接无线连接器

用ME无线连接工具右击需连接的两个无线连接器，即可进行连接。

潜行点击可清除ME无线连接工具当前的设置。

连接建立后，ME无线连接器的纹理会发生变化。

未连接的ME无线连接器：

已连接的ME无线连接器：

颜色

无线连接器可像线缆一样染色，此后其便只会与同色的线缆和无线连接器相连。

染色需要使用染色器。

正因此，无线连接器可以这样摆放：

能量使用

相连的ME无线连接器距离越远，其能量消耗就越高。这两个数据并不呈线性关系，也即，距离过远时能量消耗会极其大。

可以使用能源卡来节省能量，每张卡降低10%的能量消耗。
entries.bodyEn:
ME Wireless Connector

ME Wireless Connector can link two networks like ME Quantum Link Chamber, but it has limited range and cannot connect across dimensions. ME Wireless Connector supports only one-to-one connections. Use ME Wireless Hub if you want many-to-many connections.

Link the Wireless Connectors

Use the ME Wireless Setup Kit to click the two Wireless Connectors that you want to link.

Sneak + click to clear the ME Wireless Setup Kit's current setting.

ME Wireless Connector changes its texture when a link is successfully established.

Unlinked ME Wireless Connectors

Linked ME Wireless Connectors

Color

Wireless Connectors can be colored like cables and can connect only to cables/connectors of the same color.

You need a Color Applicator to color a connector.

So you can set up your wireless connectors like this:

Power Usage

ME Wireless Connectors consume more energy the farther apart they are. Because the cost-distance curve is not linear, the power cost can become very high when they are too far apart.

You can use Energy Card to save power; each card reduces the energy cost by 10%.

entries.zh: 配置器：模式、管道与机器侧面
entries.body:
操作步骤
1. 给配置器充能并持在手中。潜行并按“切换手持工具模式”，查看工具提示中的当前模式；物品、流体、化学品、能量、清空、旋转与扳手功能不能混用。
2. 在对应资源的配置模式中，右键机器侧面读取其配置；潜行＋右键循环该面可用的输入、输出或禁用状态。
3. 调整管道时对准机器与管道之间的连接段，潜行＋右键切换 Normal / Pull / Push / None。对准中间的管身和对准接口是不同目标。

输入与输出
机器 GUI 的侧面配置先选资源类型，再选侧面；灌注原料与主物品可能是不同通道。设为输出后还要检查该资源自动弹出，或在来源处让管道 Pull。只把机器设成输出不会让普通库存自行抽取。

注意事项
清空模式会把机器物品弹出，不等于清空所有化学品；扳手模式潜行＋右键可拆卸支持的设备，操作前确认模式和指向。多方块没有成型时尝试对框架使用配置器读取诊断。
entries.bodyEn:
Charge and hold the Configurator. Sneak and press the held-item mode key; inspect the selected mode before interacting.

In the matching resource configuration mode, right-click a machine face to inspect it and sneak-right-click to cycle its supported states. On transmitters, target the connection segment and sneak-right-click through Normal, Pull, Push and None. The central pipe body is a different target.

In machine side configuration, select the resource type before the face. Infusion material may use a different channel from the main ingredient. Enable auto-ejection or configure the source connection to Pull. Empty mode ejects items; wrench mode can dismantle supported equipment. Using it on an unformed multiblock may provide a diagnostic.

entries.zh: 滴量器：取出、注入与清空储槽
entries.body:
操作步骤
打开通用机械机器 GUI，把滴量器拿在鼠标光标上，对准流体或化学品储槽操作。左键从储槽取出可容纳的介质，右键把滴量器中的介质送入兼容储槽；操作后悬停滴量器确认内容和数量。

故障排查
不能混装不兼容介质。机器因残留错误介质而卡住时，先移走错误输入并停掉上游，再用滴量器取出；否则抽掉后会立即又被灌入。按住 Shift＋左键储槽可删除储槽内容（GUI 检查的是 Shift，不随潜行改键），执行前确认这批介质确实不要了。

注意事项
滴量器只处理兼容的 GUI 储槽，不能当作世界水桶或任意模组通用管道。携带介质的滴量器会保留内容，不要只凭物品外观判断为空。
entries.bodyEn:
Pick up the Gauge Dropper on the cursor in a Mekanism machine GUI. Left-click a compatible fluid or chemical gauge to draw from it; right-click to insert the dropper's contents. Inspect the tooltip afterward.

Stop the incorrect upstream input before removing a contaminating chemical. Shift-left-clicking a gauge can delete its contents (the GUI checks Shift, independently of the sneak binding); verify the target first. Incompatible media cannot be mixed. The dropper works with compatible GUI gauges rather than as a universal world bucket.

entries.body:
操作步骤
潜行＋右键源机器，把它支持的配置写入配置卡；查看卡片提示确认已经记录。对目标机器右键应用，再打开目标 GUI 核对侧面、红石和弹出等设置。

适用范围
配置卡复制机器支持导出的设置，不复制库存、储槽中的介质、能量或升级，也不会替你把加工配方送入机器。目标必须支持卡中对应的机器配置，不能把任意两类设备视为通用模板。

故障排查
复制后不运行时检查目标机器朝向：相对面配置正确，不代表世界中的管道已经接到了同一个方向。再确认目标供电、输入介质和输出空间。
entries.bodyEn:
Sneak-right-click the source machine to store supported configuration, inspect the card, then right-click a compatible target to apply it. Open the target GUI to verify the result.

The card does not copy inventories, tank contents, energy or upgrades. Only compatible configuration can be transferred. After copying, check machine orientation and actual pipe connections, then power, inputs and output space.

entries.zh: 原子分解机：切速与连锁模式
entries.body:
操作步骤
充能后手持工具，按模式切换键查看当前挖掘模式。不同模式改变挖掘速度与能耗；关闭模式、普通/慢速/快速模式和范围挖掘模式的可用性受当前配置限制。

使用条件
工具需要可用能量。范围模式会作用于预期以外的相连方块，切换后先检查工具提示，不要把它与 FTB 连锁键混为一谈。装备状态、模式和目标方块共同影响能否挖掘。

故障排查
完全不挖时检查是否处于关闭模式、电量是否足够以及方块保护；能挖但速度不符先确认当前模式。当前客户端实际模式键见上表，不沿用旧 Wiki 默认的 M。
entries.bodyEn:
Charge and hold the tool, then use the held-item mode key to inspect and cycle mining modes. Speed, energy cost and available area-mining modes follow the installed configuration.

Check the mode before mining connected blocks. This tool's mode and FTB Ultimine are separate systems. If mining fails, inspect disabled mode, charge and protection; if speed differs, inspect the selected mode. Do not assume an old guide's default M key.

entries.zh: Meka 工具与装甲：模块和模式
entries.body:
准备
模块用模块装配台安装到支持它的工具或护甲中。放入目标装备与对应模块，在 GUI 中执行安装；重复模块能否叠加、最多几层，取决于模块本身。安装模块不等于所有功能都已启用。

配置步骤
装备目标物品，打开模块调节器，选择部件和模块，调整启用状态、采掘范围、速度或具体行为。需要能量或燃料的模块先补足资源，再检查它对应部件的模式键。

故障排查
头、胸、腿、脚分别有自己的模式切换键。切胸部模式不会替你切换所有部件；喷气加速也要满足喷气功能和资源条件。工具无范围效果时检查模块是否实际安装、是否启用、范围参数与服务端限制。
entries.bodyEn:
Install compatible modules using the Modification Station and its GUI. Stack limits and compatibility belong to each module. Installation does not guarantee that a feature is enabled.

Equip the gear, open the module tweaker, choose the item and module, and configure enabled state, range, speed or behavior. Supply required power or fuel. Head, chest, legs and feet have separate mode actions. For missing area mining, check installation, enabled state, range and server settings.

entries.body: 给机器供能，在 GUI 的侧面配置中分别设置物品、流体和化学品输入/输出；化学管、流体管和物品管不能互相代替。工厂把相同加工并行化。
entries.bodyEn: Power the machine and configure item, fluid and chemical sides separately. Their pipes are not interchangeable. Factories run multiple operations in parallel.

entries.body: 把灌注材料放入灌注槽，主原料放入物品槽。灌注材料形成机器内部灌注储量，主原料消耗对应储量完成加工。侧面配置要区分物品与灌注物输入。
entries.bodyEn: Insert infusion material and the main ingredient into their separate slots. Infusion material fills the internal infusion buffer; processing consumes that buffer. Configure the two input categories separately.

entries.body: 接入能量，按 JEI 所示把原料送进输入槽，再从输出侧取走产物。工厂 GUI 可设置自动排序分配原料；产物堵塞时加工会停止。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power and the JEI-listed input, then extract outputs. Factory auto-sort distributes inputs between lanes. A full output blocks processing.

entries.body: 向流体槽输入配方要求的液体，供能后得到两种化学品。两个化学输出分别接管并设置抽取；不需要的副产物可在 GUI 设置排放。
entries.bodyEn: Feed the recipe fluid and power. Route both chemical outputs separately, or set unwanted output to dump in the GUI.

entries.body: 按 JEI 区分固体、流体和化学品输入，配置对应侧面并接入供能。化学品通常用加压管道传输；放射性物料还需符合容器与处理条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the solid, fluid and chemical inputs shown by JEI through their configured sides. Pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Radioactive materials require compatible containment.

entries.body: 同时接入配方要求的物品、液体、化学品与能量；分别安排物品和化学品输出，不让副产物堵住机器。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the recipe item, fluid, chemical and energy together. Extract both item and chemical products so neither output blocks the machine.

entries.body: 在 GUI 选择转换方向，接入能量，再向对应的流体槽或化学槽供给输入。输入、输出模式反转时需同步调整管道与侧面。
entries.bodyEn: Choose the conversion direction in the GUI, power the machine, and feed the matching fluid or chemical input. Reconfigure sides when reversing modes.

entries.body: 按该设施的结构规则搭建外壳、内部部件与端口，闭合结构后打开 GUI 确认成形。端口区分输入输出；反应堆需持续供给燃料和冷却，储能矩阵还需电池与供应器。
entries.bodyEn: Build the required shell, internals and ports, then confirm formation in the GUI. Configure port directions. Reactors need continuous fuel and cooling; induction matrices also need cells and providers.

entries.body: 放置后接入能量，在 GUI 设置半径、高度和过滤器，再启动。设置替换方块与自动输出时同时提供对应物品和输出容器。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power, configure radius, height and filters, then start. Replacement mode needs replacement blocks; auto-eject needs an output inventory.

entries.body: 使用配置器设置传输端的推送、拉取或普通连接。按资源种类选择管道；储罐、箱柜与能量立方通过各自 GUI 设置侧面和安全选项。
entries.bodyEn: Use a configurator to choose push, pull or normal connections. Pick the correct transport type; configure tank, bin and cube sides in their GUIs.

entries.body: 按发电机类型供给燃料或满足环境条件，把输出接到能量线缆。燃气发电机消耗兼容燃料化学品；风力和太阳能设备需要合适的位置。
entries.bodyEn: Provide compatible fuel or the required environmental conditions and connect an energy cable. Gas-burning generators consume fuel chemicals; wind and solar generators need suitable placement.

entries.zh: 侧面配置、自动弹出与资源类型
entries.body:
打开机器侧面配置，先选物品、流体、化学品或能量标签，再给各个面指定输入、输出或禁用。冶金灌注机还要区分主物品与灌注原料输入。

输出面配置好后，再开启对应资源的自动弹出；管道抽取也可在来源连接处设为拉取。只接上一根管道不一定会开始传输。配置器的模式影响操作对象，潜行配合模式切换键切换模式。
entries.bodyEn: Select the resource tab before assigning side modes. Infusion ingredients have a separate item input. Enable auto-eject or configure the extracting connection to pull. Configurator modes target different resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 冶金灌注机 / 灌注工厂
entries.body:
供能后，灌注原料槽先把红石、碳等配方原料转成内部灌注物；主输入槽放需要加工的金属或电路材料。两类输入不能混为同一个槽。

内部已有另一种灌注物时，新配方可能无法接收。需要换类型时先消耗存量，或用界面倾倒功能清空。工厂的并行槽共用灌注储量；分配原料时使用自动排序，并让全部输出槽保持有空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed infusion material and the main item through their separate inputs. The machine stores one infusion type; consume or dump it before switching. Factory lanes share the infusion buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
物品输入槽放 JEI 富集配方原料，接电后从输出槽取得成品。矿物加工与富集红石、碳等灌注原料都在这台机器处理。富集后的灌注材料用于提高灌注储量利用率，不能直接当作原矿处理。

工厂可同时加工多格原料。开启排序可让各加工格均分输入；满输出会阻塞对应加工格。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid input and power. Enrichment handles ore materials and concentrated infusion ingredients. Factory auto-sort distributes inputs; blocked outputs stop their lanes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
向物品输入侧供给原料并接电，从输出侧收取粉末或其他粉碎产物。矿物处理链中，它也可把碎块进一步粉碎。

它没有气体、流体或灌注输入；若 JEI 显示的原料属于其他机器的配方，单独放进粉碎机不会加工。工厂版增加并行格，侧面和红石配置沿用同类机器。
entries.bodyEn: A solid-to-solid machine: provide the crushing ingredient and energy, then extract output. It has no fluid, chemical or infusion input. Factory variants add parallel lanes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 电力熔炼炉 / 熔炼工厂
entries.body:
只需电能与可熔炼物品，不需要煤炭作为燃料。将物品送入输入面，从输出面取成品。能否处理以 JEI 的该机器配方为准。

升级速度时同步检查供电上限；工厂的多格同时运行会增加总耗电。不要把电池槽配置成原料输入面。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power and a smelting ingredient; fuel items are not required. Supply enough energy for parallel factory lanes and keep battery-slot access separate from ingredients.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 锇压缩机 / 压缩工厂
entries.body:
该机同时使用固体原料与锇化学品。锇原料先从对应辅助槽转为内部锇储量，再加工主输入物品。

物流配置需区分主物品、锇补充与成品。工厂各格共用内部化学品储量；缺少锇时，即使主原料和能量充足也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the primary item, osmium through the chemical/fill input, and power. Main ingredients and osmium replenishment use distinct inputs; factory lanes share the chemical buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
主原料与辅助原料分别放入两类物品槽，供能后合并成产物。配方有原料数量要求，不能只放每种一个就期待开工。

工厂各加工格需要对应的主输入，辅助原料按机器规则共用。自动化时给两个输入类别独立过滤，避免辅助材料占满主输入。
entries.bodyEn: Use the main and secondary item inputs, with the required quantities and power. Filter the two item categories separately; factories share the secondary supply as configured.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 精密锯木机 / 锯切工厂
entries.body:
投入木材或其他锯切原料并供能。主产物与概率副产物进入不同输出格，两个输出区都要安排抽取。

产物种类和副产概率看 JEI。只抽取主产物会使副产物积满，最终阻止机器继续运行。
entries.bodyEn: Feed a sawing ingredient and power. Main and secondary outputs occupy different slots; extract both to avoid blocking processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
提供物品、氧气与电能，把符合提纯配方的矿物中间产物加工成碎块。氧气要接化学品输入，不是流体口。

前后处理顺序通过 JEI 查看：提纯所得碎块通常还要经过粉碎与富集，才进入熔炼。工厂版共用氧气储量。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the item ingredient, oxygen chemical and power. Route clumps onward through the remaining processing steps; factory lanes share oxygen.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 化学压射室 / 压射工厂
entries.body:
同时输入固体原料、配方化学品与电能。矿物链常使用氯化氢处理矿石或晶体，但自定义配方也可能要求其他化学品。

检查化学储量与物品数量后再启动；输出的碎片需要交给后续提纯设备，而不是直接当作金属锭使用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid, the recipe chemical and power. Ore recipes commonly use hydrogen chloride. Send shards to the next processing machine instead of treating them as ingots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 化学氧化机 / 氧化工厂
entries.body:
固体原料从物品输入端进入，机器消耗电能并产出化学品。把加压管道接在化学输出面，而不是接物品管。

产出罐满会停止加工。此设备在硫化学和铀燃料处理等链路中承担固体转化学品的步骤；具体类型按 JEI 配方连接。
entries.bodyEn: This machine consumes a solid and power and outputs a chemical. Extract through the chemical output with pressurized tubes; a full output tank stops processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
两种化学品分别进入两个输入罐，供能后合成第三种化学品。每个输入罐只能接受当前配方允许的输入，接管时分别配置输入侧。

硫酸、氯化氢、氘氚燃料等都可能经过此类合成。它与冶金灌注机不同：主输入不是金属物品，也不使用红石灌注原料槽。
entries.bodyEn: Feed two chemical inputs separately and supply power. The result is another chemical. This is distinct from metallurgic infusion and does not use its metal/infusion-material slots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 化学溶解室 / 溶解工厂
entries.body:
把固体原料与配方要求的化学品一起输入，接电后产出矿浆或其他化学品。矿石线通常先得到未清洗矿浆，再送入化学清洗机。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。
entries.bodyEn: Combine the solid and recipe chemical with power. Ore processing produces dirty slurry for a chemical washer. Slurry uses chemical transport; clear incompatible or blocked output before changing recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 化学清洗机 / 清洗工厂
entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 化学结晶器 / 结晶工厂
entries.body:
输入对应的洁净矿浆或其他可结晶化学品并供能，输出固体晶体或颗粒。化学输入与物品输出分开设置。

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。
entries.bodyEn: Convert a recipe chemical into a solid with power. Configure chemical input and item output separately. Ore crystals still need the remaining processing stages.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入配方液体并供电，分别得到两种化学品。把两个输出都安排好；只使用氢气而忽略氧气时，氧罐满会让整台机器停机。

不保留的产物可以设为排放或仅排放过量，但先确认不是后续产线必需物。重水配方可用于取得氘，原料与普通水配方不同。
entries.bodyEn: Supply fluid and power and manage both chemical outputs. An unused full tank stops separation. Use dump settings deliberately; heavy water recipes differ from ordinary water.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 加压反应室 / 反应工厂
entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 同位素离心机 / 离心工厂
entries.body:
输入待离心的化学品并持续供能，从化学输出端抽取产物。裂变燃料链通常在这里处理六氟化铀。

它与普通固体离心机不是同一种设备。先从 JEI 查清输出化学品及下游处理方式，再连接反应堆或储罐。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the chemical feed and power, then extract the separated chemical. This is a chemical-processing machine, commonly used for fissile-fuel preparation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把化学品送入活化器并确保机器符合日照/天空条件，输出侧连接化学管。反应速度受环境影响，不能只看供料量。

它可把气态锂用于氚链，核废料处理也可能使用此设备。放射性物质需要兼容容器，断料或停光时留足储存空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed the chemical and satisfy sunlight/sky requirements. Environment affects throughput. Provide compatible containment and buffer space for radioactive recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
搭好底部和中空塔身，墙面放控制器与阀门，先从界面确认结构成形。通过阀门输入流体、输出产物，并接入热量。

水→盐水与盐水→液态锂通常需要两座独立塔。用电阻加热器向阀门供热可提高工作温度；能量线不能直接替代热连接。输出不流动时，检查抽取模式。
entries.bodyEn: Form the hollow tower with a controller and valves. Route fluid and heat through valves. Brine and lithium normally require separate stages. A resistive heater provides heat rather than direct FE input.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
燃木加热器燃烧燃料，电阻加热器把电转成热。使用热导线或正确接触面把热量送给蒸馏塔阀门、锅炉等设备。

电阻加热器 GUI 可以设置耗能，数值过高会迅速消耗储能。热导线会受传热能力与散热影响；机器有电不等于目标设施已得到足够热量。
entries.bodyEn: Fuelwood heaters burn fuel; resistive heaters turn FE into heat. Connect heat conductors or compatible adjacent heat interfaces. Set the resistive consumption deliberately and account for heat loss.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
结构内布置水区、蒸汽区、超热元件与压力分散器，并安装阀门。先用 GUI 检查结构和容量，再输入水与热量，抽出蒸汽。

钠冷却链需要把过热钠的热量交给锅炉，同时把冷却后的钠回送反应堆。蒸汽出口或回流端堵塞都会降低冷却能力，不能只连接一个输入阀就认为闭环完成。
entries.bodyEn: Form the boiler with the required water/steam regions and heating internals. Supply heat and water and extract steam. Sodium cooling also requires returning cooled sodium to the reactor.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
放在水源上方并供能，输出面接机械管道并开启抽取或弹出。GUI 中确认产物储量确实增长。

需要重水时，为兼容泵安装过滤升级，并从 JEI 确认相关配方。提高速度后还要检查源流体、能量与输出速率是否跟得上。
entries.bodyEn: Place the pump over a valid fluid source and supply power. Extract fluid through a configured output. A filter upgrade enables supported heavy-water collection behavior.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
向机器提供流体和能量，它会把流体放置到世界中。确认朝向、放置起点和可用空间后再启动，产物不是送入容器的流体缓存。

用于填充区域时让流体供应保持稳定；若目标区域不再有合适的可放置位置，设备会停止。
entries.bodyEn: Supply fluid and power to place fluid into the world. Confirm the outlet and target area; it does not simply fill an adjacent fluid inventory.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
在 GUI 设置半径、高度上下限和过滤器，供能后先搜索再启动。物品、模组、标签等过滤器决定哪些方块会被选中，反向模式会改变筛选逻辑。

若启用替换，必须补给指定替换方块，或确认配置允许无替换采掘。配置自动输出和后方库存，保持矿机及目标区域加载。搜索到方块却不挖时，逐项检查能量、替换、过滤器与保护权限。
entries.bodyEn: Configure area and filters, search, then start. Replacement mode needs replacement blocks unless permitted otherwise. Provide output storage and keep the relevant chunks loaded.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
机器背面接来源库存，输出面接物流网络。在 GUI 建立物品、标签或模组过滤规则，并可给不同规则指定颜色。

过滤器的最小/最大数量和单次传输数量会影响是否出货。颜色必须与目标网络接受的颜色相符；允许默认输出时，未命中规则的物品也会被抽出。
entries.bodyEn: Place between the source inventory and logistical network. Configure filters, quantities and colors; destination colors must match. Default routing controls unmatched items.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 物流管、限制管与分流管
entries.body:
普通物流管传送物品，来源端需要配置器拉取或由库存主动输出。颜色限制目标可达性，不能把不同颜色当作彼此隔离的库存。

限制管提高路径代价，使其他可用路线优先；分流管可由红石控制连接。排查断流时检查来源、目标容量、颜色、禁用连接和区块加载，而不仅是管道等级。
entries.bodyEn: Configure extraction at the source. Colors affect routing. Restrictive transporters deprioritize a path; diversion transporters gate connections with redstone. Check capacity and loaded paths.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
给两端选择相同频率和相同访问范围，并分别配置各类资源的输入、输出。物品、流体、化学品、能量等各自使用对应的侧面标签。

它连接的是频率库存，不能给目标机器凭空补充能量。两端区块和工作设备都要保持可用，公有与私有频率也不能只凭名字相同就互通。
entries.bodyEn: Match frequency and access scope at both ends, then configure each resource separately. The frequency is a shared buffer, not a free power source. Keep both endpoints available.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: QIO 驱动、仪表板与自动存取
entries.body:
驱动阵列装入 QIO 驱动器，并在阵列、仪表板、输入器和输出器上选择同一频率。驱动器同时有总物品数量与类型数量限制。

QIO 仅存物品，不存流体、化学品或能量。输出器按过滤器向相邻库存备货，输入器把库存物品收进频率；便携仪表板也需要绑定频率。QIO 本体不靠 FE 维持存储。
entries.bodyEn: Install QIO drives and match the frequency on all devices. QIO stores items only and has count/type limits. Importers collect items; exporters stock adjacent inventories.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
使用传送机方块与传送框架构成有效门，向底部设备供能并设置频率。目的地必须是同频率且可用的传送设施。

便携传送器选择目的频率后消耗储能传送。只有框架而没有有效控制设备、供能或可加载目的地时，界面不会显示可用传送。
entries.bodyEn: Form a teleporter with its frames, power it and set a frequency. Portable teleporters require energy and an available destination at the selected frequency.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 维度稳定器与跨区块生产
entries.body:
供能后在 GUI 勾选需要保持加载的区块，确认被选区域与实际机器位置一致。范围越大通常需要更多能量。

稳定器自己、管道沿途、资源来源和目标设备都应在已加载区域内。只加载传送器的一端，不能保证另一端整条生产线运行。
entries.bodyEn: Power the stabilizer and select chunks in its GUI. Keep the stabilizer, source, route and destination loaded; loading a single endpoint is not sufficient for a whole factory.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 公式装配器与合成公式
entries.body:
先在机器界面设置配方，用合成公式保存或锁定，再提供原料与能量。界面中的库存管理和自动模式控制是否持续合成。

此设备执行工作台类合成，不会替代熔炼、化学加工等机器。锁定输入格后应只送入对应原料，并及时抽取输出，避免配方位置被占错。
entries.bodyEn: Encode or set the crafting formula, supply ingredients and power, and select automatic mode. It performs crafting-grid recipes, not arbitrary machine processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 激光、放大器与反应堆点火
entries.body:
激光器消耗电能并沿朝向发射。放大器可接收并储存光束能量，在 GUI 设置发射阈值与红石控制，再把射束送向目标。

聚变点火时，光束需要打到反应堆激光聚焦矩阵；必须先准备好燃料和已充入燃料的黑体辐射腔。多台激光器可先给放大器蓄能，单纯朝普通外壳照射无效。
entries.bodyEn: Charge laser amplifiers and configure their release threshold. For fusion ignition, aim at the focus matrix after preparing fuel and a charged hohlraum. Ordinary casing is not the ignition target.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 裂变反应堆与冷却闭环
entries.body:
外壳内布置裂变燃料组件，并在每列顶部安装控制棒组件；端口分别承担燃料输入、冷却剂、加热后冷却剂和核废料输出。结构成形后先补足冷却剂，再以低燃烧速率启动。

裂变反应堆主要产热，不应把它当作直接输出 FE 的发电机。水冷蒸汽通常送涡轮；钠冷则通过锅炉交换热量。废料满罐、蒸汽堵塞或回水中断都会影响冷却，停堆后仍要观察温度与损伤。
entries.bodyEn: Form fuel columns with control rods and configure coolant, fuel and waste ports. Start at a low burn rate after filling coolant. Fission produces heat; turbines convert steam to FE. Continue monitoring cooling after shutdown.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
在正方形底面上搭建竖直涡轮，转子居中、叶片成对安装；旋转复合体周围的同层布置压力分散器，上部放电磁线圈、排气口和需要的饱和冷凝器。

输入蒸汽，从能量端输出 FE；装有冷凝器时，把回收水导回供水系统。发电受蒸汽吞吐、线圈、叶片等共同限制。能量缓存满时蒸汽消耗会减少，回水也可能下降，核冷却链必须考虑这种情况。
entries.bodyEn: Build the rotor, blades, disperser plane and upper coils/vents correctly. Feed steam and extract FE. Condensers return water; full energy storage reduces steam consumption and can affect reactor cooling.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 聚变反应堆、氘氚与黑体辐射腔
entries.body:
组装聚变结构并确认控制器界面成形。电动泵过滤重水，电解得到氘；热力蒸馏链和太阳能中子活化器可准备氚。把填有氘氚燃料的黑体辐射腔放入控制器，再用蓄能激光从聚焦矩阵点火。

分别输入氘与氚时要设置并维持喷射速率。直接输入预混合氘氚燃料的消耗行为不同，不要按分离燃料的喷射限制估算供料。点火成功后持续供料；水冷时还需抽出大量蒸汽。
entries.bodyEn: Prepare deuterium, tritium and a fueled hohlraum, then ignite through the laser focus matrix. Separate fuels use the configured injection rate; premixed D-T fuel behaves differently. Keep fuel and any cooling routes continuous.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 核废料、放射性容器与停机
entries.body:
核废料要进入可容纳放射性化学品的桶与化学管路。保留废料监测和处理余量，不能用普通流体桶代替。含放射性内容的设备在被拆除、内容被丢失等情况下可能释放辐射。

废料可按 JEI 进入钋/钚等处理链；核废料桶的可衰变类型并不等于所有放射性物都能消失。停堆后先处理残余废料与冷却，再拆设备；防化服和辐射检测物品用于判断、隔离游戏中的辐射风险。
entries.bodyEn: Use compatible radioactive chemical containment and keep waste processing available. Not every radioactive chemical decays in a waste barrel. Handle residual waste and cooling before dismantling, and use in-game radiation equipment.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
按 SPS 结构规则搭建外壳，安装端口，并在能量输入端口内部相邻位置放超级充电线圈。向化学输入端持续提供钋，再接入足够能量。

SPS 消耗大量能量把钋转为反物质，输出通常还需结晶成颗粒。能量瓶颈可能是端口、线圈或线缆吞吐；没有线圈的端口不能替代完整能量输入结构。
entries.bodyEn: Form the SPS and attach a supercharged coil inside each powered port. Supply polonium and substantial power to make antimatter, then crystallize it as required.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
主物品槽输入待转化材料，化学槽输入反物质，接入足够能量后执行核合成配方。成品从物品输出面抽取。

它不是免费复制器：原料、反物质和电能均按配方消耗。升级速度前先确认反物质生产和能量吞吐足够，否则只会频繁停机。
entries.bodyEn: Feed the solid, antimatter and power. Nucleosynthesis consumes all required recipe resources; ensure antimatter production and energy throughput before increasing speed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 速度、能量、过滤与化学升级
entries.body:
把升级放进机器的升级栏，而不是原料格。速度升级会提高吞吐，也可能显著提高耗能和化学消耗；能量升级用于缓解能耗或改善缓冲。

过滤、化学效率、锚定等升级只在明确支持的设备中生效。阶层安装器对支持的方块使用以升级等级，通常保留库存与配置，但不能对所有机器一概使用。
entries.bodyEn: Install supported upgrades in upgrade slots. Speed increases resource demand; energy upgrades mitigate costs. Specialized upgrades and tier installers work only on compatible devices.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
在改造站放入兼容装备和模块，再安装或移除模块。不同模块有装备位置、数量和启用状态限制；装备还需要充能才能发挥能耗型能力。

查看模块配置界面调整模式和消耗。模块不等于普通机器升级，不能放入工厂升级槽；卸下模块也不会凭空增加装备储能。
entries.bodyEn: Use a modification station to install compatible modules in powered gear. Configure module modes and respect per-item limits; equipment modules are distinct from machine upgrades.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 营养液化器与食物储存
entries.body:
液化器把兼容食物转为营养浆，需要物品输入、供能和流体输出。容器或装备的营养消耗装置使用此类营养资源。

配套食堂/装备必须有实际储量并启用对应功能。不要把营养浆当作气体送进化学管道。
entries.bodyEn: Convert compatible food into nutritional paste with power, then transfer it through fluid interfaces to supported canteens or equipment.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 安全台、私有频率与信任
entries.body:
在安全台配置所属玩家和受信任玩家，再给支持的设备选择公共、私有或受限访问。频率列表也受所有者和安全范围影响。

同名私有频率在不同玩家下并不必然互通。组队时应检查设备安全模式，避免把无法访问误判为管道或供电故障。
entries.bodyEn: Configure ownership and trusted players at the security desk. Private frequencies and restricted devices require compatible access, even when their names match.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 数控冲压、车床、轧机与压制机
entries.body:
数控冲压机需要配套模具和待加工物品；车床、轧机与压制机分别执行本机 JEI 类型中的加工，不能因为名字相近就共用所有配方。

模具/工具槽与材料输入应分开过滤，按配方显示判断模具是否保留。工厂版提供并行格，多个输出和共享辅助槽仍需完整供给；升级等级不会自动替换模具。
entries.bodyEn: Use the exact CNC machine recipe and any required mold/tool. Separate tooling from materials. Factories add parallel lanes but retain their auxiliary-input requirements.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入当前回收配方接受的物品并供能，再收集配方产物。回收不是通用垃圾桶：没有回收配方的物品不会因为放进去就被处理。

先用过滤器限制输入，避免把需要保留的成品送进回收链。输出堵塞和共享辅助资源不足也会使工厂停机。
entries.bodyEn: Recycle only items accepted by an installed recipe. Supply energy, collect results and filter inputs deliberately; unsupported items are not automatically destroyed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把配方指定的种子或植物、培养条件和所需辅助资源送进种植设备，供能后在机器内部取得产物。输入条件按该设备的 JEI 配方逐项核对。

种植站不是对外部农田施加范围加速的方块；不要只在旁边放作物而不给内部配方材料。工厂并行时检查种子、流体与输出是否持续可用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the internal planting recipe, including its required seed and auxiliary resources. This is an internal processing machine rather than an external crop-area accelerator.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
给充能站供电并在界面配置可充能范围、对象和安全选项。目标装备必须支持能量充电，并位于有效工作条件内。

无线充能不会把无储能的普通物品变成电池。多名玩家和多个装备同时充电时，总功率会被分摊。
entries.bodyEn: Power the charging station and configure its supported targets, access and work conditions. Only energy-capable items can charge; concurrent targets share available transfer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
供能后，按环境收集配方检查维度、生物群系或其他条件，并配置化学输出。产物用化学管道和兼容储罐收集。

它并非在任何环境都产生同一种物质。环境满足但不产出时，检查输出罐已有物质、供电与当前配方条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power, satisfy the ambient collection recipe conditions, and extract the chemical result. Dimension or biome conditions may change the available output.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 扩展反应堆与高阶传输
entries.body:
按通用机械扩展自身的结构规则搭建反应堆，控制器用于确认成形与运行状态，端口按该设备要求设置。燃料、启动条件与输出不沿用普通裂变/聚变反应堆的全部规则。

先从 JEI 和本机 GUI 确认接受的燃料与点火设备，再接入产线；不要把高阶激光矩阵当作普通外壳填充块。
entries.bodyEn: Use the expansion reactor own structure, fuel and ignition rules. Configure its ports and verify the controller state rather than assuming ordinary fission/fusion behavior.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 通用线缆、机械管道与加压管道
entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 基础发电机的供料条件
entries.body:
热力发电机可使用燃料/环境热条件；生物能发电机使用兼容生物燃料；燃气发电机使用可燃化学品并有自己的燃烧参数。太阳能要求天空和日照，风力发电受高度等环境条件影响。

按机型接物品或化学品供料，检查输出线与缓冲。产电设备不需要把所有侧面都设为输入；高阶大型版本仍要满足对应供料条件。
entries.bodyEn: Heat, bio and gas generators use their own fuel systems. Solar and wind depend on environmental conditions. Configure energy output and inspect fuel and buffers.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
搭建闭合动态储罐外壳，通过阀门接管。结构成形后从 GUI 检查总容量和当前流体，再设置输入与抽取。

它存储流体，不存物品或化学品。切换液体前先排空；阀门多并不自动提高外部管道吞吐。
entries.bodyEn: Form a closed tank and connect through valves. It stores fluid only. Empty incompatible contents and check the external extraction rate.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
在 GUI 指定可转换的共同标签和目标形式，投入属于该标签的兼容物品。它用于统一同类材料的表现形式。

只有被允许的标签及目标能转换；不能把任意两个拥有某个宽泛标签的物品互换。自动化先设置规则再供料。
entries.bodyEn: Select an allowed shared tag and desired output form, then supply a compatible item. Only configured tag conversions are valid.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
给充能台接电，玩家站到有效位置，让支持充电的装备从台中取能。

检查物品是否兼容、充电是否启用以及台内是否有能量；普通无储能物品不会接受电。
entries.bodyEn: Power the pad and stand on it with chargeable equipment. Check compatibility, charging settings and stored energy.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
对兼容方块使用纸箱将其打包，然后搬走打包方块并在目标处拆箱。箱中方块可能带库存或配置，应先确认提示与保护限制。

不支持打包的方块不会因重复点击而变得可搬运；多方块机器不能按单个普通箱子理解。
entries.bodyEn: Box a supported block, move the boxed block and unpack it at the destination. Respect excluded blocks and multiblock limitations.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向主输入供给待冲压材料，把配方要求的模具放在专用模具/辅助槽，供电后取得冲压件。模具与材料不是同一类输入。

自动化给辅助输入单独过滤，保留本配方所需模具。JEI 的冲压配方类型与压制机处理器组装不同；工厂并行时也要满足共享模具条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the material and required mold through distinct inputs. Filter tooling separately and keep it available. Stamping is a separate recipe type from processor assembly.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
放入数控车削配方接受的材料并供电，从成品槽取出加工件。不能用冲压、轧制配方代替车削配方。

工厂增加并行格；设置侧面输入输出与排序，并确保所有副产物/输出格可排出。是否有可加工材料以本包 JEI 该设备配方为准。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a valid lathing ingredient and power. Factory variants add lanes and need configured I/O and available output space. Other CNC recipe types are not interchangeable.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
材料进入轧制输入槽，供电后按轧机配方加工。使用 JEI 轧制类别核对目标板材等产物，别把冲压模具塞入普通轧制原料格。

批量自动化时持续补料、抽取成品，并检查工厂排序和供电能力。机器存在不代表每一种金属都有已注册的轧制配方。
entries.bodyEn: Use the rolling recipe type and its material input. Keep factory lanes powered and results extracted; a machine does not imply every material has a registered recipe.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 硅岩反应堆：专用燃料与点火
entries.body:
当前版本反应堆占九乘九乘九的结构区域，控制器必须在顶部正中心；使用硅岩反应堆外壳、兼容玻璃、端口与铅涂层激光聚焦矩阵，不能把普通聚变堆的外壳整套替用。成形后查看控制器状态。

把装有所需硅铀燃料的硅岩黑体辐射腔放入启动槽，用激光经专用聚焦矩阵加热点火。持续供给富硅岩与富铀两路燃料，或直接供应接受的硅铀燃料；输入速率影响运行。

水冷模式要供应水并抽走含钋蒸汽，该产物是化学品。端口的方向用配置器设置，能量、燃料、水和含钋蒸汽分别接兼容管路。具体启动温度与容量读取当前配置和 GUI，不套用旧版教程的固定数值。
entries.bodyEn: The installed reactor occupies a 9×9×9 area and requires its controller at the top center. Use dedicated casing, ports and laser matrix. Ignite a filled Naquadah Hohlraum, sustain accepted fuels and configure ports. Water cooling produces polonium-containing steam, a chemical output.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

工厂各加工格需要对应的主输入，辅助原料按机器规则共用。自动化时给两个输入类别独立过滤，避免辅助材料占满主输入。
entries.bodyEn: Use the main and secondary item inputs, with the required quantities and power. Filter the two item categories separately; factories share the secondary supply as configured.

向物品输入侧供给原料并接电，从输出侧收取粉末或其他粉碎产物。矿物处理链中，它也可把碎块进一步粉碎。

它没有气体、流体或灌注输入；若 JEI 显示的原料属于其他机器的配方，单独放进粉碎机不会加工。工厂版增加并行格，侧面和红石配置沿用同类机器。
entries.bodyEn: A solid-to-solid machine: provide the crushing ingredient and energy, then extract output. It has no fluid, chemical or infusion input. Factory variants add parallel lanes.

物品输入槽放 JEI 富集配方原料，接电后从输出槽取得成品。矿物加工与富集红石、碳等灌注原料都在这台机器处理。富集后的灌注材料用于提高灌注储量利用率，不能直接当作原矿处理。

工厂可同时加工多格原料。开启排序可让各加工格均分输入；满输出会阻塞对应加工格。

entries.body:
闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:

entries.body:
供能后，灌注原料槽先把红石、碳等配方原料转成内部灌注物；主输入槽放需要加工的金属或电路材料。两类输入不能混为同一个槽。

内部已有另一种灌注物时，新配方可能无法接收。需要换类型时先消耗存量，或用界面倾倒功能清空。工厂的并行槽共用灌注储量；分配原料时使用自动排序，并让全部输出槽保持有空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed infusion material and the main item through their separate inputs. The machine stores one infusion type; consume or dump it before switching. Factory lanes share the infusion buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
同时输入固体原料、配方化学品与电能。矿物链常使用氯化氢处理矿石或晶体，但自定义配方也可能要求其他化学品。

检查化学储量与物品数量后再启动；输出的碎片需要交给后续提纯设备，而不是直接当作金属锭使用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid, the recipe chemical and power. Ore recipes commonly use hydrogen chloride. Send shards to the next processing machine instead of treating them as ingots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
普通物流管传送物品，来源端需要配置器拉取或由库存主动输出。颜色限制目标可达性，不能把不同颜色当作彼此隔离的库存。

限制管提高路径代价，使其他可用路线优先；分流管可由红石控制连接。排查断流时检查来源、目标容量、颜色、禁用连接和区块加载，而不仅是管道等级。
entries.bodyEn: Configure extraction at the source. Colors affect routing. Restrictive transporters deprioritize a path; diversion transporters gate connections with redstone. Check capacity and loaded paths.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
提供物品、氧气与电能，把符合提纯配方的矿物中间产物加工成碎块。氧气要接化学品输入，不是流体口。

前后处理顺序通过 JEI 查看：提纯所得碎块通常还要经过粉碎与富集，才进入熔炼。工厂版共用氧气储量。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the item ingredient, oxygen chemical and power. Route clumps onward through the remaining processing steps; factory lanes share oxygen.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
投入木材或其他锯切原料并供能。主产物与概率副产物进入不同输出格，两个输出区都要安排抽取。

产物种类和副产概率看 JEI。只抽取主产物会使副产物积满，最终阻止机器继续运行。
entries.bodyEn: Feed a sawing ingredient and power. Main and secondary outputs occupy different slots; extract both to avoid blocking processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
只需电能与可熔炼物品，不需要煤炭作为燃料。将物品送入输入面，从输出面取成品。能否处理以 JEI 的该机器配方为准。

升级速度时同步检查供电上限；工厂的多格同时运行会增加总耗电。不要把电池槽配置成原料输入面。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power and a smelting ingredient; fuel items are not required. Supply enough energy for parallel factory lanes and keep battery-slot access separate from ingredients.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
燃木加热器燃烧燃料，电阻加热器把电转成热。使用热导线或正确接触面把热量送给蒸馏塔阀门、锅炉等设备。

电阻加热器 GUI 可以设置耗能，数值过高会迅速消耗储能。热导线会受传热能力与散热影响；机器有电不等于目标设施已得到足够热量。
entries.bodyEn: Fuelwood heaters burn fuel; resistive heaters turn FE into heat. Connect heat conductors or compatible adjacent heat interfaces. Set the resistive consumption deliberately and account for heat loss.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。

researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
主物品槽输入待转化材料，化学槽输入反物质，接入足够能量后执行核合成配方。成品从物品输出面抽取。

它不是免费复制器：原料、反物质和电能均按配方消耗。升级速度前先确认反物质生产和能量吞吐足够，否则只会频繁停机。
entries.bodyEn: Feed the solid, antimatter and power. Nucleosynthesis consumes all required recipe resources; ensure antimatter production and energy throughput before increasing speed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.

entries.body:
供能后，灌注原料槽先把红石、碳等配方原料转成内部灌注物；主输入槽放需要加工的金属或电路材料。两类输入不能混为同一个槽。

内部已有另一种灌注物时，新配方可能无法接收。需要换类型时先消耗存量，或用界面倾倒功能清空。工厂的并行槽共用灌注储量；分配原料时使用自动排序，并让全部输出槽保持有空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed infusion material and the main item through their separate inputs. The machine stores one infusion type; consume or dump it before switching. Factory lanes share the infusion buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
同时输入固体原料、配方化学品与电能。矿物链常使用氯化氢处理矿石或晶体，但自定义配方也可能要求其他化学品。

检查化学储量与物品数量后再启动；输出的碎片需要交给后续提纯设备，而不是直接当作金属锭使用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid, the recipe chemical and power. Ore recipes commonly use hydrogen chloride. Send shards to the next processing machine instead of treating them as ingots.

entries.body:
普通物流管传送物品，来源端需要配置器拉取或由库存主动输出。颜色限制目标可达性，不能把不同颜色当作彼此隔离的库存。

限制管提高路径代价，使其他可用路线优先；分流管可由红石控制连接。排查断流时检查来源、目标容量、颜色、禁用连接和区块加载，而不仅是管道等级。
entries.bodyEn: Configure extraction at the source. Colors affect routing. Restrictive transporters deprioritize a path; diversion transporters gate connections with redstone. Check capacity and loaded paths.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

提供物品、氧气与电能，把符合提纯配方的矿物中间产物加工成碎块。氧气要接化学品输入，不是流体口。

前后处理顺序通过 JEI 查看：提纯所得碎块通常还要经过粉碎与富集，才进入熔炼。工厂版共用氧气储量。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the item ingredient, oxygen chemical and power. Route clumps onward through the remaining processing steps; factory lanes share oxygen.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
投入木材或其他锯切原料并供能。主产物与概率副产物进入不同输出格，两个输出区都要安排抽取。

产物种类和副产概率看 JEI。只抽取主产物会使副产物积满，最终阻止机器继续运行。
entries.bodyEn: Feed a sawing ingredient and power. Main and secondary outputs occupy different slots; extract both to avoid blocking processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
只需电能与可熔炼物品，不需要煤炭作为燃料。将物品送入输入面，从输出面取成品。能否处理以 JEI 的该机器配方为准。

升级速度时同步检查供电上限；工厂的多格同时运行会增加总耗电。不要把电池槽配置成原料输入面。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power and a smelting ingredient; fuel items are not required. Supply enough energy for parallel factory lanes and keep battery-slot access separate from ingredients.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
燃木加热器燃烧燃料，电阻加热器把电转成热。使用热导线或正确接触面把热量送给蒸馏塔阀门、锅炉等设备。

电阻加热器 GUI 可以设置耗能，数值过高会迅速消耗储能。热导线会受传热能力与散热影响；机器有电不等于目标设施已得到足够热量。
entries.bodyEn: Fuelwood heaters burn fuel; resistive heaters turn FE into heat. Connect heat conductors or compatible adjacent heat interfaces. Set the resistive consumption deliberately and account for heat loss.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
结构内布置水区、蒸汽区、超热元件与压力分散器，并安装阀门。先用 GUI 检查结构和容量，再输入水与热量，抽出蒸汽。

钠冷却链需要把过热钠的热量交给锅炉，同时把冷却后的钠回送反应堆。蒸汽出口或回流端堵塞都会降低冷却能力，不能只连接一个输入阀就认为闭环完成。
entries.bodyEn: Form the boiler with the required water/steam regions and heating internals. Supply heat and water and extract steam. Sodium cooling also requires returning cooled sodium to the reactor.

entries.body:
对兼容方块使用纸箱将其打包，然后搬走打包方块并在目标处拆箱。箱中方块可能带库存或配置，应先确认提示与保护限制。

不支持打包的方块不会因重复点击而变得可搬运；多方块机器不能按单个普通箱子理解。
entries.bodyEn: Box a supported block, move the boxed block and unpack it at the destination. Respect excluded blocks and multiblock limitations.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
给充能台接电，玩家站到有效位置，让支持充电的装备从台中取能。

检查物品是否兼容、充电是否启用以及台内是否有能量；普通无储能物品不会接受电。
entries.bodyEn: Power the pad and stand on it with chargeable equipment. Check compatibility, charging settings and stored energy.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
输入对应的洁净矿浆或其他可结晶化学品并供能，输出固体晶体或颗粒。化学输入与物品输出分开设置。

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。
entries.bodyEn: Convert a recipe chemical into a solid with power. Configure chemical input and item output separately. Ore crystals still need the remaining processing stages.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把固体原料与配方要求的化学品一起输入，接电后产出矿浆或其他化学品。矿石线通常先得到未清洗矿浆，再送入化学清洗机。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。
entries.bodyEn: Combine the solid and recipe chemical with power. Ore processing produces dirty slurry for a chemical washer. Slurry uses chemical transport; clear incompatible or blocked output before changing recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
两种化学品分别进入两个输入罐，供能后合成第三种化学品。每个输入罐只能接受当前配方允许的输入，接管时分别配置输入侧。

硫酸、氯化氢、氘氚燃料等都可能经过此类合成。它与冶金灌注机不同：主输入不是金属物品，也不使用红石灌注原料槽。
entries.bodyEn: Feed two chemical inputs separately and supply power. The result is another chemical. This is distinct from metallurgic infusion and does not use its metal/infusion-material slots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
固体原料从物品输入端进入，机器消耗电能并产出化学品。把加压管道接在化学输出面，而不是接物品管。

产出罐满会停止加工。此设备在硫化学和铀燃料处理等链路中承担固体转化学品的步骤；具体类型按 JEI 配方连接。
entries.bodyEn: This machine consumes a solid and power and outputs a chemical. Extract through the chemical output with pressurized tubes; a full output tank stops processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
主原料与辅助原料分别放入两类物品槽，供能后合并成产物。配方有原料数量要求，不能只放每种一个就期待开工。

工厂各加工格需要对应的主输入，辅助原料按机器规则共用。自动化时给两个输入类别独立过滤，避免辅助材料占满主输入。
entries.bodyEn: Use the main and secondary item inputs, with the required quantities and power. Filter the two item categories separately; factories share the secondary supply as configured.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.

在 GUI 设置半径、高度上下限和过滤器，供能后先搜索再启动。物品、模组、标签等过滤器决定哪些方块会被选中，反向模式会改变筛选逻辑。

若启用替换，必须补给指定替换方块，或确认配置允许无替换采掘。配置自动输出和后方库存，保持矿机及目标区域加载。搜索到方块却不挖时，逐项检查能量、替换、过滤器与保护权限。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
主原料与辅助原料分别放入两类物品槽，供能后合并成产物。配方有原料数量要求，不能只放每种一个就期待开工。

工厂各加工格需要对应的主输入，辅助原料按机器规则共用。自动化时给两个输入类别独立过滤，避免辅助材料占满主输入。
entries.bodyEn: Use the main and secondary item inputs, with the required quantities and power. Filter the two item categories separately; factories share the secondary supply as configured.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向物品输入侧供给原料并接电，从输出侧收取粉末或其他粉碎产物。矿物处理链中，它也可把碎块进一步粉碎。

它没有气体、流体或灌注输入；若 JEI 显示的原料属于其他机器的配方，单独放进粉碎机不会加工。工厂版增加并行格，侧面和红石配置沿用同类机器。
entries.bodyEn: A solid-to-solid machine: provide the crushing ingredient and energy, then extract output. It has no fluid, chemical or infusion input. Factory variants add parallel lanes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
物品输入槽放 JEI 富集配方原料，接电后从输出槽取得成品。矿物加工与富集红石、碳等灌注原料都在这台机器处理。富集后的灌注材料用于提高灌注储量利用率，不能直接当作原矿处理。

工厂可同时加工多格原料。开启排序可让各加工格均分输入；满输出会阻塞对应加工格。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid input and power. Enrichment handles ore materials and concentrated infusion ingredients. Factory auto-sort distributes inputs; blocked outputs stop their lanes.

entries.body:
闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
供能后，灌注原料槽先把红石、碳等配方原料转成内部灌注物；主输入槽放需要加工的金属或电路材料。两类输入不能混为同一个槽。

内部已有另一种灌注物时，新配方可能无法接收。需要换类型时先消耗存量，或用界面倾倒功能清空。工厂的并行槽共用灌注储量；分配原料时使用自动排序，并让全部输出槽保持有空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed infusion material and the main item through their separate inputs. The machine stores one infusion type; consume or dump it before switching. Factory lanes share the infusion buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
同时输入固体原料、配方化学品与电能。矿物链常使用氯化氢处理矿石或晶体，但自定义配方也可能要求其他化学品。

检查化学储量与物品数量后再启动；输出的碎片需要交给后续提纯设备，而不是直接当作金属锭使用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid, the recipe chemical and power. Ore recipes commonly use hydrogen chloride. Send shards to the next processing machine instead of treating them as ingots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
普通物流管传送物品，来源端需要配置器拉取或由库存主动输出。颜色限制目标可达性，不能把不同颜色当作彼此隔离的库存。

限制管提高路径代价，使其他可用路线优先；分流管可由红石控制连接。排查断流时检查来源、目标容量、颜色、禁用连接和区块加载，而不仅是管道等级。
entries.bodyEn: Configure extraction at the source. Colors affect routing. Restrictive transporters deprioritize a path; diversion transporters gate connections with redstone. Check capacity and loaded paths.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
提供物品、氧气与电能，把符合提纯配方的矿物中间产物加工成碎块。氧气要接化学品输入，不是流体口。

前后处理顺序通过 JEI 查看：提纯所得碎块通常还要经过粉碎与富集，才进入熔炼。工厂版共用氧气储量。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the item ingredient, oxygen chemical and power. Route clumps onward through the remaining processing steps; factory lanes share oxygen.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
投入木材或其他锯切原料并供能。主产物与概率副产物进入不同输出格，两个输出区都要安排抽取。

产物种类和副产概率看 JEI。只抽取主产物会使副产物积满，最终阻止机器继续运行。
entries.bodyEn: Feed a sawing ingredient and power. Main and secondary outputs occupy different slots; extract both to avoid blocking processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
只需电能与可熔炼物品，不需要煤炭作为燃料。将物品送入输入面，从输出面取成品。能否处理以 JEI 的该机器配方为准。

升级速度时同步检查供电上限；工厂的多格同时运行会增加总耗电。不要把电池槽配置成原料输入面。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power and a smelting ingredient; fuel items are not required. Supply enough energy for parallel factory lanes and keep battery-slot access separate from ingredients.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
燃木加热器燃烧燃料，电阻加热器把电转成热。使用热导线或正确接触面把热量送给蒸馏塔阀门、锅炉等设备。

电阻加热器 GUI 可以设置耗能，数值过高会迅速消耗储能。热导线会受传热能力与散热影响；机器有电不等于目标设施已得到足够热量。
entries.bodyEn: Fuelwood heaters burn fuel; resistive heaters turn FE into heat. Connect heat conductors or compatible adjacent heat interfaces. Set the resistive consumption deliberately and account for heat loss.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
向机器提供流体和能量，它会把流体放置到世界中。确认朝向、放置起点和可用空间后再启动，产物不是送入容器的流体缓存。

用于填充区域时让流体供应保持稳定；若目标区域不再有合适的可放置位置，设备会停止。
entries.bodyEn: Supply fluid and power to place fluid into the world. Confirm the outlet and target area; it does not simply fill an adjacent fluid inventory.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先在机器界面设置配方，用合成公式保存或锁定，再提供原料与能量。界面中的库存管理和自动模式控制是否持续合成。

此设备执行工作台类合成，不会替代熔炼、化学加工等机器。锁定输入格后应只送入对应原料，并及时抽取输出，避免配方位置被占错。
entries.bodyEn: Encode or set the crafting formula, supply ingredients and power, and select automatic mode. It performs crafting-grid recipes, not arbitrary machine processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.bodyEn: Power the machine and configure item, fluid and chemical sides separately. Their pipes are not interchangeable. Factories run multiple operations in parallel.

entries.body:
输入待离心的化学品并持续供能，从化学输出端抽取产物。裂变燃料链通常在这里处理六氟化铀。

它与普通固体离心机不是同一种设备。先从 JEI 查清输出化学品及下游处理方式，再连接反应堆或储罐。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the chemical feed and power, then extract the separated chemical. This is a chemical-processing machine, commonly used for fissile-fuel preparation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
激光器消耗电能并沿朝向发射。放大器可接收并储存光束能量，在 GUI 设置发射阈值与红石控制，再把射束送向目标。

聚变点火时，光束需要打到反应堆激光聚焦矩阵；必须先准备好燃料和已充入燃料的黑体辐射腔。多台激光器可先给放大器蓄能，单纯朝普通外壳照射无效。
entries.bodyEn: Charge laser amplifiers and configure their release threshold. For fusion ignition, aim at the focus matrix after preparing fuel and a charged hohlraum. Ordinary casing is not the ignition target.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
激光器消耗电能并沿朝向发射。放大器可接收并储存光束能量，在 GUI 设置发射阈值与红石控制，再把射束送向目标。

聚变点火时，光束需要打到反应堆激光聚焦矩阵；必须先准备好燃料和已充入燃料的黑体辐射腔。多台激光器可先给放大器蓄能，单纯朝普通外壳照射无效。

researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
机器背面接来源库存，输出面接物流网络。在 GUI 建立物品、标签或模组过滤规则，并可给不同规则指定颜色。

过滤器的最小/最大数量和单次传输数量会影响是否出货。颜色必须与目标网络接受的颜色相符；允许默认输出时，未命中规则的物品也会被抽出。
entries.bodyEn: Place between the source inventory and logistical network. Configure filters, quantities and colors; destination colors must match. Default routing controls unmatched items.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
供能后，灌注原料槽先把红石、碳等配方原料转成内部灌注物；主输入槽放需要加工的金属或电路材料。两类输入不能混为同一个槽。

内部已有另一种灌注物时，新配方可能无法接收。需要换类型时先消耗存量，或用界面倾倒功能清空。工厂的并行槽共用灌注储量；分配原料时使用自动排序，并让全部输出槽保持有空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed infusion material and the main item through their separate inputs. The machine stores one infusion type; consume or dump it before switching. Factory lanes share the infusion buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
在改造站放入兼容装备和模块，再安装或移除模块。不同模块有装备位置、数量和启用状态限制；装备还需要充能才能发挥能耗型能力。

查看模块配置界面调整模式和消耗。模块不等于普通机器升级，不能放入工厂升级槽；卸下模块也不会凭空增加装备储能。
entries.bodyEn: Use a modification station to install compatible modules in powered gear. Configure module modes and respect per-item limits; equipment modules are distinct from machine upgrades.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
液化器把兼容食物转为营养浆，需要物品输入、供能和流体输出。容器或装备的营养消耗装置使用此类营养资源。

配套食堂/装备必须有实际储量并启用对应功能。不要把营养浆当作气体送进化学管道。
entries.bodyEn: Convert compatible food into nutritional paste with power, then transfer it through fluid interfaces to supported canteens or equipment.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
在 GUI 指定可转换的共同标签和目标形式，投入属于该标签的兼容物品。它用于统一同类材料的表现形式。

只有被允许的标签及目标能转换；不能把任意两个拥有某个宽泛标签的物品互换。自动化先设置规则再供料。
entries.bodyEn: Select an allowed shared tag and desired output form, then supply a compatible item. Only configured tag conversions are valid.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
该机同时使用固体原料与锇化学品。锇原料先从对应辅助槽转为内部锇储量，再加工主输入物品。

物流配置需区分主物品、锇补充与成品。工厂各格共用内部化学品储量；缺少锇时，即使主原料和能量充足也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the primary item, osmium through the chemical/fill input, and power. Main ingredients and osmium replenishment use distinct inputs; factory lanes share the chemical buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.

颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

投入木材或其他锯切原料并供能。主产物与概率副产物进入不同输出格，两个输出区都要安排抽取。

产物种类和副产概率看 JEI。只抽取主产物会使副产物积满，最终阻止机器继续运行。
entries.bodyEn: Feed a sawing ingredient and power. Main and secondary outputs occupy different slots; extract both to avoid blocking processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
在正方形底面上搭建竖直涡轮，转子居中、叶片成对安装；旋转复合体周围的同层布置压力分散器，上部放电磁线圈、排气口和需要的饱和冷凝器。

输入蒸汽，从能量端输出 FE；装有冷凝器时，把回收水导回供水系统。发电受蒸汽吞吐、线圈、叶片等共同限制。能量缓存满时蒸汽消耗会减少，回水也可能下降，核冷却链必须考虑这种情况。
entries.bodyEn: Build the rotor, blades, disperser plane and upper coils/vents correctly. Feed steam and extract FE. Condensers return water; full energy storage reduces steam consumption and can affect reactor cooling.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
提供物品、氧气与电能，把符合提纯配方的矿物中间产物加工成碎块。氧气要接化学品输入，不是流体口。

前后处理顺序通过 JEI 查看：提纯所得碎块通常还要经过粉碎与富集，才进入熔炼。工厂版共用氧气储量。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the item ingredient, oxygen chemical and power. Route clumps onward through the remaining processing steps; factory lanes share oxygen.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
驱动阵列装入 QIO 驱动器，并在阵列、仪表板、输入器和输出器上选择同一频率。驱动器同时有总物品数量与类型数量限制。

QIO 仅存物品，不存流体、化学品或能量。输出器按过滤器向相邻库存备货，输入器把库存物品收进频率；便携仪表板也需要绑定频率。QIO 本体不靠 FE 维持存储。
entries.bodyEn: Install QIO drives and match the frequency on all devices. QIO stores items only and has count/type limits. Importers collect items; exporters stock adjacent inventories.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
给两端选择相同频率和相同访问范围，并分别配置各类资源的输入、输出。物品、流体、化学品、能量等各自使用对应的侧面标签。

它连接的是频率库存，不能给目标机器凭空补充能量。两端区块和工作设备都要保持可用，公有与私有频率也不能只凭名字相同就互通。
entries.bodyEn: Match frequency and access scope at both ends, then configure each resource separately. The frequency is a shared buffer, not a free power source. Keep both endpoints available.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
核废料要进入可容纳放射性化学品的桶与化学管路。保留废料监测和处理余量，不能用普通流体桶代替。含放射性内容的设备在被拆除、内容被丢失等情况下可能释放辐射。

废料可按 JEI 进入钋/钚等处理链；核废料桶的可衰变类型并不等于所有放射性物都能消失。停堆后先处理残余废料与冷却，再拆设备；防化服和辐射检测物品用于判断、隔离游戏中的辐射风险。
entries.bodyEn: Use compatible radioactive chemical containment and keep waste processing available. Not every radioactive chemical decays in a waste barrel. Handle residual waste and cooling before dismantling, and use in-game radiation equipment.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
燃木加热器燃烧燃料，电阻加热器把电转成热。使用热导线或正确接触面把热量送给蒸馏塔阀门、锅炉等设备。

电阻加热器 GUI 可以设置耗能，数值过高会迅速消耗储能。热导线会受传热能力与散热影响；机器有电不等于目标设施已得到足够热量。
entries.bodyEn: Fuelwood heaters burn fuel; resistive heaters turn FE into heat. Connect heat conductors or compatible adjacent heat interfaces. Set the resistive consumption deliberately and account for heat loss.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
普通物流管传送物品，来源端需要配置器拉取或由库存主动输出。颜色限制目标可达性，不能把不同颜色当作彼此隔离的库存。

限制管提高路径代价，使其他可用路线优先；分流管可由红石控制连接。排查断流时检查来源、目标容量、颜色、禁用连接和区块加载，而不仅是管道等级。
entries.bodyEn: Configure extraction at the source. Colors affect routing. Restrictive transporters deprioritize a path; diversion transporters gate connections with redstone. Check capacity and loaded paths.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
在安全台配置所属玩家和受信任玩家，再给支持的设备选择公共、私有或受限访问。频率列表也受所有者和安全范围影响。

同名私有频率在不同玩家下并不必然互通。组队时应检查设备安全模式，避免把无法访问误判为管道或供电故障。
entries.bodyEn: Configure ownership and trusted players at the security desk. Private frequencies and restricted devices require compatible access, even when their names match.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把化学品送入活化器并确保机器符合日照/天空条件，输出侧连接化学管。反应速度受环境影响，不能只看供料量。

它可把气态锂用于氚链，核废料处理也可能使用此设备。放射性物质需要兼容容器，断料或停光时留足储存空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed the chemical and satisfy sunlight/sky requirements. Environment affects throughput. Provide compatible containment and buffer space for radioactive recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
按 SPS 结构规则搭建外壳，安装端口，并在能量输入端口内部相邻位置放超级充电线圈。向化学输入端持续提供钋，再接入足够能量。

SPS 消耗大量能量把钋转为反物质，输出通常还需结晶成颗粒。能量瓶颈可能是端口、线圈或线缆吞吐；没有线圈的端口不能替代完整能量输入结构。

结构内布置水区、蒸汽区、超热元件与压力分散器，并安装阀门。先用 GUI 检查结构和容量，再输入水与热量，抽出蒸汽。

钠冷却链需要把过热钠的热量交给锅炉，同时把冷却后的钠回送反应堆。蒸汽出口或回流端堵塞都会降低冷却能力，不能只连接一个输入阀就认为闭环完成。
entries.bodyEn: Form the boiler with the required water/steam regions and heating internals. Supply heat and water and extract steam. Sodium cooling also requires returning cooled sodium to the reactor.
