使用传送机方块与传送框架构成有效门，向底部设备供能并设置频率。目的地必须是同频率且可用的传送设施。

便携传送器选择目的频率后消耗储能传送。只有框架而没有有效控制设备、供能或可加载目的地时，界面不会显示可用传送。

搭好底部和中空塔身，墙面放控制器与阀门，先从界面确认结构成形。通过阀门输入流体、输出产物，并接入热量。

水→盐水与盐水→液态锂通常需要两座独立塔。用电阻加热器向阀门供热可提高工作温度；能量线不能直接替代热连接。输出不流动时，检查抽取模式。

先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

entries.body:
主原料与辅助原料分别放入两类物品槽，供能后合并成产物。配方有原料数量要求，不能只放每种一个就期待开工。

工厂各加工格需要对应的主输入，辅助原料按机器规则共用。自动化时给两个输入类别独立过滤，避免辅助材料占满主输入。
entries.bodyEn: Use the main and secondary item inputs, with the required quantities and power. Filter the two item categories separately; factories share the secondary supply as configured.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向物品输入侧供给原料并接电，从输出侧收取粉末或其他粉碎产物。矿物处理链中，它也可把碎块进一步粉碎。

它没有气体、流体或灌注输入；若 JEI 显示的原料属于其他机器的配方，单独放进粉碎机不会加工。工厂版增加并行格，侧面和红石配置沿用同类机器。
entries.bodyEn: A solid-to-solid machine: provide the crushing ingredient and energy, then extract output. It has no fluid, chemical or infusion input. Factory variants add parallel lanes.

entries.body:

entries.body:
物品输入槽放 JEI 富集配方原料，接电后从输出槽取得成品。矿物加工与富集红石、碳等灌注原料都在这台机器处理。富集后的灌注材料用于提高灌注储量利用率，不能直接当作原矿处理。

工厂可同时加工多格原料。开启排序可让各加工格均分输入；满输出会阻塞对应加工格。

闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.

entries.body:
供能后，灌注原料槽先把红石、碳等配方原料转成内部灌注物；主输入槽放需要加工的金属或电路材料。两类输入不能混为同一个槽。

内部已有另一种灌注物时，新配方可能无法接收。需要换类型时先消耗存量，或用界面倾倒功能清空。工厂的并行槽共用灌注储量；分配原料时使用自动排序，并让全部输出槽保持有空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed infusion material and the main item through their separate inputs. The machine stores one infusion type; consume or dump it before switching. Factory lanes share the infusion buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
同时输入固体原料、配方化学品与电能。矿物链常使用氯化氢处理矿石或晶体，但自定义配方也可能要求其他化学品。

检查化学储量与物品数量后再启动；输出的碎片需要交给后续提纯设备，而不是直接当作金属锭使用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid, the recipe chemical and power. Ore recipes commonly use hydrogen chloride. Send shards to the next processing machine instead of treating them as ingots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
普通物流管传送物品，来源端需要配置器拉取或由库存主动输出。颜色限制目标可达性，不能把不同颜色当作彼此隔离的库存。

限制管提高路径代价，使其他可用路线优先；分流管可由红石控制连接。排查断流时检查来源、目标容量、颜色、禁用连接和区块加载，而不仅是管道等级。
entries.bodyEn: Configure extraction at the source. Colors affect routing. Restrictive transporters deprioritize a path; diversion transporters gate connections with redstone. Check capacity and loaded paths.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

提供物品、氧气与电能，把符合提纯配方的矿物中间产物加工成碎块。氧气要接化学品输入，不是流体口。

前后处理顺序通过 JEI 查看：提纯所得碎块通常还要经过粉碎与富集，才进入熔炼。工厂版共用氧气储量。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the item ingredient, oxygen chemical and power. Route clumps onward through the remaining processing steps; factory lanes share oxygen.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
投入木材或其他锯切原料并供能。主产物与概率副产物进入不同输出格，两个输出区都要安排抽取。

产物种类和副产概率看 JEI。只抽取主产物会使副产物积满，最终阻止机器继续运行。
entries.bodyEn: Feed a sawing ingredient and power. Main and secondary outputs occupy different slots; extract both to avoid blocking processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
只需电能与可熔炼物品，不需要煤炭作为燃料。将物品送入输入面，从输出面取成品。能否处理以 JEI 的该机器配方为准。

升级速度时同步检查供电上限；工厂的多格同时运行会增加总耗电。不要把电池槽配置成原料输入面。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power and a smelting ingredient; fuel items are not required. Supply enough energy for parallel factory lanes and keep battery-slot access separate from ingredients.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
燃木加热器燃烧燃料，电阻加热器把电转成热。使用热导线或正确接触面把热量送给蒸馏塔阀门、锅炉等设备。

电阻加热器 GUI 可以设置耗能，数值过高会迅速消耗储能。热导线会受传热能力与散热影响；机器有电不等于目标设施已得到足够热量。
entries.bodyEn: Fuelwood heaters burn fuel; resistive heaters turn FE into heat. Connect heat conductors or compatible adjacent heat interfaces. Set the resistive consumption deliberately and account for heat loss.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

按机型接物品或化学品供料，检查输出线与缓冲。产电设备不需要把所有侧面都设为输入；高阶大型版本仍要满足对应供料条件。

entries.body: 给机器供能，在 GUI 的侧面配置中分别设置物品、流体和化学品输入/输出；化学管、流体管和物品管不能互相代替。工厂把相同加工并行化。
entries.bodyEn: Power the machine and configure item, fluid and chemical sides separately. Their pipes are not interchangeable. Factories run multiple operations in parallel.

entries.body:
在正方形底面上搭建竖直涡轮，转子居中、叶片成对安装；旋转复合体周围的同层布置压力分散器，上部放电磁线圈、排气口和需要的饱和冷凝器。

输入蒸汽，从能量端输出 FE；装有冷凝器时，把回收水导回供水系统。发电受蒸汽吞吐、线圈、叶片等共同限制。能量缓存满时蒸汽消耗会减少，回水也可能下降，核冷却链必须考虑这种情况。
entries.bodyEn: Build the rotor, blades, disperser plane and upper coils/vents correctly. Feed steam and extract FE. Condensers return water; full energy storage reduces steam consumption and can affect reactor cooling.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
外壳内布置裂变燃料组件，并在每列顶部安装控制棒组件；端口分别承担燃料输入、冷却剂、加热后冷却剂和核废料输出。结构成形后先补足冷却剂，再以低燃烧速率启动。

裂变反应堆主要产热，不应把它当作直接输出 FE 的发电机。水冷蒸汽通常送涡轮；钠冷则通过锅炉交换热量。废料满罐、蒸汽堵塞或回水中断都会影响冷却，停堆后仍要观察温度与损伤。
entries.bodyEn: Form fuel columns with control rods and configure coolant, fuel and waste ports. Start at a low burn rate after filling coolant. Fission produces heat; turbines convert steam to FE. Continue monitoring cooling after shutdown.

entries.body:
组装聚变结构并确认控制器界面成形。电动泵过滤重水，电解得到氘；热力蒸馏链和太阳能中子活化器可准备氚。把填有氘氚燃料的黑体辐射腔放入控制器，再用蓄能激光从聚焦矩阵点火。

分别输入氘与氚时要设置并维持喷射速率。直接输入预混合氘氚燃料的消耗行为不同，不要按分离燃料的喷射限制估算供料。点火成功后持续供料；水冷时还需抽出大量蒸汽。
entries.bodyEn: Prepare deuterium, tritium and a fueled hohlraum, then ignite through the laser focus matrix. Separate fuels use the configured injection rate; premixed D-T fuel behaves differently. Keep fuel and any cooling routes continuous.

输入蒸汽，从能量端输出 FE；装有冷凝器时，把回收水导回供水系统。发电受蒸汽吞吐、线圈、叶片等共同限制。能量缓存满时蒸汽消耗会减少，回水也可能下降，核冷却链必须考虑这种情况。
entries.bodyEn: Build the rotor, blades, disperser plane and upper coils/vents correctly. Feed steam and extract FE. Condensers return water; full energy storage reduces steam consumption and can affect reactor cooling.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
热力发电机可使用燃料/环境热条件；生物能发电机使用兼容生物燃料；燃气发电机使用可燃化学品并有自己的燃烧参数。太阳能要求天空和日照，风力发电受高度等环境条件影响。

按机型接物品或化学品供料，检查输出线与缓冲。产电设备不需要把所有侧面都设为输入；高阶大型版本仍要满足对应供料条件。
entries.bodyEn: Heat, bio and gas generators use their own fuel systems. Solar and wind depend on environmental conditions. Configure energy output and inspect fuel and buffers.

entries.body: 给机器供能，在 GUI 的侧面配置中分别设置物品、流体和化学品输入/输出；化学管、流体管和物品管不能互相代替。工厂把相同加工并行化。
entries.bodyEn: Power the machine and configure item, fluid and chemical sides separately. Their pipes are not interchangeable. Factories run multiple operations in parallel.

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入待离心的化学品并持续供能，从化学输出端抽取产物。裂变燃料链通常在这里处理六氟化铀。

它与普通固体离心机不是同一种设备。先从 JEI 查清输出化学品及下游处理方式，再连接反应堆或储罐。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the chemical feed and power, then extract the separated chemical. This is a chemical-processing machine, commonly used for fissile-fuel preparation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
主原料与辅助原料分别放入两类物品槽，供能后合并成产物。配方有原料数量要求，不能只放每种一个就期待开工。

工厂各加工格需要对应的主输入，辅助原料按机器规则共用。自动化时给两个输入类别独立过滤，避免辅助材料占满主输入。
entries.bodyEn: Use the main and secondary item inputs, with the required quantities and power. Filter the two item categories separately; factories share the secondary supply as configured.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向物品输入侧供给原料并接电，从输出侧收取粉末或其他粉碎产物。矿物处理链中，它也可把碎块进一步粉碎。

它没有气体、流体或灌注输入；若 JEI 显示的原料属于其他机器的配方，单独放进粉碎机不会加工。工厂版增加并行格，侧面和红石配置沿用同类机器。
entries.bodyEn: A solid-to-solid machine: provide the crushing ingredient and energy, then extract output. It has no fluid, chemical or infusion input. Factory variants add parallel lanes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入对应的洁净矿浆或其他可结晶化学品并供能，输出固体晶体或颗粒。化学输入与物品输出分开设置。

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。
entries.bodyEn: Convert a recipe chemical into a solid with power. Configure chemical input and item output separately. Ore crystals still need the remaining processing stages.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把固体原料与配方要求的化学品一起输入，接电后产出矿浆或其他化学品。矿石线通常先得到未清洗矿浆，再送入化学清洗机。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。
entries.bodyEn: Combine the solid and recipe chemical with power. Ore processing produces dirty slurry for a chemical washer. Slurry uses chemical transport; clear incompatible or blocked output before changing recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。

entries.body:
物品输入槽放 JEI 富集配方原料，接电后从输出槽取得成品。矿物加工与富集红石、碳等灌注原料都在这台机器处理。富集后的灌注材料用于提高灌注储量利用率，不能直接当作原矿处理。

工厂可同时加工多格原料。开启排序可让各加工格均分输入；满输出会阻塞对应加工格。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid input and power. Enrichment handles ore materials and concentrated infusion ingredients. Factory auto-sort distributes inputs; blocked outputs stop their lanes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
供能后，灌注原料槽先把红石、碳等配方原料转成内部灌注物；主输入槽放需要加工的金属或电路材料。两类输入不能混为同一个槽。

内部已有另一种灌注物时，新配方可能无法接收。需要换类型时先消耗存量，或用界面倾倒功能清空。工厂的并行槽共用灌注储量；分配原料时使用自动排序，并让全部输出槽保持有空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed infusion material and the main item through their separate inputs. The machine stores one infusion type; consume or dump it before switching. Factory lanes share the infusion buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
同时输入固体原料、配方化学品与电能。矿物链常使用氯化氢处理矿石或晶体，但自定义配方也可能要求其他化学品。

检查化学储量与物品数量后再启动；输出的碎片需要交给后续提纯设备，而不是直接当作金属锭使用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid, the recipe chemical and power. Ore recipes commonly use hydrogen chloride. Send shards to the next processing machine instead of treating them as ingots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
放入数控车削配方接受的材料并供电，从成品槽取出加工件。不能用冲压、轧制配方代替车削配方。

工厂增加并行格；设置侧面输入输出与排序，并确保所有副产物/输出格可排出。是否有可加工材料以本包 JEI 该设备配方为准。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a valid lathing ingredient and power. Factory variants add lanes and need configured I/O and available output space. Other CNC recipe types are not interchangeable.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
普通物流管传送物品，来源端需要配置器拉取或由库存主动输出。颜色限制目标可达性，不能把不同颜色当作彼此隔离的库存。

限制管提高路径代价，使其他可用路线优先；分流管可由红石控制连接。排查断流时检查来源、目标容量、颜色、禁用连接和区块加载，而不仅是管道等级。
entries.bodyEn: Configure extraction at the source. Colors affect routing. Restrictive transporters deprioritize a path; diversion transporters gate connections with redstone. Check capacity and loaded paths.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
固体原料从物品输入端进入，机器消耗电能并产出化学品。把加压管道接在化学输出面，而不是接物品管。

产出罐满会停止加工。此设备在硫化学和铀燃料处理等链路中承担固体转化学品的步骤；具体类型按 JEI 配方连接。
entries.bodyEn: This machine consumes a solid and power and outputs a chemical. Extract through the chemical output with pressurized tubes; a full output tank stops processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把配方指定的种子或植物、培养条件和所需辅助资源送进种植设备，供能后在机器内部取得产物。输入条件按该设备的 JEI 配方逐项核对。

种植站不是对外部农田施加范围加速的方块；不要只在旁边放作物而不给内部配方材料。工厂并行时检查种子、流体与输出是否持续可用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the internal planting recipe, including its required seed and auxiliary resources. This is an internal processing machine rather than an external crop-area accelerator.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
提供物品、氧气与电能，把符合提纯配方的矿物中间产物加工成碎块。氧气要接化学品输入，不是流体口。

前后处理顺序通过 JEI 查看：提纯所得碎块通常还要经过粉碎与富集，才进入熔炼。工厂版共用氧气储量。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the item ingredient, oxygen chemical and power. Route clumps onward through the remaining processing steps; factory lanes share oxygen.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
核废料要进入可容纳放射性化学品的桶与化学管路。保留废料监测和处理余量，不能用普通流体桶代替。含放射性内容的设备在被拆除、内容被丢失等情况下可能释放辐射。

废料可按 JEI 进入钋/钚等处理链；核废料桶的可衰变类型并不等于所有放射性物都能消失。停堆后先处理残余废料与冷却，再拆设备；防化服和辐射检测物品用于判断、隔离游戏中的辐射风险。
entries.bodyEn: Use compatible radioactive chemical containment and keep waste processing available. Not every radioactive chemical decays in a waste barrel. Handle residual waste and cooling before dismantling, and use in-game radiation equipment.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入当前回收配方接受的物品并供能，再收集配方产物。回收不是通用垃圾桶：没有回收配方的物品不会因为放进去就被处理。

先用过滤器限制输入，避免把需要保留的成品送进回收链。输出堵塞和共享辅助资源不足也会使工厂停机。
entries.bodyEn: Recycle only items accepted by an installed recipe. Supply energy, collect results and filter inputs deliberately; unsupported items are not automatically destroyed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
材料进入轧制输入槽，供电后按轧机配方加工。使用 JEI 轧制类别核对目标板材等产物，别把冲压模具塞入普通轧制原料格。

批量自动化时持续补料、抽取成品，并检查工厂排序和供电能力。机器存在不代表每一种金属都有已注册的轧制配方。
entries.bodyEn: Use the rolling recipe type and its material input. Keep factory lanes powered and results extracted; a machine does not imply every material has a registered recipe.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
投入木材或其他锯切原料并供能。主产物与概率副产物进入不同输出格，两个输出区都要安排抽取。

产物种类和副产概率看 JEI。只抽取主产物会使副产物积满，最终阻止机器继续运行。
entries.bodyEn: Feed a sawing ingredient and power. Main and secondary outputs occupy different slots; extract both to avoid blocking processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
只需电能与可熔炼物品，不需要煤炭作为燃料。将物品送入输入面，从输出面取成品。能否处理以 JEI 的该机器配方为准。

升级速度时同步检查供电上限；工厂的多格同时运行会增加总耗电。不要把电池槽配置成原料输入面。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power and a smelting ingredient; fuel items are not required. Supply enough energy for parallel factory lanes and keep battery-slot access separate from ingredients.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
向主输入供给待冲压材料，把配方要求的模具放在专用模具/辅助槽，供电后取得冲压件。模具与材料不是同一类输入。

自动化给辅助输入单独过滤，保留本配方所需模具。JEI 的冲压配方类型与压制机处理器组装不同；工厂并行时也要满足共享模具条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the material and required mold through distinct inputs. Filter tooling separately and keep it available. Stamping is a separate recipe type from processor assembly.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
燃木加热器燃烧燃料，电阻加热器把电转成热。使用热导线或正确接触面把热量送给蒸馏塔阀门、锅炉等设备。

电阻加热器 GUI 可以设置耗能，数值过高会迅速消耗储能。热导线会受传热能力与散热影响；机器有电不等于目标设施已得到足够热量。
entries.bodyEn: Fuelwood heaters burn fuel; resistive heaters turn FE into heat. Connect heat conductors or compatible adjacent heat interfaces. Set the resistive consumption deliberately and account for heat loss.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
放在水源上方并供能，输出面接机械管道并开启抽取或弹出。GUI 中确认产物储量确实增长。

需要重水时，为兼容泵安装过滤升级，并从 JEI 确认相关配方。提高速度后还要检查源流体、能量与输出速率是否跟得上。
entries.bodyEn: Place the pump over a valid fluid source and supply power. Extract fluid through a configured output. A filter upgrade enables supported heavy-water collection behavior.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入待离心的化学品并持续供能，从化学输出端抽取产物。裂变燃料链通常在这里处理六氟化铀。

它与普通固体离心机不是同一种设备。先从 JEI 查清输出化学品及下游处理方式，再连接反应堆或储罐。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the chemical feed and power, then extract the separated chemical. This is a chemical-processing machine, commonly used for fissile-fuel preparation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
主原料与辅助原料分别放入两类物品槽，供能后合并成产物。配方有原料数量要求，不能只放每种一个就期待开工。

工厂各加工格需要对应的主输入，辅助原料按机器规则共用。自动化时给两个输入类别独立过滤，避免辅助材料占满主输入。
entries.bodyEn: Use the main and secondary item inputs, with the required quantities and power. Filter the two item categories separately; factories share the secondary supply as configured.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向物品输入侧供给原料并接电，从输出侧收取粉末或其他粉碎产物。矿物处理链中，它也可把碎块进一步粉碎。

它没有气体、流体或灌注输入；若 JEI 显示的原料属于其他机器的配方，单独放进粉碎机不会加工。工厂版增加并行格，侧面和红石配置沿用同类机器。
entries.bodyEn: A solid-to-solid machine: provide the crushing ingredient and energy, then extract output. It has no fluid, chemical or infusion input. Factory variants add parallel lanes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入对应的洁净矿浆或其他可结晶化学品并供能，输出固体晶体或颗粒。化学输入与物品输出分开设置。

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。
entries.bodyEn: Convert a recipe chemical into a solid with power. Configure chemical input and item output separately. Ore crystals still need the remaining processing stages.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把固体原料与配方要求的化学品一起输入，接电后产出矿浆或其他化学品。矿石线通常先得到未清洗矿浆，再送入化学清洗机。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。
entries.bodyEn: Combine the solid and recipe chemical with power. Ore processing produces dirty slurry for a chemical washer. Slurry uses chemical transport; clear incompatible or blocked output before changing recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
物品输入槽放 JEI 富集配方原料，接电后从输出槽取得成品。矿物加工与富集红石、碳等灌注原料都在这台机器处理。富集后的灌注材料用于提高灌注储量利用率，不能直接当作原矿处理。

工厂可同时加工多格原料。开启排序可让各加工格均分输入；满输出会阻塞对应加工格。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid input and power. Enrichment handles ore materials and concentrated infusion ingredients. Factory auto-sort distributes inputs; blocked outputs stop their lanes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
供能后，灌注原料槽先把红石、碳等配方原料转成内部灌注物；主输入槽放需要加工的金属或电路材料。两类输入不能混为同一个槽。

内部已有另一种灌注物时，新配方可能无法接收。需要换类型时先消耗存量，或用界面倾倒功能清空。工厂的并行槽共用灌注储量；分配原料时使用自动排序，并让全部输出槽保持有空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed infusion material and the main item through their separate inputs. The machine stores one infusion type; consume or dump it before switching. Factory lanes share the infusion buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
同时输入固体原料、配方化学品与电能。矿物链常使用氯化氢处理矿石或晶体，但自定义配方也可能要求其他化学品。

检查化学储量与物品数量后再启动；输出的碎片需要交给后续提纯设备，而不是直接当作金属锭使用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid, the recipe chemical and power. Ore recipes commonly use hydrogen chloride. Send shards to the next processing machine instead of treating them as ingots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
放入数控车削配方接受的材料并供电，从成品槽取出加工件。不能用冲压、轧制配方代替车削配方。

工厂增加并行格；设置侧面输入输出与排序，并确保所有副产物/输出格可排出。是否有可加工材料以本包 JEI 该设备配方为准。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a valid lathing ingredient and power. Factory variants add lanes and need configured I/O and available output space. Other CNC recipe types are not interchangeable.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
普通物流管传送物品，来源端需要配置器拉取或由库存主动输出。颜色限制目标可达性，不能把不同颜色当作彼此隔离的库存。

限制管提高路径代价，使其他可用路线优先；分流管可由红石控制连接。排查断流时检查来源、目标容量、颜色、禁用连接和区块加载，而不仅是管道等级。
entries.bodyEn: Configure extraction at the source. Colors affect routing. Restrictive transporters deprioritize a path; diversion transporters gate connections with redstone. Check capacity and loaded paths.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
固体原料从物品输入端进入，机器消耗电能并产出化学品。把加压管道接在化学输出面，而不是接物品管。

产出罐满会停止加工。此设备在硫化学和铀燃料处理等链路中承担固体转化学品的步骤；具体类型按 JEI 配方连接。
entries.bodyEn: This machine consumes a solid and power and outputs a chemical. Extract through the chemical output with pressurized tubes; a full output tank stops processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 寰宇支配颜料提取工厂
entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

entries.body:
把配方指定的种子或植物、培养条件和所需辅助资源送进种植设备，供能后在机器内部取得产物。输入条件按该设备的 JEI 配方逐项核对。

种植站不是对外部农田施加范围加速的方块；不要只在旁边放作物而不给内部配方材料。工厂并行时检查种子、流体与输出是否持续可用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the internal planting recipe, including its required seed and auxiliary resources. This is an internal processing machine rather than an external crop-area accelerator.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 寰宇支配加压反应工厂
entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
提供物品、氧气与电能，把符合提纯配方的矿物中间产物加工成碎块。氧气要接化学品输入，不是流体口。

前后处理顺序通过 JEI 查看：提纯所得碎块通常还要经过粉碎与富集，才进入熔炼。工厂版共用氧气储量。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the item ingredient, oxygen chemical and power. Route clumps onward through the remaining processing steps; factory lanes share oxygen.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 寰宇支配放射性废料桶
entries.body:
核废料要进入可容纳放射性化学品的桶与化学管路。保留废料监测和处理余量，不能用普通流体桶代替。含放射性内容的设备在被拆除、内容被丢失等情况下可能释放辐射。

废料可按 JEI 进入钋/钚等处理链；核废料桶的可衰变类型并不等于所有放射性物都能消失。停堆后先处理残余废料与冷却，再拆设备；防化服和辐射检测物品用于判断、隔离游戏中的辐射风险。
entries.bodyEn: Use compatible radioactive chemical containment and keep waste processing available. Not every radioactive chemical decays in a waste barrel. Handle residual waste and cooling before dismantling, and use in-game radiation equipment.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入当前回收配方接受的物品并供能，再收集配方产物。回收不是通用垃圾桶：没有回收配方的物品不会因为放进去就被处理。

先用过滤器限制输入，避免把需要保留的成品送进回收链。输出堵塞和共享辅助资源不足也会使工厂停机。
entries.bodyEn: Recycle only items accepted by an installed recipe. Supply energy, collect results and filter inputs deliberately; unsupported items are not automatically destroyed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
材料进入轧制输入槽，供电后按轧机配方加工。使用 JEI 轧制类别核对目标板材等产物，别把冲压模具塞入普通轧制原料格。

批量自动化时持续补料、抽取成品，并检查工厂排序和供电能力。机器存在不代表每一种金属都有已注册的轧制配方。
entries.bodyEn: Use the rolling recipe type and its material input. Keep factory lanes powered and results extracted; a machine does not imply every material has a registered recipe.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
投入木材或其他锯切原料并供能。主产物与概率副产物进入不同输出格，两个输出区都要安排抽取。

产物种类和副产概率看 JEI。只抽取主产物会使副产物积满，最终阻止机器继续运行。
entries.bodyEn: Feed a sawing ingredient and power. Main and secondary outputs occupy different slots; extract both to avoid blocking processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
只需电能与可熔炼物品，不需要煤炭作为燃料。将物品送入输入面，从输出面取成品。能否处理以 JEI 的该机器配方为准。

升级速度时同步检查供电上限；工厂的多格同时运行会增加总耗电。不要把电池槽配置成原料输入面。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power and a smelting ingredient; fuel items are not required. Supply enough energy for parallel factory lanes and keep battery-slot access separate from ingredients.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
向主输入供给待冲压材料，把配方要求的模具放在专用模具/辅助槽，供电后取得冲压件。模具与材料不是同一类输入。

自动化给辅助输入单独过滤，保留本配方所需模具。JEI 的冲压配方类型与压制机处理器组装不同；工厂并行时也要满足共享模具条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the material and required mold through distinct inputs. Filter tooling separately and keep it available. Stamping is a separate recipe type from processor assembly.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
燃木加热器燃烧燃料，电阻加热器把电转成热。使用热导线或正确接触面把热量送给蒸馏塔阀门、锅炉等设备。

电阻加热器 GUI 可以设置耗能，数值过高会迅速消耗储能。热导线会受传热能力与散热影响；机器有电不等于目标设施已得到足够热量。
entries.bodyEn: Fuelwood heaters burn fuel; resistive heaters turn FE into heat. Connect heat conductors or compatible adjacent heat interfaces. Set the resistive consumption deliberately and account for heat loss.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入待离心的化学品并持续供能，从化学输出端抽取产物。裂变燃料链通常在这里处理六氟化铀。

它与普通固体离心机不是同一种设备。先从 JEI 查清输出化学品及下游处理方式，再连接反应堆或储罐。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the chemical feed and power, then extract the separated chemical. This is a chemical-processing machine, commonly used for fissile-fuel preparation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
主原料与辅助原料分别放入两类物品槽，供能后合并成产物。配方有原料数量要求，不能只放每种一个就期待开工。

工厂各加工格需要对应的主输入，辅助原料按机器规则共用。自动化时给两个输入类别独立过滤，避免辅助材料占满主输入。
entries.bodyEn: Use the main and secondary item inputs, with the required quantities and power. Filter the two item categories separately; factories share the secondary supply as configured.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向物品输入侧供给原料并接电，从输出侧收取粉末或其他粉碎产物。矿物处理链中，它也可把碎块进一步粉碎。

它没有气体、流体或灌注输入；若 JEI 显示的原料属于其他机器的配方，单独放进粉碎机不会加工。工厂版增加并行格，侧面和红石配置沿用同类机器。
entries.bodyEn: A solid-to-solid machine: provide the crushing ingredient and energy, then extract output. It has no fluid, chemical or infusion input. Factory variants add parallel lanes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入对应的洁净矿浆或其他可结晶化学品并供能，输出固体晶体或颗粒。化学输入与物品输出分开设置。

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。
entries.bodyEn: Convert a recipe chemical into a solid with power. Configure chemical input and item output separately. Ore crystals still need the remaining processing stages.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把固体原料与配方要求的化学品一起输入，接电后产出矿浆或其他化学品。矿石线通常先得到未清洗矿浆，再送入化学清洗机。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。
entries.bodyEn: Combine the solid and recipe chemical with power. Ore processing produces dirty slurry for a chemical washer. Slurry uses chemical transport; clear incompatible or blocked output before changing recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
物品输入槽放 JEI 富集配方原料，接电后从输出槽取得成品。矿物加工与富集红石、碳等灌注原料都在这台机器处理。富集后的灌注材料用于提高灌注储量利用率，不能直接当作原矿处理。

工厂可同时加工多格原料。开启排序可让各加工格均分输入；满输出会阻塞对应加工格。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid input and power. Enrichment handles ore materials and concentrated infusion ingredients. Factory auto-sort distributes inputs; blocked outputs stop their lanes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
供能后，灌注原料槽先把红石、碳等配方原料转成内部灌注物；主输入槽放需要加工的金属或电路材料。两类输入不能混为同一个槽。

内部已有另一种灌注物时，新配方可能无法接收。需要换类型时先消耗存量，或用界面倾倒功能清空。工厂的并行槽共用灌注储量；分配原料时使用自动排序，并让全部输出槽保持有空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed infusion material and the main item through their separate inputs. The machine stores one infusion type; consume or dump it before switching. Factory lanes share the infusion buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
同时输入固体原料、配方化学品与电能。矿物链常使用氯化氢处理矿石或晶体，但自定义配方也可能要求其他化学品。

检查化学储量与物品数量后再启动；输出的碎片需要交给后续提纯设备，而不是直接当作金属锭使用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid, the recipe chemical and power. Ore recipes commonly use hydrogen chloride. Send shards to the next processing machine instead of treating them as ingots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
放入数控车削配方接受的材料并供电，从成品槽取出加工件。不能用冲压、轧制配方代替车削配方。

工厂增加并行格；设置侧面输入输出与排序，并确保所有副产物/输出格可排出。是否有可加工材料以本包 JEI 该设备配方为准。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a valid lathing ingredient and power. Factory variants add lanes and need configured I/O and available output space. Other CNC recipe types are not interchangeable.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
普通物流管传送物品，来源端需要配置器拉取或由库存主动输出。颜色限制目标可达性，不能把不同颜色当作彼此隔离的库存。

限制管提高路径代价，使其他可用路线优先；分流管可由红石控制连接。排查断流时检查来源、目标容量、颜色、禁用连接和区块加载，而不仅是管道等级。
entries.bodyEn: Configure extraction at the source. Colors affect routing. Restrictive transporters deprioritize a path; diversion transporters gate connections with redstone. Check capacity and loaded paths.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
固体原料从物品输入端进入，机器消耗电能并产出化学品。把加压管道接在化学输出面，而不是接物品管。

产出罐满会停止加工。此设备在硫化学和铀燃料处理等链路中承担固体转化学品的步骤；具体类型按 JEI 配方连接。
entries.bodyEn: This machine consumes a solid and power and outputs a chemical. Extract through the chemical output with pressurized tubes; a full output tank stops processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 悖论无限颜料提取工厂
entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把配方指定的种子或植物、培养条件和所需辅助资源送进种植设备，供能后在机器内部取得产物。输入条件按该设备的 JEI 配方逐项核对。

种植站不是对外部农田施加范围加速的方块；不要只在旁边放作物而不给内部配方材料。工厂并行时检查种子、流体与输出是否持续可用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the internal planting recipe, including its required seed and auxiliary resources. This is an internal processing machine rather than an external crop-area accelerator.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 悖论无限加压反应工厂
entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
提供物品、氧气与电能，把符合提纯配方的矿物中间产物加工成碎块。氧气要接化学品输入，不是流体口。

前后处理顺序通过 JEI 查看：提纯所得碎块通常还要经过粉碎与富集，才进入熔炼。工厂版共用氧气储量。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the item ingredient, oxygen chemical and power. Route clumps onward through the remaining processing steps; factory lanes share oxygen.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 悖论无限放射性废料桶
entries.body:
核废料要进入可容纳放射性化学品的桶与化学管路。保留废料监测和处理余量，不能用普通流体桶代替。含放射性内容的设备在被拆除、内容被丢失等情况下可能释放辐射。

废料可按 JEI 进入钋/钚等处理链；核废料桶的可衰变类型并不等于所有放射性物都能消失。停堆后先处理残余废料与冷却，再拆设备；防化服和辐射检测物品用于判断、隔离游戏中的辐射风险。
entries.bodyEn: Use compatible radioactive chemical containment and keep waste processing available. Not every radioactive chemical decays in a waste barrel. Handle residual waste and cooling before dismantling, and use in-game radiation equipment.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入当前回收配方接受的物品并供能，再收集配方产物。回收不是通用垃圾桶：没有回收配方的物品不会因为放进去就被处理。

先用过滤器限制输入，避免把需要保留的成品送进回收链。输出堵塞和共享辅助资源不足也会使工厂停机。
entries.bodyEn: Recycle only items accepted by an installed recipe. Supply energy, collect results and filter inputs deliberately; unsupported items are not automatically destroyed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
材料进入轧制输入槽，供电后按轧机配方加工。使用 JEI 轧制类别核对目标板材等产物，别把冲压模具塞入普通轧制原料格。

批量自动化时持续补料、抽取成品，并检查工厂排序和供电能力。机器存在不代表每一种金属都有已注册的轧制配方。
entries.bodyEn: Use the rolling recipe type and its material input. Keep factory lanes powered and results extracted; a machine does not imply every material has a registered recipe.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
投入木材或其他锯切原料并供能。主产物与概率副产物进入不同输出格，两个输出区都要安排抽取。

产物种类和副产概率看 JEI。只抽取主产物会使副产物积满，最终阻止机器继续运行。
entries.bodyEn: Feed a sawing ingredient and power. Main and secondary outputs occupy different slots; extract both to avoid blocking processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
只需电能与可熔炼物品，不需要煤炭作为燃料。将物品送入输入面，从输出面取成品。能否处理以 JEI 的该机器配方为准。

升级速度时同步检查供电上限；工厂的多格同时运行会增加总耗电。不要把电池槽配置成原料输入面。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power and a smelting ingredient; fuel items are not required. Supply enough energy for parallel factory lanes and keep battery-slot access separate from ingredients.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
向主输入供给待冲压材料，把配方要求的模具放在专用模具/辅助槽，供电后取得冲压件。模具与材料不是同一类输入。

自动化给辅助输入单独过滤，保留本配方所需模具。JEI 的冲压配方类型与压制机处理器组装不同；工厂并行时也要满足共享模具条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the material and required mold through distinct inputs. Filter tooling separately and keep it available. Stamping is a separate recipe type from processor assembly.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
燃木加热器燃烧燃料，电阻加热器把电转成热。使用热导线或正确接触面把热量送给蒸馏塔阀门、锅炉等设备。

电阻加热器 GUI 可以设置耗能，数值过高会迅速消耗储能。热导线会受传热能力与散热影响；机器有电不等于目标设施已得到足够热量。
entries.bodyEn: Fuelwood heaters burn fuel; resistive heaters turn FE into heat. Connect heat conductors or compatible adjacent heat interfaces. Set the resistive consumption deliberately and account for heat loss.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
当前版本反应堆占九乘九乘九的结构区域，控制器必须在顶部正中心；使用硅岩反应堆外壳、兼容玻璃、端口与铅涂层激光聚焦矩阵，不能把普通聚变堆的外壳整套替用。成形后查看控制器状态。

把装有所需硅铀燃料的硅岩黑体辐射腔放入启动槽，用激光经专用聚焦矩阵加热点火。持续供给富硅岩与富铀两路燃料，或直接供应接受的硅铀燃料；输入速率影响运行。

水冷模式要供应水并抽走含钋蒸汽，该产物是化学品。端口的方向用配置器设置，能量、燃料、水和含钋蒸汽分别接兼容管路。具体启动温度与容量读取当前配置和 GUI，不套用旧版教程的固定数值。
entries.bodyEn: The installed reactor occupies a 9×9×9 area and requires its controller at the top center. Use dedicated casing, ports and laser matrix. Ignite a filled Naquadah Hohlraum, sustain accepted fuels and configure ports. Water cooling produces polonium-containing steam, a chemical output.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。

它没有气体、流体或灌注输入；若 JEI 显示的原料属于其他机器的配方，单独放进粉碎机不会加工。工厂版增加并行格，侧面和红石配置沿用同类机器。
entries.bodyEn: A solid-to-solid machine: provide the crushing ingredient and energy, then extract output. It has no fluid, chemical or infusion input. Factory variants add parallel lanes.

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。

物品输入槽放 JEI 富集配方原料，接电后从输出槽取得成品。矿物加工与富集红石、碳等灌注原料都在这台机器处理。富集后的灌注材料用于提高灌注储量利用率，不能直接当作原矿处理。

工厂可同时加工多格原料。开启排序可让各加工格均分输入；满输出会阻塞对应加工格。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid input and power. Enrichment handles ore materials and concentrated infusion ingredients. Factory auto-sort distributes inputs; blocked outputs stop their lanes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
闭合外壳，内部放感应电池和感应供应器，墙面安装端口并设置输入或输出。电池决定可储存的能量，供应器决定可传输的能量，两者不能相互替代。

矩阵有大量空余容量却充不进或放不出时，检查供应器、端口模式和外部线缆限制。外壳与端口本身不提供内部电池容量。
entries.bodyEn: Cells provide capacity; providers provide transfer throughput. Form the casing, install internals, and configure ports. Check both port and cable limits when transfer is unexpectedly slow.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
供能后，灌注原料槽先把红石、碳等配方原料转成内部灌注物；主输入槽放需要加工的金属或电路材料。两类输入不能混为同一个槽。

内部已有另一种灌注物时，新配方可能无法接收。需要换类型时先消耗存量，或用界面倾倒功能清空。工厂的并行槽共用灌注储量；分配原料时使用自动排序，并让全部输出槽保持有空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed infusion material and the main item through their separate inputs. The machine stores one infusion type; consume or dump it before switching. Factory lanes share the infusion buffer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
同时输入固体原料、配方化学品与电能。矿物链常使用氯化氢处理矿石或晶体，但自定义配方也可能要求其他化学品。

检查化学储量与物品数量后再启动；输出的碎片需要交给后续提纯设备，而不是直接当作金属锭使用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply a solid, the recipe chemical and power. Ore recipes commonly use hydrogen chloride. Send shards to the next processing machine instead of treating them as ingots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
放入数控车削配方接受的材料并供电，从成品槽取出加工件。不能用冲压、轧制配方代替车削配方。

工厂增加并行格；设置侧面输入输出与排序，并确保所有副产物/输出格可排出。是否有可加工材料以本包 JEI 该设备配方为准。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a valid lathing ingredient and power. Factory variants add lanes and need configured I/O and available output space. Other CNC recipe types are not interchangeable.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
普通物流管传送物品，来源端需要配置器拉取或由库存主动输出。颜色限制目标可达性，不能把不同颜色当作彼此隔离的库存。

限制管提高路径代价，使其他可用路线优先；分流管可由红石控制连接。排查断流时检查来源、目标容量、颜色、禁用连接和区块加载，而不仅是管道等级。
entries.bodyEn: Configure extraction at the source. Colors affect routing. Restrictive transporters deprioritize a path; diversion transporters gate connections with redstone. Check capacity and loaded paths.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
固体原料从物品输入端进入，机器消耗电能并产出化学品。把加压管道接在化学输出面，而不是接物品管。

产出罐满会停止加工。此设备在硫化学和铀燃料处理等链路中承担固体转化学品的步骤；具体类型按 JEI 配方连接。
entries.bodyEn: This machine consumes a solid and power and outputs a chemical. Extract through the chemical output with pressurized tubes; a full output tank stops processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把配方指定的种子或植物、培养条件和所需辅助资源送进种植设备，供能后在机器内部取得产物。输入条件按该设备的 JEI 配方逐项核对。

种植站不是对外部农田施加范围加速的方块；不要只在旁边放作物而不给内部配方材料。工厂并行时检查种子、流体与输出是否持续可用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the internal planting recipe, including its required seed and auxiliary resources. This is an internal processing machine rather than an external crop-area accelerator.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

来源端通常需要配置器设为拉取，或让机器主动弹出。不同等级影响容量和传输能力，不能靠升级流体管把气体送过去。
entries.bodyEn: Universal cables carry energy, mechanical pipes carry fluids and pressurized tubes carry chemicals. Configure extraction or machine ejection; tiers do not change the resource type.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
提供物品、氧气与电能，把符合提纯配方的矿物中间产物加工成碎块。氧气要接化学品输入，不是流体口。

前后处理顺序通过 JEI 查看：提纯所得碎块通常还要经过粉碎与富集，才进入熔炼。工厂版共用氧气储量。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the item ingredient, oxygen chemical and power. Route clumps onward through the remaining processing steps; factory lanes share oxygen.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
核废料要进入可容纳放射性化学品的桶与化学管路。保留废料监测和处理余量，不能用普通流体桶代替。含放射性内容的设备在被拆除、内容被丢失等情况下可能释放辐射。

废料可按 JEI 进入钋/钚等处理链；核废料桶的可衰变类型并不等于所有放射性物都能消失。停堆后先处理残余废料与冷却，再拆设备；防化服和辐射检测物品用于判断、隔离游戏中的辐射风险。
entries.bodyEn: Use compatible radioactive chemical containment and keep waste processing available. Not every radioactive chemical decays in a waste barrel. Handle residual waste and cooling before dismantling, and use in-game radiation equipment.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入当前回收配方接受的物品并供能，再收集配方产物。回收不是通用垃圾桶：没有回收配方的物品不会因为放进去就被处理。

先用过滤器限制输入，避免把需要保留的成品送进回收链。输出堵塞和共享辅助资源不足也会使工厂停机。
entries.bodyEn: Recycle only items accepted by an installed recipe. Supply energy, collect results and filter inputs deliberately; unsupported items are not automatically destroyed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
材料进入轧制输入槽，供电后按轧机配方加工。使用 JEI 轧制类别核对目标板材等产物，别把冲压模具塞入普通轧制原料格。

批量自动化时持续补料、抽取成品，并检查工厂排序和供电能力。机器存在不代表每一种金属都有已注册的轧制配方。
entries.bodyEn: Use the rolling recipe type and its material input. Keep factory lanes powered and results extracted; a machine does not imply every material has a registered recipe.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
投入木材或其他锯切原料并供能。主产物与概率副产物进入不同输出格，两个输出区都要安排抽取。

产物种类和副产概率看 JEI。只抽取主产物会使副产物积满，最终阻止机器继续运行。
entries.bodyEn: Feed a sawing ingredient and power. Main and secondary outputs occupy different slots; extract both to avoid blocking processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
只需电能与可熔炼物品，不需要煤炭作为燃料。将物品送入输入面，从输出面取成品。能否处理以 JEI 的该机器配方为准。

升级速度时同步检查供电上限；工厂的多格同时运行会增加总耗电。不要把电池槽配置成原料输入面。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power and a smelting ingredient; fuel items are not required. Supply enough energy for parallel factory lanes and keep battery-slot access separate from ingredients.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
向主输入供给待冲压材料，把配方要求的模具放在专用模具/辅助槽，供电后取得冲压件。模具与材料不是同一类输入。

自动化给辅助输入单独过滤，保留本配方所需模具。JEI 的冲压配方类型与压制机处理器组装不同；工厂并行时也要满足共享模具条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the material and required mold through distinct inputs. Filter tooling separately and keep it available. Stamping is a separate recipe type from processor assembly.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
燃木加热器燃烧燃料，电阻加热器把电转成热。使用热导线或正确接触面把热量送给蒸馏塔阀门、锅炉等设备。

电阻加热器 GUI 可以设置耗能，数值过高会迅速消耗储能。热导线会受传热能力与散热影响；机器有电不等于目标设施已得到足够热量。
entries.bodyEn: Fuelwood heaters burn fuel; resistive heaters turn FE into heat. Connect heat conductors or compatible adjacent heat interfaces. Set the resistive consumption deliberately and account for heat loss.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
通用线缆传电，机械管道传流体，加压管道传化学品。先确认来源与目标使用同一资源体系；矿浆、颜料等也属于化学品。

researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入待离心的化学品并持续供能，从化学输出端抽取产物。裂变燃料链通常在这里处理六氟化铀。

它与普通固体离心机不是同一种设备。先从 JEI 查清输出化学品及下游处理方式，再连接反应堆或储罐。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the chemical feed and power, then extract the separated chemical. This is a chemical-processing machine, commonly used for fissile-fuel preparation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入对应的洁净矿浆或其他可结晶化学品并供能，输出固体晶体或颗粒。化学输入与物品输出分开设置。

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。
entries.bodyEn: Convert a recipe chemical into a solid with power. Configure chemical input and item output separately. Ore crystals still need the remaining processing stages.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把固体原料与配方要求的化学品一起输入，接电后产出矿浆或其他化学品。矿石线通常先得到未清洗矿浆，再送入化学清洗机。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。
entries.bodyEn: Combine the solid and recipe chemical with power. Ore processing produces dirty slurry for a chemical washer. Slurry uses chemical transport; clear incompatible or blocked output before changing recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把配方指定的种子或植物、培养条件和所需辅助资源送进种植设备，供能后在机器内部取得产物。输入条件按该设备的 JEI 配方逐项核对。

种植站不是对外部农田施加范围加速的方块；不要只在旁边放作物而不给内部配方材料。工厂并行时检查种子、流体与输出是否持续可用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the internal planting recipe, including its required seed and auxiliary resources. This is an internal processing machine rather than an external crop-area accelerator.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入当前回收配方接受的物品并供能，再收集配方产物。回收不是通用垃圾桶：没有回收配方的物品不会因为放进去就被处理。

先用过滤器限制输入，避免把需要保留的成品送进回收链。输出堵塞和共享辅助资源不足也会使工厂停机。
entries.bodyEn: Recycle only items accepted by an installed recipe. Supply energy, collect results and filter inputs deliberately; unsupported items are not automatically destroyed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
材料进入轧制输入槽，供电后按轧机配方加工。使用 JEI 轧制类别核对目标板材等产物，别把冲压模具塞入普通轧制原料格。

批量自动化时持续补料、抽取成品，并检查工厂排序和供电能力。机器存在不代表每一种金属都有已注册的轧制配方。
entries.bodyEn: Use the rolling recipe type and its material input. Keep factory lanes powered and results extracted; a machine does not imply every material has a registered recipe.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向主输入供给待冲压材料，把配方要求的模具放在专用模具/辅助槽，供电后取得冲压件。模具与材料不是同一类输入。

自动化给辅助输入单独过滤，保留本配方所需模具。JEI 的冲压配方类型与压制机处理器组装不同；工厂并行时也要满足共享模具条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the material and required mold through distinct inputs. Filter tooling separately and keep it available. Stamping is a separate recipe type from processor assembly.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
供能后，按环境收集配方检查维度、生物群系或其他条件，并配置化学输出。产物用化学管道和兼容储罐收集。

它并非在任何环境都产生同一种物质。环境满足但不产出时，检查输出罐已有物质、供电与当前配方条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power, satisfy the ambient collection recipe conditions, and extract the chemical result. Dimension or biome conditions may change the available output.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入待离心的化学品并持续供能，从化学输出端抽取产物。裂变燃料链通常在这里处理六氟化铀。

它与普通固体离心机不是同一种设备。先从 JEI 查清输出化学品及下游处理方式，再连接反应堆或储罐。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the chemical feed and power, then extract the separated chemical. This is a chemical-processing machine, commonly used for fissile-fuel preparation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入对应的洁净矿浆或其他可结晶化学品并供能，输出固体晶体或颗粒。化学输入与物品输出分开设置。

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。
entries.bodyEn: Convert a recipe chemical into a solid with power. Configure chemical input and item output separately. Ore crystals still need the remaining processing stages.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把固体原料与配方要求的化学品一起输入，接电后产出矿浆或其他化学品。矿石线通常先得到未清洗矿浆，再送入化学清洗机。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。
entries.bodyEn: Combine the solid and recipe chemical with power. Ore processing produces dirty slurry for a chemical washer. Slurry uses chemical transport; clear incompatible or blocked output before changing recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
放入数控车削配方接受的材料并供电，从成品槽取出加工件。不能用冲压、轧制配方代替车削配方。

工厂增加并行格；设置侧面输入输出与排序，并确保所有副产物/输出格可排出。是否有可加工材料以本包 JEI 该设备配方为准。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a valid lathing ingredient and power. Factory variants add lanes and need configured I/O and available output space. Other CNC recipe types are not interchangeable.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
固体原料从物品输入端进入，机器消耗电能并产出化学品。把加压管道接在化学输出面，而不是接物品管。

产出罐满会停止加工。此设备在硫化学和铀燃料处理等链路中承担固体转化学品的步骤；具体类型按 JEI 配方连接。
entries.bodyEn: This machine consumes a solid and power and outputs a chemical. Extract through the chemical output with pressurized tubes; a full output tank stops processing.

researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把配方指定的种子或植物、培养条件和所需辅助资源送进种植设备，供能后在机器内部取得产物。输入条件按该设备的 JEI 配方逐项核对。

种植站不是对外部农田施加范围加速的方块；不要只在旁边放作物而不给内部配方材料。工厂并行时检查种子、流体与输出是否持续可用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the internal planting recipe, including its required seed and auxiliary resources. This is an internal processing machine rather than an external crop-area accelerator.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入当前回收配方接受的物品并供能，再收集配方产物。回收不是通用垃圾桶：没有回收配方的物品不会因为放进去就被处理。

先用过滤器限制输入，避免把需要保留的成品送进回收链。输出堵塞和共享辅助资源不足也会使工厂停机。
entries.bodyEn: Recycle only items accepted by an installed recipe. Supply energy, collect results and filter inputs deliberately; unsupported items are not automatically destroyed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
材料进入轧制输入槽，供电后按轧机配方加工。使用 JEI 轧制类别核对目标板材等产物，别把冲压模具塞入普通轧制原料格。

批量自动化时持续补料、抽取成品，并检查工厂排序和供电能力。机器存在不代表每一种金属都有已注册的轧制配方。
entries.bodyEn: Use the rolling recipe type and its material input. Keep factory lanes powered and results extracted; a machine does not imply every material has a registered recipe.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向主输入供给待冲压材料，把配方要求的模具放在专用模具/辅助槽，供电后取得冲压件。模具与材料不是同一类输入。

自动化给辅助输入单独过滤，保留本配方所需模具。JEI 的冲压配方类型与压制机处理器组装不同；工厂并行时也要满足共享模具条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the material and required mold through distinct inputs. Filter tooling separately and keep it available. Stamping is a separate recipe type from processor assembly.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入待离心的化学品并持续供能，从化学输出端抽取产物。裂变燃料链通常在这里处理六氟化铀。

它与普通固体离心机不是同一种设备。先从 JEI 查清输出化学品及下游处理方式，再连接反应堆或储罐。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the chemical feed and power, then extract the separated chemical. This is a chemical-processing machine, commonly used for fissile-fuel preparation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入对应的洁净矿浆或其他可结晶化学品并供能，输出固体晶体或颗粒。化学输入与物品输出分开设置。

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。
entries.bodyEn: Convert a recipe chemical into a solid with power. Configure chemical input and item output separately. Ore crystals still need the remaining processing stages.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把固体原料与配方要求的化学品一起输入，接电后产出矿浆或其他化学品。矿石线通常先得到未清洗矿浆，再送入化学清洗机。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。
entries.bodyEn: Combine the solid and recipe chemical with power. Ore processing produces dirty slurry for a chemical washer. Slurry uses chemical transport; clear incompatible or blocked output before changing recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
放入数控车削配方接受的材料并供电，从成品槽取出加工件。不能用冲压、轧制配方代替车削配方。

工厂增加并行格；设置侧面输入输出与排序，并确保所有副产物/输出格可排出。是否有可加工材料以本包 JEI 该设备配方为准。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a valid lathing ingredient and power. Factory variants add lanes and need configured I/O and available output space. Other CNC recipe types are not interchangeable.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes
