researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入当前回收配方接受的物品并供能，再收集配方产物。回收不是通用垃圾桶：没有回收配方的物品不会因为放进去就被处理。

先用过滤器限制输入，避免把需要保留的成品送进回收链。输出堵塞和共享辅助资源不足也会使工厂停机。
entries.bodyEn: Recycle only items accepted by an installed recipe. Supply energy, collect results and filter inputs deliberately; unsupported items are not automatically destroyed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
材料进入轧制输入槽，供电后按轧机配方加工。使用 JEI 轧制类别核对目标板材等产物，别把冲压模具塞入普通轧制原料格。

批量自动化时持续补料、抽取成品，并检查工厂排序和供电能力。机器存在不代表每一种金属都有已注册的轧制配方。
entries.bodyEn: Use the rolling recipe type and its material input. Keep factory lanes powered and results extracted; a machine does not imply every material has a registered recipe.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向主输入供给待冲压材料，把配方要求的模具放在专用模具/辅助槽，供电后取得冲压件。模具与材料不是同一类输入。

自动化给辅助输入单独过滤，保留本配方所需模具。JEI 的冲压配方类型与压制机处理器组装不同；工厂并行时也要满足共享模具条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the material and required mold through distinct inputs. Filter tooling separately and keep it available. Stamping is a separate recipe type from processor assembly.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
主物品槽输入待转化材料，化学槽输入反物质，接入足够能量后执行核合成配方。成品从物品输出面抽取。

它不是免费复制器：原料、反物质和电能均按配方消耗。升级速度前先确认反物质生产和能量吞吐足够，否则只会频繁停机。
entries.bodyEn: Feed the solid, antimatter and power. Nucleosynthesis consumes all required recipe resources; ensure antimatter production and energy throughput before increasing speed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
两种化学品分别进入两个输入罐，供能后合成第三种化学品。每个输入罐只能接受当前配方允许的输入，接管时分别配置输入侧。

硫酸、氯化氢、氘氚燃料等都可能经过此类合成。它与冶金灌注机不同：主输入不是金属物品，也不使用红石灌注原料槽。
entries.bodyEn: Feed two chemical inputs separately and supply power. The result is another chemical. This is distinct from metallurgic infusion and does not use its metal/infusion-material slots.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入配方液体并供电，分别得到两种化学品。把两个输出都安排好；只使用氢气而忽略氧气时，氧罐满会让整台机器停机。

不保留的产物可以设为排放或仅排放过量，但先确认不是后续产线必需物。重水配方可用于取得氘，原料与普通水配方不同。
entries.bodyEn: Supply fluid and power and manage both chemical outputs. An unused full tank stops separation. Use dump settings deliberately; heavy water recipes differ from ordinary water.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
热力发电机可使用燃料/环境热条件；生物能发电机使用兼容生物燃料；燃气发电机使用可燃化学品并有自己的燃烧参数。太阳能要求天空和日照，风力发电受高度等环境条件影响。

按机型接物品或化学品供料，检查输出线与缓冲。产电设备不需要把所有侧面都设为输入；高阶大型版本仍要满足对应供料条件。
entries.bodyEn: Heat, bio and gas generators use their own fuel systems. Solar and wind depend on environmental conditions. Configure energy output and inspect fuel and buffers.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
热力发电机可使用燃料/环境热条件；生物能发电机使用兼容生物燃料；燃气发电机使用可燃化学品并有自己的燃烧参数。太阳能要求天空和日照，风力发电受高度等环境条件影响。

按机型接物品或化学品供料，检查输出线与缓冲。产电设备不需要把所有侧面都设为输入；高阶大型版本仍要满足对应供料条件。
entries.bodyEn: Heat, bio and gas generators use their own fuel systems. Solar and wind depend on environmental conditions. Configure energy output and inspect fuel and buffers.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 大型回旋式气液转换机
entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.zh: 大型太阳能中子活化器
entries.body:
把化学品送入活化器并确保机器符合日照/天空条件，输出侧连接化学管。反应速度受环境影响，不能只看供料量。

它可把气态锂用于氚链，核废料处理也可能使用此设备。放射性物质需要兼容容器，断料或停光时留足储存空间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed the chemical and satisfy sunlight/sky requirements. Environment affects throughput. Provide compatible containment and buffer space for radioactive recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
热力发电机可使用燃料/环境热条件；生物能发电机使用兼容生物燃料；燃气发电机使用可燃化学品并有自己的燃烧参数。太阳能要求天空和日照，风力发电受高度等环境条件影响。

按机型接物品或化学品供料，检查输出线与缓冲。产电设备不需要把所有侧面都设为输入；高阶大型版本仍要满足对应供料条件。
entries.bodyEn: Heat, bio and gas generators use their own fuel systems. Solar and wind depend on environmental conditions. Configure energy output and inspect fuel and buffers.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
输入待离心的化学品并持续供能，从化学输出端抽取产物。裂变燃料链通常在这里处理六氟化铀。

它与普通固体离心机不是同一种设备。先从 JEI 查清输出化学品及下游处理方式，再连接反应堆或储罐。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the chemical feed and power, then extract the separated chemical. This is a chemical-processing machine, commonly used for fissile-fuel preparation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入对应的洁净矿浆或其他可结晶化学品并供能，输出固体晶体或颗粒。化学输入与物品输出分开设置。

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。
entries.bodyEn: Convert a recipe chemical into a solid with power. Configure chemical input and item output separately. Ore crystals still need the remaining processing stages.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把固体原料与配方要求的化学品一起输入，接电后产出矿浆或其他化学品。矿石线通常先得到未清洗矿浆，再送入化学清洗机。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。
entries.bodyEn: Combine the solid and recipe chemical with power. Ore processing produces dirty slurry for a chemical washer. Slurry uses chemical transport; clear incompatible or blocked output before changing recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
放入数控车削配方接受的材料并供电，从成品槽取出加工件。不能用冲压、轧制配方代替车削配方。

工厂增加并行格；设置侧面输入输出与排序，并确保所有副产物/输出格可排出。是否有可加工材料以本包 JEI 该设备配方为准。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a valid lathing ingredient and power. Factory variants add lanes and need configured I/O and available output space. Other CNC recipe types are not interchangeable.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
固体原料从物品输入端进入，机器消耗电能并产出化学品。把加压管道接在化学输出面，而不是接物品管。

产出罐满会停止加工。此设备在硫化学和铀燃料处理等链路中承担固体转化学品的步骤；具体类型按 JEI 配方连接。
entries.bodyEn: This machine consumes a solid and power and outputs a chemical. Extract through the chemical output with pressurized tubes; a full output tank stops processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

把配方指定的种子或植物、培养条件和所需辅助资源送进种植设备，供能后在机器内部取得产物。输入条件按该设备的 JEI 配方逐项核对。

工厂增加并行格；设置侧面输入输出与排序，并确保所有副产物/输出格可排出。是否有可加工材料以本包 JEI 该设备配方为准。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a valid lathing ingredient and power. Factory variants add lanes and need configured I/O and available output space. Other CNC recipe types are not interchangeable.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
固体原料从物品输入端进入，机器消耗电能并产出化学品。把加压管道接在化学输出面，而不是接物品管。

产出罐满会停止加工。此设备在硫化学和铀燃料处理等链路中承担固体转化学品的步骤；具体类型按 JEI 配方连接。
entries.bodyEn: This machine consumes a solid and power and outputs a chemical. Extract through the chemical output with pressurized tubes; a full output tank stops processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把配方指定的种子或植物、培养条件和所需辅助资源送进种植设备，供能后在机器内部取得产物。输入条件按该设备的 JEI 配方逐项核对。

种植站不是对外部农田施加范围加速的方块；不要只在旁边放作物而不给内部配方材料。工厂并行时检查种子、流体与输出是否持续可用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the internal planting recipe, including its required seed and auxiliary resources. This is an internal processing machine rather than an external crop-area accelerator.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入当前回收配方接受的物品并供能，再收集配方产物。回收不是通用垃圾桶：没有回收配方的物品不会因为放进去就被处理。

先用过滤器限制输入，避免把需要保留的成品送进回收链。输出堵塞和共享辅助资源不足也会使工厂停机。
entries.bodyEn: Recycle only items accepted by an installed recipe. Supply energy, collect results and filter inputs deliberately; unsupported items are not automatically destroyed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
材料进入轧制输入槽，供电后按轧机配方加工。使用 JEI 轧制类别核对目标板材等产物，别把冲压模具塞入普通轧制原料格。

批量自动化时持续补料、抽取成品，并检查工厂排序和供电能力。机器存在不代表每一种金属都有已注册的轧制配方。
entries.bodyEn: Use the rolling recipe type and its material input. Keep factory lanes powered and results extracted; a machine does not imply every material has a registered recipe.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向主输入供给待冲压材料，把配方要求的模具放在专用模具/辅助槽，供电后取得冲压件。模具与材料不是同一类输入。

自动化给辅助输入单独过滤，保留本配方所需模具。JEI 的冲压配方类型与压制机处理器组装不同；工厂并行时也要满足共享模具条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the material and required mold through distinct inputs. Filter tooling separately and keep it available. Stamping is a separate recipe type from processor assembly.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

种植站不是对外部农田施加范围加速的方块；不要只在旁边放作物而不给内部配方材料。工厂并行时检查种子、流体与输出是否持续可用。

researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
输入待离心的化学品并持续供能，从化学输出端抽取产物。裂变燃料链通常在这里处理六氟化铀。

它与普通固体离心机不是同一种设备。先从 JEI 查清输出化学品及下游处理方式，再连接反应堆或储罐。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the chemical feed and power, then extract the separated chemical. This is a chemical-processing machine, commonly used for fissile-fuel preparation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入对应的洁净矿浆或其他可结晶化学品并供能，输出固体晶体或颗粒。化学输入与物品输出分开设置。

它只执行 JEI 中的结晶配方，不会自动把任何矿浆变成锭。矿物晶体通常还需回到化学压射等后续链路。
entries.bodyEn: Convert a recipe chemical into a solid with power. Configure chemical input and item output separately. Ore crystals still need the remaining processing stages.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把固体原料与配方要求的化学品一起输入，接电后产出矿浆或其他化学品。矿石线通常先得到未清洗矿浆，再送入化学清洗机。

矿浆、气体都属于化学品传输体系，使用加压管道。机器已有其他类型矿浆或后端堵塞时，会阻止继续处理新原料。
entries.bodyEn: Combine the solid and recipe chemical with power. Ore processing produces dirty slurry for a chemical washer. Slurry uses chemical transport; clear incompatible or blocked output before changing recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.bodyEn: Provide a valid lathing ingredient and power. Factory variants add lanes and need configured I/O and available output space. Other CNC recipe types are not interchangeable.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先在 GUI 选择液体→化学品或化学品→液体，再按方向输入对应资源并供电。反向模式会交换使用的槽和端口。

例如液态乙烯与乙烯不是同一种传输对象：前者接流体管，后者接化学管。储量存在错误物质时，先完成处理或倾倒清空。
entries.bodyEn: Choose fluid-to-chemical or chemical-to-fluid mode before routing resources. Reversing the mode swaps the active inputs and outputs. Fluid and chemical forms require different pipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先区分单物品箱柜、流体罐、化学罐和能量立方的用途，再接相应管道。输入、输出与自动弹出可在 GUI 配置，手持容器的模式则通过物品操作切换。

装有一种物质的罐不能同时容纳不兼容的另一种。升级等级增加容量或传输能力，不会把化学罐变成流体罐；放射性化学品还有额外容纳限制。
entries.bodyEn: Use the container matching the resource type and configure its sides. Tier upgrades do not change a fluid tank into a chemical tank. Existing contents and radioactive restrictions constrain accepted resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
固体原料从物品输入端进入，机器消耗电能并产出化学品。把加压管道接在化学输出面，而不是接物品管。

产出罐满会停止加工。此设备在硫化学和铀燃料处理等链路中承担固体转化学品的步骤；具体类型按 JEI 配方连接。
entries.bodyEn: This machine consumes a solid and power and outputs a chemical. Extract through the chemical output with pressurized tubes; a full output tank stops processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

颜料属于化学品，使用加压管道和化学侧面配置。各机器内部剩余的颜色会限制下一次输入，混色配方和可染物品从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
颜料提取机把兼容染料或彩色物品转成颜料化学品；颜料混合机把两种颜料混成目标色；涂色机把颜料施加到兼容物品。

entries.bodyEn: Extract pigment from compatible items, mix chemical pigments, and apply them in the painting machine. Pigment uses chemical transport; residual colors constrain later recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
把配方指定的种子或植物、培养条件和所需辅助资源送进种植设备，供能后在机器内部取得产物。输入条件按该设备的 JEI 配方逐项核对。

种植站不是对外部农田施加范围加速的方块；不要只在旁边放作物而不给内部配方材料。工厂并行时检查种子、流体与输出是否持续可用。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the internal planting recipe, including its required seed and auxiliary resources. This is an internal processing machine rather than an external crop-area accelerator.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
压制机按主输入、第二输入和第三输入组合材料。例如处理器组装使用印刷电路、红石与印刷硅片；这类配方不使用数控冲压模具槽。

三路物品按各自侧面类别过滤，任一路不足都会停机。工厂并行时共用的辅助材料也需要足够数量，输出留出空间。
entries.bodyEn: The presser combines primary, secondary and tertiary item inputs, such as printed circuit, redstone and printed silicon. Filter each input category and supply shared auxiliaries for factory lanes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
这类配方可同时要求物品、流体、化学品和能量。把每类资源分别接入对应端口，保持固体与化学品两个输出都可排出。

乙烯、基片、HDPE 等处理链可能使用不同输入组合，切换前检查罐内残留。不要因为主产物已输出就忽略另一种产物，副产化学品满罐也会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Supply all item, fluid, chemical and energy inputs. Extract both solid and chemical products. Check residual tank contents when changing recipes; a full byproduct tank also blocks operation.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
输入当前回收配方接受的物品并供能，再收集配方产物。回收不是通用垃圾桶：没有回收配方的物品不会因为放进去就被处理。

先用过滤器限制输入，避免把需要保留的成品送进回收链。输出堵塞和共享辅助资源不足也会使工厂停机。
entries.bodyEn: Recycle only items accepted by an installed recipe. Supply energy, collect results and filter inputs deliberately; unsupported items are not automatically destroyed.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
复制设备通过本机配方消耗 UU 物质等指定资源与能量，产出目标物品、流体或化学品。它不是任意物品扫描后无消耗生成。

物品复制器、流体复制器和化学复制器的目标与输出类型不同，接对应容器。只以当前 JEI 显示的有效复制配方为准，配置中不存在的目标不能靠放入样本启用。
entries.bodyEn: Replicators consume their configured replication resource and power for supported recipes. Item, fluid and chemical variants have distinct output types; arbitrary samples do not create recipes.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
材料进入轧制输入槽，供电后按轧机配方加工。使用 JEI 轧制类别核对目标板材等产物，别把冲压模具塞入普通轧制原料格。

批量自动化时持续补料、抽取成品，并检查工厂排序和供电能力。机器存在不代表每一种金属都有已注册的轧制配方。
entries.bodyEn: Use the rolling recipe type and its material input. Keep factory lanes powered and results extracted; a machine does not imply every material has a registered recipe.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
向主输入供给待冲压材料，把配方要求的模具放在专用模具/辅助槽，供电后取得冲压件。模具与材料不是同一类输入。

自动化给辅助输入单独过滤，保留本配方所需模具。JEI 的冲压配方类型与压制机处理器组装不同；工厂并行时也要满足共享模具条件。
entries.bodyEn: Supply the material and required mold through distinct inputs. Filter tooling separately and keep it available. Stamping is a separate recipe type from processor assembly.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
输入未清洗矿浆、水与电能，输出洁净矿浆。水走流体管，矿浆走化学管，两种管道不能互换。

把洁净矿浆送入化学结晶器。切换不同矿物前，先清空或处理完输出侧残留矿浆，避免不同类型互相阻塞。
entries.bodyEn: Feed dirty slurry, water and power. Water uses fluid transport; slurry uses chemical transport. Send clean slurry to crystallization and avoid mixing incompatible slurry types.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
给充能站供电并在界面配置可充能范围、对象和安全选项。目标装备必须支持能量充电，并位于有效工作条件内。

无线充能不会把无储能的普通物品变成电池。多名玩家和多个装备同时充电时，总功率会被分摊。
entries.bodyEn: Power the charging station and configure its supported targets, access and work conditions. Only energy-capable items can charge; concurrent targets share available transfer.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
给两端选择相同频率和相同访问范围，并分别配置各类资源的输入、输出。物品、流体、化学品、能量等各自使用对应的侧面标签。

它连接的是频率库存，不能给目标机器凭空补充能量。两端区块和工作设备都要保持可用，公有与私有频率也不能只凭名字相同就互通。
entries.bodyEn: Match frequency and access scope at both ends, then configure each resource separately. The frequency is a shared buffer, not a free power source. Keep both endpoints available.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
打开机器侧面配置，先选物品、流体、化学品或能量标签，再给各个面指定输入、输出或禁用。冶金灌注机还要区分主物品与灌注原料输入。

输出面配置好后，再开启对应资源的自动弹出；管道抽取也可在来源连接处设为拉取。只接上一根管道不一定会开始传输。配置器的模式影响操作对象，潜行配合模式切换键切换模式。
entries.bodyEn: Select the resource tab before assigning side modes. Infusion ingredients have a separate item input. Enable auto-eject or configure the extracting connection to pull. Configurator modes target different resources.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
操作步骤
1. 给配置器充能并持在手中。潜行并按“切换手持工具模式”，查看工具提示中的当前模式；物品、流体、化学品、能量、清空、旋转与扳手功能不能混用。
2. 在对应资源的配置模式中，右键机器侧面读取其配置；潜行＋右键循环该面可用的输入、输出或禁用状态。
3. 调整管道时对准机器与管道之间的连接段，潜行＋右键切换 Normal / Pull / Push / None。对准中间的管身和对准接口是不同目标。

输入与输出
机器 GUI 的侧面配置先选资源类型，再选侧面；灌注原料与主物品可能是不同通道。设为输出后还要检查该资源自动弹出，或在来源处让管道 Pull。只把机器设成输出不会让普通库存自行抽取。

注意事项
清空模式会把机器物品弹出，不等于清空所有化学品；扳手模式潜行＋右键可拆卸支持的设备，操作前确认模式和指向。多方块没有成型时尝试对框架使用配置器读取诊断。
entries.bodyEn:
Charge and hold the Configurator. Sneak and press the held-item mode key; inspect the selected mode before interacting.

In the matching resource configuration mode, right-click a machine face to inspect it and sneak-right-click to cycle its supported states. On transmitters, target the connection segment and sneak-right-click through Normal, Pull, Push and None. The central pipe body is a different target.

In machine side configuration, select the resource type before the face. Infusion material may use a different channel from the main ingredient. Enable auto-ejection or configure the source connection to Pull. Empty mode ejects items; wrench mode can dismantle supported equipment. Using it on an unformed multiblock may provide a diagnostic.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
驱动阵列装入 QIO 驱动器，并在阵列、仪表板、输入器和输出器上选择同一频率。驱动器同时有总物品数量与类型数量限制。

QIO 仅存物品，不存流体、化学品或能量。输出器按过滤器向相邻库存备货，输入器把库存物品收进频率；便携仪表板也需要绑定频率。QIO 本体不靠 FE 维持存储。
entries.bodyEn: Install QIO drives and match the frequency on all devices. QIO stores items only and has count/type limits. Importers collect items; exporters stock adjacent inventories.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
使用传送机方块与传送框架构成有效门，向底部设备供能并设置频率。目的地必须是同频率且可用的传送设施。

便携传送器选择目的频率后消耗储能传送。只有框架而没有有效控制设备、供能或可加载目的地时，界面不会显示可用传送。
entries.bodyEn: Form a teleporter with its frames, power it and set a frequency. Portable teleporters require energy and an available destination at the selected frequency.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
先在机器界面设置配方，用合成公式保存或锁定，再提供原料与能量。界面中的库存管理和自动模式控制是否持续合成。

此设备执行工作台类合成，不会替代熔炼、化学加工等机器。锁定输入格后应只送入对应原料，并及时抽取输出，避免配方位置被占错。
entries.bodyEn: Encode or set the crafting formula, supply ingredients and power, and select automatic mode. It performs crafting-grid recipes, not arbitrary machine processing.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
外壳内布置裂变燃料组件，并在每列顶部安装控制棒组件；端口分别承担燃料输入、冷却剂、加热后冷却剂和核废料输出。结构成形后先补足冷却剂，再以低燃烧速率启动。

裂变反应堆主要产热，不应把它当作直接输出 FE 的发电机。水冷蒸汽通常送涡轮；钠冷则通过锅炉交换热量。废料满罐、蒸汽堵塞或回水中断都会影响冷却，停堆后仍要观察温度与损伤。
entries.bodyEn: Form fuel columns with control rods and configure coolant, fuel and waste ports. Start at a low burn rate after filling coolant. Fission produces heat; turbines convert steam to FE. Continue monitoring cooling after shutdown.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
在正方形底面上搭建竖直涡轮，转子居中、叶片成对安装；旋转复合体周围的同层布置压力分散器，上部放电磁线圈、排气口和需要的饱和冷凝器。

输入蒸汽，从能量端输出 FE；装有冷凝器时，把回收水导回供水系统。发电受蒸汽吞吐、线圈、叶片等共同限制。能量缓存满时蒸汽消耗会减少，回水也可能下降，核冷却链必须考虑这种情况。
entries.bodyEn: Build the rotor, blades, disperser plane and upper coils/vents correctly. Feed steam and extract FE. Condensers return water; full energy storage reduces steam consumption and can affect reactor cooling.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
组装聚变结构并确认控制器界面成形。电动泵过滤重水，电解得到氘；热力蒸馏链和太阳能中子活化器可准备氚。把填有氘氚燃料的黑体辐射腔放入控制器，再用蓄能激光从聚焦矩阵点火。

分别输入氘与氚时要设置并维持喷射速率。直接输入预混合氘氚燃料的消耗行为不同，不要按分离燃料的喷射限制估算供料。点火成功后持续供料；水冷时还需抽出大量蒸汽。
entries.bodyEn: Prepare deuterium, tritium and a fueled hohlraum, then ignite through the laser focus matrix. Separate fuels use the configured injection rate; premixed D-T fuel behaves differently. Keep fuel and any cooling routes continuous.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
当前版本反应堆占九乘九乘九的结构区域，控制器必须在顶部正中心；使用硅岩反应堆外壳、兼容玻璃、端口与铅涂层激光聚焦矩阵，不能把普通聚变堆的外壳整套替用。成形后查看控制器状态。

把装有所需硅铀燃料的硅岩黑体辐射腔放入启动槽，用激光经专用聚焦矩阵加热点火。持续供给富硅岩与富铀两路燃料，或直接供应接受的硅铀燃料；输入速率影响运行。

水冷模式要供应水并抽走含钋蒸汽，该产物是化学品。端口的方向用配置器设置，能量、燃料、水和含钋蒸汽分别接兼容管路。具体启动温度与容量读取当前配置和 GUI，不套用旧版教程的固定数值。
entries.bodyEn: The installed reactor occupies a 9×9×9 area and requires its controller at the top center. Use dedicated casing, ports and laser matrix. Ignite a filled Naquadah Hohlraum, sustain accepted fuels and configure ports. Water cooling produces polonium-containing steam, a chemical output.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
核废料要进入可容纳放射性化学品的桶与化学管路。保留废料监测和处理余量，不能用普通流体桶代替。含放射性内容的设备在被拆除、内容被丢失等情况下可能释放辐射。

废料可按 JEI 进入钋/钚等处理链；核废料桶的可衰变类型并不等于所有放射性物都能消失。停堆后先处理残余废料与冷却，再拆设备；防化服和辐射检测物品用于判断、隔离游戏中的辐射风险。
entries.bodyEn: Use compatible radioactive chemical containment and keep waste processing available. Not every radioactive chemical decays in a waste barrel. Handle residual waste and cooling before dismantling, and use in-game radiation equipment.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

在改造站放入兼容装备和模块，再安装或移除模块。不同模块有装备位置、数量和启用状态限制；装备还需要充能才能发挥能耗型能力。

查看模块配置界面调整模式和消耗。模块不等于普通机器升级，不能放入工厂升级槽；卸下模块也不会凭空增加装备储能。

entries.body:
把升级放进机器的升级栏，而不是原料格。速度升级会提高吞吐，也可能显著提高耗能和化学消耗；能量升级用于缓解能耗或改善缓冲。

过滤、化学效率、锚定等升级只在明确支持的设备中生效。阶层安装器对支持的方块使用以升级等级，通常保留库存与配置，但不能对所有机器一概使用。
entries.bodyEn: Install supported upgrades in upgrade slots. Speed increases resource demand; energy upgrades mitigate costs. Specialized upgrades and tier installers work only on compatible devices.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
液化器把兼容食物转为营养浆，需要物品输入、供能和流体输出。容器或装备的营养消耗装置使用此类营养资源。

配套食堂/装备必须有实际储量并启用对应功能。不要把营养浆当作气体送进化学管道。
entries.bodyEn: Convert compatible food into nutritional paste with power, then transfer it through fluid interfaces to supported canteens or equipment.
researchSource: installed Mekanism 10.7.19 descriptions, GUI labels and recipes

entries.body:
操作步骤
打开通用机械机器 GUI，把滴量器拿在鼠标光标上，对准流体或化学品储槽操作。左键从储槽取出可容纳的介质，右键把滴量器中的介质送入兼容储槽；操作后悬停滴量器确认内容和数量。

故障排查
不能混装不兼容介质。机器因残留错误介质而卡住时，先移走错误输入并停掉上游，再用滴量器取出；否则抽掉后会立即又被灌入。潜行＋左键储槽可删除储槽内容，执行前确认这批介质确实不要了。

注意事项
滴量器只处理兼容的 GUI 储槽，不能当作世界水桶或任意模组通用管道。携带介质的滴量器会保留内容，不要只凭物品外观判断为空。
entries.bodyEn:
Pick up the Gauge Dropper on the cursor in a Mekanism machine GUI. Left-click a compatible fluid or chemical gauge to draw from it; right-click to insert the dropper's contents. Inspect the tooltip afterward.

Stop the incorrect upstream input before removing a contaminating chemical. Sneak-left-clicking a gauge can delete its contents; verify the target first. Incompatible media cannot be mixed. The dropper works with compatible GUI gauges rather than as a universal world bucket.

entries.body:
操作步骤
充能后手持工具，按模式切换键查看当前挖掘模式。不同模式改变挖掘速度与能耗；关闭模式、普通/慢速/快速模式和范围挖掘模式的可用性受当前配置限制。

使用条件
工具需要可用能量。范围模式会作用于预期以外的相连方块，切换后先检查工具提示，不要把它与 FTB 连锁键混为一谈。装备状态、模式和目标方块共同影响能否挖掘。

故障排查
完全不挖时检查是否处于关闭模式、电量是否足够以及方块保护；能挖但速度不符先确认当前模式。当前客户端实际模式键见上表，不沿用旧 Wiki 默认的 M。
entries.bodyEn:
Charge and hold the tool, then use the held-item mode key to inspect and cycle mining modes. Speed, energy cost and available area-mining modes follow the installed configuration.

Check the mode before mining connected blocks. This tool's mode and FTB Ultimine are separate systems. If mining fails, inspect disabled mode, charge and protection; if speed differs, inspect the selected mode. Do not assume an old guide's default M key.

entries.zh: 扳手：旋转、拆卸与接口朝向
entries.body:
操作步骤
手持扳手右键支持的机械动力方块，围绕点击面的轴调整朝向。潜行＋右键拆卸支持的部件并回收；传送带、漏斗、管道及其他连接组件依照它们自己的可调整状态响应。

输入与输出
漏斗送不出、机械臂取不到物品时先看箭头与接口朝向。转动机器会改变连接关系，齿轮、轴、皮带和流体口都要重新核对。对准不同面可能得到不同旋转轴。

故障排查
没有反应先确认目标支持扳手以及是否在领地保护范围内。不要把所有模组扳手当作机械动力扳手的完全替代品；各自支持的拆卸和旋转逻辑不同。
entries.bodyEn:
Right-click a supported Create component with the wrench to rotate it around the clicked face. Sneak-right-click dismantles supported components. Belts, funnels, pipes and other connections have their own adjustable states.

Inspect arrows and face directions when a funnel or Mechanical Arm cannot transfer. Rotation can change shaft, gear, belt and fluid connections. If nothing happens, check support and protection; other mods' wrenches are not necessarily equivalent.

entries.zh: 工程师护目镜：看转速与应力
entries.body:
操作步骤
佩戴工程师护目镜，对准机械动力机器和传动组件读取信息。转速表观察转速与旋转方向，应力表观察动力网络负载；它们与护目镜提供的是诊断，不会自动增加动力。

故障排查
整条线停转：先确认动力源正在输出，再检查是否过载、传动是否断开、齿轮或轴是否接反。提高转速也会提高许多机器的应力需求，不能只给末端加变速器就认为所有设备都会更快。

加工停住
网络仍转而机器不加工时，检查所需最低转速、旋转方向、物品位置、配方条件和输出空间。应力足够只说明能驱动，不代表加工条件满足。流体设备另查泵方向、管路和目标储槽。
entries.bodyEn:
Wear Engineer Goggles and look at Create machinery and transmission components. Speedometers show speed and direction; Stressometers show network load. These are diagnostics, not power sources.

For a stopped network, check the source, overstress, broken connections and opposed rotation. Higher speed often increases stress requirements. If the network turns but processing stops, check minimum speed, direction, ingredients, placement and output space; inspect pump directions and tanks for fluid machines.

entries.zh: 思索：查看动态机器教程
entries.body:
操作步骤
在物品界面把鼠标悬停在机械动力物品上，按住提示中的 W 打开思索。该按键是当前模组提示中的固定入口，不是本手册给所有模组统一绑定的“教程键”。

阅读方法
等待动画逐段演示，结合高亮方块和说明理解输入、输出及结构。遇到多个主题可切换主题查看，同一机器可能把基础工作方式与自动化分成不同场景。

配方区别
思索展示工作原理；其中出现的物品组合不一定就是本包改过的实际配方。制作和加工数量继续查本包 JEI，不能照搬原版思索材料数量。
entries.bodyEn:
Hover a Create item and hold the W shown in its tooltip to open Ponder. Follow the animation, highlighted blocks and captions; inspect additional scenes for automation details.

Ponder explains mechanics. Its example ingredients may differ from this modpack's recipes, so use the pack's JEI entries for actual ingredients and quantities.

entries.zh: 蓝图：部署、移动、旋转与开炮
entries.body:
操作步骤
用蓝图与笔选择区域并保存，或在蓝图桌把已存在的蓝图写入空白蓝图。手持蓝图部署预览，按住蓝图工具菜单键并滚轮选择移动、旋转等工具，再按屏幕提示调整。确认位置、朝向和高度后才交给加农炮。

输入与输出
在加农炮 GUI 放入已经部署的蓝图，提供火药，在相邻库存放材料。放入书或剪贴板可制作材料清单。设置替换策略、是否跳过缺料以及如何处理原有方块后启动。

故障排查
不施工先检查蓝图是否部署、目标是否在可施工范围、火药、材料和红石状态。预览位置错误应先暂停并取回蓝图重新部署；蓝图记录结构，不会免除材料消耗。
entries.bodyEn:
Select and save a region with Schematic and Quill, or write an existing file using the Schematic Table. Deploy the preview. Hold the schematic menu key and scroll between manipulation tools, then follow the on-screen instructions to set position and rotation.

Insert the deployed schematic into the cannon, supply gunpowder and adjacent material inventories, and print a material list with a book or clipboard. Review replacement and missing-material policies before starting. For no construction, inspect deployment, reach, fuel, materials and redstone.

entries.body: 用水车、风车或其他动力源带动轴、齿轮和传动部件。机器除了转速还受应力容量限制；用护目镜和应力表检查网络。
entries.bodyEn: Connect shafts and gears to a kinetic source. Machines require sufficient speed and stress capacity. Goggles and stressometers inspect the network.

entries.body: 机械动力从机器轴接入。压制机向下压工作物品或置物台；搅拌器下方放工作盆，按配方加入物品/流体，需加热的配方在盆下方放置符合条件的热源。
entries.bodyEn: Provide rotation at the shaft. A press works on a depot or basin; a mixer works over a basin containing the recipe inputs. Heated recipes need a suitable heat source below the basin.

entries.body: 磨石从顶部接收物品，供给旋转动力后从侧面抽取产物。粉碎轮成对相对旋转，把物品送入两轮中间。
entries.bodyEn: Feed items into the top of a powered millstone and extract from its sides. Crushing wheels must form a counter-rotating pair; feed the gap between them.

entries.body: 给鼓风机提供旋转动力，让气流经过配方要求的水、熔岩、火或其他介质，再吹向物品。不同介质对应洗涤、熔炼、烟熏或其他加工。
entries.bodyEn: Power the fan and direct its airflow through the required medium, then across items. Water, lava, fire and other media provide different processing modes.

entries.body: 机械手持有所需物品，喷口储存所需液体，物品由置物台或传送带经过工作区。序列组装按 JEI 顺序重复；动力合成器需按图连接输出路径并统一启动。
entries.bodyEn: Equip deployers and fill spouts, then route items through their work areas. Sequenced assembly follows JEI order and repetition counts. Mechanical crafters need a connected output path and activation.

entries.body: 漏斗负责容器与传送带之间转移，溜槽传送垂直物品，机械臂先用扳手选择输入和输出端再放置。黄铜部件可提供更细的过滤与数量控制。
entries.bodyEn: Funnels connect inventories and belts; chutes handle vertical movement. Configure mechanical-arm inputs and outputs before placing it. Brass components offer finer filters and quantity control.

entries.body: 把需要运动的方块用强力胶或底盘连接成整体，再用轴承、活塞、绳索滑轮或列车结构装配。与静态仓库交换物品时使用匹配的便携式接口。
entries.bodyEn: Attach moving blocks with super glue or chassis, then assemble using bearings, pistons, pulleys or trains. Use matching portable interfaces to exchange contents with stationary storage.

entries.zh: 使用模拟拉杆控制红石信号
entries.en: Controlling signals using the Analog Lever
entries.body:
模拟拉杆可提供紧凑而精确的红石信号源

右击会提升输出的模拟信号的强度

潜行右击会减少输出的模拟信号的强度
entries.bodyEn:
Analog Levers make for a compact and precise source of redstone power

Right-click to increase its analog power output

Right-click while Sneaking to decrease the power output again

entries.body:
安山隧道可用于遮掩传送带

当安山隧道与侧边有连接时……

……经过的所有物品堆都会被精准地分出一个物品

剩下的物品则不受影响，继续前进
entries.bodyEn:
Andesite Tunnels can be used to cover up your belts

Whenever an Andesite Tunnel has connections to the sides...

...they will split exactly one item off of any passing stacks

The remainder will continue on its path

entries.body:
时刻表可用于为司机提供目的地

当有列车到站时，比较器会检测到一个信号

注意，只能从指示的方向驶入车站

车站也可以用于自动分配新的时刻表

放置在车站上的时刻表会自动复制到当前列车上

与手动调度相反，司机不会携带物品在身上
entries.bodyEn:
Schedules can be used to provide drivers with a destination

Comparators will receive a signal whenever a Train is present

Mind that a Station can only be approached from the indicated direction

Stations can also be used to assign new Schedules automatically

The Schedule placed on a station will automatically copy itself to present trains

As opposed to manual scheduling, drivers will not take the item with them

entries.body:
一个可以对放入的物品以及流体进行处理的盆

处理完毕后，工作盆会尝试从它的侧面向下方输出

若在正确的位置上放置了有效的组件，工作盆会显示出一个输出口

有多种设备可以使得工作盆变为该形态

产物会被输出到盆下方的容器内

如果输出口没有显示，那么盆内的产物将会一直留存在盆内

这在产物需要作为新一轮处理的原料时相当有用

需要输出的产物仍需从盆内取出

你可能需要过滤器来避免未被处理的物品被输出出去
entries.bodyEn:
A Basin can hold Items and Fluids for Processing

After a processing step, basins try to output below to the side of them

When a valid component is present, the Basin will show an output faucet

A number of options are applicable here

Outputs will be caught by the inventory below

Without output faucet, the Basin will retain items created in its processing

This can be useful if outputs should be re-used as ingredients

Desired outputs will then have to be extracted from the basin

A Filter might be necessary to avoid pulling out un-processed items

entries.en: Movement Modes of the Mechanical Bearing
entries.body:
停止时，轴承会控制结构以特定的角度停在最近的与网格相对齐之处

你可以调整使整个结构永不方块化，或者仅在结构的起始位置方块化
entries.bodyEn:
When Stopped, the Bearing will place the structure at the nearest grid-aligned Angle

It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only near the angle it started at

entries.body:
手持传送带右击两根传动杆，可以将两根杆连接起来

如果不小心选错了，潜行右击即可取消选择

你也可以在传送带的中间加装额外的传动杆

通过传送带连接的传动杆，会以相同的转速以及方向进行旋转

加装的传动杆可以用扳手拆下来

传送带亦可染色
entries.bodyEn:
Right-Clicking two shafts with a belt item will connect them together

Accidental selections can be canceled with Right-Click while Sneaking

Additional Shafts can be added throughout the Belt

Shafts connected via Belts will rotate with Identical Speed and Direction

Added shafts can be removed using the wrench

Mechanical Belts can be dyed for aesthetic purposes

entries.zh: 传送带的有效连接方向
entries.body:
传送带的连接方向并不是任意的

1. 可以水平连接

2. 可以对角连接

3. 可以垂直连接

4. 还可以水平连接竖直放置的传动杆

以上为所有可能的连接方向，传送带的连接范围为 2 到 20 格
entries.bodyEn:
Belts cannot connect in arbitrary directions

1. They can connect horizontally

2. They can connect diagonally

3. They can connect vertically

4. And they can connect vertical shafts horizontally

These are all possible directions. Belts can span any Length between 2 and 20 blocks

entries.body:
烈焰人燃烧室可以为工作盆的物品处理提供热量

为此，你需要喂给烈焰人一些燃料

如果喂给它烈焰蛋糕，它还能达到更强的热量等级

你可以用机械手或者动力臂进行自动补充
entries.bodyEn:
Blaze Burners can provide Heat to Items processed in a Basin

For this, the Blaze has to be fed with flammable items

With a Blaze Cake, the Burner can reach an even stronger level of heat

The feeding process can be automated using Deployers or Mechanical Arms

entries.body:
安山岩漏斗一次只能提取出一个物品

黄铜漏斗可以一次提取一组物品

使用面板可以精确调节黄铜漏斗的提取数量。

对着过滤槽使用某个物品，可以限制漏斗的行为，使其只传输匹配的物品
entries.bodyEn:
Andesite Funnels can only ever extract single items.

Brass Funnels can extract up to a full stack.

The value panel allows for precise control over the extracted stack size.

Using items on the filter slot will restrict the funnel to only transfer matching stacks.

entries.body:
黄铜隧道可以遮掩住你的传送带

隧道的每一个开口面都有过滤槽

在输入处的过滤槽仅会阻挡住不匹配的物品

输出处的过滤槽可用于以种类为依据的物品整理

当通过的物品有多个有效输出端时，那么隧道的分配模式将会决定这些物品何去何从

连接了平行传送带的黄铜隧道，会将隧道、传送带组成一个组

输入的物品现在会分配到所有连接的输出端

在这一情况下，你也可以将物品直接输入到隧道方块中
entries.bodyEn:
Brass Tunnels can be used to cover up your belts

Brass Tunnels have filter slots on each open side

Filters on inbound connections simply block non-matching items

Filters on outbound connections can be used to sort items by type

Whenever a passing item has multiple valid exits, the distribution mode will decide how to handle it

Brass Tunnels on parallel belts will form a group

Incoming Items will now be distributed across all connected exits

For this, items can also be inserted into the Tunnel block directly

entries.en: Distribution Modes of the Brass Tunnel
entries.body:
黄铜隧道的分配模式可以调节

“分流”会尝试在可用输出端之间均匀分配物品堆

如果某个输出端无法容纳更多的物品，那它会被跳过，不参与计算

“强制分流”不会跳过某个输出端，而是一直等待此输出端能够容纳更多物品，才会继续物品传输

“轮询调度”会保持物品堆完整，循环检索各个输出端，满足条件后分配整堆物品

与分流类似，如果某个输出端无法容纳更多物品，那它会被跳过

“强制轮询调度”不会跳过某个输出端

“最近优先”会将物品优先分配到距离输入端更近的输出端

“随机”会随机选择一个输出端，一次性分配整堆物品

“同步输入”是黄铜隧道的一种特殊设定

只有在组内全部的隧道都有一个等待通过的物品时，物品才能通过此隧道

这确保了所有受影响的传送带能够以相同的速率进行物品补给
entries.bodyEn:
The distribution behaviour of Brass Tunnels can be configured

'Split' will attempt to distribute the stack evenly between available outputs

If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped

'Forced Split' will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free

'Round Robin' keeps stacks whole, and cycles through outputs iteratively

Once Again, if an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped

'Forced Round Robin' never skips outputs

'Prefer Nearest' prioritizes the outputs closest to the items' input location

'Randomize' will distribute whole stacks to randomly picked outputs

'Synchronize Inputs' is a unique setting for Brass Tunnels

Items are only allowed past if every tunnel in the group has one waiting

This ensures that all affected belts supply items at the same rate

entries.zh: 使用矿车装配站移动结构
entries.body:
矿车装配站会将它所连接的结构安装到矿车上

若没有通入红石信号，它会将矿车结构拆解为方块的形式

对着结构化的矿车使用你的扳手，就可以将其变为物品形式
entries.bodyEn:
Powered Cart Assemblers mount attached structures to passing Minecarts

Without a redstone signal, it disassembles passing cart contraptions back into blocks

Using a Wrench on the Minecart will let you carry the Contraption elsewhere

entries.body:
若两个矿车装配站连接在同一结构下……

给其中的任意一方的矿车装配站通入红石信号，都会组装矿车结构

两辆矿车此时的行为与用矿车连轴器连接在一起时十分相似
entries.bodyEn:
Whenever two Cart Assemblers share an attached structure...

Powering either of them will create a Carriage Contraption

The carts will behave like those connected via Minecart Coupling

entries.body:
矿车结构会随着矿车的运动而发生转向

该箭头将指定结构的哪一侧会被视为“正面”

如果装配站的配置为“旋转锁定”，那么结构的方向将不会改变
entries.bodyEn:
Cart Contraptions will rotate to face towards their carts' motion

This Arrow indicates which side of the Structure will be considered the front

If the Assembler is set to Lock Rotation, the contraptions' orientation will never change

entries.zh: 另外几种矿车以及铁轨
entries.en: Other types of Minecarts and Rails
entries.body:
放置在普通轨道上的矿车装配站并不会影响路过的矿车结构

如果放置在动力铁轨或控制铁轨上且没有通入红石信号，矿车结构将停在此处，直到再次充能

另外的几种矿车可以当作锚点来使用

动力矿车会试图始终保持燃烧状态，并从任何连接的容器内提取燃料
entries.bodyEn:
Cart Assemblers on Regular Tracks will not affect the passing carts' motion

When on Powered or Controller Rail, the carts will be held in place until it's Powered

Other types of Minecarts can be used as the anchor

Furnace Carts will keep themselves powered, pulling fuel from any attached inventories

entries.zh: 使用锁链传动轮传递旋转力
entries.en: Relaying rotational force using Chain Conveyors
entries.body:
右击两个锁链传动轮以连接它们

锁链传动轮之间可以互相传递旋转力……

……并连接到它们上方或下方的传动杆

手持扳手时右击可以在锁链上移动

在交汇处，面向某条锁链的方向即可跟随它运动
entries.bodyEn:
Right-click two conveyors with chains to connect them

Chain conveyors relay rotational power between each other..

..and connect to shafts above or below them

Right-click holding a wrench to start travelling on the chain

At a junction, face towards a chain to follow it

entries.zh: 使用链式传动箱传动旋转力
entries.en: Relaying rotational force with Chain Drives
entries.body:
同一行上的链式传动箱会相互间传递旋转

所有以此种方式连接的传动杆都会以相同的方向进行旋转

同一行的传动箱内的任意一个传动箱，旋转 90 度之后仍可以正常工作
entries.bodyEn:
Chain Drives relay rotation to each other in a row

All shafts connected like this will rotate in the same direction

Any part of the row can be rotated by 90 degrees

entries.zh: 利用可调节链式传动箱进行转速调节
entries.en: Controlling rotational speed with Chain Gearshifts
entries.body:
未充能的可调节链式传动箱与普通链式传动箱无异

当被充能时，它会将转速加倍并将其传动至其他链式传动箱

若被充能的可调节传动箱并不是动力输入端，它会把转速减半

在这两种情况中，同一组的其他链式传动箱的转速都为被充能的可调节链式传动箱的两倍

转速的倍率可在 ×1 和 ×2 间根据红石信号的强弱来精确调整

12 RPM
entries.bodyEn:
Unpowered Chain Gearshifts behave exactly like Chain Drives

When Powered, the speed transmitted to other Chain Drives in the row is doubled

Whenever the Powered Gearshift is not at the source, its speed will be halved instead

In both cases, Chain Drives in the row always run at 2x the speed of the Powered Gearshift

Using analog signals, the ratio can be adjusted more precisely between 1 and 2

12 RPM

entries.zh: 使用溜槽向下运输物品
entries.body:
溜槽可在两个容器之间垂直传输物品

使用扳手右击可以在溜槽上设置观察窗

工业铁块可用于装饰溜槽

对着另一个溜槽的侧面放置溜槽，将会放置下一个斜向的溜槽
entries.bodyEn:
Chutes can transport items vertically from and to inventories

Using the Wrench, a window can be created

Using Industrial Iron Blocks, chutes can be encased

Placing chutes targeting the side faces of another will make it diagonal

entries.zh: 使用溜槽向上运输物品
entries.body:
在溜槽上或下方使用鼓风机时，物品会根据风的方向向上或下移动

佩戴工程师护目镜时，你可以看见物品的移动方向

若溜槽的末端被挡住，则物品只能从侧边进行提取或输入
entries.bodyEn:
Using Encased Fans at the top or bottom, a Chute can move items upward

Inspecting chutes with Engineers' Goggles reveals information about the movement direction

On the 'blocked' end, items will have to be inserted/taken from the sides

entries.zh: 使用时钟轴承移动结构
entries.body:
时钟轴承会黏着其正面上的方块

当接受旋转力时，其附着结构会根据游戏内时间来进行旋转

右击可以激活/停止结构运动

在时针前方可添加第二个结构

请确保这两个结构没有互相被例如强力胶等方式黏附

第二个结构将会作为分针进行旋转
entries.bodyEn:
Clockwork Bearings attach to blocks in front of them

Upon receiving Rotational Force, the structure will be rotated according to the hour of the day

Right-Click the bearing to start or stop animating the structure

In front of the Hour Hand, a second structure can be added

Ensure that the two Structures are not glued to each other

The Second Structure will now rotate as the Minute Hand

entries.body:
大齿轮与小齿轮可以斜向传递动力

从大齿轮传递动力至小齿轮时，转速翻倍

从小齿轮传递动力至大齿轮时，转速减半
entries.bodyEn:
Large and Small cogs can be connected diagonally

Shifting from large to small cogs, the conveyed speed will be doubled

Shifting the opposite way, the conveyed speed will be halved

entries.body:
安山机壳或黄铜机壳，可以用来装饰齿轮

在装壳后添加的组件将不会与传动轴相连

扳手可用于切换连接
entries.bodyEn:
Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Cogwheels

Components added after encasing will not connect to the shaft outputs

The Wrench can be used to toggle connections

entries.body:
动态结构上的元件默认情况下总是启用的

动态结构控制器可以在运动时移动控制它们

它们能被放在动态结构中的任何地方

当方块化时，过滤器可以被更改成特定的目标元件

当它在实体化时收到了红石信号……

……目标元件将会一开始就被关闭
entries.bodyEn:
Actors on moving contraptions are always active by default

Contraption Controls can be used to toggle them on the fly

They can be attached anywhere on the contraption

While disassembled, the filter can be changed to target specific types of actors

If it is redstone-activated during assembly...

...targeted actors will be turned off from the start

entries.body:
一对粉碎轮，磨物快又准

接入的旋转必须使得这两个轮子啮合转动

扔入或者放入的物品都会被粉碎处理

你也可以使用自动化方案进行物品的输入与取出
entries.bodyEn:
A pair of Crushing Wheels can grind items very effectively

Their Rotational Input has to make them spin into each other

Items thrown or inserted into the top will get processed

Items can be inserted and picked up through automated means as well

entries.body:
接入旋转力，机械手便可以模仿玩家的交互行为

它只会与它正前方第 2 格处的位置进行交互

放在在它面前的方块不会阻拦它的工作

机械手可以：

以及攻击生物

对着机械手的前部右击，即可将手上的物品给予它使用

物品也可以自动化输入到机械手内

机械手附带一个过滤槽

设定了过滤后，只有它手中的物品与过滤相匹配时，它才会工作

只有与过滤匹配的物品才可输入……

……只有不匹配的物品可被抽取出来
entries.bodyEn:
Given Rotational Force, a Deployer can imitate player interactions

It will always interact with the position 2 blocks in front of itself

Blocks directly in front will not obstruct it

Deployers can:

Place Blocks,

Use Items,

Activate Blocks,

Harvest blocks

and Attack Mobs

Right-click the front to give it an Item to use

Items can also be inserted automatically

Deployers carry a filter slot

When a filter is set, it activates only while holding a matching item

Only items matching the filter can now be inserted...

...and only non-matching items will be extracted

entries.body:
当机械手在动态结构上时……

机械手会对每一个经过的方块使用结构中任意容器内的物品

过滤槽可用于指定要抽取的物品
entries.bodyEn:
Whenever Deployers are moved as part of an animated Contraption...

They activate at each visited location, using items from inventories anywhere on the contraption

The Filter slot can be used to specify which items to pull

entries.body:
当机械手持有合适的物品时，它可以自动处理下方的物品

物品可以被丢在机械手下方，或放在置物台上

当传送带上的物品经过机械手下方时……

……机械手会使物品停下，然后处理这个物品
entries.bodyEn:
With a fitting held item, Deployers can process items provided beneath them

The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Deployer

When items are provided on a belt...

The Deployer will hold and process them automatically

entries.body:
当被红石充能时，机械手会停止工作

在停止工作前，机械手会完成当前正在进行的工作周期

因此，通入单次负红石脉冲可以精确控制机械手，使其每次只进行单个周期的工作
entries.bodyEn:
When powered by Redstone, Deployers will not activate

Before stopping, the Deployer will finish any started cycles

Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle

entries.body:
置物台可以被当成一个“静止的”传送带原件使用

右击可以手动放置或取下物品

与传送带一样，它也可以将其内的物品转送到其他设备中进行加工……

……同时物品也可以被机械手存取
entries.bodyEn:
Depots can serve as 'stationary' belt elements

Right-Click to manually place or remove Items from it

Just like Mechanical Belts, it can provide items to processing

...as well as provide Items to Mechanical Arms

entries.body:
翻牌显示器是告示牌的可扩展替代品

它们需要旋转力以供运作

可以使用已书写的剪贴板设置静态文本

使用显示链接器显示动态文本

可以使用染料来改变单行的颜色

可以通过空手点击来重置单行内容
entries.bodyEn:
Display Boards are a scalable alternative to the sign

They require Rotational Force to operate

Static text can be applied using written Clipboards

And dynamic text through the use of Display Links

Dyes can be applied to individual lines of the board

Lines can be reset by clicking them with an empty hand

entries.body:
显示链接器可用于可视化动态信息

首先，右击目标显示器……

……然后将其连接到要读取的方块上

打开界面选择和配置要发送的内容

显示器现在将接收其上的信息

不是所有方块都可以作为信息源

每个兼容的方块都提供了独特的信息

显示链接器可以在很多“显示器”上生效
entries.bodyEn:
Display Links can be used to visualise dynamic information

First, right-click the target display...

...then attach it to the block to read from

Open the Interface to select and configure what is sent

The display will now receive information from the link

Not every block can act as a source

Each compatible block provides unique information

The Display Link can work with several different displays

entries.body:
当被红石充能时，显示链接器将停止发送新信息

一旦红石信号断开，计时器就会重置，并立即发送新信息

信息源方块发出的红石信号不会影响链接器
entries.bodyEn:
When powered by Redstone, Display Links stop sending updates

Once unpowered, the Timer is reset and new info is sent immediately

Signals emitted from the source do not affect the Link

entries.body:
升降机滑轮可以在已标记的位置之间垂直移动结构

开始建造你的升降机轿厢

放置一对面对面的接触式红石信号发生器……

……并且把其中一个附着到你的动态结构上

安装动态结构控制器以便于选择楼层

确保升降机滑轮接入了动力

右击升降机滑轮以组装升降机

现在静止的接触式红石信号发生器转变成了一个升降机锚点

升降机锚点代表一个“楼层”，且可以被配置

所有在此列的接触式红石信号发生器会被转化

对升降机锚点通入红石信号以召唤轿厢

移动速度取决于输入滑轮的转速

滚动并单击控制方块以选择楼层

右击已组装的滑轮来将轿厢方块化

升降机上的滑动门会自动打开和关闭

当轿厢到达某楼层，该楼层的升降机锚点会发出信号

这可能有助于在到达时触发门或者其他特殊效果

显示链接器安装在任何升降机锚点上都能显示目前轿厢所在的楼层
entries.bodyEn:
Elevator Pulleys can move structures vertically between marked locations

Start by constructing a cabin

Place a pair of Redstone Contacts facing each other...

...and glue one of them to your moving structure

Contraption Controls can be attached to make floor selection easier

Ensure that the pulley is supplied with Rotational Power

Right-Clicking the pulley assembles the elevator

The stationary contact now turns into an Elevator Contact

Elevator Contacts represent a 'floor' and can be configured

Any redstone contact sharing this column will be converted

Supply a redstone pulse to call the elevator to the contact

The movement speed depends on the rotation input on the pulley

Scroll and click on the controls block to choose a floor while on-board

Right-Clicking the assembled pulley will turn the cabin back into blocks

Sliding doors attached to the cabin will open and close automatically

Elevator Contacts emit a signal while the cabin is on their floor

This can be useful to trigger doors or special effects upon arrival

Display Links on any of the contacts can show the current floor of the elevator

entries.body:
当使用一个滑轮组装了一个动态结构……

……同一高度的其他滑轮也会被连接到结构上

它们不需要接入动力，且只有装饰效果
entries.bodyEn:
Whenever a pulley assembles a contraption...

...other pulleys on the same layer will connect to the structure

They do not require to be powered, the effect is purely cosmetic

entries.zh: 使用空的烈焰人燃烧室
entries.body:
手持空的烈焰人燃烧室右击烈焰人来抓取烈焰人

或者，可以直接从烈焰人刷怪笼中收集烈焰人

这样，你便有了一个可供部分机器加工的热源

如果是为了美观，空的烈焰人燃烧室也可以被打火石点燃

你可以使用注入了灵魂的物品转化这种火焰

但是，没有烈焰人，这样的火焰并不足以用于工业级加热工作
entries.bodyEn:
Right-click a Blaze with the empty burner to capture it

Alternatively, Blazes can be collected from their Spawners directly

You now have an ideal heat source for various machines

For Aesthetic purposes, Empty Blaze Burners can also be lit using Flint and Steel

The flame can be transformed using a soul-infused item

However, without a blaze they are not suitable for industrial heating

entries.body:
铜机壳可以用于装饰流体管道

除了遮掩流体管道之外，装壳的流体管道将不再改变其连接状态

它将不会对旁边新放置或移除的管道做出反应
entries.bodyEn:
Copper Casing can be used to decorate Fluid Pipes

Aside from being concealed, Encased Pipes are locked into their connectivity state

It will no longer react to any neighbouring blocks being added or removed

entries.zh: 使用工厂仪表自动化动力合成
entries.body:
工厂仪表可以自动调配动力合成器的配方

将所需原材料像之前那样连接

当检测到一个有效配方时，在界面中会出现一个新的按钮

当自动调配启用时，包裹可被自动解包至动力合成器

配方必须为 3×3 大小且动力合成器需要使用扳手连接

对着仪表长按右键以设置目标数量

现在可以通过多个不同配方的仪表来实现通用合成

输出必须送回一个连接的仓库中以结束循环

推荐使用理包机以避免多个包裹输入造成的错误
entries.bodyEn:
Factory gauges provide auto-arrangement for crafting table recipes

Connect the required ingredients as before

When a valid recipe is detected, a new button appears in the UI

With auto-arrangement active, the boxes can be unwrapped into crafters directly

The setup must be 3x3 and the crafters have to be connected via wrench

Hold Right-click on the gauge to set the target amount

This crafter can now be used universally, by more gauges with different recipes

Outputs should be sent back to a linked inventory to close the loop

Using a Re-packager is recommended to prevent fragmentation of input packages

entries.zh: 将仪表连接到其他方块
entries.body:
当在界面中添加新连接时……

……仪表也接受无线红石终端和显示链接器

当库存物品数量达到或超过目标数量时，将会输出红石信号

接收模式的无线红石终端可以阻止仪表发送请求

显示链接器可以提供已连接仪表的状态概要
entries.bodyEn:
When adding a new connection from the UI...

...the gauge also accepts Redstone and Display Links

Redstone links will be powered when the stock level is at or above the target amount

In receiver mode, links can stop the gauge from sending requests

Display links can provide a status overview of connected gauges

entries.zh: 使用工厂仪表自动化生产
entries.body:
当仪表没有被放置在打包机上时……

它们将监测所有已连接的存储中物品的库存数量

手持物品右击以监测该物品

它将显示网络中此物品的总数量

仪表可以通过发送该物品的合成配方以补充库存水平

首先，在新的仪表中添加合成材料

在目标界面中，可以建立新的连接

输入面板可以使用扳手更改路径使其更加美观

在界面中，查看输入并指定每批次输出的数量

指定原料应被发送到的地址

对仪表按住右键以设置目标数量

当网络中的物品数量少于其标记数量……

……它将向指定的地址发送新的原材料

输出的物品随后需要返回任一已经连接的仓库中

绿色连接代表目标数量已经达成

仪表的控制范围可以扩展到更多步骤的合成

每一个仪表都只会单独检测某种物品的存储数量
entries.bodyEn:
Whenever gauges are not placed on a packager...

They will instead monitor stock levels of all linked inventories

Right-click it with the item that should be monitored

It will now display the total amount present on the network

The gauge can replenish stock levels by sending other items to be processed

First, add the required ingredients as new factory gauges

From the target's UI, new connections can be made

For aesthetics, input panels can be wrenched to change the pathing

In the UI, review the inputs and specify how much of the output gets made per batch

Specify the address that ingredients should be sent to

The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge

Whenever the network has fewer items than the amount...

...it will send new ingredients to the specified address

The outputs then need to return to any of the linked inventories

Green connections indicate that the target amount has been reached

The board of gauges can expand to include more recipe steps

Each gauge maintains the stock level of its item independently

entries.zh: 使用工厂仪表进行补货
entries.body:
放置前，右击一个仓储链接站以连接至整个网络

当被放置在打包机上时，工厂仪表可以检测库存内的物品

手持物品右击以监测该物品

它将显示库存中此物品的数量

仪表可以从物流网络中向库存输入物品

对其再次右击以打开它的配置界面

设置一个用来请求物品的地址

对仪表按住右键以设置目标数量

当箱子中的物品数量少于目标数量时……

……物流网络系统会向指定的地址发送更多物品

然后，它们可以路由到打包机中
entries.bodyEn:
Right-click a Stock link before placement to connect to its network

When placed on a packager, factory gauges can monitor items inside the inventory

Right-click it with the item that should be monitored

It will now display the amount present in the inventory

The gauge can refill this inventory from the logistics network

Right-click it again to open its configuration UI

Set an address that should be used for the requested items

The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge

Whenever the chest has fewer items than this amount...

...the logistics network sends more, with the specified address

From there, they can be routed to the packager

entries.body:
当气流吹过熔岩时，气流会被加热

热气流中的物品会被冶炼

但在气流中的食物会被直接烧成灰

而想要烹饪食物，必须要通过吹过火焰的气流来烟熏食物

当气流吹过水后，便可用于洗涤物品

这种加工方法可以做到不少有趣的事情

鼓风机的转速对加工的速度没有影响，只影响气流的吹拂距离

而那些放置在置物台或者传送带上的物品，鼓风机也是可以处理的
entries.bodyEn:
When passing through lava, the Air Flow becomes Heated

Items caught in the area will be smelted

Food items thrown here would be incinerated

Instead, a setup for Smoking using Fire should be used for them

Air Flows passing through water create a Washing Setup

Some interesting new processing can be done with it

The Speed of the Fan does NOT affect the processing speed, only its range

Fan Processing can also be applied to Items on Depots and Belts

entries.body:
流体管道可以用于连接两个或多个流体容器

使用扳手，可以为直管道安装观察窗

带有观察窗的管道无法建立侧向管道连接

使用动力泵，流体管道可以传输流体

一开始，流体不会真正地被抽出

只有当管道内的流体流彻底连通之后，流体才会开始逐渐从一个容器中转移到另一个中

这意味着流体管道本身并不真正存储任何流体
entries.bodyEn:
Fluid Pipes can connect two or more fluid sources and targets

Using a wrench, a straight pipe segment can be given a window

Windowed pipes will not connect to any other adjacent pipe segments

Powered by Mechanical Pumps, the Pipes can transport Fluids

No fluid is being extracted at first

Once the flow connects them, the endpoints gradually transfer their contents

Thus, the Pipe blocks themselves never 'physically' contain any fluid

entries.body:
流体管道的末端可以与许多种容器连接

任何可以容纳流体的容器都可以被填充或从中抽取

开放的管道口可以吸走流体源方块……

……或者将流体源排放出来

管道也可以从许多种其他方块中直接抽取流体
entries.bodyEn:
Endpoints of a pipe network can interact with a variety of blocks

Any block with fluid storage capabilities can be filled or drained

Source blocks right in front of an open end can be picked up...

...while spilling into empty spaces can create fluid sources

Pipes can also extract fluids from a handful of other blocks directly

entries.body:
流体储罐可以多格连接，提供更大的存储量

流体储罐的最大横截面为 3×3……

……并且可以超过 30 格高

使用扳手可以打开或关闭观察窗
entries.bodyEn:
Fluid Tanks can be combined to increase the total capacity

Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...

...and grow in height by more than 30 additional layers

Using a Wrench, a tanks' window can be toggled

entries.zh: 使用流体储罐存储流体
entries.body:
流体储罐可以存储大量的流体

流体管道可以在流体储罐的任何一面将流体输入/输出

使用比较器可以检测储罐中的流体储量

在生存模式中，无法直接用容器向储罐中存入或取出流体

要装满/倒空流体容器，可以使用工作盆，分液池或注液器
entries.bodyEn:
Fluid Tanks can be used to store large amounts of fluid

Pipe networks can push and pull fluids from any side

The contained fluid can be measured by a Comparator

However, in Survival Mode Fluids cannot be added or taken manually

You can use Basins, Item Drains and Spouts to drain or fill fluid containing items

entries.body:
直接放置时，漏斗会将物品从容器中取出

潜行放置时，漏斗会将物品置入容器中

使用扳手可以改变漏斗的存/取模式

相同的规则适用于大多数朝向。

在传送带末端放置的漏斗会根据传送带的传动方向存/取物品
entries.bodyEn:
Placed normally, it pulls items from the inventory.

Placed while sneaking, it puts items into the inventory.

Using a wrench, the funnel can be flipped after placement.

Same rules will apply for most orientations.

Funnels on belts will extract/insert depending on its movement direction.

entries.body:
漏斗不能在闭合容器之间直接传输物品

溜槽和智能溜槽更适用于这样的场景。

水平传输也是如此，也许传送带更方便快捷
entries.bodyEn:
Funnels cannot ever transfer between closed inventories directly.

Chutes or Smart chutes might be more suitable for such purposes.

Same applies for horizontal movement. A mechanical belt should help here.

entries.body:
起重机取物器可以被放置在起重机杆上，并且可以沿着起重机杆运动

起重机可以移动其黏附的方块
entries.bodyEn:
Gantry Carriages can mount to and slide along a Gantry Shaft.

Gantry setups can move attached Blocks.

entries.body:
无需强力胶，起重机取物器便可与起重机杆相连

即使是在移动的起重机杆上也是如此

因此，起重机系统可以串联起来，如此可以影响到多轴向的运动
entries.bodyEn:
Gantry shafts attach to a carriage without the need of super glue

Same applies for carriages on moved Gantry Shafts

Thus, a gantry system can be cascaded to cover multiple axes of movement

entries.body:
起重机杆可以有相反的方向

起重机取物器的移动方向取决于起重机杆的方向

……以及起重机杆的旋转方向

在旋转传递中，此规则同样适用
entries.bodyEn:
Gantry Shafts can have opposite orientations

The movement direction of carriages depend on their shafts' orientation

...as well as the rotation direction of the shaft

Same rules apply for the propagated rotation

entries.body:
被红石信号激活的起重机杆，将不会移动其上的取物器

作为替代，杆上的旋转力会传递到取物器的输出杆上
entries.bodyEn:
Redstone-powered gantry shafts stop moving their carriages

Instead, its rotational force is relayed to the carriages' output shaft

entries.body:
起重机杆组成了起重机系统的基础，与其相接的取物器可以沿着杆进行移动

起重机系统可以移动与其相接的方块
entries.bodyEn:
Gantry Shafts form the basis of a gantry setup. Attached Carriages will move along them.

Gantry setups can move attached Blocks.

entries.zh: 使用十字齿轮箱传递旋转力
entries.body:
更改旋转轴向，很容易使得整个旋转体系变得臃肿不堪

十字齿轮箱则是替代方案，它的体积更为小巧紧凑

垂直相邻的传动杆，旋转方向呈镜像

直线连接的传动杆，旋转方向相反
entries.bodyEn:
Jumping between axes of rotation can get bulky quickly

A gearbox is the more compact equivalent of this setup

Shafts around corners rotate in mirrored directions

Straight connections will be reversed

entries.zh: 使用手摇曲柄产生旋转力
entries.en: Generating Rotational Force using Hand Cranks
entries.body:
玩家可以使用手摇曲柄来手动产生旋转力

按住右键可以逆时针旋转它

潜行并右击可使它顺时针旋转
entries.bodyEn:
Hand Cranks can be used by players to apply rotational force manually

Hold Right-Click to rotate it Counter-Clockwise

Sneak and Hold Right-Click to rotate it Clockwise

entries.zh: 使用软管滑轮抽取或排放流体
entries.en: Source Filling and Draining using Hose Pulleys
entries.body:
软管滑轮可以用于方便地对一个较大区域进行抽取流体或填满流体的操作

通过输入动力可以调节软管末端的高度

反转动力输入的方向可以收起软管

管道可以连接在另一侧

连接的管道可以将流体输入到软管滑轮中，软管会在下方排出口处放置流体源……

……或者提供吸力来抽取世界中的流体

软管滑轮的抽取/排放速度取决于连接管道中流体的流速
entries.bodyEn:
Hose Pulleys can be used to fill or drain large bodies of Fluid

With the Kinetic Input, the height of the pulleys' hose can be controlled

The Pulley retracts while the input rotation is inverted

On the opposite side, pipes can be connected

Attached pipe networks can either provide fluid to the hose...

...or pull from it, draining the pool instead

Fill and Drain speed of the pulley depends entirely on the fluid networks' throughput

entries.zh: 被动抽取和排放大体量流体
entries.en: Passively Filling and Draining large bodies of Fluid
entries.body:
当软管被放进足够大的流体中时……

……它在抽取或排放流体时将不会影响流体源

可以从这些软管滑轮中无限量地抽取或向其排放流体
entries.bodyEn:
When deploying the Hose Pulley into a large enough ocean...

It will provide/dispose fluids without affecting the source

Pipe networks can limitlessly take fluids from/to such pulleys

entries.zh: 软管滑轮的排水/抽水机制
entries.en: Fill and Drain level of Hose Pulleys
entries.body:
当软管彻底收回时，软管滑轮无法工作

抽取流体的顺序为由上至下

流体表面最终将会被抽取到刚好低于软管开口

填充流体的顺序为由下至上

流体最多只能被填充至软管开口所在的高度
entries.bodyEn:
While fully retracted, the Hose Pulley cannot operate

Draining runs from top to bottom

The surface level will end up just below where the hose ends

Filling runs from bottom to top

The filled pool will not grow beyond the layer above the hose end

entries.zh: 使用分液池提取物品中的流体
entries.en: Emptying Fluid Containers using Item Drains
entries.body:
分液池可以提取物品中的流体

右击可以将手持物品中的流体倒入分液池中

当物品从侧面输入时……

……物品将会滚过分液池顶部，并在此过程中将其包含的流体排入分液池内

流体管道可以从分液池中抽取流体
entries.bodyEn:
Item Drains can extract fluids from items

Right-click it to pour fluids from your held item into it

When items are inserted from the side...

...they roll across, emptying out their contained fluid

Pipe Networks can now pull the fluid from the drains' internal buffer

entries.body:
可以组合物品保险库以增加总容量

它们的直径最多可以有 3 个方块宽……

……长度最多为直径的 3 倍
entries.bodyEn:
Item Vaults can be combined to increase the total capacity

Their base square can be up to 3 blocks wide...

...and grow in length up to 3x their diameter

entries.body:
物品保险库可用于存储大量物品

但是，不能手动添加或获取物品

任何用于物品传输的组件都可以用于添加……

……和从该容器中取出物品
entries.bodyEn:
Item Vaults can be used to store large amounts of items

However, contents cannot be added or taken manually

Any components for item transfer can both insert...

...and take contents from this container

entries.zh: 使用大水车产生旋转力
entries.en: Generating Rotational Force using Large Water Wheels
entries.body:
大水车利用相邻的水流来产生旋转力

覆盖其他侧面不会进一步增加其动力输出

它的旋转速度只有普通水车的一半……

……但是大幅提高了应力生产能力

对水车使用木板以改变其外观
entries.bodyEn:
Large Water Wheels draw force from adjacent Water Currents

Covering additional sides will not improve its kinetic output further

These rotate only at half the speed of regular water wheels...

...but provide a substantially higher stress capacity

Use wood planks on the wheel to change its appearance

entries.zh: 使用轴向底盘黏合方块
entries.body:
它的外露面可以变为黏性面

再次点击黏性面，可以将它的对面也变得具有黏性

空手潜行右击可以移除此面的黏性物

黏性面可以将此面前方的一长条方块黏住

使用扳手可以精确控制底盘的影响范围

按住 Ctrl 以调节所有底盘的影响范围

若想让底盘的其他面也能粘方块，你需要用到强力胶

利用这些机制，任何形状的结构都可以作为动态结构移动
entries.bodyEn:
The open faces of a Linear Chassis can be made Sticky

Click again to make the opposite side sticky

Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime

Stickied faces of the Linear Chassis will attach a line of blocks in front of it

Using a Wrench, a precise Range can be specified for this chassis

Holding CTRL adjusts the range of all connected Chassis Blocks

Attaching blocks to any other side requires the use of Super Glue

Using these mechanics, structures of any shape can move as a Contraption

entries.body:
相邻的轴向底盘可以相互连接在一起

其中的一个底盘若被移动，其余的底盘也会跟着移动

不同种类的底盘，或者是朝向不一致的底盘，将不会相连
entries.bodyEn:
Linear Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks next to them

When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it

Chassis of a different type or facing another direction will not attach

entries.body:
你得在放置动力臂之前就配置好它的输入以及输出端

手持动力臂右击某个容器，可以将其指定为目标

再次右击可以使其在输入端（蓝色）以及输出端（黄色）之间切换

左击此组件可以移除选择

将动力臂放下来后，它会将此前选择的方块作为目标

在有效范围内，动力臂可以有任意数量的输出以及输入端

然而，并不是所有的容器可以被直接交互

在此情况下，漏斗和置物台可以解决此问题
entries.bodyEn:
Mechanical Arms have to be assigned their in- and outputs before they are placed

Right-Click inventories while holding the Arm to assign them as Targets

Right-Click again to toggle between Input (Blue) and Output (Yellow)

Left-Click components to remove their Selection

Once placed, the Mechanical Arm will target the blocks selected previously

They can have any amount of in- and outputs within their range

However, not every type of Inventory can be interacted with directly

Funnels and Depots can help to Bridge that gap

entries.en: Filtering Outputs of the Mechanical Arm
entries.body:
有时，你会想着利用某种过滤限制动力臂的目标

动力臂自身并不提供任何过滤选项

然而，若将黄铜漏斗作为目标，则漏斗的过滤槽可以应用至动力臂上

动力臂足够智能，它不会去拿取那些它无法分配的物品
entries.bodyEn:
Inputs

Outputs

Sometimes it is desirable to restrict targets of the Arm by matching a filter

Mechanical Arms by themselves do not provide any options for filtering

Brass Funnels as Targets do however communicate their own filter to the Arm

The Arm is smart enough not to pick up items it couldn't distribute

entries.en: Distribution modes of the Mechanical Arm
entries.body:
若动力臂必须在数个有效的输出端之间作出选择……

……它会依照自己的设定选择特定的行为

面板允许您对其进行配置

“轮询调度”模式很好理解，即循环输出至所有有效的输出端

如果某个输出端无法容纳更多物品，则它会被跳过

“强制轮询调度”不会跳过任何输出端，动力臂会一直等待，直到输出端有空位容纳物品输入

“第一目标优先”模式会使得动力臂先将物品输出至更早被选择的输出端
entries.bodyEn:
Outputs

Whenever an Arm has to choose between multiple valid outputs...

...it will act according to its setting

The value panel will allow you to configure it

Round Robin mode simply cycles through all outputs that are available

If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped

Forced Round Robin mode will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free

Prefer First prioritizes the outputs selected earliest when configuring this Arm

entries.zh: 利用红石信号控制动力臂
entries.body:
当被红石充能时，动力臂会停止工作

在停止工作前，它会完成当前正在进行的工作周期

因此，通入单次负红石脉冲可以精确控制动力臂，使其每次只进行单个周期的工作
entries.bodyEn:
When powered by Redstone, Mechanical Arms will not activate

Before stopping, it will finish any started cycles

Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle

entries.body:
动力合成器阵列可用于自动化任何合成配方的制作

使用扳手可以调控合成器的合成通路

所有的合成通路必须汇集到任意一侧的一个出口，整套合成器方可算是设置正确

输出产物会被放入位于出口的容器中

动力合成器的运转需要旋转力的供应

右击合成器正面，可以手动放入物品

一旦合成通路上的所有合成槽位都有了物品，合成就会开始

而对于那些没有完全占满所有合成器槽位的配方，你可以通入红石信号强制开启合成
entries.bodyEn:
An array of Mechanical Crafters can be used to automate any Crafting Recipe

Using a Wrench, the Crafters' paths can be arranged

For a valid setup, all paths have to converge into one exit at any side

The outputs will be placed into the inventory at the exit

Mechanical Crafters require Rotational Force to operate

Right-Click the front to insert Items manually

Once every slot of a path contains an Item, the crafting process will begin

For recipes not fully occupying the crafter setup, the start can be forced using a Redstone Pulse

entries.zh: 连接动力合成器的容器
entries.body:
合成器可以自动接受向其输入的物品

对其背面使用扳手，可以连接合成器

所有相连的合成器可以访问同一个位置的输入
entries.bodyEn:
Items can be inserted to Crafters automatically

Using the Wrench at their backs, Mechanical Crafter inputs can be combined

All connected Crafters can now be accessed by the same input location

entries.zh: 盖住动力合成器的合成槽
entries.body:
有些配方需要额外的合成器，来补足合成通路上的间隙

使用合成槽盖板，合成器在合成时的行为就如同一个空的合成槽位

使用扳手在背面创建的的共享输入也可以跨越有盖的合成器
entries.bodyEn:
Some recipes will require additional Crafters to bridge gaps in the path

Using Slot Covers, Crafters can be set to act as an Empty Slot in the arrangement

Shared Inputs created with the Wrench at the back can also reach across covered Crafters

entries.zh: 在动态结构中使用动力收割机
entries.body:
当动力收割机作为动态结构的一部分移动时……

它会采收其路径上的作物，并重置这些作物的生长进度
entries.bodyEn:
Whenever Harvesters are moved as part of an animated Contraption...

They will harvest and reset any mature crops on their way

entries.zh: 使用动力搅拌器处理物品
entries.en: Processing Items with the Mechanical Mixer
entries.body:
使用搅拌器和工作盆，你可以自动化某些合成配方

有效配方包括各种无序合成配方，以及一些额外的配方

一些配方可能需要使用烈焰人燃烧室提供热量

过滤槽可用于解决两个配方相互冲突的情况。
entries.bodyEn:
With a Mixer and Basin, some Crafting Recipes can be automated

Available recipes include any Shapeless Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones

Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner

The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.

entries.zh: 使用动力活塞移动结构
entries.body:
动力活塞可以移动它前方的方块

移动速度和方向取决于通入活塞的旋转力

黏性动力活塞可以将连接的方块拉回来
entries.bodyEn:
Mechanical Pistons can move blocks in front of them

Speed and direction of movement depend on the Rotational Input

Sticky Mechanical Pistons can pull the attached blocks back

entries.en: Movement Modes of the Mechanical Piston
entries.body:
一旦活塞停下，被移动的结构就会恢复到方块状态

你也可以将其配置为永不方块化，或者只在起始位置方块化
entries.bodyEn:
Whenever Pistons stop moving, the moved structure reverts to blocks

It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only at the location it started at

entries.zh: 在动态结构中使用动力犁
entries.body:
当动力犁作为动态结构的一部分移动时……

……它会破坏掉那些不具有固体碰撞箱的方块

此外，动力犁可以耕地

……它也可以在不伤害实体的情况下推动它们
entries.bodyEn:
Whenever Ploughs are moved as part of an animated Contraption...

...they will break blocks without a solid collision hitbox

Additionally, ploughs can create farmland

...they can also launch entities without hurting them

entries.zh: 使用动力冲压机处理物品
entries.en: Processing Items with the Mechanical Press
entries.body:
动力冲压机可以处理位于其下方的物品

在其下方丢入物品，或者将物品放在置物台上，都算作有效的物品输入

若物品位于传送带上……

冲压机会使物品停下，然后自动处理这一物品
entries.bodyEn:
The Mechanical Press can process items provided beneath it

The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Press

When items are provided on a belt...

The Press will hold and process them automatically

entries.zh: 使用动力冲压机压缩物品
entries.en: Compacting items with the Mechanical Press
entries.body:
对放置于工作盆内的物品进行冲压，可以将这些物品压缩在一起

压缩意指任何同种物品填满了 2×2 或者 3×3 网格的配方，以及一些额外的配方

一些配方可能需要使用烈焰人燃烧室提供热量

过滤槽可用于解决两个配方相互冲突的情况。
entries.bodyEn:
Pressing items held in a Basin will cause them to be Compacted

Compacting includes any filled 2x2 or 3x3 Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones

Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner

The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.

entries.body:
动力泵可以控制管道网络中的流体

其上的箭头指示流体流向

泵后的管道网络正在抽取流体……

……而泵前的网络则在排放流体

动力泵的方向不受旋转方向的影响

取而代之的是，可以使用扳手来反转方向
entries.bodyEn:
Mechanical Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks

Their arrow indicates the direction of flow

The network behind is now pulling fluids...

...while the network in front is transferring it outward

The pumps direction is unaffected by the input rotation

Instead, a Wrench can be used to reverse the direction

entries.body:
动力泵的压力最多沿管线传递 16 格，与输入动力无关

提高输入转速，可以加快流体的蔓延速度……

……以及液体的传输速度

同一管道网络中的多个并联动力泵，它们的传输量可以叠加

确保它们都朝向同一方向
entries.bodyEn:
Regardless of speed, Mechanical Pumps affect pipes connected up to 16 blocks away

Speeding up the input rotation changes the speed of flow propagation...

...and the speed at which fluids are transferred

Pumps can combine their throughputs within shared pipe networks

Ensure that all of them are facing in the same direction

entries.zh: 使用动力压路机填充地形
entries.body:
当方块化时，动力压路机可以被设为其他模式

“填充”模式可以帮你填充路面和地形之间的缝隙

在“竖直填充”模式，它们会简单地把方块以柱形放置到路面下方

在“坡度填充”模式，层数越靠下，填充面积就越大

与“清理并铺路”相反，这些模式下，动力压路机不会破坏原有的方块
entries.bodyEn:
While disassembled, rollers can be set to other modes

The 'fill' modes can help to bridge gaps between pavement and terrain

On 'straight fill', they will place simple columns down to the surface

On 'sloped fill', layers placed further down will increase in size

As opposed to 'clear & pave', neither of these modes will cause the rollers to break existing blocks

entries.zh: 使用动力压路机清理和铺路
entries.en: Clearing and Paving with the Roller
entries.body:
动力压路机可以帮助你清理轨道或道路周围的地形

在默认模式，如果没有设定材料，它只会像钻头一样清理方块

当方块化时，可以指定合适的铺路材料

材料可通过附着在结构上的箱子或木桶供应

除了破坏方块外，它现在将同时替换下面一层方块

请注意，任何被压路机摧毁的方块都有可能不产生掉落物

动力压路机在列车上尤其好用，但也可以在大多数的动态结构上使用
entries.bodyEn:
Mechanical rollers help to clean up terrain around tracks or paths

In its default mode, without a material set, it will simply clear blocks like a Drill

While disassembled, a suitable paving material can be specified

Materials can be supplied via chests or barrels attached to the structure

In addition to breaking blocks, it will now replace the layer beneath them

Note that any block destroyed by a roller has a chance not to yield drops

Rollers are especially useful on Trains, but can also be used on most other types of moving contraptions

entries.en: Cutting Trees with the Mechanical Saw
entries.body:
向其通入旋转力后，动力锯可以直接砍伐掉它面前的树木

想要一次性砍掉整棵树，锯子必须破坏掉树与地面连接的最后一个方块
entries.bodyEn:
When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Saw will cut trees directly in front of it

In order to cut the tree fully, the Saw has to break the last block connecting it to the ground

entries.en: Processing Items on the Mechanical Saw
entries.body:
面朝上的动力锯可以处理各种物品

处理过后的物品的弹出方向始终与通入锯中的旋转转向相反

锯子可以与传送带放置在一条直线上，相互配合工作

若输入原料有多种可能产物，你可以用动力锯上的过滤槽指定只产出某种产物

若没有使用过滤槽，动力锯会在各产物中按顺序循环输出
entries.bodyEn:
Upward facing Mechanical Saws can process a variety of items

The processed item always moves against the rotational input to the saw

Saws can work in-line with Mechanical Belts

When an ingredient has multiple possible outcomes, the filter slot can specify it

Without filter, the Saw would cycle through all outcomes instead

entries.body:
石磨会对输入的物品进行研磨

在其侧边使用齿轮与其相耦合，方可为其通入动力

顶部可以丢入或者塞入物品

一段时间过后，右击石磨可以拿出其中的产物

产物的提取也是可以自动化的
entries.bodyEn:
Millstones process items by grinding them

They can be powered from the side using cogwheels

Throw or Insert items at the top

After some time, the result can be obtained via Right-click

The outputs can also be extracted by automation

entries.body:
当被红石充能时，辉光管会显示出信号的强度

使用已书写的剪贴板，可以显示自定义文本

使用染料右击，便可更改辉光管的显示颜色
entries.bodyEn:
When powered by Redstone, Nixie Tubes will display the signal strength

Using written Clipboards, custom text can be displayed

Right-Click with Dye to change their display colour

entries.body:
右击一条锁链并在其附近放置货物蛙港

在库存界面中为其分配一个地址

如果包裹记录的地址与蛙港不匹配……

货物蛙港就会把包裹挂到锁链上

如果没有有效的目的地，包裹就会在原地旋转

可以在锁链网络中的任意位置添加更多的蛙港

包裹会在锁链网络中寻找到达对应蛙港的路线

货物蛙港可以直接访问其下方的容器

货物蛙港也可和打包机同时工作，物品在打包后会直接放到锁链物流线上

派送包裹至“李华”

用剪贴板右击蛙港来收集它们的地址

记有地址的剪贴板可以用于在其他UI界面中自动完成地址输入
entries.bodyEn:
Right-click a Chain Conveyor and place the Frogport nearby

Assign it an address in the inventory UI

If the address of an inserted package does not match it..

Albert

→ Peter

..the Frogport will place the package on the conveyor

Packages spin in place if they have no valid destination

More Frogports can be added anywhere on the chain network

Packages find their path to a matching frog on the chain network

→ Peter

Frogports can directly interface with inventories below them

This also works with packagers. Items can be packed and shipped directly

Albert

Addresses packages to 'Peter'

Right-click Frogports with a clipboard to collect their address

Clipboards with collected names can help auto-complete address inputs in other UIs

entries.body:
将打包机对接到它们的目标库存

接入红石信号，它会把库存中的物品打包进包裹

它们可以被捡起，也可以进行运输，就像其他任何物品一样

放入打包机的包裹将被拆解，而内容物将存放到库存中

打包机无法接收无法完全拆卸的包裹
entries.bodyEn:
Attach packagers to the inventory they should target

Given redstone power, it will pack items from the inventory into a package

These can be picked up and transported like any other item

Packages inserted will be destroyed, unpacking the contents into the inventory

Packagers will not accept packages they cannot fully unpack

entries.body:
当一个告示牌被放置在打包机上时……

打包完毕的包裹将会携带一行写有其地址的文字

包裹过滤器根据包裹的地址制定它们的路线

动力锯可以拆解在传送带上的包裹从而保证结构的紧凑

除过滤器外，货物蛙港和邮箱亦可以指定包裹路线

查看它们的思索界面来了解它们的行为
entries.bodyEn:
Warehouse

When a sign is placed on a packager..

→ Warehouse

Created packages will carry the written lines of text as their address

Package filters route packages based on their address

→ Warehouse

Factory

→ Factory

Factory

For compactness, mechanical saws can unpack straight onto a belt

Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities

Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour

entries.body:
若无相接的活塞杆，动力活塞将无法推动方块

在其背面安装的活塞杆长度，决定了活塞的推动范围
entries.bodyEn:
Without attached Poles, a Mechanical Piston cannot move

The Length of pole added at its back determines the Extension Range

entries.body:
管道无法与动态结构上的流体储罐直接交互

这一方块可以在不停止动态结构的情况下与动态结构上的流体储罐进行交互

放置第二个接口时，记得要与动态结构上的接口相隔 1 到 2 格的距离

当它们经过彼此时，会连接到一起

接口连接状态下，固定端的接口便会作为整个动态结构流体储罐的代理

流体可被泵入到动态结构内……

……或是从动态结构中抽取出来

如果一小段时间内没有流体交换，接口将会断开连接，动态结构将会重新开始运动
entries.bodyEn:
Fluid Tanks on moving contraptions cannot be accessed by any pipes

This component can interact with fluid tanks without the need to stop the contraption

Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween

Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection

While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL Tanks on the contraption

Fluid can now be inserted...

...or extracted from the contraption

After no contents have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way
