entries.body:
使用矿车装配站移动结构
矿车装配站会将它所连接的结构安装到矿车上

若没有通入红石信号，它会将矿车结构拆解为方块的形式

对着结构化的矿车使用你的扳手，就可以将其变为物品形式

组装矿车结构
若两个矿车装配站连接在同一结构下……

给其中的任意一方的矿车装配站通入红石信号，都会组装矿车结构

两辆矿车此时的行为与用矿车连轴器连接在一起时十分相似

矿车结构的方向设定
矿车结构会随着矿车的运动而发生转向

该箭头将指定结构的哪一侧会被视为“正面”

如果装配站的配置为“旋转锁定”，那么结构的方向将不会改变

另外几种矿车以及铁轨
放置在普通轨道上的矿车装配站并不会影响路过的矿车结构

如果放置在动力铁轨或控制铁轨上且没有通入红石信号，矿车结构将停在此处，直到再次充能

另外的几种矿车可以当作锚点来使用

动力矿车会试图始终保持燃烧状态，并从任何连接的容器内提取燃料
entries.bodyEn:
Moving Structures using Cart Assemblers
Powered Cart Assemblers mount attached structures to passing Minecarts

Without a redstone signal, it disassembles passing cart contraptions back into blocks

Using a Wrench on the Minecart will let you carry the Contraption elsewhere

Assembling Carriage Contraptions
Whenever two Cart Assemblers share an attached structure...

Powering either of them will create a Carriage Contraption

The carts will behave like those connected via Minecart Coupling

Orientation Settings for Minecart Contraptions
Cart Contraptions will rotate to face towards their carts' motion

This Arrow indicates which side of the Structure will be considered the front

If the Assembler is set to Lock Rotation, the contraptions' orientation will never change

Other types of Minecarts and Rails
Cart Assemblers on Regular Tracks will not affect the passing carts' motion

When on Powered or Controller Rail, the carts will be held in place until it's Powered

Other types of Minecarts can be used as the anchor

Furnace Carts will keep themselves powered, pulling fuel from any attached inventories

entries.body:
桌布可以用来展示物品

在物流系统的帮助下，它们亦可用于出售物品

从商店的库存、打包机和仓储链接站开始

将一个仓储发报机绑定至仓储链接站并且置于商店内

将一只生物或者烈焰人燃烧室指定为店长

将待售的商品放入商店库存

要创建一个新的交易，你需要拿着一张桌布与店长交互

放置后，在一侧的物品栏位设置价格

之后，其他玩家就能与商店交互

结账时，购买的物品将会被打包进一个包裹中

然后，它们可以传输到商铺店面

交付的物品将会被存储在仓储发报机内
entries.bodyEn:
Table cloths can be used to display items

With the help of a logistics system, they can also be used to sell items

Start with the shop's inventory, a Packager and Stock link

Bind a Stock ticker to the link and place it in the shop

Employ a mob or blaze burner as the shop keeper

Fill the shop inventory with items to be sold

To create a new trade, interact with the shop keeper while holding a table cloth

Once placed, set a price in the item slot on the side

Other players can now interact with the shop

When checking out at the cashier, the bought items will be placed into a package

From there, they can be transported to the shop front

The payments will be stored inside the stock ticker block

entries.body:
使用风帆框架来组装风车
风帆框架是组装风车的趁手材料

无需强力胶等黏附手段，它们便可自行相互连接
entries.bodyEn:
Assembling Windmills using Sail Frames
Sail Frames are handy blocks to create Windmills with

They will attach to blocks and each other without the need of Super Glue or Chassis Blocks

entries.body:
打包和拆解包裹
将打包机对接到它们的目标库存

接入红石信号，它会把库存中的物品打包进包裹

它们可以被捡起，也可以进行运输，就像其他任何物品一样

放入打包机的包裹将被拆解，而内容物将存放到库存中

打包机无法接收无法完全拆卸的包裹

使用地址路由包裹
当一个告示牌被放置在打包机上时……

打包完毕的包裹将会携带一行写有其地址的文字

包裹过滤器根据包裹的地址制定它们的路线

动力锯可以拆解在传送带上的包裹从而保证结构的紧凑

除过滤器外，货物蛙港和邮箱亦可以指定包裹路线

查看它们的思索界面来了解它们的行为
entries.bodyEn:
Creating and unwrapping packages
Attach packagers to the inventory they should target

Given redstone power, it will pack items from the inventory into a package

These can be picked up and transported like any other item

Packages inserted will be destroyed, unpacking the contents into the inventory

Packagers will not accept packages they cannot fully unpack

Routing packages with an address
Warehouse

When a sign is placed on a packager..

→ Warehouse

Created packages will carry the written lines of text as their address

Package filters route packages based on their address

→ Warehouse

Factory

→ Factory

Factory

For compactness, mechanical saws can unpack straight onto a belt

Aside from filters, Frogports and Postboxes have package routing abilities

Inspect them to find out more about their behaviour

entries.body:
使用管道运输流体
流体管道可以用于连接两个或多个流体容器

使用扳手，可以为直管道安装观察窗

带有观察窗的管道无法建立侧向管道连接

使用动力泵，流体管道可以传输流体

一开始，流体不会真正地被抽出

只有当管道内的流体流彻底连通之后，流体才会开始逐渐从一个容器中转移到另一个中

这意味着流体管道本身并不真正存储任何流体

抽取和填充流体容器
流体管道的末端可以与许多种容器连接

任何可以容纳流体的容器都可以被填充或从中抽取

开放的管道口可以吸走流体源方块……

……或者将流体源排放出来

管道也可以从许多种其他方块中直接抽取流体
entries.bodyEn:
Moving Fluids using Copper Pipes
Fluid Pipes can connect two or more fluid sources and targets

Using a wrench, a straight pipe segment can be given a window

Windowed pipes will not connect to any other adjacent pipe segments

Powered by Mechanical Pumps, the Pipes can transport Fluids

No fluid is being extracted at first

Once the flow connects them, the endpoints gradually transfer their contents

Thus, the Pipe blocks themselves never 'physically' contain any fluid

Draining and Filling fluid containers
Endpoints of a pipe network can interact with a variety of blocks

Any block with fluid storage capabilities can be filled or drained

Source blocks right in front of an open end can be picked up...

...while spilling into empty spaces can create fluid sources

Pipes can also extract fluids from a handful of other blocks directly

一对粉碎轮，磨物快又准

接入的旋转必须使得这两个轮子啮合转动

扔入或者放入的物品都会被粉碎处理

你也可以使用自动化方案进行物品的输入与取出

Processing Items with Crushing Wheels
A pair of Crushing Wheels can grind items very effectively

Their Rotational Input has to make them spin into each other

Items thrown or inserted into the top will get processed

Items can be inserted and picked up through automated means as well

entries.body:
从物流请求合并包裹
有时，请求的货物有必要以单一的包裹送达

请求来源 A

请求来源 B

否则，其他包裹可能混入其中

在这种情况下，将包裹重定向运输到一个存储方块中

在存储方块上放置一个理包机，并用红石信号激活

一旦所有分包裹送达，它们将会被打包成一个新包裹并输出

如此，请求的物品将被以可预测的顺序一同送达
entries.bodyEn:
Merging packages from a request
Sometimes, it is crucial for logistical requests to arrive as a single package

Order A

Order B

Otherwise, other packages could arrive inbetween

When this is the case, redirect packages to an inventory

Attach a re-packager, and power it with redstone

Once all fragments arrived, they will be exported as a new package

Now, requested items arrive together and in a predictable order

使用动力冲压机处理物品
动力冲压机可以处理位于其下方的物品

在其下方丢入物品，或者将物品放在置物台上，都算作有效的物品输入

若物品位于传送带上……

冲压机会使物品停下，然后自动处理这一物品

使用动力冲压机压缩物品
对放置于工作盆内的物品进行冲压，可以将这些物品压缩在一起

压缩意指任何同种物品填满了 2×2 或者 3×3 网格的配方，以及一些额外的配方

一些配方可能需要使用烈焰人燃烧室提供热量

entries.bodyEn:
Processing Items with the Mechanical Press
The Mechanical Press can process items provided beneath it

The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Press

When items are provided on a belt...

The Press will hold and process them automatically

Compacting items with the Mechanical Press
Pressing items held in a Basin will cause them to be Compacted

Compacting includes any filled 2x2 or 3x3 Crafting Recipe, plus a couple extra ones

Some of those recipes may require the heat of a Blaze Burner

The filter slot can be used in case two recipes are conflicting.

entries.body:
使用存量转信器监测
存量转信器用于监测容器内的存量

当容器内存量超过设定的上阈值时……

……转信器会改变其红石输出

在存量达到下阈值之前，信号将持续输出

红石输出现在可以用于控制物品供应，保持缓冲区已被填充

在界面中可以调节具体的阈值

使用过滤器可以只计算特定的内容物的总量

流体缓冲区可以以类似方式进行监测

……奇妙的是，它也能检测绳索滑轮伸出的长度
entries.bodyEn:
Monitoring with the Threshold Switch
Threshold Switches monitor the fill level of containers

When the inventory content exceeds the upper threshold...

...the switch will change its redstone output

The signal stays until the lower threshold is reached

The redstone output can now be used to control item supply, keeping the buffer filled

The specific thresholds can be changed in the UI

A filter can help to only count specific contents toward the total

Fluid buffers can be monitored in a similar fashion

...as well as, curiously, the length of an extended rope pulley

entries.bodyEn:

When powered by Redstone, it breaks the connection

在库存界面中为其分配一个地址

Warehouse

Conversely, packages matching the address will be dropped off

Packages that arrived by train can be extracted from the Postbox

Warehouse

Packages can still be delivered from or to their inventory

黄铜漏斗
安山岩漏斗一次只能提取出一个物品

黄铜漏斗可以一次提取一组物品

使用面板可以精确调节黄铜漏斗的提取数量。

对着过滤槽使用某个物品，可以限制漏斗的行为，使其只传输匹配的物品

物流方向
直接放置时，漏斗会将物品从容器中取出

潜行放置时，漏斗会将物品置入容器中

使用扳手可以改变漏斗的存/取模式

相同的规则适用于大多数朝向。

在传送带末端放置的漏斗会根据传送带的传动方向存/取物品

直接运输
漏斗不能在闭合容器之间直接传输物品

溜槽和智能溜槽更适用于这样的场景。

水平传输也是如此，也许传送带更方便快捷

漏斗的兼容性
漏斗可以与一些其他组件互动

使用漏斗
用漏斗来存取容器内的物品，可谓又快又好

红石信号控制
红石信号会使漏斗停止工作
entries.bodyEn:
The Brass Funnel
Andesite Funnels can only ever extract single items.

Brass Funnels can extract up to a full stack.

The value panel allows for precise control over the extracted stack size.

Using items on the filter slot will restrict the funnel to only transfer matching stacks.

Direction of Transfer
Placed normally, it pulls items from the inventory.

Placed while sneaking, it puts items into the inventory.

Using a wrench, the funnel can be flipped after placement.

Same rules will apply for most orientations.

Funnels on belts will extract/insert depending on its movement direction.

Direct transfer
Funnels cannot ever transfer between closed inventories directly.

Chutes or Smart chutes might be more suitable for such purposes.

Same applies for horizontal movement. A mechanical belt should help here.

Funnel compatibility
Funnels should also interact nicely with a handful of other components.

Vertical Saws

Depots

Item Drains

Using funnels
Funnels are ideal for transferring items from and to inventories.

Redstone control
Redstone power will prevent any funnel from acting

使用动力泵传输流体
动力泵可以控制管道网络中的流体

其上的箭头指示流体流向

泵后的管道网络正在抽取流体……

……而泵前的网络则在排放流体

动力泵的方向不受旋转方向的影响

取而代之的是，可以使用扳手来反转方向

动力泵的传输机制
动力泵的压力最多沿管线传递 16 格，与输入动力无关

提高输入转速，可以加快流体的蔓延速度……

……以及液体的传输速度

同一管道网络中的多个并联动力泵，它们的传输量可以叠加

确保它们都朝向同一方向
entries.bodyEn:
Fluid Transportation using Mechanical Pumps
Mechanical Pumps govern the flow of their attached pipe networks

Their arrow indicates the direction of flow

The network behind is now pulling fluids...

...while the network in front is transferring it outward

The pumps direction is unaffected by the input rotation

Instead, a Wrench can be used to reverse the direction

Throughput of Mechanical Pumps
Regardless of speed, Mechanical Pumps affect pipes connected up to 16 blocks away

Speeding up the input rotation changes the speed of flow propagation...

...and the speed at which fluids are transferred

Pumps can combine their throughputs within shared pipe networks

Ensure that all of them are facing in the same direction

潜行右击可以切换接收模式

手持扳手右击也可以

Redstone Links can transmit redstone signals wirelessly

Right-click while Sneaking to toggle receive mode

A simple Right-click with a Wrench can do the same

Receivers emit the redstone power of transmitters within 256 blocks

Placing items in the two slots can specify a Frequency

Only the links with matching Frequencies will communicate

一种专为列车结构设计的新型轨道

要批量放置多排轨道，单击现有轨道

To place rows of track in bulk, click on an existing track

Then place or select a second track

Tracks can also be placed as turns or slopes

When connecting, tracks will try to make each turn equally sized

Holding the sprint key while connecting...

Materials in the off-hand will be paved under tracks automatically

Trains on this track are now able to travel across dimensions

工作盆内物品处理
一个可以对放入的物品以及流体进行处理的盆

处理完毕后，工作盆会尝试从它的侧面向下方输出

若在正确的位置上放置了有效的组件，工作盆会显示出一个输出口

有多种设备可以使得工作盆变为该形态

产物会被输出到盆下方的容器内

如果输出口没有显示，那么盆内的产物将会一直留存在盆内

这在产物需要作为新一轮处理的原料时相当有用

需要输出的产物仍需从盆内取出

你可能需要过滤器来避免未被处理的物品被输出出去
entries.bodyEn:
Processing Items in the Basin
A Basin can hold Items and Fluids for Processing

After a processing step, basins try to output below to the side of them

When a valid component is present, the Basin will show an output faucet

A number of options are applicable here

Outputs will be caught by the inventory below

Without output faucet, the Basin will retain items created in its processing

This can be useful if outputs should be re-used as ingredients

Desired outputs will then have to be extracted from the basin

A Filter might be necessary to avoid pulling out un-processed items

entries.body:
串联起重机
无需强力胶，起重机取物器便可与起重机杆相连

即使是在移动的起重机杆上也是如此

因此，起重机系统可以串联起来，如此可以影响到多轴向的运动

起重机移动方向
起重机杆可以有相反的方向

起重机取物器的移动方向取决于起重机杆的方向

……以及起重机杆的旋转方向

在旋转传递中，此规则同样适用

起重机的力传递
被红石信号激活的起重机杆，将不会移动其上的取物器

作为替代，杆上的旋转力会传递到取物器的输出杆上

使用起重机杆
起重机杆组成了起重机系统的基础，与其相接的取物器可以沿着杆进行移动

起重机系统可以移动与其相接的方块
entries.bodyEn:
Cascaded Gantries
Gantry shafts attach to a carriage without the need of super glue

Same applies for carriages on moved Gantry Shafts

Thus, a gantry system can be cascaded to cover multiple axes of movement

Gantry Movement Direction
Gantry Shafts can have opposite orientations

The movement direction of carriages depend on their shafts' orientation

...as well as the rotation direction of the shaft

Same rules apply for the propagated rotation

Gantry Power Propagation
Redstone-powered gantry shafts stop moving their carriages

Instead, its rotational force is relayed to the carriages' output shaft

Using Gantry Shafts
Gantry Shafts form the basis of a gantry setup. Attached Carriages will move along them.

Gantry setups can move attached Blocks.

entries.body:
阀门手轮可以使组件旋转一个精确的角度

可以在输入面板上配置角度

右击将使其进行一次旋转

潜行并右击可以反向旋转它

记得调好轴承模式，别让结构变回了方块

可以通过染色来美化阀门手轮
entries.bodyEn:
Valve handles can be used to rotate components by a precise angle

The angle can be configured on the input panel

Right-Click to activate one rotation

Sneak-Right-Click to activate it in the opposite direction

Mind that Bearings have to be specifically told not to disassemble

Valve handles can be dyed for aesthetic purposes

entries.body:
桌布可以用来展示物品

在物流系统的帮助下，它们亦可用于出售物品

从商店的库存、打包机和仓储链接站开始

将一个仓储发报机绑定至仓储链接站并且置于商店内

将一只生物或者烈焰人燃烧室指定为店长

将待售的商品放入商店库存

要创建一个新的交易，你需要拿着一张桌布与店长交互

放置后，在一侧的物品栏位设置价格

之后，其他玩家就能与商店交互

结账时，购买的物品将会被打包进一个包裹中

然后，它们可以传输到商铺店面

交付的物品将会被存储在仓储发报机内
entries.bodyEn:
Table cloths can be used to display items

With the help of a logistics system, they can also be used to sell items

Start with the shop's inventory, a Packager and Stock link

Bind a Stock ticker to the link and place it in the shop

Employ a mob or blaze burner as the shop keeper

Fill the shop inventory with items to be sold

To create a new trade, interact with the shop keeper while holding a table cloth

Once placed, set a price in the item slot on the side

Other players can now interact with the shop

When checking out at the cashier, the bought items will be placed into a package

From there, they can be transported to the shop front

The payments will be stored inside the stock ticker block

entries.body:
物品舱口附着在容器上，点击存入手持物品；潜行点击可存入背包中快捷栏以外的物品。

工具箱存放八种物品，附近玩家可用“访问附近工具箱”快捷键远程打开。先设置格子的物品类型，再用补货与交换功能整理常用建材，按键以当前键位设置为准。
entries.bodyEn: An Item Hatch deposits held items; sneak-click deposits non-hotbar inventory items. Toolboxes hold eight types and support the configured nearby-toolbox access key.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
使用石磨处理物品
石磨会对输入的物品进行研磨

在其侧边使用齿轮与其相耦合，方可为其通入动力

顶部可以丢入或者塞入物品

一段时间过后，右击石磨可以拿出其中的产物

产物的提取也是可以自动化的
entries.bodyEn:
Processing Items in the Millstone
Millstones process items by grinding them

They can be powered from the side using cogwheels

Throw or Insert items at the top

After some time, the result can be obtained via Right-click

The outputs can also be extracted by automation

entries.body:
使用动力钻头破坏方块
向其通入旋转力后，动力钻头会破坏它面前的方块

它的挖掘速度取决于通入的旋转速度

在结构中使用动力钻头
当钻头作为动态结构的一部分移动时……

……它会破坏掉它撞上的方块
entries.bodyEn:
Breaking Blocks with the Mechanical Drill
When given Rotational Force, a Mechanical Drill will break blocks directly in front of it

Its mining speed depends on the Rotational Input

Using Mechanical Drills on Contraptions
Whenever Drills are moved as part of an animated Contraption...

...they will break blocks the contraption runs them into

entries.body:
绳索滑轮与结构一同运动
当绳索滑轮本身在结构中被带动时……

……附着在滑轮上的结构会被滑轮拉着一同移动

注意，只有绳索滑轮停止工作时才能被移动

绳索滑轮的运动模式
当绳索滑轮停止运动时，它所附着的动态结构便会方块化

你可以调整使整个结构永不方块化，或者仅在结构的初始位置方块化

同步的滑轮运动
当使用一个滑轮组装了一个动态结构……

……同一高度的其他滑轮也会被连接到结构上

它们不需要接入动力，且只有装饰效果

使用绳索滑轮移动结构
绳索滑轮在接受旋转力时可以垂直移动方块结构

移动的方向及速度取决于提供的转速
entries.bodyEn:
Moving Pulleys as part of a Contraption
Whenever Pulleys are themselves being moved by a Contraption...

...its attached structure will be dragged with it

Mind that pulleys are only movable while stopped

Movement Modes of the Rope Pulley
Whenever Pulleys stop moving, the moved structure reverts to blocks

It can be configured never to revert to solid blocks, or only at the location it started at

Synchronised Pulley Movement
Whenever a pulley assembles a contraption...

...other pulleys on the same layer will connect to the structure

They do not require to be powered, the effect is purely cosmetic

Moving Structures using Rope Pulleys
Rope Pulleys can move blocks vertically when given Rotational Force

Direction and Speed of movement depend on the Rotational Input

entries.body:
使用注液器填充物品
注液器可以将流体装入下方经过且可以接受该流体的物品

注液器的流体容器无法直接手动交互

使用管道可以将流体输入到注液器内

输入的物品可以被放置在其下方的置物台上

当传送带上的物品经过注液器下方时……

注液器会使物品停下，然后自动处理这一物品
entries.bodyEn:
Filling Items using a Spout
The Spout can fill fluid holding items provided beneath it

The content of a Spout cannot be accessed manually

Instead, Pipes can be used to supply it with fluids

The Input items can be placed on a Depot under the Spout

When items are provided on a belt...

The Spout will hold and process them automatically

entries.body:
玫瑰石英灯
玫瑰石英灯通入红石信号后会处于激活状态

它们之后会继续产生红石信号

当多盏灯排成一组时……

……激活一盏灯会集中信号给它，并熄灭其余的灯

比较器根据到激活的灯的距离产生输出

灯也可以用扳手手动开关
entries.bodyEn:
Rose Quartz Lamps
Rose Quartz Lamps activate on a Redstone signal

They will continue to emit redstone power afterwards

When multiple lamps are arranged in a group...

...activating a Lamp will focus the signal to it, deactivating all others

Comparators output based on the distance to a powered lamp

The Lamps can also be toggled manually using a Wrench

entries.body:
使用翻牌显示器
翻牌显示器是告示牌的可扩展替代品

它们需要旋转力以供运作

可以使用已书写的剪贴板设置静态文本

使用显示链接器显示动态文本

可以使用染料来改变单行的颜色

可以通过空手点击来重置单行内容
entries.bodyEn:
Using Display Boards
Display Boards are a scalable alternative to the sign

They require Rotational Force to operate

Static text can be applied using written Clipboards

And dynamic text through the use of Display Links

Dyes can be applied to individual lines of the board

Lines can be reset by clicking them with an empty hand

entries.body:
使用弹射置物台
手持弹射置物台时，潜行右击可以设置弹射目标位置

现在，放置下的弹射置物台会将物品弹射至目标位置

限制范围内的任意距离和高度均可作为有效目标地点

但是，目标位置与置物台的连线，必须垂直于置物台的侧面

如果没有设置有效目标位置，弹射置物台会直接将其前方一格设为默认目标位置

提供旋转力可为其蓄力

蓄力完毕后，放置在它上方的物品会被立刻弹射出去

如果目标为容器，则弹射置物台会等待容器有位置后再弹射物品

通过面板，可以调整弹射所要求的物品数量

现在，只有等被放置的物品数量等于所设定数量时，弹射置物台才会弹射物品

生物和玩家站在弹射置物台上时会被直接弹射

使用弹射置物台来分流物品
与黄铜隧道搭配使用时，弹射置物台可以将物品以特定数量进行分流

首先，将黄铜隧道调整为“最近优先”模式，从而让它优先侧面输出

置物台上所设置的物品数量则为被分流出去的物品数量

当所设置的物品数量被分流出去后……

……剩余的物品则会继续前进

使用红石控制弹射置物台
当被红石充能时，弹射置物台停止工作

置物台弹射的瞬间可以被侦测器侦测
entries.bodyEn:
Using Weighted Ejectors
Sneak and Right-Click holding an Ejector to select its target location

The placed ejector will now launch objects to the marked location

A valid target can be at any height or distance within range

They cannot however be off to a side

If no valid Target was selected, it will simply target the block directly in front

Supply Rotational Force in order to charge it up

Items placed on the ejector cause it to trigger

If Inventories are targeted, the ejector will wait until there is space

Using the value panel, a required Stack Size can be configured

It is now limited to this stack size, and only activates when its held stack reaches this amount

Mobs and Players will always trigger an Ejector when stepping on it

Splitting item stacks using Weighted Ejectors
Combined with Brass Tunnels, Ejectors can split item stacks by specific amounts

First, configure the Brass Tunnel to 'Prefer Nearest', in order to prioritize its side output

The Stack Size set on the Ejector now determines the amount to be split off

While a new stack of the configured size exits the side output...

...the remainder will continue on its path

Controlling Weighted Ejectors with Redstone
When powered by Redstone, Ejectors will not activate

Observers can detect when Ejectors activate

entries.body:
侦测列车
选择一个列车轨道，然后将侦测器放在附近

侦测器将检测任何经过标记的列车

侦测器可以设置过滤为仅给匹配的货物激活
entries.bodyEn:
Detecting Trains
Select a Train Track then place the Observer nearby

The Observer will detect any Trains passing over the marker

Observers can be filtered to activate for matching cargo

entries.body:
右击列车站点并在其附近放置邮箱

在库存界面中为其分配一个地址

如果包裹记录的地址与邮箱不匹配……

……列车停靠在车站时会将其作为货物收集

反之，地址相匹配的包裹将会被卸下

被列车运输到目的地的包裹可以从邮箱中取出

与列车类似，处在已卸载区块中的邮箱仍然会发挥作用

包裹仍然可以从它们的仓库中发出或接收
entries.bodyEn:
Right-click a Train Station and place the Postbox nearby

Assign it an address in the inventory UI

If the address of an inserted package does not match it..

Warehouse

→ Outpost

..trains stopping at the station will collect it as cargo

Conversely, packages matching the address will be dropped off

Packages that arrived by train can be extracted from the Postbox

Warehouse

→ Warehouse

Just like trains, Postboxes maintain their behaviour in unloaded chunks

Packages can still be delivered from or to their inventory

entries.body:
动态结构的流体交换
管道无法与动态结构上的流体储罐直接交互

这一方块可以在不停止动态结构的情况下与动态结构上的流体储罐进行交互

放置第二个接口时，记得要与动态结构上的接口相隔 1 到 2 格的距离

当它们经过彼此时，会连接到一起

接口连接状态下，固定端的接口便会作为整个动态结构流体储罐的代理

流体可被泵入到动态结构内……

……或是从动态结构中抽取出来

如果一小段时间内没有流体交换，接口将会断开连接，动态结构将会重新开始运动
entries.bodyEn:
Contraption Fluid Exchange
Fluid Tanks on moving contraptions cannot be accessed by any pipes

This component can interact with fluid tanks without the need to stop the contraption

Place a second one with a gap of 1 or 2 blocks inbetween

Whenever they pass by each other, they will engage in a connection

While engaged, the stationary interface will represent ALL Tanks on the contraption

Fluid can now be inserted...

...or extracted from the contraption

After no contents have been exchanged for a while, the contraption will continue on its way

在库存界面中为其分配一个地址

如果包裹记录的地址与邮箱不匹配……

反之，地址相匹配的包裹将会被卸下

entries.bodyEn:
Right-click a Train Station and place the Postbox nearby

Assign it an address in the inventory UI

If the address of an inserted package does not match it..

Warehouse

→ Outpost

..trains stopping at the station will collect it as cargo

Conversely, packages matching the address will be dropped off

Packages that arrived by train can be extracted from the Postbox

Warehouse

→ Warehouse

Just like trains, Postboxes maintain their behaviour in unloaded chunks

Packages can still be delivered from or to their inventory

entries.body:
利用可调节链式传动箱进行转速调节
未充能的可调节链式传动箱与普通链式传动箱无异

当被充能时，它会将转速加倍并将其传动至其他链式传动箱

若被充能的可调节传动箱并不是动力输入端，它会把转速减半

在这两种情况中，同一组的其他链式传动箱的转速都为被充能的可调节链式传动箱的两倍

转速的倍率可在 ×1 和 ×2 间根据红石信号的强弱来精确调整

12 RPM
entries.bodyEn:
Controlling rotational speed with Chain Gearshifts
Unpowered Chain Gearshifts behave exactly like Chain Drives

When Powered, the speed transmitted to other Chain Drives in the row is doubled

Whenever the Powered Gearshift is not at the source, its speed will be halved instead

In both cases, Chain Drives in the row always run at 2x the speed of the Powered Gearshift

Using analog signals, the ratio can be adjusted more precisely between 1 and 2

12 RPM

entries.body:
使用鼓风机处理物品
当气流吹过熔岩时，气流会被加热

热气流中的物品会被冶炼

但在气流中的食物会被直接烧成灰

而想要烹饪食物，必须要通过吹过火焰的气流来烟熏食物

当气流吹过水后，便可用于洗涤物品

这种加工方法可以做到不少有趣的事情

鼓风机的转速对加工的速度没有影响，只影响气流的吹拂距离

而那些放置在置物台或者传送带上的物品，鼓风机也是可以处理的

鼓风机的气流
鼓风机使用旋转力来制造气流

流速以及方向由所接受旋转力的强弱以及方向而定
entries.bodyEn:
Processing Items using Encased Fans
When passing through lava, the Air Flow becomes Heated

Items caught in the area will be smelted

Food items thrown here would be incinerated

Instead, a setup for Smoking using Fire should be used for them

Air Flows passing through water create a Washing Setup

Some interesting new processing can be done with it

The Speed of the Fan does NOT affect the processing speed, only its range

Fan Processing can also be applied to Items on Depots and Belts

Air flow of Encased Fans
Encased Fans use Rotational Force to create an Air Current

Strength and Direction of Flow depends on the Rotational Input

entries.body:
物品舱口附着在容器上，点击存入手持物品；潜行点击可存入背包中快捷栏以外的物品。

工具箱存放八种物品，附近玩家可用“访问附近工具箱”快捷键远程打开。先设置格子的物品类型，再用补货与交换功能整理常用建材，按键以当前键位设置为准。
entries.bodyEn: An Item Hatch deposits held items; sneak-click deposits non-hotbar inventory items. Toolboxes hold eight types and support the configured nearby-toolbox access key.

entries.body:
桌布可以用来展示物品

在物流系统的帮助下，它们亦可用于出售物品

从商店的库存、打包机和仓储链接站开始

将一个仓储发报机绑定至仓储链接站并且置于商店内

将一只生物或者烈焰人燃烧室指定为店长

将待售的商品放入商店库存

要创建一个新的交易，你需要拿着一张桌布与店长交互

Table cloths can be used to display items

With the help of a logistics system, they can also be used to sell items

Start with the shop's inventory, a Packager and Stock link

Bind a Stock ticker to the link and place it in the shop

Employ a mob or blaze burner as the shop keeper

Fill the shop inventory with items to be sold

To create a new trade, interact with the shop keeper while holding a table cloth

Once placed, set a price in the item slot on the side

Other players can now interact with the shop

When checking out at the cashier, the bought items will be placed into a package

From there, they can be transported to the shop front

The payments will be stored inside the stock ticker block

使用径向底盘黏着方块
相同的径向底盘会连接成一排

当其中的一个底盘被某个结构带动时，其余的底盘也会被带动

底盘的侧边可以变为黏性面

再次点击黏性面，可以让其所有面都变得带黏性

空手潜行右击可以移除其上的黏性物

若有物品与底盘的黏性面相接触……

……底盘便会与同层且位于半径内的所有可到达方块黏着在一起

Attaching blocks using Radial Chassis
Radial Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks in a row

When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it

The side faces of a Radial Chassis can be made Sticky

Click again to make all other sides sticky

Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime

Whenever a Block is next to a sticky face...

...it will attach all reachable blocks within a radius on that layer

Using a Wrench, a precise Radius can be specified for this chassis

Blocks not reachable by any sticky face will not attach

在蛙港间运输包裹
右击一条锁链并在其附近放置货物蛙港

在库存界面中为其分配一个地址

如果包裹记录的地址与蛙港不匹配……

货物蛙港就会把包裹挂到锁链上

如果没有有效的目的地，包裹就会在原地旋转

可以在锁链网络中的任意位置添加更多的蛙港

包裹会在锁链网络中寻找到达对应蛙港的路线

货物蛙港可以直接访问其下方的容器

货物蛙港也可和打包机同时工作，物品在打包后会直接放到锁链物流线上

派送包裹至“李华”

用剪贴板右击蛙港来收集它们的地址

记有地址的剪贴板可以用于在其他UI界面中自动完成地址输入
entries.bodyEn:
Transporting packages between Frogports
Right-click a Chain Conveyor and place the Frogport nearby

Assign it an address in the inventory UI

If the address of an inserted package does not match it..

Albert

→ Peter

..the Frogport will place the package on the conveyor

Packages spin in place if they have no valid destination

More Frogports can be added anywhere on the chain network

Packages find their path to a matching frog on the chain network

→ Peter

Frogports can directly interface with inventories below them

This also works with packagers. Items can be packed and shipped directly

Albert

Addresses packages to 'Peter'

Right-click Frogports with a clipboard to collect their address

Clipboards with collected names can help auto-complete address inputs in other UIs

Right-click it to pour fluids from your held item into it

使用起重机取物器
起重机取物器可以被放置在起重机杆上，并且可以沿着起重机杆运动

起重机可以移动其黏附的方块

串联起重机
无需强力胶，起重机取物器便可与起重机杆相连

即使是在移动的起重机杆上也是如此

因此，起重机系统可以串联起来，如此可以影响到多轴向的运动

起重机移动方向
起重机杆可以有相反的方向

起重机取物器的移动方向取决于起重机杆的方向

……以及起重机杆的旋转方向

在旋转传递中，此规则同样适用

起重机的力传递
被红石信号激活的起重机杆，将不会移动其上的取物器

作为替代，杆上的旋转力会传递到取物器的输出杆上
entries.bodyEn:
Using Gantry Carriages
Gantry Carriages can mount to and slide along a Gantry Shaft.

Gantry setups can move attached Blocks.

Cascaded Gantries
Gantry shafts attach to a carriage without the need of super glue

Same applies for carriages on moved Gantry Shafts

Thus, a gantry system can be cascaded to cover multiple axes of movement

Gantry Movement Direction
Gantry Shafts can have opposite orientations

The movement direction of carriages depend on their shafts' orientation

...as well as the rotation direction of the shaft

Same rules apply for the propagated rotation

Gantry Power Propagation
Redstone-powered gantry shafts stop moving their carriages

Instead, its rotational force is relayed to the carriages' output shaft

entries.body:
使用脉冲延长器控制信号
脉冲延长器可以延长通过的信号

它会在短暂延迟后激活……

……并在配置的持续时间后取消激活

通过面板，可以配置持续时间

配置的持续时间最长可达 1 小时
entries.bodyEn:
Controlling signals using Pulse Extenders
Pulse Extenders can lengthen a signal passing through

They activate after a short delay...

...and cool down for the configured duration

Using the value panel, the discharge time can be configured

The configured duration can range up to an hour

空手潜行右击可以移除此面的黏性物

黏性面可以将此面前方的一长条方块黏住

使用扳手可以精确控制底盘的影响范围

按住 Ctrl 以调节所有底盘的影响范围

若想让底盘的其他面也能粘方块，你需要用到强力胶

成组移动轴向底盘

其中的一个底盘若被移动，其余的底盘也会跟着移动

不同种类的底盘，或者是朝向不一致的底盘，将不会相连

Attaching blocks using Linear Chassis
The open faces of a Linear Chassis can be made Sticky

Click again to make the opposite side sticky

Sneak and Right-Click with an empty hand to remove the slime

Stickied faces of the Linear Chassis will attach a line of blocks in front of it

Using a Wrench, a precise Range can be specified for this chassis

Holding CTRL adjusts the range of all connected Chassis Blocks

Attaching blocks to any other side requires the use of Super Glue

Using these mechanics, structures of any shape can move as a Contraption

Moving Linear Chassis in groups
Linear Chassis connect to identical Chassis blocks next to them

When one is moved by a Contraption, the others are dragged with it

Chassis of a different type or facing another direction will not attach

entries.body:

大水车利用相邻的水流来产生旋转力

覆盖其他侧面不会进一步增加其动力输出

它的旋转速度只有普通水车的一半……

……但是大幅提高了应力生产能力

对水车使用木板以改变其外观
entries.bodyEn:
Generating Rotational Force using Large Water Wheels
Large Water Wheels draw force from adjacent Water Currents

Covering additional sides will not improve its kinetic output further

These rotate only at half the speed of regular water wheels...

...but provide a substantially higher stress capacity

Use wood planks on the wheel to change its appearance

当安山隧道与侧边有连接时……

……经过的所有物品堆都会被精准地分出一个物品

剩下的物品则不受影响，继续前进
entries.bodyEn:
Using Andesite Tunnels
Andesite Tunnels can be used to cover up your belts

Whenever an Andesite Tunnel has connections to the sides...

...they will split exactly one item off of any passing stacks

The remainder will continue on its path

后方输入的信号会将其设为开启状态

侧边输入的信号会将其设为关闭状态

你也可以手动切换其状态
entries.bodyEn:
Controlling signals using the Powered Latch
Powered Latches are redstone controllable Levers

Signals at the back switch it on

Signals from the side switch it back off

Powered latches can also be toggled manually

entries.body:
配置动力臂
你得在放置动力臂之前就配置好它的输入以及输出端

手持动力臂右击某个容器，可以将其指定为目标

再次右击可以使其在输入端（蓝色）以及输出端（黄色）之间切换

左击此组件可以移除选择

将动力臂放下来后，它会将此前选择的方块作为目标

在有效范围内，动力臂可以有任意数量的输出以及输入端

然而，并不是所有的容器可以被直接交互

在此情况下，漏斗和置物台可以解决此问题

过滤动力臂的输出端
有时，你会想着利用某种过滤限制动力臂的目标

动力臂自身并不提供任何过滤选项

然而，若将黄铜漏斗作为目标，则漏斗的过滤槽可以应用至动力臂上

动力臂足够智能，它不会去拿取那些它无法分配的物品

动力臂的分配模式
若动力臂必须在数个有效的输出端之间作出选择……

……它会依照自己的设定选择特定的行为

面板允许您对其进行配置

“轮询调度”模式很好理解，即循环输出至所有有效的输出端

如果某个输出端无法容纳更多物品，则它会被跳过

“强制轮询调度”不会跳过任何输出端，动力臂会一直等待，直到输出端有空位容纳物品输入

“第一目标优先”模式会使得动力臂先将物品输出至更早被选择的输出端

利用红石信号控制动力臂
当被红石充能时，动力臂会停止工作

在停止工作前，它会完成当前正在进行的工作周期

因此，通入单次负红石脉冲可以精确控制动力臂，使其每次只进行单个周期的工作
entries.bodyEn:
Setting up Mechanical Arms
Mechanical Arms have to be assigned their in- and outputs before they are placed

Right-Click inventories while holding the Arm to assign them as Targets

Right-Click again to toggle between Input (Blue) and Output (Yellow)

Left-Click components to remove their Selection

Once placed, the Mechanical Arm will target the blocks selected previously

They can have any amount of in- and outputs within their range

However, not every type of Inventory can be interacted with directly

Funnels and Depots can help to Bridge that gap

Filtering Outputs of the Mechanical Arm
Inputs

Outputs

Sometimes it is desirable to restrict targets of the Arm by matching a filter

Mechanical Arms by themselves do not provide any options for filtering

Brass Funnels as Targets do however communicate their own filter to the Arm

The Arm is smart enough not to pick up items it couldn't distribute

Distribution modes of the Mechanical Arm
Outputs

Whenever an Arm has to choose between multiple valid outputs...

...it will act according to its setting

The value panel will allow you to configure it

Round Robin mode simply cycles through all outputs that are available

If an output is unable to take more items, it will be skipped

Forced Round Robin mode will never skip outputs, and instead wait until they are free

Prefer First prioritizes the outputs selected earliest when configuring this Arm

Controlling Mechanical Arms with Redstone
When powered by Redstone, Mechanical Arms will not activate

Before stopping, it will finish any started cycles

Thus, a negative pulse can be used to trigger exactly one activation cycle

entries.body: 这是结构或端口部件。按对应多方块的结构预览放置；端口承担输入/输出时，在成形结构或端口 GUI 中设置方向。
entries.bodyEn: Place this structural/port component according to its multiblock guide. Configure port directions in the formed structure or port GUI.

entries.body: 用水车、风车或其他动力源带动轴、齿轮和传动部件。机器除了转速还受应力容量限制；用护目镜和应力表检查网络。
entries.bodyEn: Connect shafts and gears to a kinetic source. Machines require sufficient speed and stress capacity. Goggles and stressometers inspect the network.

entries.body:
车站和调度
时刻表可用于为司机提供目的地

当有列车到站时，比较器会检测到一个信号

注意，只能从指示的方向驶入车站

车站也可以用于自动分配新的时刻表

放置在车站上的时刻表会自动复制到当前列车上

与手动调度相反，司机不会携带物品在身上

使用列车时刻表
时刻表让列车可以被其他司机控制

将物品拿在手上右击打开界面

一旦规划好，时刻表就可以交给列车司机

任何坐在列车驾驶台前面的生物，或者烈焰人燃烧室，都能成为一名合格的列车长

用拴绳拴住生物可以更方便地使它们坐上座位

可以随时从司机那里取回时刻表
entries.bodyEn:
Stations & Scheduling
Schedules can be used to provide drivers with a destination

Comparators will receive a signal whenever a Train is present

Mind that a Station can only be approached from the indicated direction

Stations can also be used to assign new Schedules automatically

The Schedule placed on a station will automatically copy itself to present trains

As opposed to manual scheduling, drivers will not take the item with them

Using Train Schedules
Schedules allow Trains to be controlled by other Drivers

Right-click with the item in hand to open its Interface

Once programmed, the Schedule can be handed off to a Train Driver

Any mob or blaze burner sitting in front of Train Controls is an eligible conductor

Creatures on a lead can be given their seat more conveniently

Schedules can be retrieved from Drivers at any moment

entries.body:
传送带用法
手持传送带右击两根传动杆，可以将两根杆连接起来

如果不小心选错了，潜行右击即可取消选择

你也可以在传送带的中间加装额外的传动杆

通过传送带连接的传动杆，会以相同的转速以及方向进行旋转

加装的传动杆可以用扳手拆下来

传送带亦可染色

传送带的有效连接方向
传送带的连接方向并不是任意的

1. 可以水平连接

2. 可以对角连接

3. 可以垂直连接

4. 还可以水平连接竖直放置的传动杆

以上为所有可能的连接方向，传送带的连接范围为 2 到 20 格

给传送带装壳
安山机壳或黄铜机壳，可以用来装饰传送带

使用扳手即可移除机壳

在物流中使用传送带
运动的传送带可以运输物品以及其他实体

空手右击传送带，即可将其上的物品拿下来
entries.bodyEn:
Using Mechanical Belts
Right-Clicking two shafts with a belt item will connect them together

Accidental selections can be canceled with Right-Click while Sneaking

Additional Shafts can be added throughout the Belt

Shafts connected via Belts will rotate with Identical Speed and Direction

Added shafts can be removed using the wrench

Mechanical Belts can be dyed for aesthetic purposes

Valid Orientations for Mechanical Belts
Belts cannot connect in arbitrary directions

1. They can connect horizontally

2. They can connect diagonally

3. They can connect vertically

4. And they can connect vertical shafts horizontally

These are all possible directions. Belts can span any Length between 2 and 20 blocks

Encasing Belts
Brass or Andesite Casing can be used to decorate Mechanical Belts

A wrench can be used to remove the casing

Using Mechanical Belts for Logistics
Moving belts will transport Items and other Entities

Right-Click with an empty hand to take items off a belt

entries.body:
使用空的烈焰人燃烧室
手持空的烈焰人燃烧室右击烈焰人来抓取烈焰人

或者，可以直接从烈焰人刷怪笼中收集烈焰人

这样，你便有了一个可供部分机器加工的热源

如果是为了美观，空的烈焰人燃烧室也可以被打火石点燃

你可以使用注入了灵魂的物品转化这种火焰

但是，没有烈焰人，这样的火焰并不足以用于工业级加热工作
entries.bodyEn:
Using Empty Blaze Burners
Right-click a Blaze with the empty burner to capture it

Alternatively, Blazes can be collected from their Spawners directly

You now have an ideal heat source for various machines

For Aesthetic purposes, Empty Blaze Burners can also be lit using Flint and Steel

The flame can be transformed using a soul-infused item

However, without a blaze they are not suitable for industrial heating

entries.body:
使用强力胶来黏附方块
强力胶用于将方块组合成动态结构

右击两个端点来创建一个新的“胶合”区域

手持强力胶左击可以移除选区

同一个选区内相邻的方块会互相拉动对方

互相重叠的选区会一起移动

悬挂在其它方块上的方块通常不需要强力胶
entries.bodyEn:
Attaching blocks using Super Glue
Super Glue groups blocks together into moving contraptions

Clicking two endpoints creates a new 'glued' area

To remove a box, punch it with the glue item in hand

Adjacent blocks sharing an area will pull each other along

Overlapping glue volumes will move together

Blocks hanging on others usually do not require glue

entries.body:
操作步骤
手持扳手右键支持的机械动力方块，围绕点击面的轴调整朝向。潜行＋右键拆卸支持的部件并回收；传送带、漏斗、管道及其他连接组件依照它们自己的可调整状态响应。

输入与输出
漏斗送不出、机械臂取不到物品时先看箭头与接口朝向。转动机器会改变连接关系，齿轮、轴、皮带和流体口都要重新核对。对准不同面可能得到不同旋转轴。

故障排查
没有反应先确认目标支持扳手以及是否在领地保护范围内。不要把所有模组扳手当作机械动力扳手的完全替代品；各自支持的拆卸和旋转逻辑不同。
entries.bodyEn:
Right-click a supported Create component with the wrench to rotate it around the clicked face. Sneak-right-click dismantles supported components. Belts, funnels, pipes and other connections have their own adjustable states.

Inspect arrows and face directions when a funnel or Mechanical Arm cannot transfer. Rotation can change shaft, gear, belt and fluid connections. If nothing happens, check support and protection; other mods' wrenches are not necessarily equivalent.

entries.body:
操作步骤
佩戴工程师护目镜，对准机械动力机器和传动组件读取信息。转速表观察转速与旋转方向，应力表观察动力网络负载；它们与护目镜提供的是诊断，不会自动增加动力。

故障排查
整条线停转：先确认动力源正在输出，再检查是否过载、传动是否断开、齿轮或轴是否接反。提高转速也会提高许多机器的应力需求，不能只给末端加变速器就认为所有设备都会更快。

加工停住
网络仍转而机器不加工时，检查所需最低转速、旋转方向、物品位置、配方条件和输出空间。应力足够只说明能驱动，不代表加工条件满足。流体设备另查泵方向、管路和目标储槽。
entries.bodyEn:
Wear Engineer Goggles and look at Create machinery and transmission components. Speedometers show speed and direction; Stressometers show network load. These are diagnostics, not power sources.

For a stopped network, check the source, overstress, broken connections and opposed rotation. Higher speed often increases stress requirements. If the network turns but processing stops, check minimum speed, direction, ingredients, placement and output space; inspect pump directions and tanks for fluid machines.

entries.body:
操作步骤
用蓝图与笔选择区域并保存，或在蓝图桌把已存在的蓝图写入空白蓝图。手持蓝图部署预览，按住蓝图工具菜单键并滚轮选择移动、旋转等工具，再按屏幕提示调整。确认位置、朝向和高度后才交给加农炮。

输入与输出
在加农炮 GUI 放入已经部署的蓝图，提供火药，在相邻库存放材料。放入书或剪贴板可制作材料清单。设置替换策略、是否跳过缺料以及如何处理原有方块后启动。

故障排查
不施工先检查蓝图是否部署、目标是否在可施工范围、火药、材料和红石状态。预览位置错误应先暂停并取回蓝图重新部署；蓝图记录结构，不会免除材料消耗。
entries.bodyEn:
Select and save a region with Schematic and Quill, or write an existing file using the Schematic Table. Deploy the preview. Hold the schematic menu key and scroll between manipulation tools, then follow the on-screen instructions to set position and rotation.

Insert the deployed schematic into the cannon, supply gunpowder and adjacent material inventories, and print a material list with a book or clipboard. Review replacement and missing-material policies before starting. For no construction, inspect deployment, reach, fuel, materials and redstone.

entries.zh: 工业先锋：范围、工作条件与附加流体
entries.body:
一、先看工作区
在机器 GUI 开启工作范围预览，核对朝向、高度与是否覆盖目标。范围升级影响支持范围的机器，不会让任意设备忽略位置和目标规则。

二、再看运行条件
检查 FE、红石控制、工作区是否存在有效作物/实体/方块。流体提取器等设备有自己的工作方式，不能给每台设备都套同一套“通电就转”规则。种植机种子、采收机目标高度和产物流向要分别安排。

三、输入输出分开查
溶解室按当前 JEI 准备物品与流体，材料是无序放置；每类流体先确认名称和数量。副产物流体储槽满也会堵住设备。空储槽不代表管道资源类型和接收面就一定正确。

四、附属升级
机器不支持的升级不能强装。水培模拟处理器先在普通水培床训练数据；大型溶解室按本机附属版本是单方块，不能照旧教程搭多方块。
entries.bodyEn:
Inspect the displayed working area, facing and height before adding upgrades. Check FE, redstone and valid crops, entities or blocks; machines have different operating requirements.

For the Dissolution Chamber, supply the installed JEI ingredients and fluid. Its ingredients are shapeless. A full byproduct tank can block work. Check resource type and receiving side even when a tank appears empty.

Use only supported upgrades. Train hydroponic simulation data in a normal Hydroponic Bed first. The installed Extra Upgrades large chamber is a single block rather than the structure shown in older guides.

entries.body: 接入 FE，在机器 GUI 设置工作区域、输入输出和红石控制。处理类机器按 JEI 供给物品/流体；作业类机器保持工作区有效和产物可输出。
entries.bodyEn: Supply FE and configure work area, sides and redstone control. Processing machines consume JEI inputs; world-working machines need valid targets and free outputs.

entries.body: 流体提取器面向适用原木收集乳胶。乳胶加工单元同时输入乳胶和水并供能，橡胶后续加工成塑料；具体配方查 JEI。
entries.bodyEn: Face a fluid extractor into a valid log to collect latex. Supply latex, water and power to the latex processing unit; process rubber further into plastic using JEI recipes.

entries.body: 向物品格投入完整配方材料，流体槽注入配方流体并供能。配方要求的空位也需保留；输出物品和流体都要及时取走。
entries.bodyEn: Insert the complete item recipe, supply its fluid and power. Preserve empty recipe slots where required. Keep both item and fluid outputs clear.

entries.body: 把生物限制在机器工作区域内。屠宰/粉碎设备输出各自的流体或战利品；复制机还需有效的生物捕获装置与精华；停滞室用于保持目标生物。
entries.bodyEn: Keep mobs inside the working area. Slaughter and crusher machines produce their respective fluids or loot. Duplicators also require a valid captured mob and essence; stasis chambers hold targets.

entries.body: 钻头对准矿石或流体激光基座并供能。基座中配置镜片与深度；产物还受维度、生物群系和配方条件影响，不是仅接电就能产出任意资源。
entries.bodyEn: Aim powered laser drills at the correct base. Configure lenses and depth at the base; dimensions, biomes and recipe conditions also control the output.

entries.body: 在 GUI 确认作业范围，让作物、土壤或动物位于该范围。按机器类型补充种子、肥料、饲料、流体或能量，并抽取物品及流体副产物。
entries.bodyEn: Keep valid crops, soil or animals within the configured work area. Provide seeds, fertilizer, feed, fluids or energy as required and extract all products.

entries.body: 根据机器界面区分物品、经验和流体槽，按 JEI 流程逐级处理。洗涤、发酵、筛分设备通常需要前一步的流体产物，别把不同流体管路接混。
entries.bodyEn: Use the machine slots for items, experience and fluids as labelled. Follow JEI processing stages and keep fluid outputs routed into the correct next machine.

entries.zh: 流体提取机：从原木提取乳胶
entries.body:
把有效原木放在机器正前方，从内部流体罐抽出乳胶。原木会逐渐被消耗：先变去皮原木，之后消失，需要自动补放。多台提取机可以围着同一原木工作。

不供电也可提取，接电会加快。不同木材的提取效率看 JEI；它不负责把乳胶变成橡胶。
entries.bodyEn: Place a valid log in front and extract latex. Logs are gradually stripped and consumed. Power is optional and accelerates extraction.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
向两个流体输入分别供给乳胶和水，并接电生产干橡胶。不要只给乳胶，也不要把水挤进已经装乳胶的罐。

干橡胶到塑料的后续加工看本包 JEI 配方。自动化时同时检查两种流体库存与成品输出空间。
entries.bodyEn: Supply latex, water and energy. Keep both fluid supplies available and extract dry rubber. Follow the installed recipes for subsequent plastic processing.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 溶解室：物品与流体合成
entries.body:
接电，在物品输入区放齐配方要求的材料，并把所需流体送入输入罐。当前版本最多使用八类物品输入与一种流体。配方是无序的，不要求材料按 JEI 图中的格位摆放。

材料齐全并找到配方后，机器会锁定物品槽以免继续塞料。它可输出物品或流体，两类产物都要安排抽取；成品罐满、物品不足或流体种类错误都会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power, all item ingredients and the input fluid. Recipes are shapeless. Once a recipe matches, ingredient slots lock. Extract both item and fluid results.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 种植机的九区种子配置
entries.body:
把机器安在种植区域下方，检查工作范围投影。GUI 的九个彩色种子槽对应上方区域的九个分区；在对应格放种子或树苗，并接电。

作物还需要有效土壤、空间及各自生长条件。范围插件只扩大兼容机器的区域，不能让种子绕过种植条件。
entries.bodyEn: Place below the farming area. The nine colored seed slots correspond to nine regions. Provide power, valid soil and sufficient space.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
提供骨粉或本模组肥料及电能，面向有效作物区域。它会持续对同一株施肥，直到那株不能再接受骨粉，然后转向下一株。

向日葵等一直能接受骨粉的目标可能占住工作顺序；不要把这类目标混进普通作物田。
entries.bodyEn: Supply bone meal or fertilizer and power. The machine keeps fertilizing a target until it no longer accepts bone meal; endlessly fertilizable plants can monopolize it.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 收割机：作物、树木与污泥
entries.body:
接电并对准农田或树木，收取成熟作物和木材。树木只要底部原木位于工作区，采伐还会沿相连原木和树叶继续。

普通模式会破坏作物，安排种植机补种；供给少量以太可支持对应重种行为。机器还会产生污泥，接流体输出交给污泥精炼机，避免内部副产物积满。
entries.bodyEn: Harvest mature crops and connected trees with power. Crops normally need replanting; ether supports replanting behavior. Extract sludge as well as items.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
在水培床上放可兼容作物，提供电与水；下界作物使用对应的熔岩条件。它加速上方作物生长。

补给少量以太能显著加强生长并自动重种。把收获端、流体和电力一起接好；单独放一张床不会自行完成种植和输出。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the crop, power and water, or lava for supported Nether crops. Ether greatly accelerates growth and supports automatic replanting.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 模拟水培床与模拟处理器
entries.body:
模拟水培床读取水培模拟处理器中记录的数据来产生作物掉落物。先准备带有效模拟数据的处理器，再放入床的对应槽，供电并抽取产物。

空白处理器或不支持的作物数据不会提供有效产出。它与普通水培床的实体种植流程不同，检查处理器提示与床的状态栏。
entries.bodyEn: The simulated bed uses crop data on a Hydroponic Simulation Processor. Insert a processor with valid data, supply power and extract drops. Check the processor and machine status.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
在工作范围内放可繁殖的成年动物，向机器提供对应繁殖食物与电能。它按动物接受的食物喂养，不能用一种种子喂所有物种。

留出幼体空间，配合幼体分离机把新生动物移到另一侧，防止区域内拥挤。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power and the species-specific breeding food. Keep valid adults inside the work area and separate offspring when needed.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
接电并把羊、牛等放进前方范围，机器对兼容动物剪毛或挤奶。羊需要先长回羊毛，不能连续无限剪取。

物品与流体产物分别抽取；没有合适动物或产物库存已满时不再工作。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power and compatible animals in range. It shears sheep and milks cows; collect item and fluid outputs separately.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
机器把范围内匹配的动物传送到背后，默认用于将幼体与成体分开。GUI 可以切换所移动的动物类型。

先确认朝向，背后要留出围栏和接收空间。它不会生成或繁殖动物，应与喂养机分工。
entries.bodyEn: Configure the target type in the GUI. Matching animals are moved behind the machine. Provide a safe receiving pen and correct orientation.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
下水道从范围内动物收集污水，并可把附近经验转为精华。通过流体管分别抽取相应流体。

把污水送进污水堆肥机得到肥料，再供催熟机使用。肥料不是精华，两个循环的管路需要区分。
entries.bodyEn: The sewer collects animal sewage and experience-derived essence. Send sewage to the composter for fertilizer; route essence separately.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
把生物送入前方工作范围并接电。该机器把生物转成液态肉和粉红黏液，不生成普通掉落物或经验。

两种流体分别安排抽取。被动动物通常更适合粉红黏液产线；需要物品掉落和经验时使用生物粉碎机。
entries.bodyEn: This machine turns mobs into liquid meat and pink slime, without normal drops or experience. Extract both fluids; use a Mob Crusher for loot.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 生物粉碎机：掉落物与精华
entries.body:
供电，保持目标位于工作范围，机器按生物战利品表产生掉落物，并生成精华。物品和精华要分别导出。

GUI 可切换不产精华、改用随机时运等级的模式。不要把屠宰场的液态肉/粉红黏液输出与本机混为一条流程。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power and mobs in range. Collect loot and essence separately. An alternate mode trades essence production for random Fortune levels.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 生物复制机与生物捕捉工具
entries.body:
手持生物捕捉工具右击目标将其装入，再把带生物数据的工具放入复制机。机器还需要电和精华，在周围生成对应生物。

附近同类生物过多时会停止生成，及时把产出生物移走。工具也能通过对地使用释放所装生物；空工具不会指定复制种类。
entries.bodyEn: Capture a mob in a Mob Imprisonment Tool, insert it, then supply power and essence. Nearby entity limits can stop spawning.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
停滞室接电后冻结并治疗工作范围内的实体，可用于固定以太产线的凋灵。机器有效范围需要覆盖目标。

以太由流体激光钻基座在凋灵正上方按其配方条件抽取，停滞室本身不产以太。钻基座仍需要钻头充能及正确催化条件。
entries.bodyEn: A powered Stasis Chamber freezes and heals entities in range. Ether extraction uses a Fluid Laser Base above a Wither; the chamber only holds the entity.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
供给电能、凋灵骷髅头和灵魂沙，机器在前方工作区域自动摆出召唤结构。确认投影区域没有阻挡，材料库存足够。

它只负责摆放召唤结构，需另行安排凋灵固定、击杀与产物回收。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power, wither skeleton skulls and soul sand. Keep the build area clear. The machine assembles the summon structure; containment and killing are separate.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
向激光钻供电，调整方向与位置，让它的工作范围找到矿物或流体激光钻基座。钻头给找到的基座充能，资源在基座中产出。

钻头有电但无进度时，检查它是否实际指向基座，不能直接从钻头抽矿。
entries.bodyEn: Power the drill and align its work area with a compatible laser base. It charges the base; resource outputs are collected from the base.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 矿物激光钻基座与透镜
entries.body:
放好基座并让激光钻向它充能。GUI 设置采掘深度，产物权重还受基座所在生物群系影响。

彩色透镜提高对应资源的产出权重，不保证只产一种矿。先在 JEI 核对目标矿的生物群系、深度和透镜颜色，保持物品输出畅通。
entries.bodyEn: Charge the base with laser drills. Depth, biome and lens weighting affect results. Lenses increase weight rather than guarantee exclusive output.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
放入 JEI 配方所需催化物，催化物用于匹配条件而不会消耗。调整深度，在要求的生物群系设置基座，并连接激光钻充能。

部分流体还要求基座下面有指定实体。产物从基座流体罐抽取；只有充能、没有催化物或实体条件时不会出液体。
entries.bodyEn: Insert the nonconsumed catalyst, match biome/depth and any entity condition, then charge with drills. Extract the produced fluid from the base.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
向洗矿厂供给矿物原料、液态肉和电力，产出对应矿种的生矿肉流体。为不同矿种安排清晰管路，避免残留另一种矿肉占据目标罐。

生矿肉还需要送发酵站加工，本机不会直接输出金属粉。
entries.bodyEn: Combine an ore with liquid meat and power to produce that ore’s raw ore meat. Send the fluid to a fermentation station.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
把生矿肉送入发酵站，在 GUI 选择生产类型和封存液位。达到配置液位后才封存并开始发酵。

产出发酵矿肉后送流体筛分机；液位设得过高但供料不足时，看起来会一直等待，检查封存设置。
entries.bodyEn: Choose the production mode and sealing threshold. Raw ore meat ferments after reaching that level; insufficient fill can leave it waiting.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
输入发酵矿肉、沙子与电，机器把流体加工成对应矿种的粉末。沙子是参与处理的材料，不能只供流体。

成品接后续冶炼，输出库存满时停止。检查输入流体是否已经完成发酵。
entries.bodyEn: Supply fermented ore meat, sand and power to obtain the corresponding ore dust. Raw ore meat must be fermented first.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
把收割机的污泥送入精炼机并供电，产生对应的随机材料。为多种可能产物预留输出格并连接物品抽取。

它消耗污泥，不接受污水或液态肉；不同副产物流体需要独立过滤。
entries.bodyEn: Supply sludge and power, then collect its possible material outputs. Sewage and liquid meat are separate fluids.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
供给水、熔岩和电。在 GUI 选择基础产物及后续动作，把生成的石料继续熔炼、粉碎或合成。

这些动作是机器内部的处理链，要按需要依次配置。产物和本包允许的加工以 JEI 为准；输出不畅会使链路停止。
entries.bodyEn: Supply water, lava and power. Configure the generated material and subsequent smelting, crushing or crafting actions. Extract the final output.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
供电并在输入区放可熔炼物品，多个加工槽可以并行处理。除成品外，每次熔炼还会生成少量精华。

物品成品和精华分别抽取，持续自动化时避免任一输出区积满。
entries.bodyEn: Powered parallel smelting also produces essence. Extract the smelted items and the fluid byproduct.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
让机器相邻至少两个水源，开始生成水。接入流体管收取内部水罐。

增加相邻水源并供电可提高产水速度。它的水源条件由相邻方块判断，仅在远处放一池水不够。
entries.bodyEn: Place at least two adjacent source-water blocks. Additional sources and power accelerate collection. Extract the internal water buffer.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
把机器放在至少三乘三、一格深的水池上方，供电后自动捕鱼。让下方保持有效水池，物品从内部库存抽取。

输出可能包括鱼之外的战利品，接收库存应留出多种物品位置。
entries.bodyEn: Place above a water pool at least 3×3 and one block deep. Supply power and collect the fishing outputs.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
放入可复制的真菌，提供水和电进行复制。下界真菌需要熔岩条件，按当前配方接入正确流体。

它复制真菌，不承担树木收割或普通作物种植。为输入和输出分配不同物流侧。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a supported fungus, power and the required fluid; Nether fungi use lava. Route input and output separately.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 生物反应机：原料多样性
entries.body:
输入水与兼容的种子、树苗、染料等生物原料，产出生物燃料。同一批中不同原料种类越多，单位材料的生物燃料收益越好。

用过滤和定量补料维持多种原料，避免一种廉价材料塞满所有格。生物燃料送发电机或无尽工具。
entries.bodyEn: Combine water and compatible biological ingredients. A greater variety of ingredients improves fuel yield. Keep input slots supplied with distinct types.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 简易与生物燃料发电机
entries.body:
简易发电机燃烧可燃物供能；内部能量满时仍可能继续消耗当前燃料。生物燃料发电机使用流体生物燃料，能量满时可停止耗燃料。

把能量送往外部储能或负载，按机型分别接物品燃料或流体燃料。
entries.bodyEn: The Pitiful Generator burns solid fuel and can waste a burning fuel while full. The Biofuel Generator uses biofuel and pauses fuel use when its energy buffer is full.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 菌丝发电机与菌丝反应堆
entries.body:
各类菌丝发电机使用不同物品、流体或特殊条件。先按各机器 GUI 与 JEI 供给各自燃料，再接电力输出，不能把所有发电机都当煤炭发电机。

菌丝反应堆要求每一种所需菌丝发电机各有一台同时实际工作。只是摆出机器或让已满储能的发电机待机不满足条件；保持燃料和能量消耗端都畅通。
entries.bodyEn: Each mycelial generator has its own fuel or condition. The reactor requires all required generator types to be actively running simultaneously, not merely placed or idle.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
输入未附魔的可附魔物品、大量精华与电力，机器进行对应等级的附魔。确保精华是本机接受的流体，成品从输出槽取出。

它会生成附魔，不是把书上的指定附魔转移到装备。指定合并使用附魔施加器。
entries.bodyEn: Supply an enchantable item, essence and power. The factory generates enchantments; use the applicator for targeted book/item combination.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
输入带附魔物品与书并接电，把物品附魔提取到书上。GUI 还可切换把附魔转为精华的模式。

两种模式的结果不同，启动前检查模式、书的库存和输出空间；不要把需要保留的附魔在精华模式下处理。
entries.bodyEn: Provide an enchanted item and books. Select extraction to books or conversion into essence before starting. Keep output space available.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
类似铁砧，把待处理物品与附魔书/合并材料放入对应槽。它以精华支付费用，接电并提供足够精华后取得结果。

高费用操作还可使用机器上方储罐的精华。检查兼容性和费用，不能用普通水替代精华。
entries.bodyEn: Use the anvil-like input slots and pay with essence. Large operations can draw essence from a tank above the machine. Check compatibility and cost.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
把混合物品交给分选机，分别输出有附魔与无附魔的物品。为各输出连接独立库存。

它只分类，不执行附魔、脱附或经验转换。
entries.bodyEn: Separate enchanted and unenchanted items into their respective outputs. It does not enchant or remove enchantments.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
提供电、水、空瓶与酿造材料，在各材料槽设置自动酿造链。内部有水时可填充空瓶。

绿色过滤槽必须设定允许取出的目标药水，否则成品可能无法抽出；中间药水应留给后续酿造。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power, water, bottles and brewing ingredients. Configure the green output filter to the final potion so intermediate stages stay in the machine.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
在 GUI 选择目标染料，补给其需要的基础颜色与电力，再抽取目标色。不同目标需要的基础色组合不同。

先检查配方与每种颜色库存，缺少一色会停止，不是任意染料都能直接换成任意颜色。
entries.bodyEn: Select the desired dye and supply its base-color ingredients and power. All required colors must be available.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
破坏机处理正前方方块，把掉落物放入内部库存；放置机消耗内部方块，在正前方放置。二者都需电力并受目标空间条件限制。

先确认正面，再配置红石和自动输出。种植、乳胶原木补放等流程可用放置机配合，不能把破坏机输出接回自己的目标格。
entries.bodyEn: Both operate directly in front. The breaker collects drops; the placer consumes stored blocks. Supply power and configure redstone and output routing.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
收集器抽取正前方的流体源方块，放置器消耗内部流体在目标位置放置。接电并让输入或输出管道连接正确的内部流体罐。

流动水不等于源方块，目标已被占用也会影响放置。与世界交互和罐到罐传输是两种用途。
entries.bodyEn: The collector drains a source block in front; the placer places stored fluid. Supply power and connect the correct fluid buffer.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
物品和流体传输器装在相隔一格的库存对应侧，两端都要安装。右击中心切换输入/抽取，在 GUI 设置黑白名单；同一面可以叠装不同类型。

调节模式限制目标库存保持的数量，速度与效率插件分别提高工作频率和单次量。世界传输器用于拾取或投出世界物品，不是普通库存间桥接。
entries.bodyEn: Install matching transporters at both inventories. Configure insertion/extraction, filters and regulator limits. World transporters interact with dropped items.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
传送带移动物品和实体，流体运输只支持水平段。染料改变颜色；荧石加速物品/实体，塑料防止路过玩家捡走带上物品。

抽取与插入升级操作库存，检测升级输出检测信号，弹射/掉落/传送升级改变去向，分配升级按 GUI 比例分流。需要分流的出口侧都应装对应升级，并在升级 GUI 设置过滤。
entries.bodyEn: Conveyors move items/entities and transport fluids horizontally. Upgrades extract, insert, detect, launch, drop, teleport or split; configure their filters and destination settings.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 范围、速度、效率与处理插件
entries.body:
范围插件扩大有工作区且接受插件的机器范围。速度、效率、处理插件分别影响工作进度、操作所需时间或完成时的处理次数；它们不是同一个参数。

把插件插入机器的插件槽，并用范围投影和 GUI 状态检查实际效果。提高处理量后同步补足能量、原料及输出。
entries.bodyEn: Range addons affect compatible work areas. Other addons change progress speed, operation time or operations per completion. Install in accepted slots and size the supporting supply accordingly.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
无尽工具以已储能量决定等级，高等级解锁更大范围或更强功能。潜行右击打开工具 GUI，设置范围、模式和充电开关；生物燃料可提高使用效率。

钻头用于范围挖掘，锯用于连续伐木，锤用于范围攻击与斩首，三叉戟提供对应投掷能力。无尽充能器给可充能物品充电，特别适合大量储能的无尽工具。
entries.bodyEn: Stored energy determines the tool tier. Sneak-right-click configures modes and charging. Drill, saw, hammer and trident have distinct functions; biofuel improves efficiency.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 无尽背包与肉食供给器
entries.body:
无尽背包可配置自动拾取、磁铁、库存补货和多余物品销毁。每格规则独立设置；启用销毁前确认过滤内容。

背包内生物燃料支持自动操作，精华用于收集经验，液态肉用于自动进食。肉食供给器也能在玩家背包中使用所储液态肉补充食物。
entries.bodyEn: Configure pickup, magnet, restocking and overflow rules per slot. Biofuel powers automation, essence stores picked-up experience, and liquid meat supports feeding.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
检测前方范围的实体数，在背面输出对应强度的红石信号。确认工作区、朝向和后方信号线路。

可用来控制刷怪、繁殖或物流开关；它只检测，不搬运或伤害生物。
entries.bodyEn: Counts entities in front and emits the corresponding redstone strength behind. Configure the work area and orient the output correctly.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 水培模拟处理器：先采集数据
entries.body:
将空白处理器用于普通水培床，采集作物数据。处理器提示会显示正在模拟的作物、执行次数、效率与潜在掉落。

再把有数据的处理器交给模拟水培床，以所记录作物数据产出掉落物。不要把空白处理器直接当作完整作物配方。
entries.bodyEn: Gather crop data using the processor in a normal Hydroponic Bed. Its tooltip shows crop, executions, efficiency and drops. Use the trained processor in a simulated bed.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 大型溶解室与线程插件
entries.body:
当前安装的更多升级 3.3.008 将大型溶解室做成单方块大型机器，各面可以配置输入输出，不需要沿用旧版本的外部成形结构。按 GUI 锁定输入与线程设置安排原料。

线程插件提高大型机器并行处理数量。材料、流体、能量与输出都按并行量准备；锁定槽的数量与可接受数量需要一并检查，不能只堆叠速度插件。
entries.bodyEn: The installed Extra Upgrades 3.3.008 uses a single-block large Dissolution Chamber with sided I/O. Configure locked inputs and threads; provision all resources for parallel operations.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 流体合成台与精密合成
entries.body:
流体合成台同时使用物品网格与所需流体，按配方放好材料。GUI 可在普通手动合成与匹配后自动合成之间切换。

精密合成台按自身配方工作，概率插件只用于明确接受它的精密合成设备。结构型设备先用投影确认成形，不能只把控制器当完整机器。
entries.bodyEn: The fluid crafting table combines a crafting grid with fluid and supports manual/automatic modes. Precision recipes and chance addons require their own compatible machine.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 配置复制、流体传输与平台建造
entries.body:
配置工具潜行右击复制机器配置，潜行加 Ctrl 右击粘贴，潜行对空气右击清空记录。仅对兼容机器使用。

连接工具对空气右击切换模式。流体传输模式先右击第一端，再潜行右击第二端，设置输入/输出且满足同维度与距离条件。平台模式先记录建造机，再潜行右击目标中心，GUI 设置边界与遇阻跳过/破坏行为。
entries.bodyEn: Copy compatible configuration with sneak-right-click and paste with sneak-Ctrl-right-click. The connection tool switches modes in air and binds fluid endpoints or a platform builder and center.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 灵魂激光基座、管道与灵魂激荡
entries.body:
用蓝色透镜配置灵魂激光基座，从监守者提取灵魂；停滞室可用于固定并治疗目标。基座储有灵魂后，用灵魂管道连接灵魂激荡器。

让激荡器朝向需要加速的兼容机器，它会消耗灵魂加速目标。红石信号使激荡器停止；被加速禁用标签排除的方块不会生效。倍率和持续时间以本包配置为准。
entries.bodyEn: Use a blue lens to extract Warden souls into the base. Pipe souls to a Soul Surge facing the target machine. Redstone stops the surge; excluded blocks cannot be accelerated.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 黑洞单元、流体罐与控制器
entries.body:
黑洞单元用于大量存一种物品，黑洞罐用于大量存一种流体。等级提高容量，输入物与现有类型不兼容时不会混装。

控制器集中访问已安装/关联的单元或罐。连接自动化前检查所管理的存储槽与输出模式，不能把高容量理解成无限物品类型。
entries.bodyEn: Black Hole Units store one item type; tanks store one fluid type. Controllers expose their supported installed/linked storage. Check types, slots and transfer modes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 更多升级灌注器与龙蛋锻造
entries.body:
更多升级灌注器使用一类物品与配方流体，产出灌注物品；例如龙息流体与容器的处理属于这类配方。输入与输出分别接管/库存。

龙蛋锻造设备使用物品及两路流体，可能同时输出物品与流体。按本机投影/结构状态检查成形，再供给每一输入罐，产物两类都要收取；它与大型溶解室的结构规则不同。
entries.bodyEn: The extra infuser combines an item with a fluid. Dragon-egg forging has two fluid inputs and may output both items and fluid; verify its structure/status and extract every result.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 工厂构造器、抛光机与凝固器
entries.body:
工厂构造器使用多种物品与两路流体制造对应设备，按 JEI 把两种流体分别送入输入罐。升级构造器按其自身配方类型配置。

抛光机有主材料、透镜辅助输入与流体输入，水与待抛光宝石不能缺；凝固器把配方流体变成固体，部分配方还需物品。按配方要求过滤辅助槽，并从成品侧抽取。
entries.bodyEn: Factory constructors use multiple items and two fluids. Polishing combines a main item, lens input and fluid. Solidifying converts recipe fluids, sometimes with an item, into solid results.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 菌丝网络烟花火箭发电机
entries.body:
各类菌丝发电机使用不同物品、流体或特殊条件。先按各机器 GUI 与 JEI 供给各自燃料，再接电力输出，不能把所有发电机都当煤炭发电机。

菌丝反应堆要求每一种所需菌丝发电机各有一台同时实际工作。只是摆出机器或让已满储能的发电机待机不满足条件；保持燃料和能量消耗端都畅通。
entries.bodyEn: Each mycelial generator has its own fuel or condition. The reactor requires all required generator types to be actively running simultaneously, not merely placed or idle.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
把有效原木放在机器正前方，从内部流体罐抽出乳胶。原木会逐渐被消耗：先变去皮原木，之后消失，需要自动补放。多台提取机可以围着同一原木工作。

不供电也可提取，接电会加快。不同木材的提取效率看 JEI；它不负责把乳胶变成橡胶。
entries.bodyEn: Place a valid log in front and extract latex. Logs are gradually stripped and consumed. Power is optional and accelerates extraction.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
接电并把羊、牛等放进前方范围，机器对兼容动物剪毛或挤奶。羊需要先长回羊毛，不能连续无限剪取。

物品与流体产物分别抽取；没有合适动物或产物库存已满时不再工作。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power and compatible animals in range. It shears sheep and milks cows; collect item and fluid outputs separately.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
放入可复制的真菌，提供水和电进行复制。下界真菌需要熔岩条件，按当前配方接入正确流体。

它复制真菌，不承担树木收割或普通作物种植。为输入和输出分配不同物流侧。
entries.bodyEn: Provide a supported fungus, power and the required fluid; Nether fungi use lava. Route input and output separately.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body: 这是结构或端口部件。按对应多方块的结构预览放置；端口承担输入/输出时，在成形结构或端口 GUI 中设置方向。
entries.bodyEn: Place this structural/port component according to its multiblock guide. Configure port directions in the formed structure or port GUI.

输入带附魔物品与书并接电，把物品附魔提取到书上。GUI 还可切换把附魔转为精华的模式。

两种模式的结果不同，启动前检查模式、书的库存和输出空间；不要把需要保留的附魔在精华模式下处理。
entries.bodyEn: Provide an enchanted item and books. Select extraction to books or conversion into essence before starting. Keep output space available.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
输入水与兼容的种子、树苗、染料等生物原料，产出生物燃料。同一批中不同原料种类越多，单位材料的生物燃料收益越好。

用过滤和定量补料维持多种原料，避免一种廉价材料塞满所有格。生物燃料送发电机或无尽工具。
entries.bodyEn: Combine water and compatible biological ingredients. A greater variety of ingredients improves fuel yield. Keep input slots supplied with distinct types.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
放入 JEI 配方所需催化物，催化物用于匹配条件而不会消耗。调整深度，在要求的生物群系设置基座，并连接激光钻充能。

部分流体还要求基座下面有指定实体。产物从基座流体罐抽取；只有充能、没有催化物或实体条件时不会出液体。
entries.bodyEn: Insert the nonconsumed catalyst, match biome/depth and any entity condition, then charge with drills. Extract the produced fluid from the base.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 菌丝网络附魔书发电机

entries.body:
供给电能、凋灵骷髅头和灵魂沙，机器在前方工作区域自动摆出召唤结构。确认投影区域没有阻挡，材料库存足够。

它只负责摆放召唤结构，需另行安排凋灵固定、击杀与产物回收。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power, wither skeleton skulls and soul sand. Keep the build area clear. The machine assembles the summon structure; containment and killing are separate.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

输入发酵矿肉、沙子与电，机器把流体加工成对应矿种的粉末。沙子是参与处理的材料，不能只供流体。

成品接后续冶炼，输出库存满时停止。检查输入流体是否已经完成发酵。
entries.bodyEn: Supply fermented ore meat, sand and power to obtain the corresponding ore dust. Raw ore meat must be fermented first.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

让机器相邻至少两个水源，开始生成水。接入流体管收取内部水罐。

增加相邻水源并供电可提高产水速度。它的水源条件由相邻方块判断，仅在远处放一池水不够。
entries.bodyEn: Place at least two adjacent source-water blocks. Additional sources and power accelerate collection. Extract the internal water buffer.

entries.body:
把机器放在至少三乘三、一格深的水池上方，供电后自动捕鱼。让下方保持有效水池，物品从内部库存抽取。

输出可能包括鱼之外的战利品，接收库存应留出多种物品位置。
entries.bodyEn: Place above a water pool at least 3×3 and one block deep. Supply power and collect the fishing outputs.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

两种流体分别安排抽取。被动动物通常更适合粉红黏液产线；需要物品掉落和经验时使用生物粉碎机。
entries.bodyEn: This machine turns mobs into liquid meat and pink slime, without normal drops or experience. Extract both fluids; use a Mob Crusher for loot.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
把生矿肉送入发酵站，在 GUI 选择生产类型和封存液位。达到配置液位后才封存并开始发酵。

产出发酵矿肉后送流体筛分机；液位设得过高但供料不足时，看起来会一直等待，检查封存设置。
entries.bodyEn: Choose the production mode and sealing threshold. Raw ore meat ferments after reaching that level; insufficient fill can leave it waiting.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
各类菌丝发电机使用不同物品、流体或特殊条件。先按各机器 GUI 与 JEI 供给各自燃料，再接电力输出，不能把所有发电机都当煤炭发电机。

菌丝反应堆要求每一种所需菌丝发电机各有一台同时实际工作。只是摆出机器或让已满储能的发电机待机不满足条件；保持燃料和能量消耗端都畅通。
entries.bodyEn: Each mycelial generator has its own fuel or condition. The reactor requires all required generator types to be actively running simultaneously, not merely placed or idle.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
提供电、水、空瓶与酿造材料，在各材料槽设置自动酿造链。内部有水时可填充空瓶。

绿色过滤槽必须设定允许取出的目标药水，否则成品可能无法抽出；中间药水应留给后续酿造。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power, water, bottles and brewing ingredients. Configure the green output filter to the final potion so intermediate stages stay in the machine.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
在水培床上放可兼容作物，提供电与水；下界作物使用对应的熔岩条件。它加速上方作物生长。

补给少量以太能显著加强生长并自动重种。把收获端、流体和电力一起接好；单独放一张床不会自行完成种植和输出。
entries.bodyEn: Provide the crop, power and water, or lava for supported Nether crops. Ether greatly accelerates growth and supports automatic replanting.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
黑洞单元用于大量存一种物品，黑洞罐用于大量存一种流体。等级提高容量，输入物与现有类型不兼容时不会混装。

控制器集中访问已安装/关联的单元或罐。连接自动化前检查所管理的存储槽与输出模式，不能把高容量理解成无限物品类型。

entries.body:
破坏机处理正前方方块，把掉落物放入内部库存；放置机消耗内部方块，在正前方放置。二者都需电力并受目标空间条件限制。

先确认正面，再配置红石和自动输出。种植、乳胶原木补放等流程可用放置机配合，不能把破坏机输出接回自己的目标格。
entries.bodyEn: Both operate directly in front. The breaker collects drops; the placer consumes stored blocks. Supply power and configure redstone and output routing.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
向洗矿厂供给矿物原料、液态肉和电力，产出对应矿种的生矿肉流体。为不同矿种安排清晰管路，避免残留另一种矿肉占据目标罐。

生矿肉还需要送发酵站加工，本机不会直接输出金属粉。
entries.bodyEn: Combine an ore with liquid meat and power to produce that ore’s raw ore meat. Send the fluid to a fermentation station.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
供给水、熔岩和电。在 GUI 选择基础产物及后续动作，把生成的石料继续熔炼、粉碎或合成。

这些动作是机器内部的处理链，要按需要依次配置。产物和本包允许的加工以 JEI 为准；输出不畅会使链路停止。
entries.bodyEn: Supply water, lava and power. Configure the generated material and subsequent smelting, crushing or crafting actions. Extract the final output.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
接电，在物品输入区放齐配方要求的材料，并把所需流体送入输入罐。当前版本最多使用八类物品输入与一种流体。配方是无序的，不要求材料按 JEI 图中的格位摆放。

材料齐全并找到配方后，机器会锁定物品槽以免继续塞料。它可输出物品或流体，两类产物都要安排抽取；成品罐满、物品不足或流体种类错误都会停机。
entries.bodyEn: Provide power, all item ingredients and the input fluid. Recipes are shapeless. Once a recipe matches, ingredient slots lock. Extract both item and fluid results.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
向两个流体输入分别供给乳胶和水，并接电生产干橡胶。不要只给乳胶，也不要把水挤进已经装乳胶的罐。

干橡胶到塑料的后续加工看本包 JEI 配方。自动化时同时检查两种流体库存与成品输出空间。
entries.bodyEn: Supply latex, water and energy. Keep both fluid supplies available and extract dry rubber. Follow the installed recipes for subsequent plastic processing.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
接电并对准农田或树木，收取成熟作物和木材。树木只要底部原木位于工作区，采伐还会沿相连原木和树叶继续。

普通模式会破坏作物，安排种植机补种；供给少量以太可支持对应重种行为。机器还会产生污泥，接流体输出交给污泥精炼机，避免内部副产物积满。
entries.bodyEn: Harvest mature crops and connected trees with power. Crops normally need replanting; ether supports replanting behavior. Extract sludge as well as items.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 菌丝网络史莱姆发电机
entries.body:
各类菌丝发电机使用不同物品、流体或特殊条件。先按各机器 GUI 与 JEI 供给各自燃料，再接电力输出，不能把所有发电机都当煤炭发电机。

菌丝反应堆要求每一种所需菌丝发电机各有一台同时实际工作。只是摆出机器或让已满储能的发电机待机不满足条件；保持燃料和能量消耗端都畅通。
entries.bodyEn: Each mycelial generator has its own fuel or condition. The reactor requires all required generator types to be actively running simultaneously, not merely placed or idle.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
在工作范围内放可繁殖的成年动物，向机器提供对应繁殖食物与电能。它按动物接受的食物喂养，不能用一种种子喂所有物种。

留出幼体空间，配合幼体分离机把新生动物移到另一侧，防止区域内拥挤。
entries.bodyEn: Supply power and the species-specific breeding food. Keep valid adults inside the work area and separate offspring when needed.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
输入未附魔的可附魔物品、大量精华与电力，机器进行对应等级的附魔。确保精华是本机接受的流体，成品从输出槽取出。

它会生成附魔，不是把书上的指定附魔转移到装备。指定合并使用附魔施加器。
entries.bodyEn: Supply an enchantable item, essence and power. The factory generates enchantments; use the applicator for targeted book/item combination.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
供电并在输入区放可熔炼物品，多个加工槽可以并行处理。除成品外，每次熔炼还会生成少量精华。

物品成品和精华分别抽取，持续自动化时避免任一输出区积满。
entries.bodyEn: Powered parallel smelting also produces essence. Extract the smelted items and the fluid byproduct.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
简易发电机燃烧可燃物供能；内部能量满时仍可能继续消耗当前燃料。生物燃料发电机使用流体生物燃料，能量满时可停止耗燃料。

把能量送往外部储能或负载，按机型分别接物品燃料或流体燃料。
entries.bodyEn: The Pitiful Generator burns solid fuel and can waste a burning fuel while full. The Biofuel Generator uses biofuel and pauses fuel use when its energy buffer is full.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
下水道从范围内动物收集污水，并可把附近经验转为精华。通过流体管分别抽取相应流体。

把污水送进污水堆肥机得到肥料，再供催熟机使用。肥料不是精华，两个循环的管路需要区分。
entries.bodyEn: The sewer collects animal sewage and experience-derived essence. Send sewage to the composter for fertilizer; route essence separately.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
把收割机的污泥送入精炼机并供电，产生对应的随机材料。为多种可能产物预留输出格并连接物品抽取。

它消耗污泥，不接受污水或液态肉；不同副产物流体需要独立过滤。
entries.bodyEn: Supply sludge and power, then collect its possible material outputs. Sewage and liquid meat are separate fluids.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
把机器安在种植区域下方，检查工作范围投影。GUI 的九个彩色种子槽对应上方区域的九个分区；在对应格放种子或树苗，并接电。

作物还需要有效土壤、空间及各自生长条件。范围插件只扩大兼容机器的区域，不能让种子绕过种植条件。
entries.bodyEn: Place below the farming area. The nine colored seed slots correspond to nine regions. Provide power, valid soil and sufficient space.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
手持生物捕捉工具右击目标将其装入，再把带生物数据的工具放入复制机。机器还需要电和精华，在周围生成对应生物。

附近同类生物过多时会停止生成，及时把产出生物移走。工具也能通过对地使用释放所装生物；空工具不会指定复制种类。
entries.bodyEn: Capture a mob in a Mob Imprisonment Tool, insert it, then supply power and essence. Nearby entity limits can stop spawning.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.zh: 菌丝网络下界之星发电机

entries.bodyEn: Supply power and mobs in range. Collect loot and essence separately. An alternate mode trades essence production for random Fortune levels.

entries.body:
黑洞单元用于大量存一种物品，黑洞罐用于大量存一种流体。等级提高容量，输入物与现有类型不兼容时不会混装。

控制器集中访问已安装/关联的单元或罐。连接自动化前检查所管理的存储槽与输出模式，不能把高容量理解成无限物品类型。
entries.bodyEn: Black Hole Units store one item type; tanks store one fluid type. Controllers expose their supported installed/linked storage. Check types, slots and transfer modes.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
机器把范围内匹配的动物传送到背后，默认用于将幼体与成体分开。GUI 可以切换所移动的动物类型。

先确认朝向，背后要留出围栏和接收空间。它不会生成或繁殖动物，应与喂养机分工。
entries.bodyEn: Configure the target type in the GUI. Matching animals are moved behind the machine. Provide a safe receiving pen and correct orientation.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
传送带移动物品和实体，流体运输只支持水平段。染料改变颜色；荧石加速物品/实体，塑料防止路过玩家捡走带上物品。

抽取与插入升级操作库存，检测升级输出检测信号，弹射/掉落/传送升级改变去向，分配升级按 GUI 比例分流。需要分流的出口侧都应装对应升级，并在升级 GUI 设置过滤。
entries.bodyEn: Conveyors move items/entities and transport fluids horizontally. Upgrades extract, insert, detect, launch, drop, teleport or split; configure their filters and destination settings.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
各类菌丝发电机使用不同物品、流体或特殊条件。先按各机器 GUI 与 JEI 供给各自燃料，再接电力输出，不能把所有发电机都当煤炭发电机。

菌丝反应堆要求每一种所需菌丝发电机各有一台同时实际工作。只是摆出机器或让已满储能的发电机待机不满足条件；保持燃料和能量消耗端都畅通。
entries.bodyEn: Each mycelial generator has its own fuel or condition. The reactor requires all required generator types to be actively running simultaneously, not merely placed or idle.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
把混合物品交给分选机，分别输出有附魔与无附魔的物品。为各输出连接独立库存。

它只分类，不执行附魔、脱附或经验转换。
entries.bodyEn: Separate enchanted and unenchanted items into their respective outputs. It does not enchant or remove enchantments.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
下水道从范围内动物收集污水，并可把附近经验转为精华。通过流体管分别抽取相应流体。

把污水送进污水堆肥机得到肥料，再供催熟机使用。肥料不是精华，两个循环的管路需要区分。
entries.bodyEn: The sewer collects animal sewage and experience-derived essence. Send sewage to the composter for fertilizer; route essence separately.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body: 接入 FE，在机器 GUI 设置工作区域、输入输出和红石控制。处理类机器按 JEI 供给物品/流体；作业类机器保持工作区有效和产物可输出。
entries.bodyEn: Supply FE and configure work area, sides and redstone control. Processing machines consume JEI inputs; world-working machines need valid targets and free outputs.

entries.body:
破坏机处理正前方方块，把掉落物放入内部库存；放置机消耗内部方块，在正前方放置。二者都需电力并受目标空间条件限制。

先确认正面，再配置红石和自动输出。种植、乳胶原木补放等流程可用放置机配合，不能把破坏机输出接回自己的目标格。
entries.bodyEn: Both operate directly in front. The breaker collects drops; the placer consumes stored blocks. Supply power and configure redstone and output routing.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body: 这是结构或端口部件。按对应多方块的结构预览放置；端口承担输入/输出时，在成形结构或端口 GUI 中设置方向。
entries.bodyEn: Place this structural/port component according to its multiblock guide. Configure port directions in the formed structure or port GUI.

entries.body:
类似铁砧，把待处理物品与附魔书/合并材料放入对应槽。它以精华支付费用，接电并提供足够精华后取得结果。

高费用操作还可使用机器上方储罐的精华。检查兼容性和费用，不能用普通水替代精华。
entries.bodyEn: Use the anvil-like input slots and pay with essence. Large operations can draw essence from a tank above the machine. Check compatibility and cost.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
向激光钻供电，调整方向与位置，让它的工作范围找到矿物或流体激光钻基座。钻头给找到的基座充能，资源在基座中产出。

钻头有电但无进度时，检查它是否实际指向基座，不能直接从钻头抽矿。
entries.bodyEn: Power the drill and align its work area with a compatible laser base. It charges the base; resource outputs are collected from the base.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
模拟水培床读取水培模拟处理器中记录的数据来产生作物掉落物。先准备带有效模拟数据的处理器，再放入床的对应槽，供电并抽取产物。

空白处理器或不支持的作物数据不会提供有效产出。它与普通水培床的实体种植流程不同，检查处理器提示与床的状态栏。
entries.bodyEn: The simulated bed uses crop data on a Hydroponic Simulation Processor. Insert a processor with valid data, supply power and extract drops. Check the processor and machine status.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
停滞室接电后冻结并治疗工作范围内的实体，可用于固定以太产线的凋灵。机器有效范围需要覆盖目标。

以太由流体激光钻基座在凋灵正上方按其配方条件抽取，停滞室本身不产以太。钻基座仍需要钻头充能及正确催化条件。
entries.bodyEn: A powered Stasis Chamber freezes and heals entities in range. Ether extraction uses a Fluid Laser Base above a Wither; the chamber only holds the entity.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
放好基座并让激光钻向它充能。GUI 设置采掘深度，产物权重还受基座所在生物群系影响。

彩色透镜提高对应资源的产出权重，不保证只产一种矿。先在 JEI 核对目标矿的生物群系、深度和透镜颜色，保持物品输出畅通。
entries.bodyEn: Charge the base with laser drills. Depth, biome and lens weighting affect results. Lenses increase weight rather than guarantee exclusive output.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips
