entries.body:
更多升级灌注器使用一类物品与配方流体，产出灌注物品；例如龙息流体与容器的处理属于这类配方。输入与输出分别接管/库存。

龙蛋锻造设备使用物品及两路流体，可能同时输出物品与流体。按本机投影/结构状态检查成形，再供给每一输入罐，产物两类都要收取；它与大型溶解室的结构规则不同。
entries.bodyEn: The extra infuser combines an item with a fluid. Dragon-egg forging has two fluid inputs and may output both items and fluid; verify its structure/status and extract every result.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
当前安装的更多升级 3.3.008 将大型溶解室做成单方块大型机器，各面可以配置输入输出，不需要沿用旧版本的外部成形结构。按 GUI 锁定输入与线程设置安排原料。

线程插件提高大型机器并行处理数量。材料、流体、能量与输出都按并行量准备；锁定槽的数量与可接受数量需要一并检查，不能只堆叠速度插件。
entries.bodyEn: The installed Extra Upgrades 3.3.008 uses a single-block large Dissolution Chamber with sided I/O. Configure locked inputs and threads; provision all resources for parallel operations.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
流体合成台同时使用物品网格与所需流体，按配方放好材料。GUI 可在普通手动合成与匹配后自动合成之间切换。

精密合成台按自身配方工作，概率插件只用于明确接受它的精密合成设备。结构型设备先用投影确认成形，不能只把控制器当完整机器。
entries.bodyEn: The fluid crafting table combines a crafting grid with fluid and supports manual/automatic modes. Precision recipes and chance addons require their own compatible machine.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
配置工具潜行右击复制机器配置，潜行加 Ctrl 右击粘贴，潜行对空气右击清空记录。仅对兼容机器使用。

连接工具对空气右击切换模式。流体传输模式先右击第一端，再潜行右击第二端，设置输入/输出且满足同维度与距离条件。平台模式先记录建造机，再潜行右击目标中心，GUI 设置边界与遇阻跳过/破坏行为。
entries.bodyEn: Copy compatible configuration with sneak-right-click and paste with sneak-Ctrl-right-click. The connection tool switches modes in air and binds fluid endpoints or a platform builder and center.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
用蓝色透镜配置灵魂激光基座，从监守者提取灵魂；停滞室可用于固定并治疗目标。基座储有灵魂后，用灵魂管道连接灵魂激荡器。

让激荡器朝向需要加速的兼容机器，它会消耗灵魂加速目标。红石信号使激荡器停止；被加速禁用标签排除的方块不会生效。倍率和持续时间以本包配置为准。
entries.bodyEn: Use a blue lens to extract Warden souls into the base. Pipe souls to a Soul Surge facing the target machine. Redstone stops the surge; excluded blocks cannot be accelerated.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
用蓝色透镜配置灵魂激光基座，从监守者提取灵魂；停滞室可用于固定并治疗目标。基座储有灵魂后，用灵魂管道连接灵魂激荡器。

让激荡器朝向需要加速的兼容机器，它会消耗灵魂加速目标。红石信号使激荡器停止；被加速禁用标签排除的方块不会生效。倍率和持续时间以本包配置为准。
entries.bodyEn: Use a blue lens to extract Warden souls into the base. Pipe souls to a Soul Surge facing the target machine. Redstone stops the surge; excluded blocks cannot be accelerated.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body: 接入 FE，在机器 GUI 设置工作区域、输入输出和红石控制。处理类机器按 JEI 供给物品/流体；作业类机器保持工作区有效和产物可输出。
entries.bodyEn: Supply FE and configure work area, sides and redstone control. Processing machines consume JEI inputs; world-working machines need valid targets and free outputs.

entries.body:
工厂构造器使用多种物品与两路流体制造对应设备，按 JEI 把两种流体分别送入输入罐。升级构造器按其自身配方类型配置。

抛光机有主材料、透镜辅助输入与流体输入，水与待抛光宝石不能缺；凝固器把配方流体变成固体，部分配方还需物品。按配方要求过滤辅助槽，并从成品侧抽取。
entries.bodyEn: Factory constructors use multiple items and two fluids. Polishing combines a main item, lens input and fluid. Solidifying converts recipe fluids, sometimes with an item, into solid results.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body: 这是结构或端口部件。按对应多方块的结构预览放置；端口承担输入/输出时，在成形结构或端口 GUI 中设置方向。
entries.bodyEn: Place this structural/port component according to its multiblock guide. Configure port directions in the formed structure or port GUI.

entries.body:
向两个流体输入分别供给乳胶和水，并接电生产干橡胶。不要只给乳胶，也不要把水挤进已经装乳胶的罐。

干橡胶到塑料的后续加工看本包 JEI 配方。自动化时同时检查两种流体库存与成品输出空间。
entries.bodyEn: Supply latex, water and energy. Keep both fluid supplies available and extract dry rubber. Follow the installed recipes for subsequent plastic processing.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
将空白处理器用于普通水培床，采集作物数据。处理器提示会显示正在模拟的作物、执行次数、效率与潜在掉落。

再把有数据的处理器交给模拟水培床，以所记录作物数据产出掉落物。不要把空白处理器直接当作完整作物配方。
entries.bodyEn: Gather crop data using the processor in a normal Hydroponic Bed. Its tooltip shows crop, executions, efficiency and drops. Use the trained processor in a simulated bed.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
下水道从范围内动物收集污水，并可把附近经验转为精华。通过流体管分别抽取相应流体。

把污水送进污水堆肥机得到肥料，再供催熟机使用。肥料不是精华，两个循环的管路需要区分。
entries.bodyEn: The sewer collects animal sewage and experience-derived essence. Send sewage to the composter for fertilizer; route essence separately.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
手持生物捕捉工具右击目标将其装入，再把带生物数据的工具放入复制机。机器还需要电和精华，在周围生成对应生物。

附近同类生物过多时会停止生成，及时把产出生物移走。工具也能通过对地使用释放所装生物；空工具不会指定复制种类。
entries.bodyEn: Capture a mob in a Mob Imprisonment Tool, insert it, then supply power and essence. Nearby entity limits can stop spawning.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
停滞室接电后冻结并治疗工作范围内的实体，可用于固定以太产线的凋灵。机器有效范围需要覆盖目标。

以太由流体激光钻基座在凋灵正上方按其配方条件抽取，停滞室本身不产以太。钻基座仍需要钻头充能及正确催化条件。
entries.bodyEn: A powered Stasis Chamber freezes and heals entities in range. Ether extraction uses a Fluid Laser Base above a Wither; the chamber only holds the entity.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
放好基座并让激光钻向它充能。GUI 设置采掘深度，产物权重还受基座所在生物群系影响。

彩色透镜提高对应资源的产出权重，不保证只产一种矿。先在 JEI 核对目标矿的生物群系、深度和透镜颜色，保持物品输出畅通。
entries.bodyEn: Charge the base with laser drills. Depth, biome and lens weighting affect results. Lenses increase weight rather than guarantee exclusive output.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

entries.body:
无尽工具以已储能量决定等级，高等级解锁更大范围或更强功能。潜行右击打开工具 GUI，设置范围、模式和充电开关；生物燃料可提高使用效率。

钻头用于范围挖掘，锯用于连续伐木，锤用于范围攻击与斩首，三叉戟提供对应投掷能力。无尽充能器给可充能物品充电，特别适合大量储能的无尽工具。
entries.bodyEn: Stored energy determines the tool tier. Sneak-right-click configures modes and charging. Drill, saw, hammer and trident have distinct functions; biofuel improves efficiency.
researchSource: installed Industrial Foregoing 3.6.39 Patchouli entries, recipes and tooltips

背包内生物燃料支持自动操作，精华用于收集经验，液态肉用于自动进食。肉食供给器也能在玩家背包中使用所储液态肉补充食物。
entries.bodyEn: Configure pickup, magnet, restocking and overflow rules per slot. Biofuel powers automation, essence stores picked-up experience, and liquid meat supports feeding.

entries.zh: Oritech：扩展坞、机器效率与接口
entries.body:
操作步骤
扩展坞必须直接连接机器，或连接到已接入这台机器的另一个扩展坞。它本身没有效率加成，作用是增加可连接的插件位置；仅仅摆在机器附近不会生效。

配置步骤
在机器 UI 左上角悬停机器核心图标，查看机器品质；核心品质决定最大支持的扩展坞数量。接入实际插件后再查看效率、能耗与工作状态变化，并核对物品、流体和能量接口。

故障排查
装了扩展没有变化先检查位置与适用机器，再检查附加组件类型和连接。角色强化屏幕属于另一套系统，按键不会代替机器扩展坞 GUI。当前配方及输入量以本包 JEI 为准。
entries.bodyEn:
An extender must connect directly to the machine or another connected extender. It adds attachment positions rather than providing an efficiency bonus itself. Hover the machine-core icon at the top-left of the machine GUI to inspect quality; core quality limits the number of extenders. Connect supported addons, then inspect processing, energy and resource ports.

If an addon has no effect, check position, machine compatibility and addon type. The player augment screen is a separate system and does not replace the extender GUI. Use the pack's JEI for processing ingredients.

entries.zh: Oritech：人体强化研究与能力开关
entries.body:
准备
按模组指南搭建人体强化中心，提供研究需要的能量和材料；研究站作为多方块附加结构接入中心。具体结构和材料以当前指南及本包 JEI 为准。

操作步骤
进入已成型的中心打开研究界面，在科技树选择满足前置的项目；材料从玩家库存或机器库存取用。研究完成后还要支付安装所需资源，才会成为角色强化。研究和已安装能力不是同一个状态。

能力开关
已安装强化后，按住上方强化键打开轮盘，悬停要切换的能力，松开按键确认开关。矿石视觉、速度等会影响操作的能力可在此管理。中心界面的 Import 可导入角色已安装的强化；移除强化不会返还安装资源。

故障排查
轮盘没有能力时，先确认项目已经安装而不只是研究完成。研究进度与未安装的研究结果保存在机器内，拆毁中心会丢失这些内容。只关闭能力的开关，不等于移除能力或返还资源。
entries.bodyEn:
Build the Cybernetic Augmentation Center and connected multiblock research stations following the installed guide. Supply energy and project ingredients from the player or machine inventory. Choose a project whose prerequisites are satisfied. Completed research still needs the installation resource cost before it becomes a player augment.

Hold the augment binding to open the radial menu, hover an ability and release to toggle it. The center's Import function can import installed augments. Removing an augment does not refund installation resources.

For an empty radial menu, confirm installation rather than research completion. Unapplied research and progress are stored in the machine and are lost if it is destroyed. Toggling an ability off is different from removing it.

entries.body: 给机器供能，通过框架和机器核心部件完成装配；扩展件放在允许的连接位置。输入和输出按机器 GUI 及 JEI 配方设置。
entries.bodyEn: Power the machine, assemble its required frame and core components, and attach addons at valid positions. Use its GUI and JEI recipes to route inputs and outputs.

entries.body: 先完成机器要求的部件，再接入能量与 JEI 中的原料。不同机器负责离心、粉碎、装配、铸造或原子锻造；扩展件会影响效率、速度和处理能力。
entries.bodyEn: Complete the required machine components and supply energy and JEI inputs. Centrifuges, grinders, assemblers, foundries and atomic forges use distinct recipe types; addons modify their performance.

entries.body: 按装置的朝向和结构要求布置发射端、目标与连接部件，提供持续能量。粒子碰撞配方和激光目标通过 JEI 确认，保持束路和输出位置有效。
entries.bodyEn: Build emitters, targets and connecting components with the required orientation and structure. Provide continuous power and verify particle or laser targets in JEI.

entries.zh: 加速器磁场、速度传感器与目标指定器
entries.body:
用高级目标指定器先右击粒子加速器记录控制器，再右击磁场或速度传感器绑定。磁场要位于加速器区域内并与环同高，且仅在服务端配置启用时有效。

速度传感器自动模式读取当前配方要求的速度，手动模式按阈值输出红石，关闭模式不输出。加速器电机下方可装支持的速度或效率扩展。
entries.bodyEn: Record the accelerator controller, then bind a magnetic field or speed sensor. Fields need valid in-ring placement. Sensor modes use recipe speed, a manual threshold or no output.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 无人机跨维度扩展与框架放置器
entries.body:
无人机港安装跨维度扩展后才可支持对应跨维度目标，服务端也必须启用该功能。用目标指定器记录有效港口并设置目标，库存有物品时才有可运送货物。

框架放置器潜行右击支持框架的机器，可辅助建造框架。它用于框架兼容设备，不能替代所有机器结构与扩展坞配置。
entries.bodyEn: A drone port needs the cross-dimensional addon and server support for dimensional transfers. The frame placer builds frames for compatible machines with sneak-right-click.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
控制器是粒子的进入点。插入该方块的物品会被转化为粒子。碰撞结果可从输出槽中收集。

需要再控制器正后方放置一个直线导向环，且导向环朝侧面，确保视觉上正确对齐。任何物品都可以插入控制器中作为粒子使用。

插入后，粒子将沿着导向环定义的路径前进。

有关粒子加速器的详细机制，请查看粒子加速器指南。
entries.bodyEn:
The particle accelerator controller is the entry point for particles. Items inserted into this block are turned into particles. Collision results can be collected from the output slot.

A straight guide ring needs to be placed right behind the controller, facing to the side, with visuals aligning correctly. Any item can be inserted into the controller to be used as a particle.

Once inserted, the particle travels along a route defined by the guide rings.

For detailed information on particle acceleration mechanics, see the particle accelerator guide.

entries.zh: 粒子加速器直线型马达
entries.body:
粒子通过加速器马达时，会消耗能量使粒子速度增加1 m/s。

马达可在加速器路径中作为直线导轨。

有关粒子加速器的详细机制，请查看粒子加速器指南。
entries.bodyEn:
Passing through an accelerator motor speeds up the particle by 1 m/s, as long as the motor is powered.

Motors can be used as straight guides in the accelerator path.

For detailed information on particle acceleration mechanics, see the particle accelerator guide.

entries.body:
导向环定义了粒子在加速器中前进的路径。

右击可在一侧添加45度转弯。另一个导向环需要按照导向环定义的路径位于粒子的行进路线上。根据速度不同，导向方块所允许的间距会增加。

给非直线的导向环红石信号会切换其引导路径。激活时，它引导粒子直行；未激活时，它引导粒子进入原始的弯曲方向。

有关粒子加速器的详细机制，请查看粒子加速器指南。
entries.bodyEn:
Guide rings define the path that particles travel along in the accelerator.

They can be right-clicked to add a 45-degree turn on one side. Another guide ring needs to be in the particle's path as defined by the guide rings. Depending on the speed, the allowed distance between guide blocks increases.

When a redstone signal is applied to a non-straight guide block, it becomes a switch block. When powered on, it leads particles straight; when powered off, it guides them into the original curved direction.

For detailed information on particle acceleration mechanics, see the particle accelerator guide.

entries.body:
可以用粒子传感器测量粒子的速度。比较器可以根据粒子的速度提供红石信号。

下表显示了每个红石级别的所需速度：

1. 02. 103. 504. 755. 1006. 1507. 2508. 5009. 75010. 100011. 250012. 500013. 750014. 1000015. 15000

传感器可在加速器路径中作为直线导轨。

有关粒子加速器的详细机制，请查看粒子加速器指南。
entries.bodyEn:
A particle sensor can measure a particle's speed. A comparator can then provide a redstone signal based on that speed.

The following table shows the required speed for each redstone level:

1. 0 2. 10 3. 50 4. 75 5. 100 6. 150 7. 250 8. 500 9. 750 10. 1000 11. 2500 12. 5000 13. 7500 14. 10000 15. 15000

Sensors can be used as straight guides in the accelerator path.

For detailed information on particle acceleration mechanics, see the particle accelerator guide.

entries.body:
量子研究站是高级插件，用于赛博改造中心。它是研究时空和高能物理学的终极强化所必需的设施。

该设施需要3个机器核心，并占用赛博改造中心的一个研究站槽位。

这一等级会解锁更强大的科技植入体以及它的早期版本，例如生命壁垒、宙斯盾系统、撷取星辰、暗夜之子、超速挖掘和疾电闪步等植入体。
entries.bodyEn:
The Quantum Research Station is a high-tier expansion for the Augmentation Center. It is required to research endgame augmentations that deal with space-time and high-energy physics.

It also requires 3 machine cores and occupies one of the center's research station slots.

This tier unlocks stronger technical augments and upgraded versions of earlier ones, such as stronger health boosts, better armor, far reach, night vision, hyper mining, and high-speed movement augments.

entries.body:
奥术研究站允许你的赛博改造中心运用奥术能量。它是研究“不洁”类植入体所必需的组件。

该设施需要3个机器核心，并占用赛博改造中心的一个研究站槽位，和其他类型的研究站相同。

这一等级涵盖了科技树中最不寻常的植入体，包含御风之术、隐形斗篷、便携折跃、矿石感应、重力衰减、三生有幸和其他后期科技与魔法的混合升级。
entries.bodyEn:
The Arcane Research Station allows your Augmentation Center to work with arcane energy. It is a necessary component for researching "Unholy" augmentations.

It requires 3 machine cores and fills one augmentation-center station slot, just like the other station types.

This tier covers the most unusual augments in the tree, including flight, cloak, portal return, ore vision, gravity control, luck, and other late-game hybrid tech-magic upgrades.

entries.body:
装配器具备2x2合成方格，只要有能量、输入槽中有物品且输出槽有空间放置产物就会自动装配物品，

输入槽中组件的顺序无关紧要。如果机器需要2个相同物品，也可以从同一个槽位中取两个。

对于精细的物品输入，可以使用物品栏代理插件来控制物品的去向。或者，装配器也有不同的输入模式。“均匀填充模式”或“侧面”变种可以让某些设置的自动化变得更加容易。

自动化也可以通过AE2完成。样板供应器可以与装配器即放即用。
entries.bodyEn:
The assembler features a 2x2 crafting grid and will automatically assemble items as long as it has energy, items in the input slots, and space for the finished product in the output slot.

The order of the components in the input slots does not matter. If a machine needs 2 of the same item, it can also take both from the same slot.

For fine-tuned item input, an inventory proxy addon can be used to control which items go where. Alternatively, the assembler also has different input modes. The "Fill-Evenly" or "Sided" variants can make automation much easier for some setups.

Automation can also be done via AE2. Pattern providers work out of the box with the assembler.

entries.body:
原子锻造器是一种用于制造高级计算引擎、强化深板岩以及辅助倍矿处理的机器。

能量线缆无法直接连接到原子锻造器；它需要通过末影激光器供能。

这意味着你的主要瓶颈通常是激光吞吐量。更多激光、更快的激光运行速度以及专用能源都能提高生产速度。

原子锻造器具有不同的输入模式以简化自动化。“均匀填充”或“侧面”变种确保每个物品进入正确的槽位。

自动化也可以通过AE2完成。样板供应器可以与锻造器即放即用。

与其他机器不同，原子锻造器的处理周期由其能量缓存决定。只有锻造器完全充满至配方所需能量后，配方才会完成。使用多台激光器或提高其处理速度可以大大加快这一过程。

如果感觉锻造器运行很慢，通常不是物品输入的问题。充能速率才是。
entries.bodyEn:
The atomic forge is a machine used to create advanced computer chips, reinforce deepslate, and help with high-yield ore processing.

Energy pipes cannot connect directly to an atomic forge; it needs to be powered by an enderic laser.

That means your main bottleneck is usually laser throughput. More lasers, faster laser operation, and a dedicated power supply all increase production speed.

The atomic forge has different input modes to make automation easier. "Fill-Evenly" or "Sided" variants can be used to make sure each item goes in the right slot.

Automation can also be done via AE2. Pattern providers work out of the box with the forge.

Unlike other machines, the atomic forge's processing cycle is determined by its energy buffer. The recipe will only complete once the forge has been fully charged to the required level. Using multiple lasers, or increasing their speed, can greatly speed up this process.

If the forge feels slow, item input is usually not the problem. Charge rate is.

entries.body:
赛博改造中心是研究和安装永久性身体升级的主要设施。这些强化提供各种增益，从被动属性提升到全新能力。

恭喜！自你领悟此肉身之衰弱伊始。你便深恶之，那么您正是我们的理想客户。你渴望钢铁之正当及伟力，*Oritech公司*很乐意效劳。

请记住，一旦你向往那神圣机械的纯洁，便再无回头之路。所有植入体强化都是永久性的，并可能导致一种难以理解的冲动，将你曾经的同伴视为“粗劣生物质”。

要开始，走进组装好的赛博改造中心。这将打开研究界面，你可以在其中浏览并启动项目。每个植入体强化需要特定的能量和资源，可从你的个人物品栏或机器内部存储（通过界面访问）中抽取。

许多高阶升级需要先完成前置研究，如科技树所示。

该中心作为研究站的枢纽，研究站以多方块结构建造。改造中心最多支持

三个研究站，允许并行处理。

*   每个研究站需要3个机器核心。*   一个研究站同一时间只能进行一项研究。

已研究的植入体存储在机器内存中。如果改造中心被破坏，所有未应用的研究进度和蓝图都将丢失。

研究完成后，植入体即可进行安装。该程序需要一次性资源消耗，以将技术与玩家永久融合。

如果你已安装植入体，可以在机器中使用载入功能将其载入机器（UI左下角按钮）。

植入体管理：

你的强化是永久的：无需维护或持续消耗能量。然而，如果某种能力造成干扰（如矿石感知或超速挖掘），它们可以随时开关。

*   开关菜单：按住植入体热键（默认为[G]）打开径向菜单。悬停在目标植入体上并松开按键以切换其开关。*   移除：虽然植入体设计为永久性，但必要时可以移除。注意安装时投入的资源不予退还。

面向整合包开发者

Oritech植入体完全由数据驱动且可配置，允许通过数据包进行广泛自定义。

*   修饰型植入体：修改实体属性（如速度、交互距离、生命值）。*   效果型植入体：像药水那样施加状态效果。*   自定义植入体：实现独特逻辑（如矿石感知）。这些可以在数据包中引用，但需要Java模组来实现底层逻辑。

现有植入体可通过JSON修改或禁用，也可以定义新的植入体。*   定义示例：攻击伤害植入体(GitHub)*   纹理位置：`oritech/textures/gui/augment`

请记住为任何自定义添加翻译条目。
entries.bodyEn:
The Cybernetic Augmentation Center is the main facility for researching and installing permanent upgrades to your body. These augmentations provide various benefits, ranging from passive stat boosts to entirely new abilities.

Congratulations! If from the moment you understood the weakness of your flesh, it disgusted you, then you are our ideal customer. You crave the strength and certainty of steel, and *Oritech Inc* is happy to oblige.

Please remember that once you aspire to the purity of the blessed machine, there is no going back. All augmentations are permanent, and may cause an inexplicable urge to refer to your former peers as "crude biomass."

To begin, walk into the assembled Cybernetic Augmentation Center. This opens the research interface, where you can browse and start projects. Each augmentation requires specific energy and resources, drawn from either your personal inventory or the machine's internal storage (accessible via the interface).

Many high-tier upgrades require earlier research, as shown in the tech tree.

The center acts as a hub for Research Stations, constructed as multiblock add-ons. The main unit supports up to three stations, allowing for parallel processing. *   Each station requires 3 Machine Cores. *   A station handles one active research task at a time.

Researched Augments are stored locally within the machine's memory. If the center is destroyed, all unapplied research progress and blueprints will be lost.

Once a research is complete, the augmentation becomes available for installation. The procedure requires a one-time resource cost to permanently fuse the technology with your player.

If you have augmentations installed, you can load them into the machine using the Import function (bottom-left UI button).

Augmentation Management:

Your enhancements are meant to be permanent: they require no maintenance or ongoing energy cost. However, should an ability prove distracting (like Ore Vision or Hyper Speed), it can be toggled at will.

*   Toggle Menu: Hold the augmentation hotkey ([G] by default) to open the radial interface. Hover over the desired augment and release to switch its state. *   Removal: While augmentations are intended to be permanent, they can be removed if necessary. Note that resources invested in the installation are non-refundable.

Information for Modpack Developers

Oritech augmentations are fully data-driven and configurable, allowing extensive customization through datapacks.

*   Modifier Augments: Alter entity attributes (e.g., speed, reach, health). *   Effect Augments: Apply status effects similar to potions. *   Custom Augments: Implement unique logic (e.g., Ore Vision). These can be referenced in datapacks but require a Java mod for the underlying logic.

Existing augments can be mo

entries.body:
基础发电机燃料标准熔炉燃料（煤炭、木头、木炭等）来发电。这是你游戏早期能量需求的起始发电机。

将任何燃料输入物品栏。发电机会燃料燃料并将能量储存在内部缓存中，然后传输给连接的机器或线缆。

它是你第一个工作间的理想机器，因为它便宜、燃料灵活，且不需要多方块结构搭建。一台发电机足以撑起一条起步产线，但建造第二或第三台通常是支持装配器、磨粉机和电炉同时运行的最简单方式。
entries.bodyEn:
Burns standard furnace fuels (coal, wood, charcoal, etc.) to generate power. This is your starting generator for early-game power needs.

Insert any combustible fuel into the inventory. The generator burns it and stores energy in its internal buffer, which gets sent to connected machines or cables.

It is a good machine for your first workshop because it is cheap, fuel-flexible, and does not require multiblock setup. One generator is enough for a starter line, but building a second or third is often the easiest way to support an Assembler, Pulverizer, and Powered Furnace at the same time.

entries.body:
一个大型的多方块结构，利用阳光发电。具有根据时间和光照等级激活的折叠动画。

使用机器核心建筑3x3多方块结构。当面板能直视天空时，它会在白天自动发电。

面板根据以下条件折叠或展开：*   展开（激活）：白天且天空光照 >= 12*   折叠（未激活）：夜晚或光照不足

机器核心品质直接影响产能速率。

确保面板直视天空以获得最佳效果。

需要3x3的区域。放置控制器并添加所需的核心。

太阳能适合作为被动能源，因为它不消耗燃料，但通常应与能量存储或燃料备用能源搭配，以应对夜间运行。

能量从北、南和下方向输出。
entries.bodyEn:
A large multiblock that generates power from sunlight. Features a folding animation that activates based on time of day and light levels.

Build the 3x3 multiblock structure using machine cores. The panel automatically generates energy during the day when it has a clear view of the sky.

The panel folds and unfolds based on conditions: *   Unfolded (Active): Day time with light level >= 12 *   Folded (Inactive): Night or low light

Core quality directly affects power generation rate.

Make sure the panel has a clear view of the sky for best results.

Requires a 3x3 area. Place the controller and add the required cores.

Solar is good for background power because it consumes no fuel, but it should usually be paired with stored power or fuel-based backup for night operation.

Energy outputs to the North, South, and Down sides.

entries.body:
将生物质或其他生物材料转化为能量。是回收农场有机废料的好方法。

你可以通过合成表查看其接受的生物质衍生燃料和其他生物材料。这是一种需要机器核心才能运行的多方块结构机器。

如果你已经拥有自动树场、农场或其他能稳定产生有机废料的系统，这是最容易实现自动化的发电机之一。由于它支持插件，即使在基础发电机退役后，也能长期保持实用价值。

保存生物质的稳定供应以持续运行。
entries.bodyEn:
Converts biomass and other biological materials into energy. A good way to recycle organic waste from your farms.

Feed it biomass-derived fuels and other biological materials accepted by your recipe viewer. This is a multiblock machine that needs machine cores to work.

It is one of the easiest generators to automate if you already have tree farms, crop farms, or other systems that produce steady organic waste. Because it supports addons, it can stay useful well after the basic generator has been retired.

Keep a steady supply of biomass to run this continuously.

entries.body: 给机器供能，通过框架和机器核心部件完成装配；扩展件放在允许的连接位置。输入和输出按机器 GUI 及 JEI 配方设置。
entries.bodyEn: Power the machine, assemble its required frame and core components, and attach addons at valid positions. Use its GUI and JEI recipes to route inputs and outputs.

entries.body:
储能扩展坞结合了扩展坞的插槽扩展和大增加能量容量的功能。

适用于所有带有能量的方块。

能量缓存
entries.bodyEn:
The Power Bank Addon Extender combines the slot expansion of an extender with a large internal energy reserve.

Applicable to all blocks with energy.

Energy Buffer

entries.body:
Oritech包含多种用于工厂建筑的强化护板。它们非常适合用作地板、墙壁和结构外壳。

所有强化护板都有台阶、楼梯和压力板变种。

*   铜强化护板：用于机器外壳的标准护板。它具有简洁、平滑的纹理，与Oritech机器完美搭配。*   铁强化护板：一种浅灰色、坚固的护板。适用于重工业区和结构支撑。*   镍强化护板：一种明亮、耐腐蚀的护板，略带黄色色调。适用于洁净室或专用设备区域。*   碳强化护板：一种现代化、暗色的护板。适用于对比效果和暗色的高级设施。
entries.bodyEn:
Oritech includes several plating blocks for factory construction. They work well for floors, walls, and structural casings.

All plating blocks come with slab, stair and pressure plate variants.

*   Machine Plating: The standard plating used for machine casings. It has a clean, smooth texture that fits well with Oritech machines. *   Iron Plating: A darker, rugged industrial-grade plating. Good for heavy industry areas and structural supports. *   Nickel Plating: A bright, corrosion-resistant plating with a slightly yellowish tint. Useful for clean rooms or specialized equipment areas. *   Carbon Plating: A modern, high-strength dark plating. Useful for contrast and darker advanced facility designs.

entries.body: 给机器供能，通过框架和机器核心部件完成装配；扩展件放在允许的连接位置。输入和输出按机器 GUI 及 JEI 配方设置。
entries.bodyEn: Power the machine, assemble its required frame and core components, and attach addons at valid positions. Use its GUI and JEI recipes to route inputs and outputs.

entries.body:
工业壁灯是一种工厂照明方块。可在大范围内提供明亮的照明。

有两种安装方式：*   平装式：直接贴附在方块表面安装。*   悬挂式：悬挂在天花板。

无法关闭照明。
entries.bodyEn:
The ceiling light is a factory lighting block. It provides bright light over a wide area.

There are two variants: *   Flush Mount: Placed directly against a block face. *   Hanging: Suspended from a chain for high ceilings.

The light cannot be toggled.

entries.body:
工业壁灯是一种工厂照明方块。可在大范围内提供明亮的照明。

有两种安装方式：*   平装式：直接贴附在方块表面安装。*   悬挂式：悬挂在天花板。

无法关闭照明。
entries.bodyEn:
The ceiling light is a factory lighting block. It provides bright light over a wide area.

There are two variants: *   Flush Mount: Placed directly against a block face. *   Hanging: Suspended from a chain for high ceilings.

The light cannot be toggled.

entries.body:
离心机通过高速旋转离心和转化物品。它可用于从粉碎工厂获得的矿碎块中提取矿粉，将煤粉纺成碳纤维，或处理各种流体。

处理流体时，必须安装流体处理插件，它才能接受流体。

流体离心

流体可以直接泵入和泵出离心机方块本身，而非插件。插件仅用于启用流体处理功能。常规用法包括将原油精炼成不同类型的燃料或将小麦加工成塑料片。

如果流体配方无法启动，通常问题是已经安装了插件但机器状态非刷新。放置插件后打开机器界面，使其正确初始化。
entries.bodyEn:
The centrifuge separates and transforms items through high-speed rotation. It can be used to extract ore dusts from ore clumps obtained from a fragment forge, spin coal dust into carbon fiber strands, or process various liquids.

When processing fluids, a fluid addon must be attached to the centrifuge before it can accept liquids.

Fluid Separation

Fluids can be pumped directly in and out of the centrifuge block itself, not the addon. The addon is only required to enable fluid processing compatibility. Common uses include refining crude oil into different fuel types or processing wheat into plastic sheets.

If fluid recipes do not start, the usual problem is that the addon was attached but the machine state has not refreshed yet. Open the machine after placing the addon so it initializes properly.

entries.body:
装备充能器是一种专用工作站，用于快速充能工具和盔甲。它还可以填充或排空喷气背包等基于流体的装备。

充能与维护

只需将你的手钻、链锯或外骨骼套装放入充能器槽位中。机器会自动从其内部RF缓存中提取能量，以快速充能物品。这也是为外骨骼喷气背包供应涡轮燃料的主要方式。
entries.bodyEn:
The Equipment Charger is a specialized station used to rapidly recharge powered tools and armor. It can also be used to fill or empty fluid-based equipment like jetpacks.

Power and Maintenance

Simply place your hand drill, chainsaw, or exo-suit pieces into the charger's slots. The machine will draw from its internal RF buffer to restore the item's charge at a high rate. It is also the primary way to supply turbofuel to an exo-jetpack.

entries.body:
工业冷却器从高温工业过程中移除热量。它通常是稳定核反应堆组件或高级材料冷却所必需的设备。

它接收水并输出冰块。

最重要的用途是为依赖冷却剂吸收器式冷却的反应堆装置生成冷却剂，因此一旦你开始扩展核能规模，它会变得更有用。

环境效率

冷却器的性能严重依赖于周围环境。当放置在寒冷生物群系中时，它的运行速度翻倍且能量效率显著提高。内部判定基于常规的寒冷生物群系标签而非硬编码的短列表，因此大多数雪地或冰冻生物群系都符合条件。
entries.bodyEn:
The Industrial Chiller removes heat from high-temperature industrial processes. It is often required for stabilized nuclear reactor components or advanced material cooling.

It takes in water and outputs frozen ice blocks.

Its most important use is producing coolant for reactor setups that rely on absorber-based cooling, so it becomes much more useful once you start scaling nuclear power.

Environmental Efficiency

The chiller's performance depends heavily on its surroundings. It works twice as fast and with significantly better energy efficiency when placed in cold biomes. Internally this is based on the conventional cold biome tag rather than a tiny hardcoded list, so most snowy or frozen biomes qualify.

entries.body: 创造/测试方块，提供无限能量或作为垃圾桶使用。可以无限输入和输出能量。红色标记为输出端。
entries.bodyEn: Creative/testing block that provides infinite energy or acts as a void. Energy can be inserted and extracted infinitely. Output is on the red marker.

entries.body:
流体版本的创造能量存储。提供无限流体或作为垃圾桶使用。

桶交互：用桶设置流体类型。
entries.bodyEn:
Fluid version of the Creative Energy Storage. Provides infinite fluid or acts as a void.

Bucket Interaction: Use a bucket to set the fluid type.

entries.body:
作物过滤器插件用于自动化农场。当安装在挖掘机器上时，它可以过滤目标，避免破坏未成熟的作物或动物。

该插件适用于：

- 方块破坏器

- 末影激光器 （可禁用方块破坏并在安装生物校位插件时过滤未成年动物）

作物过滤

该插件确保机器只会破坏完全成熟且可收获的作物。还能防止机器误伤工作区域内的被动生物或家畜。
entries.bodyEn:
The Crop Filter Addon is used for automated farming. When attached to a mining machine, it filters targets to avoid destroying immature crops or animals.

This addon is applicable to:

- Block Destroyer

- Enderic Laser (works for both block destruction and animal filtering with the hunter addon)

Crop Filtering

The filter makes sure the machine only breaks crops that are fully grown and ready for harvest. It also prevents the machine from accidentally killing passive mobs or farm animals within its working area.

entries.body:
基岩层钻机是一种大型机器，用于从基岩层下方提取资源。

它必须直接放置在资源节点上方才能运行。

从基岩中提取资源

钻机会扫描其下方3x3区域，并从3格深度内可见的矿石节点进行开采。右击时，机器会高亮显示下方的目标资源节点。

由于其极高的能量需求，它无法通过标准线缆供能，必须用末影激光器供能。

资源节点是无限的材料源，钻机的开采不会使其枯竭。

运行细节

运行时，钻机每完成一个周期都会从其下方3x3区域内随机选择一个方块。不需要区域内的所有方块都为矿石节点，但为获得最佳产量，你应该尝试将钻机放置在矿石节点数最多的位置上方。
entries.bodyEn:
The Bedrock Extractor is a large machine used to extract resources from below the bedrock layer.

It can only operate when placed directly above resource nodes.

Bedrock Resource Extraction

The extractor scans a 3x3 area below it and mines from the first visible ore nodes found within 3 blocks depth. When right-clicked, the machine will highlight the targeted resource nodes below.

Because of its high power requirements, it cannot be powered via standard cables and must be energized by enderic lasers.

Resource nodes are infinite sources of material and will never be depleted by the extractor.

Operation Details

During operation, the extractor randomly selects one block from the 3x3 area below it for each successful cycle. Not all blocks in the area need to be ore nodes, but for the best yield, you should try to position the extractor over a spot with the maximum number of ore nodes.

entries.body:
方块破坏器是一种龙门组件，用于破坏下方区域内的方块。它是一种多方块结构，在机器框架上运行，并作用于直接位于框架下层的方块。

破坏方块所需时间和能量取决于方块的硬度。

要启用农场功能，安装作物过滤器插件。这将使方块破坏器跳过所有未成熟的作物，实现自动化收割。

通过安装矿场插件，方块破坏器可以作为采矿矿使用。每个矿场插件将下方范围乘以8：

*   1个插件：8方块范围*   2个插件：64方块范围*   3个插件：512方块范围

作为矿场使用时默认速度非常慢，因此建议添加一些速度和效率升级插件。
entries.bodyEn:
The destroyer block is a gantry component that breaks blocks in the area below. It is a multiblock that operates on a machine frame and targets the block layer directly below the frame.

The time and energy required to break a block depend on the block's hardness.

To enable farming use, install the crop filter addon. This causes the block destroyer to skip all non-finished crops, allowing for automated harvesting.

By adding quarry addons, the block destroyer can also function as a quarry. Each quarry addon multiplies the downward range by 8:

*   1 Addon: 8 blocks range *   2 Addons: 64 blocks range *   3 Addons: 512 blocks range

The default speed is fairly slow when used as a quarry, so adding some speed and efficiency addons is recommended.

entries.body:
无人机港通过自主飞行无人机实现远距离物流运输，可运输物品和流体。起飞点和着陆点都需要匹配的无人机港。

物流与目标定位

要建立连接，需使用目标标识器将发送港绑定到指定目标。目标港必须至少相距50格，且位于已加载区块。虽然一个港只能发送到一个目标港。但可以接收来自多个其他港的货物。然而，如果一个港持续发送物品，可能会“堵塞”目标港，阻止其他港的货物到达。

能量与升级

- 运输成本：运输时间是恒定的，但能量消耗随距离按公式计算：`sqrt(距离) * 50 + 1024` RF。

- 流体传输：要运输流体，发送和接收港都必须配备流体处理插件。

- 自动化：安装控制单元插件可监控物品栏和运行状态。

红石控制模式

控制单元插件启用高级比较器输出：

- 能量测量：信号强度基于能量储量。

- 物品栏槽位测量：信号强度基于物品或流体数量，取其中最大值。

- 进度测量：信号强度基于当前进度。

- 运行状态测量：信号强度基于状态（空闲、发送中、接收中）。

- 控制输入：给插件红石信号以禁用港口发送或接收。
entries.bodyEn:
The drone port enables long-range logistics by transporting items and fluids via autonomous flying drones. It requires a matching drone port at both the takeoff and landing positions.

Logistics and Targeting

To establish a connection, use a target designator to bind a sending port to a specific destination. Target ports must be at least 50 blocks away and located in chunk-loaded areas. While a port can only send to one destination, it can receive shipments from multiple external ports. However if one port is continuously sending items, it can "clog" a target port and prevent shipments from other ports from arriving.

Energy and Upgrades

- Travel Cost: Delivery time is constant, but the energy consumption scales with distance according to `sqrt(distance) * 50 + 1024` RF.

- Fluid Transport: To carry liquids, both the sending and receiving ports must be equipped with a fluid addon.

- Automation: Attaching a redstone addon allows for monitoring of inventory levels and operational status.

Redstone Control Modes

The redstone addon enables advanced comparator outputs:

- Power Measure: Signal strength based on stored energy.

- Inventory Slot Measure: Signal strength based on the largest amount of material (item or fluid).

- Progress Measure: Signal based on operation progress.

- Activity Measure: Signal based on state (idle, sending, receiving).

- Input Control: Powering the addon prevents the port from sending or receiving.

entries.body:
稳定附魔器可以添加标准魔咒到装备或工具上。与普通附魔台不同，它允许你从界面中选择特定的魔咒。

附魔器需要能量和灵魂运行，其附近的奥术触媒将提供灵魂。

- 灵魂：附魔器本身不储存灵魂。必须有一个或多个存有灵魂的奥术触媒在其16格内。

- 触媒数量：更高级的魔咒需要附近有更多激活的奥术触媒，并消耗更多灵魂。所需触媒数量为合并魔咒费用+目标等级。

1. 将待附魔物品放入左侧槽位。2. 打开GUI并选择所需的魔咒。3. 若能量和附近的触媒数量足够，附魔将自动进行。4. 完成后，附魔物品将移至右侧输出槽位。

附魔所需时间随魔咒等级和稀有度提升而增加。
entries.bodyEn:
The Stabilized Enchanter is used to apply standard enchantments to equipment and tools. Unlike a standard enchanting table, it allows you to select the specific enchantment you want from its interface.

To operate, the enchanter needs both energy and souls from nearby arcane catalysts.

- Souls: The enchanter does not store souls. It must be within 16 blocks of one or more catalysts that contain souls.

- Catalyst Count: Higher level enchantments require more active catalysts nearby, and consume more souls. The number of catalysts required is the enchantment's base cost plus the target level.

1. Place the item to be enchanted in the left slot. 2. Open the GUI and select the desired enchantment. 3. If enough energy and nearby catalysts are available, the process will begin. 4. Once finished, the enchanted item will move to the right output slot.

The time required to complete an enchantment increases with the enchantment's level and rarity.

entries.body:
奥术触媒用于储存灵魂和高级附魔。它储存的灵魂可供附近的稳定附魔器使用，也可以直接用附魔书和物品进行附魔。

奥术触媒会自动收集16格方块半径内释放的任何灵魂。当附近有生物死亡或收获灵魂之花时会释放灵魂。

奥术触媒的基础容量为50灵魂。要储存更多灵魂，必须用末影激光器为其供能。

- 衰减：若能量供应中断，容量将缓慢回落至50。

稳定性风险：如果触媒内的灵魂数量超过当前容量（例如装满灵魂时断电）, 它将变得不稳定。经过3秒（60刻）的不稳定状态后, 它将爆炸。爆炸强度随超额灵魂数量增加而提升。

将附魔书放入第一个槽位，物品放入第二个槽位，即可直接为物品附魔。

- 等级要求：使用的附魔书必须为该魔咒的原版最高等级。

- 无限制：此方法无视标准附魔规则，可以将任何魔咒应用于任何物品。

- 超附：若物品已经达到该魔咒的最高等级，触媒可以将其“超附”至更高等级。

- 消耗：超附时，附魔书将被消耗。

超附的灵魂消耗远超正常附魔，且随着目标等级呈指数型增长。
entries.bodyEn:
The Arcane Catalyst is used for soul storage and advanced enchanting. It stores souls, which can then be used by a nearby Stabilized Enchanter or for direct book enchanting.

The catalyst automatically collects any souls released within a 16-block radius. Souls are released when mobs die nearby or when Soul Flowers are harvested.

The catalyst has a base capacity of 50 souls. To store more, it must be supplied with energy, such as from a Laser Arm.

- Decay: If the energy supply is cut, the capacity will slowly drop back to 50.

Stability Risk: If the catalyst contains more souls than its current capacity (e.g., if power is lost while it's full), it will become unstable. After 3 seconds (60 ticks) of instability, it will explode. The explosion strength increases with the amount of excess souls.

By placing an Enchanted Book in the first slot and an item in the second, you can enchant items directly.

- Level Requirement: The book used must be at the maximum vanilla level for that enchantment.

- No Restrictions: This method ignores standard enchantment rules, allowing you to apply any enchantment to any item.

- Hyper Levels: If the item already has the enchantment at its maximum level, the catalyst can "hyper enchant" it to even higher levels.

- Consumption: The enchanted book is consumed during the hyper enchanting process.

Hyper enchanting costs much more souls than standard enchanting, scaling exponentially with the target level.

entries.body:
Oritech中的能量是推送式的，因此发电机和能量存储会将主动将能量推送到线缆，线缆再将其传输至连接的机器。管道本身没有提取模式。可使用管道扳手禁用管道连接。

*   标准：基础杆状线缆。*   带框架：用于建筑整合的完整方块变种。*   集装：另类美术风格。集装变种不直接与机器相连，仅能连接其他线缆。

更高的传输速率请改用超导体。
entries.bodyEn:
Power in Oritech is push-based, so generators and storage blocks push power into the pipes, which then send it to connected machines. There is no extraction mode on the pipe itself. A wrench can be used to disable pipe connections.

*   Standard: Basic stick-like pipe *   Framed: Full-block variant for building integration *   Duct: Alternative aesthetic style. Ducted variants do not connect to machines directly, only to other pipes.

For very high power transfer, use Superconductors instead.

entries.body:
施肥器用于加速连接到机器框架下方的作物生长。他需要水和能量才能运行。

对下方方块的效果类似于使用骨粉，但效果更弱。此外，它还能为下方的耕地提供水分。

矿物浆液流体可以代替水使用。这将显著增加加速效果。

骨粉也可以放入方块施肥器以增加其效力。

这台机器适用于持续耕作，而非爆发式生长。水是廉价的基础流体，而当你需要更高的作物产量时，矿物浆液是更好的选择。

与其他龙门机器一样，多台施肥器可以共用同一个框架，并在相同区域内轮流作业。
entries.bodyEn:
The fertilizer is used to speed up crop growth below the connected machine frame. It requires water and energy to operate.

The effect on the blocks below is similar to applying bonemeal, although it is less potent. Additionally, it hydrates the farmland below.

Mineral Slurry fluid can be used instead of water. This will significantly increase the strength of the growth effect.

Bone meal can also be inserted into the fertilizer block to increase its potency.

This machine is meant for continuous farming rather than burst growth. Water is the cheap baseline fluid, while mineral slurry is the better option when you want much higher crop throughput.

Like other gantry machines, multiple fertilizers can share a single frame and iterate over the same field.

entries.body:
在机器和储罐间传输流体。默认传输速率为每3刻500mB。流体管道没有内部储存空间。

管道会连接到任何具有流体处理功能的方块。右击对应的管道部分即可切换提取模式。无需使用扳手。不过，可以使用扳手来禁用管道连接。

*   标准：基础管道模型。*   带框架：用于墙体整合的固体版本。*   集装：另类美术风格。集装变种不直接与机器相连，仅能连接其他管道。
entries.bodyEn:
Transports liquids between machines and tanks. The default transfer rate is 0.5 buckets every 3 ticks. Fluid pipes do not have internal storage.

Connect pipes to any block with fluid handling. Right-click the relevant pipe part to toggle extraction. No wrench is needed. However, a wrench can be used to disable pipe connections.

*   Standard: Basic pipe model *   Framed: Solid block version for wall integration *   Duct: Alternative aesthetic style. Ducted variants do not connect to machines directly, only to other pipes.

entries.body:
铸造器专门用于制作Oritech机器所需的各种合金。虽然其中一些合金可以手动合成，但这样做比使用铸造器显著消耗更多的资源。

一旦你的能源和矿石供应稳定，铸造器就成为高效制作进阶合金，如钢、琥珀金、精镍、有机钢、辐镍晶等的首选方式。

如果你仍在手搓合金，这通常是回本最快的机器。
entries.bodyEn:
As soon as your power and ore flow are stable, the foundry becomes the efficient way to make progression alloys such as steel, electrum, adamant, biosteel, energite, and more.

If you are still hand-crafting alloys, this is usually the machine that pays for itself fastest.

entries.body:
粉碎工厂是提高矿处理产线产量的重要设备。将矿石粉碎产出粗矿，将粗矿粉碎产出矿碎块。

在粉碎粗矿时，粉碎工厂总是会产出一个矿碎块和3个同种矿碎末。同时还会产出3个不同类型的矿碎末作为副产物。

通过给机器安装一个产量升级插件来翻倍副产物。仅支持1个产量升级插件。
entries.bodyEn:
The fragment forge is a major step in improving the yield of your ore processing chain. Fragmenting ore blocks creates raw ores, and fragmenting raw ores creates ore clumps.

When fragmenting raw ores, the fragment forge always outputs one ore clump and 3 additional small ore clumps of the same type. It also creates 3 small clumps of a different resource as byproduct.

The production of these byproducts can be doubled by attaching a yield addon to the machine. Only 1 yield addon is supported.

entries.body:
Oritech的物品物流包含物品管道和物品筛选器。物品管道可相互连接，也可与相邻的容器连接。

与其他管道不同，物品管道没有储存空间。这意味着其他方块，如漏斗等无法自行将物品输入到管道网络。相反，物品管道可以设置提取模式从附近的容器中提取物品。

*   标准：基础管道。*   带框架：完整方块版本。*   透明：在内部显示移动的物品。仅在整个管道网络均为透明管道时有效。*   集装：另类美术风格。集装变种不直接与机器相连，仅能连接其他管道。

要切换提取模式，右击管道连接到方块的部分。仅到管道连接至支持提取的方块时有效。管道的每个连接处都可以切换提取模式。使用管道扳手禁用特定方向的连接。

提取的物品将放入网络中最近可用容器中，依照世界距离计算。

管道始终从容器的第一个非空槽位提取物品。如果该物品无法放入管道网络中的任何容器，它就会阻塞该容器的提取。

你可以为管道安装马达（通过右击）来升级提取管道，使其能从所有槽位提取。出于性能考虑，这不是默认行为。

默认传输速率为每5刻8个物品。
entries.bodyEn:
Oritech includes item pipes and item filter blocks for item logistics. Item pipes connect to each other and to neighboring inventories.

Unlike other pipes, item pipes do not have an inventory. This means that other blocks, such as hoppers, cannot insert items into the pipe network on their own. Instead, an item pipe can be set to extract from a nearby inventory.

*   Standard: Basic pipe *   Framed: Full-block version *   Transparent: Shows items moving inside. Only works if the entire pipe path is from transparent pipes. *   Duct: Alternative aesthetic style. Ducted variants do not connect to machines directly, only to other pipes.

To toggle extraction mode, right-click the section of the pipe connected to the block you want to extract from. Extraction will only be enabled if the pipe is connected to a block that supports extraction. Each pipe connection can be toggled independently. Use a pipe-wrench to disable connections in specific directions.

Extracted items are placed into the closest available inventory further down the network, based on world distance.

Pipes will always extract from the first non-empty slot in an inventory. If the item cannot be placed into an inventory within the pipe network, it will block the pipe from extracting from that inventory.

You can install a motor in the pipe (by right-clicking it) to upgrade the extracting pipe to extract from all slots. This is not the default behaviour for performance reasons.

The default transfer rate is 8 items every 5 ticks.

entries.body:
用法与标准能量线缆类似，但吞吐量更高。它们比常规线缆更粗。超导体无法和常规能量线缆连接。

*   标准：核心超导体线缆。*   带框架：完整方块版本。*   集装：另类美术风格。集装变种不直接与机器相连，仅能连接其他线缆。

对巨大能量输出至关重要，如核反应堆。
entries.bodyEn:
Works like standard energy pipes but with much higher throughput. They are thicker than regular pipes. Superconductors cannot connect to regular energy pipes.

*   Standard: Core superconductor cable *   Framed: Full-block version *   Duct: Alternative aesthetic style. Ducted variants do not connect to machines directly, only to other pipes.

Essential for transferring the huge energy output of a Nuclear Reactor.

entries.body:
能量仅能从机器正面的2个黄色连接点输出。

通过管道或桶接收流体燃料。这是一种需要机器核心的多方块结构。你也用流体容器物品点击机器来输入或输出燃料。

石油足以让其运行，但精炼燃料才是这台机器真正高效的关键。如果你已经有精炼厂，这通常是消耗那些升级燃料的最佳首选设备。

精炼燃料比原始燃料提供更高的能量密度。
entries.bodyEn:
Energy is only output at the 2 yellow connection spots in the machine front.

Accepts liquid fuels through pipes or buckets. This is a multiblock that needs machine cores. You can also insert or extract fuel by clicking the machine with a fluid containing item.

Raw oil is enough to get it running, but refined fuels are where the machine becomes truly efficient. If you already have a refinery, this is usually the best first consumer for those upgraded fuels.

Refined fuels provide much higher energy density than raw resources.

entries.body:
工业玻璃是专为工厂建筑制造的强化玻璃。它带有金属框架且防爆，这使其适用于隔离室、反应堆观察口和机器视窗。

它可以与相邻的工业玻璃连接，形成无缝玻璃。
entries.bodyEn:
Industrial glass is reinforced glass made for factory builds. It has a metal frame and is blast-resistant, which makes it useful for containment chambers, reactor viewports, and machine windows.

It connects to adjacent industrial glass blocks to create seamless windows.

entries.body:
Oritech包含多种用于工厂建筑的强化护板。它们非常适合用作地板、墙壁和结构外壳。

所有强化护板都有台阶、楼梯和压力板变种。

*   铜强化护板：用于机器外壳的标准护板。它具有简洁、平滑的纹理，与Oritech机器完美搭配。*   铁强化护板：一种浅灰色、坚固的护板。适用于重工业区和结构支撑。*   镍强化护板：一种明亮、耐腐蚀的护板，略带黄色色调。适用于洁净室或专用设备区域。*   碳强化护板：一种现代化、暗色的护板。适用于对比效果和暗色的高级设施。
entries.bodyEn:
Oritech includes several plating blocks for factory construction. They work well for floors, walls, and structural casings.

All plating blocks come with slab, stair and pressure plate variants.

*   Machine Plating: The standard plating used for machine casings. It has a clean, smooth texture that fits well with Oritech machines. *   Iron Plating: A darker, rugged industrial-grade plating. Good for heavy industry areas and structural supports. *   Nickel Plating: A bright, corrosion-resistant plating with a slightly yellowish tint. Useful for clean rooms or specialized equipment areas. *   Carbon Plating: A modern, high-strength dark plating. Useful for contrast and darker advanced facility designs.

entries.body: 给机器供能，通过框架和机器核心部件完成装配；扩展件放在允许的连接位置。输入和输出按机器 GUI 及 JEI 配方设置。
entries.bodyEn: Power the machine, assemble its required frame and core components, and attach addons at valid positions. Use its GUI and JEI recipes to route inputs and outputs.

entries.body:
使用物品筛选器来控制物品流向。需要对着目标容器放置。有五个输入面，总是从朝向的输出面输出。

仅接受与UI中设置的过滤器匹配的物品，并自动将其输出到目标容器。不会自动从相邻容器中提取物品。它们内部有1个槽位。

放置时，请确保唯一的输出面指向你希望过滤物品的去处。

如果安装了"FTB Filters"模组，你可以在物品筛选器中使用该模组的智能过滤器。
entries.bodyEn:
Use item filters to control which items go where. They are blocks you place next to the target inventory. They have five input sides and always output to the side they are facing.

They only accept items that match the filter set in the UI and automatically output them to the target inventory. They do not automatically extract items from neighboring inventories. They also have a 1-slot internal inventory.

When placing them, make sure the one different output side points where you want the filtered items to go.

If the "FTB Filters" mod is installed, you can use the smart filters from that mod inside the item filter block.

entries.body:
Oritech的物品物流包含物品管道和物品筛选器。物品管道可相互连接，也可与相邻的容器连接。

与其他管道不同，物品管道没有储存空间。这意味着其他方块，如漏斗等无法自行将物品输入到管道网络。相反，物品管道可以设置提取模式从附近的容器中提取物品。

*   标准：基础管道。*   带框架：完整方块版本。*   透明：在内部显示移动的物品。仅在整个管道网络均为透明管道时有效。*   集装：另类美术风格。集装变种不直接与机器相连，仅能连接其他管道。

要切换提取模式，右击管道连接到方块的部分。仅到管道连接至支持提取的方块时有效。管道的每个连接处都可以切换提取模式。使用管道扳手禁用特定方向的连接。

提取的物品将放入网络中最近可用容器中，依照世界距离计算。

管道始终从容器的第一个非空槽位提取物品。如果该物品无法放入管道网络中的任何容器，它就会阻塞该容器的提取。

你可以为管道安装马达（通过右击）来升级提取管道，使其能从所有槽位提取。出于性能考虑，这不是默认行为。

默认传输速率为每5刻8个物品。
entries.bodyEn:
Oritech includes item pipes and item filter blocks for item logistics. Item pipes connect to each other and to neighboring inventories.

Unlike other pipes, item pipes do not have an inventory. This means that other blocks, such as hoppers, cannot insert items into the pipe network on their own. Instead, an item pipe can be set to extract from a nearby inventory.

*   Standard: Basic pipe *   Framed: Full-block version *   Transparent: Shows items moving inside. Only works if the entire pipe path is from transparent pipes. *   Duct: Alternative aesthetic style. Ducted variants do not connect to machines directly, only to other pipes.

To toggle extraction mode, right-click the section of the pipe connected to the block you want to extract from. Extraction will only be enabled if the pipe is connected to a block that supports extraction. Each pipe connection can be toggled independently. Use a pipe-wrench to disable connections in specific directions.

Extracted items are placed into the closest available inventory further down the network, based on world distance.

Pipes will always extract from the first non-empty slot in an inventory. If the item cannot be placed into an inventory within the pipe network, it will block the pipe from extracting from that inventory.

You can install a motor in the pipe (by right-clicking it) to upgrade the extracting pipe to extract from all slots. This is not the default behaviour for performance reasons.

The default transfer rate is 8 items every 5 ticks.

entries.body:
大型能量存储的容量远超便携能量存储。默认容量为20M RF。

能量可以从任意位置输入，但仅从🔴红色输出标记处输出。

插件可以增加容量或传输速率。吞吐量统计数据可在机器GUI中查看。
entries.bodyEn:
Large energy storage with much more capacity than the small version. Default capacity is 20M RF.

Energy can be inserted anywhere, but is only output at the 🔴 red output marker.

Addons can increase capacity or throughput. Throughput statistics can be viewed in the machine GUI. The output limit slider in the screen allows you to set a custom output limit if you want to limit how much RF a target machine / network should get.

entries.body:
末影激光器消耗大量能量，从特定方向发射高能光束。它主要用于快速远程采矿，或作为远距离能量传输系统。

控制与瞄准

要设置目标方向，需用目标标识器设定。激光的最大射程为128格，会持续发射直到被阻挡或被红石信号关闭。注意，你只是设置了激光的射击方向，而非最终到达的目标方块。它会尝试破坏该方向上的所有方块。

挖掘时，激光会自动将掉落物收集到其内部物品栏中。

无法放入内部物品栏的物品将被销毁。请确保使用物流管道持续提取资源。请注意：激光会破坏路径上几乎所有东西（标靶方块除外），但会穿过玻璃。

高级交互

- 能量传输：当瞄准机器或能量存储时，激光为其充能，无视正常的输入限制。这是为原子锻造器和基岩层钻机供能的必要方式。

- 采集辐水晶：将激光瞄准紫水晶簇，开采时可将其转化为辐水晶。

- 生长加速：瞄准紫水晶母岩可大幅加速其生长速率，且不会破坏它。

- 战斗：安装生物校位插件后，激光将主动追踪并攻击实体。速度类插件同样适用于战斗。

- 外骨骼胸甲充能：如果玩家被瞄准（仅当安装了生物校位插件），激光可为玩家的外骨骼胸甲无线充能。

插件&升级

激光器只在其底部有一个插件槽位，可显著改变其大规模作业时的行为。

- 矿场插件：将激光转换为大规模挖掘工具。增加光束宽度，使其能高效清理大型隧道或区域，而不仅是一条直线。

- 产量升级插件：类似于时运效果，增加挖掘方块的资源掉落。

- 速度升级插件：提高挖掘速度（或能量传输量），但能耗更高。

- 效率升级插件：降低挖掘或加速方块生长时的能量消耗。

- 生物校位插件：将激光切换至战斗模式。通过对激光器使用目标标识器，可循环切换瞄准模式（仅敌对生物、敌对和中立生物、所有非玩家生物）。
entries.bodyEn:
The enderic laser uses large amounts of energy to fire a high-power beam in a specific direction. It is primarily used for rapid long-range mining or as an long-range power transmission system.

Control and Targeting

To set the target direction, use a target designator on the laser block. The laser has a maximum range of 128 blocks and will continue firing until obstructed or disabled by a redstone signal. Note that you're only setting a target direction, not target block. It will try to destroy all blocks in that direction.

When mining, the laser automatically collects drops into its internal inventory.

Items that do not fit into the internal inventory will be destroyed. Ensure you use item pipes to extract resources continuously. Be careful: the laser will destroy almost anything in its path, though it passes through glass.

Advanced Interactions

- Energy Transfer: When aimed at machines or power storage, the laser will charge them, ignoring normal input limits. This is required for the Atomic Forge and Bedrock Extractor.

- Fluxite Harvesting: Directing the laser at amethyst clusters will transform them into fluxite when mined.

- Growth Acceleration: Aiming at a Budding Amethyst will massively accelerate its growth rate without destroying it.

- Combat: Equipped with a hunter addon, the laser will actively track and attack entities. Addons like speed apply to combat as well.

- Exo-Armor Charging: The laser can wirelessly charge a player's Exo Chestplate if the player is targeted (only with a hunter addon installed).

Addons & Upgrades

The laser has a single addon slot at the bottom, which significantly alters its behavior for large-scale operations.

- Quarry Addon: Converts the laser into a mass-excavation tool. It increases the beam's width, allowing it to clear large tunnels or areas efficiently rather than just a single line.

- Yield Addon: Acts like Fortune, increasing the resource drops from mined blocks.

- Speed Addon: Increases the mining speed (or amount of energy transferred) at the cost of higher energy consumption.

- Efficiency Addon: Decreases the energy consumption when mining or accelerating blocks.

- Hunter Addon: Switches the laser to combat mode. You can cycle targeting modes (Monsters, Animals, Traders) by using the Target Designator on the laser block.

entries.body:
使用熔岩作为燃料发电。可以使用电动泵大量收集熔岩。

流体输入可以通过储罐、泵或管道实现自动化。早期手动用桶装填也可以，但一旦成为完成流体网络的一部分，这台机器的表现会好得多。

值得为这台机器专门精炼地狱火，因为它的燃料时间比普通熔岩长得多。
entries.bodyEn:
Uses lava as fuel to generate electricity. A pump can be used to collect lava in large quantities.

Fluid input can be automated with tanks, pumps, or pipes. Manual bucket filling is fine early, but the machine is much better once it is part of a proper fluid network.

Sheol fire is worth refining specifically for this machine because it burns for much longer than plain lava.

entries.body:
低当量核爆炸装置是曼哈顿模块的小型、更可控的版本。

虽然威力不如大型版本，但它仍具有危险性，必须极其谨慎的处理。当你需要局部爆炸来进行地形改造或清理刷怪区域，又不想造成全尺寸核装置那样巨大的弹坑时，它就很有用。

可通过红石信号或附近的爆炸触发。警告，信号与爆炸之间没有延迟。

即使“低当量”，其爆炸威力仍远超标准TNT。确保在引爆前已妥善封锁区域并处于安全距离。

有一个名为“无聊的核弹”的配置选项，可使该装置表现得像TNT方块那样。
entries.bodyEn:
The Low-Yield Nuclear Explosion Device is a smaller, more controlled version of the Manhattan Module.

While it is less powerful than the larger version, it is still dangerous and should be handled with extreme caution. It is useful when you need a more localized explosion for landscaping or clearing hostile territory without the much larger crater of a full-scale nuclear device.

It can be triggered with a redstone signal or a nearby explosion. Be warned, there's no delay between the signal and the explosion.

Even with its "low yield," the blast is significantly more powerful than standard TNT. Ensure you have properly secured the area and are at a safe distance before detonation.

There is a config setting called "Boring Nukes" which makes the device behave like a block of TNT.

entries.body:
机器适配器插件是一种能量模块，为能量系统提供额外的连接点。

适用于所有带有能量的方块。

外部充能

与标准机器只在底座接收能量不同，机器适配器插件允许能量直接输入到插件方块本身。
entries.bodyEn:
The Acceptor Addon is an energy module that provides an external connection point for energy systems.

Applicable to all blocks with energy.

External Charging

entries.body:
脉冲超频插件允许机器在短期内以更高的速度运行。生效时，它使机器以正常速度的8倍运行。

适用于所有配方处理机器（如磨粉机、电炉、离心机等）。

当机器长期超频工作时会过热。如果超过最大超频时间，机器将进入节流状态，在此状态下会正常速度的80%运行，并多消耗20%能量，直至冷却完成。

脉冲超频插件最适合间歇性处理任务，不建议用于需要长期运行的机器上。

超频管理

每个脉冲超频插件将增加12秒最大超频持续时间。为避免过热，机器必须定时停机，以便充能超频计时。当超频运行时，机器UI将显示剩余的超频时间。
entries.bodyEn:
The Burst Addon allows machines to operate at much higher speeds for short durations. When active, it makes the machine run at 8x its normal speed.

Applicable to all recipe processing machines (e.g. pulverizers, furnaces, centrifuges, etc.)

Machines using burst addons can overheat if used for too long. If the burst time is exceeded, the machine will enter a throttled state, operating at 80% of its normal speed and consuming 20% more energy until it has cooled down.

Burst addons are best for intermittent processing tasks but are not recommended for machines that need to run continuously.

Managing Bursts

Each burst addon increases the maximum burst duration by 12 seconds. To avoid overheating, the machine must stop processing periodically to allow the burst meter to recharge. When a burst addon is active, the machine UI will show the remaining burst time.

entries.body: 给机器供能，通过框架和机器核心部件完成装配；扩展件放在允许的连接位置。输入和输出按机器 GUI 及 JEI 配方设置。
entries.bodyEn: Power the machine, assemble its required frame and core components, and attach addons at valid positions. Use its GUI and JEI recipes to route inputs and outputs.

entries.body:
机器之心是一个游戏后期的插件，可将数个机器加成整合到单个方块中。

组合插件

此插件非常强大，但有一个严格的限制：只有当它是机器上第一个且唯一的插件时，才能发挥作用。如果存在任何其他的插件或扩展坞，机器之心将保持未激活状态。其主要目的是让带有大量插件的机器更加紧凑。

根据创建时连接到插件铰接器的插件提供加成。只有改变机器数值的插件才能以这种方式压缩。蒸汽锅炉插件、控制单元插件、物品栏代理插件、生物校位插件或任何需要直接与插件交互的插件都无法被压缩。
entries.bodyEn:
The Heart of the Machine is a late-game addon that combines several machine bonuses into a single block.

Combined Addons

This addon is powerful, but it comes with one strict limitation: it only functions if it is the first and only addon attached to the machine. If any other addons or extenders are present, the Heart of the Machine will remain inactive. Its main purpose is letting machines with many addons be more compact.

It provides the benefits based on the addons connected to the Addon Splicer during creation. Only addons that change machine stats can be compacted this way. The steam boiler addon, redstone addon, inventory proxy addon, hunter addon, or anything else that needs direct interaction with the addon cannot be compacted.

entries.body:
机器核心决定了Oritech多方块机器的品质。更好的核心不会让机器变得更快。其主要目的是增加机器支持的扩展坞层数和连接的插件。

用途

- 多方块结构机器右击时会高亮显示所需的机器核心位置。

- 手持机器核心右击机器可自动放置到合适位置，只要目标位置未被阻挡。

- 最终机器品质控制的是扩展坞深度和插件规模，而非原始合成速度。
entries.bodyEn:
Machine cores determine the quality of Oritech multiblock machines. Better cores do not automatically make a machine faster. Their main purpose is to increase how many layers of extenders and connected addons a machine can support.

Usage

- Multiblock machines highlight their required core positions when right-clicked.

- You can also right-click a machine with a core in hand to place the next valid core automatically, as long as the target spot is unobstructed.

- The resulting machine quality controls extender depth and addon scaling rather than raw crafting speed.
