entries.body:
电弧炉是用来快速熔化金属的大型结构。它由一个钢制大缸和上方的加热电极构成。
电弧炉因其高速和并行处理能力，非常适合用来熔化金属或者炼钢，然而其工作原理相当复杂，也需要持续进行维护以维持运行。
产生的炉渣需及时移出电弧炉，否则会停止运作。降解的电极也需要按时进行交换。
按照第一页所示进行搭建，之后用工程师锤单击炼药锅就可以了。
能量从背面的三个接线器输入，而用给正面的控制面板一个红石信号则会关闭电弧炉。右击面板、“桶”或者缸来打开GUI。

指引：
一开始GUI可能看着让人不知所措，但实际上它的构成很直白。

顶上三个槽用来放石墨电极。
左侧的十二个槽则是用来输入原料的。每个槽旁边都有温度指示，代表熔化进度。
右侧的四个槽是添加剂用槽。添加剂会在途中被加入熔融金属，产生新的产物。例如钢可以向液态铁中加入焦煤粉来制作。
原料和添加剂从顶部的两个口输入。其中，原料要输入到电极的左侧，而添加剂要输入到电极的右侧。
底部的七个槽由六个产物槽和一个炉渣槽组成。输出的材料可以从结构前方的“桶”处获得，而炉渣会从机器背部的口输出。电弧炉会自动识别相连接的容器或者传送带并将产物和炉渣输出。
entries.bodyEn:
The Arc Furnace is a massive machine used to quickly alloy metals and smelt ores. It consists of supports and a steel and firebrick vat topped by electrodes to heat the vat.

Arc furnaces can smelt batches of many items at once, but are little faster than their simpler sisters at the cost of larger amounts of power. Thus, they excel at speed for big orders.

As a consequence of the order of magnitude increase in speed from parallel smelting, the Arc Furnace is a complex machine that requires hand maintenance in the form of replacement of the electrodes. This maintenance cannot be performed automatically.

Once the electrodes are used for approximately four continuous days of smelting, they become degraded enough that they break.

To form the structure, assemble it as shown on the first page, then click the cauldron with an Engineer's Hammer.

Energy is input through the three connectors at the back, and supplying the control panel at the front with a redstone signal will turn off the machine.

 Outputs are retrieved from the basin at the front of the structure, slag through the port at the center back. The Arc Furnace will automatically push outputs and slag to connected receptacles.

Right-clicking the panel, cauldron, or vat will open the interface.

Interface:
The three slots at the top are for the Graphite Electrodes.

The twelve slots on the left are the input slots for metals and ores. Each slot has a temperature bar next to it, representing the progress of smelting.

The button in the top left of the screen changes whether items are spread across the arc furnace or concentrated in one point in the vat.

The four slots on the right are for "additives", different materials added to the molten metal during the crafting process. An example of these would be adding Coke Dust to melting Iron in order to create Steel.

Inputs and additives are inserted through the two hatches at the top of the structure, inputs to the left and additives to the right of the electrodes.

The seven slots at the bottom are six output slots and a slot for slag, on the bottom right.

entries.body:
装配机是一个可以像玩家一样制作物品的机器。
像上图一样搭建好结构，然后用锤子右击其中一条传送带就可以了。

你右击的那条传送带会变成输入端，它上面的蓝色标记和机器侧面的箭头也指代输入端。
装配机最多可以储存三个配方，并且会按配方顺序进行合成。这使得上一个配方的成品可以作为下一个配方的原材料。
三个合成栏用来储存配方，而下方的十八个槽是用来储存原料的。

输入端除了输入物品，也可以输入流体。流体会储存在机器内置的三个储罐中。
这些储罐中的流体可以代替利用流体储罐的合成中所使用的流体。
装配机的能量需要从上方正中间的方块输入。
entries.bodyEn:
The Assembler is a complex machine capable of crafting items, similar to a player.

To form the structure, build it like demonstrated above and use the Engineer's Hammer on the inwards facing conveyor.

The Assembler allows for up to 3 recipes to be stored inside it that will be performed in order. The outputs of previous recipes can be used as inputs for following recipes.

The 3 crafting grids store the recipes, and the 18 slots below them are the inventory for materials.

The input side, in addition to an item input, also features a fluid input to fill the three internal tanks of the machine.

Fluid in these tanks can be used to replace fluid containers like water buckets in recipes. Recipes to use fluids are specified by the same buckets as in the crafting table.

Power for the machine is input through the plug on the top center block, and redstone control can be done through the two ports on the sides of the machine.

entries.body:
工程师装配台是专为专业工程师打造的工作台。它广泛用于组装工程师蓝图所记载的物品。

多种蓝图均可合成，具体细节参见此处；少数特定蓝图则需在探索世界时发现或从村民处购买。

要在装配台使用蓝图，请将其放入界面左侧槽位，并将所需材料放入中间的六个槽位。

成品可从右侧取出。将鼠标悬停于输出槽位上，可精确查看每件物品所需的材料清单。

装配台的另一项功能是改装与配置更复杂的工具和装置。例如采矿机械钻、重型盾牌或左轮手枪等物品。

当此类物品放入装配台主槽位时，界面将显示新的升级槽位——通过向其中插入对应升级模块，即可完成工具改装。
entries.bodyEn:
The Engineer's Workbench is a professional worktable for the educated engineer. It is widely used to create items described by Engineer's Blueprints.

A wide variety of blueprints can be crafted, as detailed here, whereas a few select ones can only be discovered in the world or bought from villagers.

To use a blueprint in the Workbench, put it in the slot on the left of the GUI and the necessary ingredients in the six slots in the middle.

The resulting items can then be retrieved from the right side. Hovering your mouse over these output slots will inform you exactly which materials are needed for each item.

A secondary function of the Workbench is the modification and configuration of more complex tools and gadgets. The Mining Drill, Heavy Plated Shield or Revolver are examples of such items.

When placed in the main slot of the workbench, it's use becomes that of modifying these tools by inserting applicable upgrades into the new slots that appear.

entries.body: 多方块按工程师手册结构搭好后，用工程师锤右键指定方块成形。接线器与电线需匹配电压等级；处理设备接入能量、材料和输出容器。
entries.bodyEn: Build multiblocks and form them with an Engineer's Hammer at the designated block. Match connectors and wires to voltage tiers; supply machines with energy and materials.

entries.body:
粗制高炉用于提高铁的含碳量，使之成为钢。为了达成目的，只有含碳量高的纯燃料才可被用于高炉，比如焦煤和木炭。
高炉炼钢还会产生矿渣，你必须定期清理，否则高炉便会停止工作。理论上来说矿渣属于废弃物，但还是有一些办法将矿渣回收利用。

。
搭建一个高炉，你需要用27个高炉砖搭建出3x3x3的结构，然后用工程师锤右击其中一个侧面中央的方块。
具体搭建参考上图。粗制高炉无法自动化生产。所有输入输出必须通过手动打开GUI完成。如果你想要自动化冶炼钢铁，你可能需要查看强化高炉的相关搭建信息。
entries.bodyEn:
The Crude Blast Furnace is used to increase the carbon contents in iron, turning it into TD LINK STEEL.

 To achieve this, only pure, high-carbon fuels may be used for the furnace, such as coal coke and charcoal.

Along with steel, the furnace will also create slag, which you must remove or the furnace will cease to function.

While it is technically a waste product, there are various ways to recycle it, such as brick construction or concrete.

To form a Blast Furnace, arrange 27 of the furnace bricks in a 3x3x3 cube, and rightclick one of the sides' center blocks with an Engineer's Hammer.

The Crude Blast Furnace is not automateable. All in- and outputs must be arranged manually through its GUI. If you want to automate the creation of steel, you should probably look into creating an Improved Blast Furnace.

entries.body:
强化高炉是炼钢的更专业方法。它不仅可以实现输入和输出的自动化，还可以配备预热器，使用热空气来加快精炼过程。
这个高炉是由强化高炉砖制成的，所以建议你把你的第一批钢材用于这个升级。
强化高炉的结构与其粗制的前身类似，但砖材已经过加固，并在顶部加了一个输入的料斗。钢材在炉的前部输出，矿渣在炉的后部输出，高炉将自动输出到连接的储存空间或传送带。铁和焦炭则通过顶部送入高炉。

高炉预热器用来加热空气，然后将其吹入高炉，以加速铁的精炼过程。每个炉可以有两个预热器连接到两边的端口，每个预热器需要Flux/t来运作。
entries.bodyEn:
The Improved Blast Furnace is a much more professional way of creating steel. Not only does it allow the automation of in- and outputs, it can also be outfitted with preheaters to speed up the refinement process by addition of hot air.

The furnace is made from reinforced bricks, a prime choice for the aspiring engineer's first steel.

The structure of the Furnace is similar to its crude predecessor, but the bricks have been reinforced and a hopper was added at the top to funnel in the inputs.

Steel is output at the front of the furnace, slag at the back, and the furnace will automatically output to connected inventories or conveyor belts. Iron and Coal Coke are fed in through the top.

The ports on the sides of the furnace are used for the addition of heated air through the action of heaters described in the following pages.

Blast Furnace Preheaters are used to heat up air and then blow it into the furnace to speed up the refinement process of iron. Each furnace can have up to two preheaters connected to the ports on the each side, and each preheater requires  Flux/t to operate.

entries.bodyEn:
The following pages feature all the Engineer's Blueprints that can be crafted by normal means. Other specialized Blueprints may need to be acquired from villagers or found in the world.

All of these blueprints, including specialized ones, can be used in an Engineer's Workbench to craft the items they describe.

entries.body:
灌装机可以将流体装入容器。
多方块结构如上所示，可以镜像。使用工程师锤右击中心传送带即可创建。传送带的方向很重要。

该机器可存储8桶液体流体。流体从金属储罐的端口输入，能量则从另一侧的顶部输入。

灌装机会固定一个容器，直到它完全充满灌装机内没有更多流体。因此灌装机可以灌装一些较大的容器，只要它得到稳定的流体输入。
这种工作方式可以通过手持工程师之锤潜行右键禁用。

灌装机可以用来灌装任何在搅拌机中酿造的药剂。

此外，灌装机可以使用酚醛树脂模压工程塑胶物品，也可以使用红石酸来氧化铜块。
entries.bodyEn:
The Bottling Machine fills fluids into containers or molds.

The structure is created as shown above, but can be mirrored. To form it, rightclick the central conveyor with an Engineer's Hammer. The direction of the conveyors is important.

The machine can store 8 buckets of fluid, which is input through the ports on the metal tank. Energy is input through the connection at the top of the opposing side.

Generally, the Bottling Machine will be able to fill any container that has a filled version available (bucket, glass bottle). It will also accept other items that can store fluids, like the Mining Drill or a Jerrycan.

The machine will hold onto a container until it is completely full, or the machine is not being supplied with any more fluid.

This allows it to fill even larger containers, provided it receives a steady input of fluid.

This behavior can be disabled by sneaking and rightclicking it with an Engineer's Hammer.

The machine can be used to bottle any potions that were brewed in the Mixer.

Additionally, it serves to create duroplast items from resin and oxidize copper blocks with redstone acid.

entries.body:
断路刀闸是一种简单的开关装置，可切断导线中的电流。

它连接两根同类型导线，仅在激活时允许电力通过。由于高风险，此类开关无法接入高压线路。

可用于将高耗电设备与电网隔离，或在需要时接入额外发电机组。

开关开启时会输出红石信号，使用工程师螺丝刀点击开关可反转这一逻辑。

也是控制  电力灯具 的理想选择！

红石控制断路刀闸是手动断路器的全面升级版本，具备更优的线路、传输能力和绝缘性。

不同于手动断路器，红石断路器可承载高压线路，但出于安全考虑无法手动操作。

向设备任意侧面输入红石信号即可断开连接，使用工程师螺丝刀可反转这一逻辑。
entries.bodyEn:
Breaker Switches are simple switches that can stop the flow of power through wires.

They connect two wires of the same type and will only allow power to pass when activated. Due to the high risk, these switches cannot be connected to HV wiring.

This can be used to separate power-hungry machinery from the network or hook up an additional set of generators when needed.

They will also emit a redstone signal when they are switched on; this behaviour can be inverted by clicking the switch with an Engineer's Screwdriver.

Additionally they are an excellent way to control your powered lights!
Redstone Breakers are an all-around improved version of the manual Breaker Switch, with improved wiring, throughput, and isolation.

Redstone Breakers are able to handle HV wiring, unlike their manual counterparts, but cannot be operated by hand due to the safety risk.

A redstone signal applied to any side of the device will break the connection. This behavior can be inverted with the Engineers' Screwdriver.

entries.body: 蓄电池是一种电能储存装置。你可以用工程师锤来调整每一面的配置，蓝色代表输入，橙色代表输出，没有颜色标记则会阻止任何连接。潜行右击使用工程师锤可以配置对侧面。
entries.bodyEn:
Accumulators serve as energy storage units. Input and output power is limited to one connector of the voltage of the accumulator per side.

Side configuration can be adjusted with the hammer: Blue corresponds to input, orange corresponds to output, and no colour marking preventing any connection at all.

Sneaking while configuring a side will configure the side opposite to the one that was clicked.

充电站允许你为工具或其它物品进行充电。
能量能够从底部或后部输入，而物品可以手动放入或自动输入。

在正面的电子管会给出一个物品当前电量的反馈，但是充电站方块同时也会输出一个同样的红石比较器信号。
entries.bodyEn:
The Charging Station is a device that allows you to charge tools and other items that can accept energy.

Power can be input through the bottom or the back and items can be placed in manually or inserted automatically.

The electron tubes at the front give a feedback about the charge fraction of the item.

Comparators can be used to read the current charge fraction of the item as a redstone signal.

entries.body:
... 却少有人能听见 

这个世界存在一种难以言喻的奇妙现象：当无人靠近时，任何机械与生物似乎都会停止活动。但工程师无法一直守在机器旁维持运转 —— 因此需要人造观测者代劳！

共振观测仪借助回响碎片的奇异特性与高敏 Sculk 传感器（幽匿传感器），可使周围约  方块  的区域保持激活状态，即便附近无人也能正常工作。

运行需求：
能量通过装置  右侧  的接口输入。
记录观测数据需从  左侧  接口放入  纸张 。
控制方式：前方控制面板接收到红石信号时会关闭装置，使用工程师螺丝刀可反转这一逻辑。

交互装置会打开界面：

左侧读数显示所有被观测仪维持激活的方块，点击列表条目会发送振动定位对应方块。
纸张也可在此处放入，槽位旁会显示剩余记录时间。单张纸可持续记录  秒 。
entries.bodyEn:
...but few can hear

There is a curiosity about this world, not easily described. It appears as if any machine and living being simply stops moving when no one is close enough to perceive it.

But no engineer can afford to waste their time standing next to the machine to keep it running - so an artificial observer shall do so instead!

The resonanz observer relies on the strange qualities of echo shards and the highly sensitive sculk sensor to keep an area of approximately  blocks around it active and working, even if no one is nearby.

To operate, the observer needs energy, input through the port on the right side of the structure.

To protocol its observations, it also requires a supply of paper, fed in through the port on the left side.

Applying a redstone signal to the control panel at the front will disable the machine, this behavior can be inverted by use of the Engineer's Screwdriver.

Interacting with the machine will bring up its interface.

The readout on the left shows all the blocks which the observer is keeping active.
Clicking an entry in the list will send out some vibration to indicate the blocks.

Paper can also be input here, with the remaining duration displayed next to the slot.
A single piece of paper lasts for  seconds of recording.

entries.body:
使用电路工作台，可以将复杂的红石逻辑电路从数平方米的面积压缩到仅一块电路板上。

逻辑电路由使用焊料（如铅线或铜线）将真空管安装到电路底板上制成。

由于需要将元件焊接到电路板上，必须向工作台背面的接口供电。

使用各种元件，您随后选择想要制作的电路模式，并决定输入值以及指定的输出端。

可用的输入和输出端包括红石导线的16个彩色通道，以及8个“寄存器”。

寄存器允许在处理逻辑的方块内临时存储一个值，具体细节将在后文详述。

设置好逻辑运算符、输入和输出端后，所需的元件会列在左侧输入槽旁边。

所需元件的数量取决于电路的复杂程度，其中与非门是最容易制作的。

只要备有足够的元件，您就可以从右侧的输出槽取出制作完成的电路。

后续页面将详细介绍在工作台中配置逻辑电路的有用技巧。

有用的快捷键：

将鼠标悬停在某个输入或输出端按钮上时，按数字键可将其更改为该编号的寄存器。按字母键可循环切换以该字母开头的颜色。

拿起一个制作完成的逻辑电路，点击电路工作台界面中心区域，即可将其指令复制到工作台上。
entries.bodyEn:
Using the Circuit Workbench, complex redstone logic circuits can be compressed from several square meters onto just a single board.

Logic Circuits are made from Vacuum Tubes mounted to backplanes using solder such as Lead Wire or Copper Wire.

Due to the need to solder components to the board, power must be supplied to the plug on the back of the table.

Using the various components, you then select the pattern of circuit you want to make and decide the input values, as well as the designated output.

The available in- and outputs are the 16 colored channels of a Redstone wire, as well as 8 "Registers".

These allow for a temporary storage of a value within the block that handles the logic, as detailed later.

After setting the operator, in- and outputs, the required components are listed next to the input slots on the left.

The amount of components required depends on the complexity of the circuit, with NAND being the easiest to produce.

As long as enough components are present, you can then take the completed circuit from the output on the right.

Several helpful tips are detailed upon the following pages for configuring logic circuits in the workbench.

Helpful shortcuts:

When hovering over a in- or output button, press a numbered key to change it to the numbered register. Press a letter to cycle through the colors starting with that letter.

Pick up a finished logic circuit and click it on the center of the circuit table's interface to copy the instructions to the table.

entries.body:
制砖工艺已发展至超越因过热产生废料（烧结块）的阶段。

想要重现标志性烧结砖外立面效果的人，可以将普通砖块放入 烟熏炉  中加热，玻璃化并炭化其表面，从而制成 过烧红砖块。

为完善由其制成的外立面效果，烧结砖可与陶瓦 结合，生产出多种外立面装饰变体： 过烧红砖墙角  和 窗台 。

过烧红砖块 也可加工成 台阶、台阶半砖 和 墙壁。

过烧红砖块墙壁 在其顶部层有小型烘焙砖材窗台。
entries.bodyEn:
The art of brickmaking has progressed past wasting parts of the batch by producing clinker from overheating.

Those looking to recreate the iconic look of clinker brick facades may heat bricks in the Smoker to vitrify and char the facades into Clinker Bricks.

To complement the look of facades made from them, clinker bricks can be combined with terracotta to produce several decorative variants for facades: Clinker Brick Quoins and Sills.

Clinker Bricks can also be formed into stairs, slabs, and walls.

Clinker Brick Walls have a small sill of baked brick on the top-most layer.

entries.body:
园艺玻璃罩，又称花园钟罩，是一种用来加速植物生长的机械。即使是身为农业苦手的工程师也能用它来种植并收获作物。

该设备通过其各接口输入能量、流体和物品。
园艺玻璃罩需要水和能量来运行，你也可以在左边的槽位加入肥料来加速作物生长。
土壤和种子需要被放在中间的槽位；每类种子都需要对应的土壤来生长，并且土壤会被自动翻耕为耕地。

产品存储在右边的槽位，并可以通过玻璃罩前方的接口自动输出。
entries.bodyEn:
Garden Cloches are machines designed to hasten the growth of plants in a controlled, semi hydroponic environment.

It allows even agriculturally challenged engineers to grow plants quickly and automatically harvest their produce.

The device accepts power through the plugs on the top and sides, and fluid and items through the other ports.

When provided with power and water, the Garden Cloche will use the water to grow crops.

Providing fertilizers such as Sulfur or Industrial Fertilizer will boost the growth speed significantly. Only one fertilizer will be used at a time, and will stay dissolved in the water until it is finished.

Soil and seeds are placed in the middle; each seed requires the correct soil to grow on, with dirt being automatically tilled into farmland.

Produced items are stored in the slots on the right, and will be automatically output through the hatch at the front of the glass dome.

entries.body:
焦炉是你在发展沉浸工程时所建造的第一台重要设备。

此过程的副产品是杂酚油，可以用来制作防腐木。这种防腐木材是贯穿始终的基础建筑材料。

焦化过程极其缓慢，但采用批次处理，最多可同时处理 16 块煤炭 或 8 根原木。
因此，建议建造多个焦炉并储备足够的燃料以提高效率。

焦炉可以自动化运行，以实现燃料和油料更大规模的工业生产。

物品可通过漏斗或传送带输入和输出。

杂酚油必须使用流体泵抽取，因为焦炉不会自动输出它。

要形成焦炉多方块结构，请将27个焦炉砖块排列成一个3×3×3的立方体，并用工程师锤右键点击任意侧面中心位置的砖块。
entries.bodyEn:
The Coke Oven is the first important machine on the engineer's journey.

The brick oven heats up fuels in a low-oxygen environment, pyrolyzing them into a more carbon-rich version, such as Coal Coke, or Charcoal.

A byproduct of this process is Creosote Oil, which is used as a preservative for wood. This preserved wood serves as a basic construction material all throughout.

The coking process is slow, but works in batches, allowing up to 16 pieces of coal or 8 wooden logs to be processed at the same time.
As such, it's recommended to build multiple ovens and stock them with enough fuel to be efficient.

The Coke Oven can be automated to facilitate a more industrial scale of fuel and oil production.

Items can be inserted and extracted by use of hoppers or conveyor belts.

The creosote oil can be extracted by use of a fluid pump, as the oven will not output it automatically.

To form a Coke Oven, arrange 27 of these blocks in a 3x3x3 cube, and right-click one of the sides' center blocks with an Engineer's Hammer.

entries.body:
电网包含三类关键设备：接线器用于接入和输出电网，继电器用于将多根导线连接在一起，变压器用于在不同电压等级的导线之间转换电压。

接线器 作为电网的输入/输出端口。通过它们连接的受电设备会将能量传输至电网中。
继电器 不进行能量的输入或输出，它们充当电网的枢纽。

导线线圈 用于连接两个设备：在第一个设备上使用导线线圈，然后在第二个设备上使用同一个线圈。如果方块阻挡了导线路径，连接会断开，两点之间的传输速率取决于它们之间最低等级的导线。

电压规则：
接线器和继电器只能连接与其设计电压相同的导线。

变压器只能连接两根不同电压的导线。

设备只能使用与其设计相匹配的电压。

低压和中压导线可以绝缘，以防止伤害附近的生物。

在接线器上使用“选取方块”功能时按住潜行键，会从你的物品栏中选取与其连接的导线。

传输限制：
接线器有其最大传输功率（ IF/t）。

导线有其最大承载功率，超过则会损坏（ IF/t）。

电网管理：
多个接线器的能量可以通过继电器 合并至单根导线上，从而集中进行远距离传输。

如果合并的接线器过多，导致其 总最大传输速率超过了导线的承载能力，导线将会熔毁。

远距离传输：
只要导线的起点（输入）和终点（输出）正常工作，能量即可传输。
这意味着可以使用高压导线跨越很远的距离，将能量传输给朋友或远处的基地。
entries.bodyEn:
Power grids have three important devices: connectors in- and output to the net, relays attach multiple wires together, and Transformers that convert between different voltages of wire.

Connectors serve as in- and outputs to the electrical grid. Powered devices connected with them will transfer power through the grid.

Relays will not in- or output power, they serve as hubs for the electrical grid.

To connect two devices, use a wire coil on the first one, then use the same coil on the second. Connections will break if a block obstructs the wire.

The transfer rate between two points depends on the lowest tier of wire between them.

Connectors and relays can only take wires of the same voltage that the device was designed for. Transformers will only take two wires of different voltages, and voltages only work with devices designed for them.

Low and medium voltage wires can be insulated to prevent damage to nearby creatures.

Sneaking when using the "Pick Block" function on a connector will pick the connected wire from your inventory.

Connectors have a maximum power they will transmit in IF/t , and wires have a maximum power before they fail  IF/t.

Multiple connectors can unify onto a single wire using relays, centralizing long-range transfer to just a single wire. If enough connectors are unified that the maximum transfer rate exceeds that of the wire, the wire will burn up.

Only the input and output of a wire need be working for the wire to transfer energy, which means that large distances can be bridged with high- voltage wires to transfer energy to friends or far outposts.

entries.body:
电网包含三类关键设备：接线器用于接入和输出电网，继电器用于将多根导线连接在一起，变压器用于在不同电压等级的导线之间转换电压。

接线器 作为电网的输入/输出端口。通过它们连接的受电设备会将能量传输至电网中。
继电器 不进行能量的输入或输出，它们充当电网的枢纽。

导线线圈 用于连接两个设备：在第一个设备上使用导线线圈，然后在第二个设备上使用同一个线圈。如果方块阻挡了导线路径，连接会断开，两点之间的传输速率取决于它们之间最低等级的导线。

电压规则：
接线器和继电器只能连接与其设计电压相同的导线。

变压器只能连接两根不同电压的导线。

设备只能使用与其设计相匹配的电压。

低压和中压导线可以绝缘，以防止伤害附近的生物。

在接线器上使用“选取方块”功能时按住潜行键，会从你的物品栏中选取与其连接的导线。

传输限制：
接线器有其最大传输功率（ IF/t）。

导线有其最大承载功率，超过则会损坏（ IF/t）。

电网管理：
多个接线器的能量可以通过继电器 合并至单根导线上，从而集中进行远距离传输。

如果合并的接线器过多，导致其 总最大传输速率超过了导线的承载能力，导线将会熔毁。

远距离传输：
只要导线的起点（输入）和终点（输出）正常工作，能量即可传输。
这意味着可以使用高压导线跨越很远的距离，将能量传输给朋友或远处的基地。
entries.bodyEn:
Power grids have three important devices: connectors in- and output to the net, relays attach multiple wires together, and Transformers that convert between different voltages of wire.

Connectors serve as in- and outputs to the electrical grid. Powered devices connected with them will transfer power through the grid.

Relays will not in- or output power, they serve as hubs for the electrical grid.

To connect two devices, use a wire coil on the first one, then use the same coil on the second. Connections will break if a block obstructs the wire.

The transfer rate between two points depends on the lowest tier of wire between them.

Connectors and relays can only take wires of the same voltage that the device was designed for. Transformers will only take two wires of different voltages, and voltages only work with devices designed for them.

Low and medium voltage wires can be insulated to prevent damage to nearby creatures.

Sneaking when using the "Pick Block" function on a connector will pick the connected wire from your inventory.

Connectors have a maximum power they will transmit in IF/t , and wires have a maximum power before they fail  IF/t.

Multiple connectors can unify onto a single wire using relays, centralizing long-range transfer to just a single wire. If enough connectors are unified that the maximum transfer rate exceeds that of the wire, the wire will burn up.

Only the input and output of a wire need be working for the wire to transfer energy, which means that large distances can be bridged with high- voltage wires to transfer energy to friends or far outposts.

entries.body:
探测接线器是集成了  红石比较器  多项功能的紧凑型装置，可通过连接的红石线输出比较器信号强度。
此外，还能设置  信号阈值  —— 仅当信号强度超过设定值时才会输出。

双信道运作：支持同时在两个信道工作，一个信道发送读取的信号，另一个信道接收并输出信号，所有设置均可通过工程师螺丝刀完成。

多方块适配：许多多方块机械支持比较器接口（详见后文），通常在其红石控制面可连接比较器或探测接线器，例如：
储罐/筒仓：如对应手册所述；
组装机/自动工作台/破碎机：根据库存填充度输出信号；
锯木厂：根据锯片完整度输出信号；
电弧熔炉：根据库存填充度输出信号，顶部电极处的比较器会反映受损最严重电极的状态；
压榨机/发酵罐/混合机：根据库存填充度输出信号；
挖掘机：根据矿脉剩余矿石量输出信号。
若需深入分析多方块机械的库存、能量或流体存储状态，建议使用  机器接口 。
entries.bodyEn:
Probe Connectors are a compact device with many functions of the redstone comparator.

Comparator signal levels will be output on the redstone wire connected. Additionally, a signal thresholds can be set where the probe will only output if the signal is above the given threshold.

These probes can operate on two channels, sending their read signal on one while still receiving and outputting signals on another. All these settings are configured by using the Engineer's Screwdriver.

Note that many multiblocks feature comparator-support, as described on the following pages. Where available, the redstone control surface of the multiblock is the designated spot to connect a comparator or probe connector.

Tank: As detailed in its manual entry
Silo: As detailed in its manual entry
Assembler: Outputs a signal relative to the fill of the inventory.
Automated Workbench: Outputs a signal relative to the fill of the inventory.
Crusher: Outputs a signal relative to the fill of the inventory.
Sawmill: Outputs a signal relative to the integrity of the sawblade.

Arc Furnace: Outputs a signal relative to the fill of the inventory.
A comparator at the electrodes at the top will send a signal reflecting the integrity of the most damaged electrode.
Squeezer: Outputs a signal relative to the fill of the inventory.
Fermenter: Outputs a signal relative to the fill of the inventory.
Mixer: Outputs a signal relative to the fill of the inventory.

Excavator: Outputs a signal relative to the remaining ore in the vein.

For more detailed analysis of the various multiblocks, their inventories, energy- and fluid storages, consider using the Machine Interface instead.

设备只能使用与其设计相匹配的电压。

低压和中压导线可以绝缘，以防止伤害附近的生物。

在接线器上使用“选取方块”功能时按住潜行键，会从你的物品栏中选取与其连接的导线。

传输限制：
接线器有其最大传输功率（ IF/t）。

导线有其最大承载功率，超过则会损坏（ IF/t）。

电网管理：
多个接线器的能量可以通过继电器 合并至单根导线上，从而集中进行远距离传输。

如果合并的接线器过多，导致其 总最大传输速率超过了导线的承载能力，导线将会熔毁。

远距离传输：
只要导线的起点（输入）和终点（输出）正常工作，能量即可传输。
这意味着可以使用高压导线跨越很远的距离，将能量传输给朋友或远处的基地。
entries.bodyEn:
Power grids have three important devices: connectors in- and output to the net, relays attach multiple wires together, and Transformers that convert between different voltages of wire.

Connectors serve as in- and outputs to the electrical grid. Powered devices connected with them will transfer power through the grid.

Relays will not in- or output power, they serve as hubs for the electrical grid.

To connect two devices, use a wire coil on the first one, then use the same coil on the second. Connections will break if a block obstructs the wire.

The transfer rate between two points depends on the lowest tier of wire between them.

Connectors and relays can only take wires of the same voltage that the device was designed for. Transformers will only take two wires of different voltages, and voltages only work with devices designed for them.

Low and medium voltage wires can be insulated to prevent damage to nearby creatures.

Sneaking when using the "Pick Block" function on a connector will pick the connected wire from your inventory.

Connectors have a maximum power they will transmit in IF/t , and wires have a maximum power before they fail  IF/t.

Multiple connectors can unify onto a single wire using relays, centralizing long-range transfer to just a single wire. If enough connectors are unified that the maximum transfer rate exceeds that of the wire, the wire will burn up.

Only the input and output of a wire need be working for the wire to transfer energy, which means that large distances can be bridged with high- voltage wires to transfer energy to friends or far outposts.

导线线圈 用于连接两个设备：在第一个设备上使用导线线圈，然后在第二个设备上使用同一个线圈。如果方块阻挡了导线路径，连接会断开，两点之间的传输速率取决于它们之间最低等级的导线。

entries.body:
传送带是一种无需能量驱动的简易物品运输方式。

传送带能移动除生物可推动外的多种实体，其主要设计用途是运输物品。牛、羊等生物也可被传送，但可能与某些物品专用设计不兼容。物品掉落在传送带上会沿轨道移动，且物品可通过漏斗或管道等设备直接输出到传送带。

当物品被推至有空余空间的容器时会自动存入，否则会在容器入口处堆积。

传送带上的物品堆积可能导致食物腐烂或其他类似效果，触发条件为传送带上有物品滞留且无新物品移动空间。

工程师锤操作：右键点击旋转传送带方向；潜行 + 右键点击调整上下运行方向。

用任意染料右键点击传送带可给侧板染色，便于识别。

红石控制传送带：接收到红石信号时停止运行，无信号时正常传送，无法用工程师螺丝刀修改逻辑。

卸货传送带：中部有卸货口，物品可向下掉落至下方容器（若下方为空则直接掉落），卸料口可通过红石信号关闭。

抽取传送带：类似漏斗从容器中提取物品，操作如下：

潜行 + 工程师锤右键点击切换输入面；

工程师螺丝刀调整提取速度。

垂直传送带：可垂直向上运输物品（非倾斜角度），通过皮带上的 料斗提升物体（无法运输流体），可将物品送入上方容器或从顶部边缘排出至其他传送带。

分流传送带：交替将物体和生物向左 / 右引导，不会拆分堆叠物品，仅对整体堆叠或实体进行方向引导。

遮蔽传送带：功能与普通传送带相同，但顶部覆盖脚手架，防止实体拾取物品。右键点击可更换为其他脚手架或玻璃材质改变外观。

同理，卸货、提取、分流、垂直传送带均可加装脚手架顶盖，在保留原有功能的同时防止物品被拾取。
entries.bodyEn:
Conveyor Belts are an easy, unpowered method of moving in-world things around.

Conveyor belts will move anything other creatures can push and several they cannot, with their primary design point being items. Other creatures such as cows and sheep can also be moved, but will not interact with some item-specific designs.

Items dropped onto conveyor belts will move along a belt, and items can be dropped onto belts from devices such as hoppers or pipes.

Should items be pushed against an inventory that has space, the items will be inserted into the inventory. Otherwise, they will back up outside of the inventory.

Backups of items that occur on belts can leave food to rot or other similar behaviors, and will be triggered by items left standing on belts with no space for new items to move

The Engineer's Hammer can be used to rotate the belts (rightclick) or adjust whether they should run up- or downwards (sneak + rightclick).

Rightclicking a conveyor with any dye will colour the walls of the conveyor for identification.

Redstone Controlled Conveyor Belt are those that can be disabled with a redstone signal.

These conveyor belts will move without a redstone signal and cannot be changed with the Engineer's Screwdriver.

Dropping Conveyor Belts have a hatch in the middle and allow items to drop downwards.

Items will be inserted into inventories below or simply dropped if there is empty space below the conveyor.

The hatch can be shut with a redstone signal.

Extracting Conveyor Belts extract items from an inventory in a similar fashion to hoppers.

Sneak + rightclick with an Engineer's Hammer to change its input side.

Use the Engineer's Screwdriver to adjust the extraction speed.

Vertical Conveyor Belts can carry materials directly upwards, not only at angles. such as standard conveyor belts can.

Using the buckets attached to the belt, it will lift objects straight up. Despite the use of the term "bucket", it will not lift fluids.

This belt can insert into inventories above it or simply expel items over the edge at the top onto other conveyors.

Splitting Conveyor Belts alternate between redirecting objects and creatures left and right.

It will not split stacks of items collected together, only direct stacks left or right as with other entities.

Covered Conveyor Belts works just like normal conveyors, but are covered by a piece of scaffolding, which prevents entities from picking up items from it.

You can rightclick it with other types of scaffold or glass to change the cover's appearance.

Similarly, the Dropping, Extracting, Splitting and Vertical Conveyors can also be covered in scaffolding to achieve the same benefits of "pickup-prevention" while still functioning as they normally do.

entries.body: 工程师工作台是普通工作台的简易升级版。其台面采用防腐木材打造，关闭工作台时，能将合成材料保留在制作格内，避免材料意外掉落。此外，工作台配备小型抽屉，可用来存放制作组件，便于你随时取用，让项目制作更高效便捷。
entries.bodyEn:
The Engineer's Crafting Table is a simple upgrade to the normal Crafting Table. In addition to the treated wood top, it keeps ingredients inside the crafting grid when it is closed.
The table also features a small drawer to store some of your crafting components.

entries.body:
木制储物箱 它的功能与箱子类似，可容纳多达27组物品，并根据存放量输出比较器信号。与普通箱子不同的是，木制储物箱能够密封，确保在拾取时箱内物品不会掉落。
使用工程师锤长按右键点击储物箱即可将其密封，之后破坏箱子就能完整拾取。这也意味着，与潜影盒不同，储物箱不会被活塞推动破坏。
打开储物箱界面时，可编辑顶部名称，修改后的名称会在后续查看箱子时显示。

强化储物箱采用钢材加固框架，能够抵御爆炸带来的毁灭性伤害。因此，即便在爆炸附近，加固储物箱也不会破裂，箱内物品也不会掉落。
entries.bodyEn:
Wooden Storage Crates are similar to a chest in function, storing up to 27 stacks of material and providing a comparator signal based on their fill.

Unlike chests, they can be sealed up to keep all the material stored within a crate when picking it up.
Using an Engineer's Hammer on a crate for an extended duration will seal it up, after which it can be broken to pick it up.

This does mean that unlike Shulker Boxes, storage crates cannot be broken by pistons.

When opening a crate's interface, its name at the top can be edited, and the edited name will appear when looking at the block afterward.

Reinforced Storage Crates are framed with steel, allowing them to resist the otherwise devastating dangers posed by explosions.

Due to this, they will not break or drop their items when explosions happen near enough to otherwise destroy them.

Both types of crates, as well as shulker boxes, can be placed on a storage shelf for easier access to their items.

entries.body: 粉碎矿物是提高产量的有效途径，因为每个矿物都可以加工得到两份可以烧制的矿粉。这台工业级粉碎机让这个过程变得更加方便。机器的加工速度取决于能源供应量。向前方的控制板输入一个红石信号会暂停机器工作，可以用工程师螺丝刀反转。右击正前面中心方块以完成建造过程。它的前面是底部有一个轻型工程块的宽面。然而粉碎机不仅仅是用于粉碎矿物。生物落入粉碎机将会受到持续的伤害而最终的掉落物会从粉碎机的输出端输出。同样的，所有无法被处理的物品将会被销毁。
entries.bodyEn:
Drum crushers are an industrial method of reducing ores and metals to dust, and your enemies to soup-like homogenate. The Crusher can also process blocks such as cobblestone into gravels and reduced forms.

The machine is formed as shown previously by right-clicking the central fence of the long side with the redstone input with an Engineer's Hammer.

The processing speed of the Crusher depends on the power supplied to it, with efficiency kept constant.

Applying a redstone signal to the control panel at the front will halt the crushers process, this behavior can be inverted by use of the Engineer's Screwdriver.

Power is supplied to the plug on top of the shoulder of the machine, and items through the drums at the top. Items are output from the port in the bottom of the front.

Drum crushers are not only used for crushing ores and stones, however. Every living being to fall into the machine will take grave damage and the crusher will output the relevant drops.

entries.body: 电流互感器是用于测量电流的设备。它可以挂在任何导线上，测量传输的能量，右击即可查看平均的Flux/t。
entries.bodyEn:
The Current Transformer is a measurement device for electrical throughput.

It can be hooked up in any powerline and will keep track of energy transferred through it, returning an average Flux/t upon rightclick.

If a comparator is attached to the base of the transformer, it will output a signal from 0-15 depending upon the fill ratio of the wire's maximum transfer rate.

entries.body:
高电压结构是令人着迷的，但要让它变得能用，你得有一个发电机来输出能源。
柴油发电机是其中一种产生这类能量的方式。它由复杂的多结构方式组成，并且将要用到生物柴油或者是其他燃料。由于其产出高，它将会快速消耗燃料来运作，所以请确保你有足够的燃料来支撑它的运转。
该装置由引擎，发电机及散热器块组建而成。将这些零件如上方所示形状放置好，接着用工程师锤敲一下位于中央的任意发电机模块或散热器模块即可。
燃料需要从发电机的底部位置输入，而能量的输出口允许增加至三个。它所拥有的Flux/t的输出量将会平均分散在各个连接点上。发电机只有至少一个输出口有需求的时候才会工作。
用红石信号激活侧面的控制面板可以关闭发电机，可以用工程师螺丝刀反转。
entries.bodyEn:
High-Voltage architecture might be fascinating, but an electrical grid isn't very useful unless there is a generator which can provide for it.

The Diesel Generator is the primary method of generating HV power. It will run off of Biodiesel or other heavy fuels, as detailed in the following pages. Due to its high output, it will consume fuel rapidly, so sufficient fuel production is a must.

The engine and generator are constructed from radiators, pipes, engineering blocks, and scaffolding as shown above and formed via activating the central generator with an Engineer's Hammer.

Fuel is to be input at the bottom corners of the generator, and energy will be output to up to three plugs on the bar above the generator.

The Flux/t the generator outputs will be split between all connected plugs. The generator will only run when at least one output can accept energy.

The small terminal on the side will turn off the generator if supplied with a redstone signal, this behavior can be inverted by use of the Engineer's Screwdriver.

The following is a list of fuels the generator can accept and for how long a full bucket will power the generator:

entries.body:
最简单的发电形式并非太阳能或燃煤，而是利用自然力驱动发电机。动能发电机可连接产生轴功率的集成装置，并根据其转动速度产生电力。

后续章节将详细介绍的风车和水车是动能发电机可接受的轴功率来源，且必须在发电机安装后再组装这些装置以实现连接。其他轴功率来源无法与动能发电机配合使用，也无法产生电力。

 风车是一种基础但缓慢的发电方式，其速度取决于前方空间 —— 若气流受阻，输出功率会大幅下降。此外，雨天或暴风雨等天气条件会带来更强风力，使转速提高。

 在风车叶片上覆盖布料可提升风能发电效率，这能增加表面积，进而提高转速和能量输出。风车帆由  坚韧布料 制成，右键点击风车即可安装。

 水车是稳定的轴功率产生装置。由于承受更高应力，水车的构造需要  钢 。其转速取决于流经水轮的水量，水量越大转速越高。单个动能发电机最多可将三个水轮并排安装。
entries.bodyEn:
The simplest form of power generation available is not solar or coal, but using natural forces to excite a generator.

The Kinetic Dynamo connects to integrated methods of producing shaft power and produces electrical power based on how fast they turn.

Windmills and waterwheels, detailed in the following pages, are the sources of shaft power the Kinetic Dynamo will accept, and must be assembled after the dynamo for them to connect.

Other sources of shaft power cannot be used with the kinetic dynamo, and will not produce electrical power.

Windmills are a basic but slow method of generating power. Speed depends on the space in front of it, with its output reducing greatly if the airflow is obscured. Additionally, weather conditions like rain or storms result in stronger winds and higher speeds.

Wind-based power generation can be improved by covering the blades in cloth. Doing so increases the surface area and with it the rotation speed and energy output.
Windmill sails are crafted from tough fabric and applied to the windmill by right clicking it.

Waterwheels are constant method of generating shaft power. Due to the higher stresses involved, waterwheels require steel in their construction.

Rotational speed is based on the amount of water flowing around the wheel, with more water providing a greater speed.

Up to three water wheels can be placed against each other and provide shaft power from a single shaft.

entries.body:
电磁铁是由导线缠绕铁磁芯制成的大型线圈，通电后会产生磁场。该磁场能将附近物品吸附至磁铁处，非常适合从（生物）农场收集掉落物。
通电状态下持续运行，可通过红石信号关闭；
潜行并使用工程师螺丝刀右键点击，可反转红石信号的控制逻辑。
entries.bodyEn:
The Electromagnet is a large coil of wire wound around a ferromagnetic core which creates a magnetic field when provided with electric current.

This field attracts nearby items to the magnet, ideal for spoil collection from (mob-)farms.

The magnet runs continuously while it is being supplied with power, but can be disabled with a redstone signal. This behavior can be inverted by sneaking and rightclicking it with an Engineer's Screwdriver.

entries.body:
斗轮式挖掘机可谓是现代机械的巅峰之作。它能够将正常挖矿采集不到的矿物从矿脉中挖掘出来。作为代价，斗轮式挖掘机拥有极为复杂的结构，并且需要消耗Flux/t来维持运作。
结构由两部分组成：第一页中的机器和前一页展示的斗轮，它正好能够嵌入机器的“吊带”位置。能量输入端在机器的侧面，后面添加了红石控制面板以及物品输出口。

当挖掘机开采矿物时，矿脉的范围会缓慢减小，不过一个矿脉能够支撑个方块的开采。
entries.bodyEn:
The Excavator is one of the pinnacles of modern industry, able to dig up minerals from veins normally inaccessible.

Due to the intensive requirements of extracting sparse veins from the rock, the Excavator is a complex machine which requires  Flux/t in order to operate.

Mining commences from the bottom tip of the bucket wheel, and materials are output from the rear of the engine bracket.

The three plugs for the engine take in power from the side, and the back features a redstone control panel.

As the excavator digs up ores, the yield of the vein slowly decreases, but a mineral deposit can provide at maximum  blocks of ore.

The structure is comprised of two pieces: The engine shown on the following page and the bucket wheel displayed on the next, which fits into the 'braces' of the engine. The full structure can be assembled by using the Engineer's Hammer on the rear central Heavy Engineering Block.

The wheel can be formed on its own via using the Engineer's Hammer on the central steel block.
The engine can be formed on its own via the rear center port's Heavy Engineering Block, and will form the bucket wheel with it provided it is placed properly.

entries.body:
线缆本身无法穿透岩石、木材或其他工业材料构成的障碍。

通过精心敷设陶土绝缘层，可在这些材料内部构建固态导管以传输电力。

馈穿绝缘体能将两个接线器跨越一格厚墙壁连接，且每个接线器仅能接入单根线缆。

使用工程师锤右键点击任意两个接线器（中间间隔任意“标准”实心方块），即可创建馈穿绝缘体。

可为对应线缆类型选用非结构接线器来构建馈穿绝缘体。
entries.bodyEn:
Wires on their own cannot coexist with rock, or wood, or more industrial materials blocking their path.

With the careful application of terracotta insulation, a solid conduit can be constructed inside of these materials to conduct power.

The Feedthrough Insulator allows two connectors to be merged across one meter walls, and cannot connect more than one wire per connector.

They can be created with any "normal" solid block in the middle, by right-clicking either of two connectors with an Engineer's Hammer.

Non-structural connectors can be used to create feedthrough insulators for the corresponding wire type.

entries.body:
发酵机是一个多方块结构，通过发酵过程从某些水果、谷物和蔬菜中提取乙醇。结构建立如上所示，并使用工程师锤在有工程块的一侧右击中央炼药锅形成。
物品可以通过后面的两个标有蓝点的舱口输入。带有橙色圆点的舱口作为物品输出，它下面的方块输出流体。
在前面的控制面板上通入红石信号将停止机器的进程，可以用工程师螺丝刀来反转。

下面的列表显示了各种可以发酵成乙醇的物质，以及它们的产量。
entries.bodyEn:
The Fermenter is a multiblock structure that extracts ethanol from certain fruits, grains and vegetables through a fermenting process. The structure is built as shown above and formed by using the Engineer's Hammer on the central cauldron, on the side of the redstone port.

Items can be input into the Fermenter via the two hatches at the back that are marked with blue dots. The hatch with the orange dot serves as an item output and the block below it to output fluids.

Applying a redstone signal to the control panel at the front will halt the machine's process, this behavior can be inverted by use of the Engineer's Screwdriver.

The following list shows various items that can be fermented into ethanol, and the amount they produce.

entries.body:
流体管道是输送流体的高效方案，避免大规模搬运储罐或水桶的繁琐。

管道系统会将输入的流体均分至所有可用输出端。

低压环境下流体传输缓慢。由流体泵或大型机械输出的加压流体可实现高速输送。

铺设时管道将自动连接所有相邻接口。使用工程师锤可手动连接/断开管道间或管道与储罐的链接。

管道可加装脚手架覆层。直接放置脚手架将覆盖管道；潜行+右键点击管道可拆除覆层。

此外，使用任意染料右键点击管道可进行染色标识。染色管道不会自动连接新铺设的管道。
entries.bodyEn:
Fluid Pipes are a versatile and efficient method of transporting fluids, unlike moving tanks ore buckets around en masse.

Pipe systems will output any fluid input to them across the available ouputs, split evenly.

At low pressure, pipe systems will transport fluid slowly. Pressurized fluids output from a Fluid Pump or certain large machines can move much faster.

Fluid Pipes will connect to all possible connections when they are placed. The Engineer's Hammer can be used to connect or disconnect fluid pipes from each other and from tanks.

Fluid Pipes can be covered with scaffolding. Placing the scaffolding onto a pipe will cover it, and sneaking + rightclicking the pipe will remove it.

Additionally, rightclicking a pipe with any dye will color it to allow easy identification. Colored pipes do not connect to newly placed pipes.

entries.body:
流体阀是带栅格开口的终端装置，作为管道系统的端点，允许流体泄入外界环境。

流体只能填充至出口侧面的高度，一旦达到该高度，回流机制将阻止流体继续流动。

使用工程师锤可动态配置阀体侧面功能（输入/输出/封闭）。

红石信号将锁定流体阀，阻止流体通过阀门泄入外界。
entries.bodyEn:
Fluid Outlets are open grates that act as endpoints for pipe systems where fluids can flow out into the world.

Fluid can only be filled up to the level of the outlet's sides, and once that level is reached backflow will prevent fluid flow.

The sides of the outlet can be changes between input, output, or closed with the Engineer's Hammer.

Redstone signals will prevent fluid from flowing into the Fluid Outlet and thus the world.

entries.body:
流体泵用于在管道系统内外加压输送流体。

仅当储罐与泵的对应侧面存在连接时，才会从木桶或木桶矿车中抽取流体。

使用工程师锤点击泵体下半部侧面，可切换连接模式（输入/输出/阻断）。

收到红石信号时，流体泵将以低压模式运行；使用工程师螺丝刀右键点击可反转此触发逻辑。

为流体泵通入通量能将激活高压泵模式，大幅提升传输速率。

置于外界流体池旁时，泵体将通过输入口将流体吸入内部储罐。水体的抽取方式与水桶取水机制相同。

被抽取的流动流体会被替换为圆石（替换量等于流体体积）。潜行状态下使用工程师锤点击泵顶可切换此功能开关。
entries.bodyEn:
Fluid Pumps are used to move and pressurize fluids, both within and without pipe systems.

Fluids will only be pumped from fluid barrels or minecarts if the tank and pump have connections on that side.

Using the Engineer's Hammer on the faces of the lower half of the pump will change the connection between input, output, and blocked.

When given a redstone signal, the fluid pump will extract at low power. Right-clicking it with an Engineer's Screwdriver will invert this behavior.

Providing a fluid pump with flux will engage the high pressure pump and significantly increase the transfer rate.

When placed against pools of fluid in the world, pumps will suck up the fluid into their internal tank from their inputs. Water can be pumped in the same way it can be picked up with a bucket.

Fluids that are picked up will be replaced with cobblestone to the amount of flowing fluids in the world. This behavior can be toggled off and on by using an Engineer's Hammer on the pump's top while sneaking.

entries.body:
外置加热器物如其名，能用 Flux 产生热量，当它被放置在熔炉旁边时可以使用热能驱动熔炉，这样熔炉便无需添加任何燃料。

使用工程师锤右击一个面可以将其调整为能量的输入面，潜行右击以调整其另一面。
外置加热器的每 tick 能耗会随着每个热量单位的温度升高提高 8 Flux/t。在为熔炉升温的初始阶段，加热器每 tick 会产生至多 4 热量单位，但熔炉达到最高温时，它只需要产生 1 热量单位来让温度保持下去。

更好的是，当熔炉达到最高温时，加热器将会消耗额外的 24 Flux/t 来提高熔炉的加工速度。加热器只会作用于一个有可用输入输出槽位的熔炉以节能。但你可以对其提供红石信号来禁用这一功能并让熔炉保持最大温度。
entries.bodyEn:
The External Heater generates heat from Flux, which it outputs to the heat vents on its sides.

It cannot produce the reducing atmospheres used in Blast Furnaces, woodsmoke for food preservation, or temperatures necessary for kilns.

When placed next to a normal furnace, this thermal energy will provide the furnace heat without consuming fuel.

The sides of the heater can be configured with the Engineer's Hammer, sneak to target the opposing side.

The heater will consume 8 Flux/t for each furnace it needs to heat. To preheat the furnace, it will take four times that, until the furnace is at temperature.

When a furnace is at maximum temperature, the External Heater will consume a total 32 Flux/t per furnace for increased smelting speed, unless a redstone signal disables the speed boost.

Only furnaces which have items to smelt and space to smelt them will be heated.

entries.body:
木桶 专为液体存储设计，不易滚动移位，是工业生产和资源管理的可靠帮手。
木桶结构简易，单桶可容纳 12 桶液体，但不可存储气体或高温流体。使用工程师锤右键点击桶身侧面，可进行配置操作。
金属桶 与木桶功能类似，仅材质不同。它具备更强的耐受性，支持存储高温流体与气体，并且可通过 红石信号 控制自动输出功能的开关。
entries.bodyEn:
Wooden Barrels are simple containers that can store up to 12 buckets of liquid, but not gasses or hot fluids.

Right-clicking the vertical sides of the barrel with the Engineer's Hammer will configure them.

Metal Barrels are identical to their wooden counterparts, other than the material of their construction.

Metal barrels may store hot fluids as well as gasses, and their automatic output can be disabled by a redstone signal.

entries.body: 工业大麻是一种用途极为广泛的植物，在工程行业中不可或缺。其种子可用于制作植物油，植物油是合成  生物柴油 的重要原料；而大麻纤维则能织成结实耐用的  坚韧布料  。种子可通过收割高草等方式获取。坚韧布料由大麻纤维编织而成，具有出色的韧性。经过防水处理后，可制成  人造皮革  ；未经处理的坚韧布料，可用于制作  改良风车  的风车帆、  气球  、  汉麻混凝土  以及  气垫  。气垫由坚韧布料制成并充气，能够有效吸收冲击力，使人从高处落下时免受伤害。与粘液块不同的是，它不会让撞击物体反弹。人造皮革通过将坚韧布料浸泡在植物油或蜂蜡中制成，经过防水处理后，可替代普通动物皮革，用于制造  传送带  等物品。
entries.bodyEn:
Industrial Hemp is a very versatile plant, with uses all throughout the engineering profession. It seeds can be used for the creation of LINK TO GO HERE(plant oil), used in Biodiesel; its fibers can be used in the creation of a sturdy canvas, Tough Fabric.

The seeds can be obtained by breaking tall grass and other similar methods of collection.

Tough Fabric is a resilient weave made from hemp fiber. When waterproofed, it can be used as Ersatz Leather.

On its own, it can be used to create Improved Windmills as well as Balloons, Hempcrete, and Jump Cushions.

Jump Cushions are simple blocks created from tough fabric and inflated with air. They are capable of absorbing impacts and prevent damage from falling when landed upon, but, unlike slime blocks, will not cause impacting object so rebound.

Ersatz leather is created via saturating tough fabric with plant oil or beeswax. This waterproofed fabric can be used in many things normal animal leather can be used in, such as Conveyor Belts.

entries.body: 汉麻混凝土是一种纤维质材料，相比普通混凝土强度稍弱，却拥有出色的绝缘性能。它可像  混凝土砖  一样切割成标准砖块，但无法加工成薄片或其他特殊构件 。
entries.bodyEn:
Hempcrete is a fibrous, weaker variant of concrete with higher insulation potential.

Hempcrete can be cut into the same kinds of bricks as Concrete can, but cannot be cut into slices or other specialty constructs.

entries.body:
计量分配器可以在输出之前将传送带的物品聚集起来，以便将优化的批量物品转移到机器中。

放置方块并打开它的接口以设置各种过滤器。任何传入的物品都将被直接接收到过滤器下面的槽中，并且只在满足所有过滤器时输出收集的物品。
此行为可以通过“输出模式”按钮进行调整。上面提到的默认行为称为收集模式。在单个模式中，任何满足其过滤数量的产品将被输出。

使用缓冲器下方的9个按钮，你可以在红石线路的颜色间切换。附加一个红石接口连接器，当满足过滤器时，计量分配器将沿着红石线发送信号。
这使你可以在需要的数量满足时，禁用部分的传送带和机器。注意如果多个过滤器使用同样的颜色，想要输出信号都要满足。
entries.bodyEn:
The Item Batcher is designed to collect a set of items from an inputting conveyor before sending them onwards, in order to transfer optimized batch sizes to machinery.

In batched mode, incoming items will be accepted into the inventory directly below the filters, and the collected batch will only be output when all filters are satisfied.

Once the output mode of the device has been adjusted to single mode, any item that satisfies its filtered quantity will be output instead.

The connections below the filters of the buffer set the target color of redstone wire through attached Redstone Interface Connectors.

When each individual filter is satisfied, a high signal on its configured color will be sent out through the connector.

Note that if multiple filters use the same colour, all must be satisfied for a signal to output.

These signals can be used to configure machinery, displays, or other contraptions to control entire factories.

entries.body:
闪电是一种自然现象。它包含了大量的原始力量，而避雷针能够驾驭这种力量。
通过在多方块结构上堆叠大量钢栅栏，可以增加在雨天或雷暴天气闪电击中它的概率。
当钢柱被击中时，产生的大量能量会被储存在避雷针中然后缓慢的传输到侧面的能量连接点。手持工程师锤右击中央方块完成搭建。

你可以在最顶端的钢栅栏搭建一个相互连接的钢栅栏“网”来增加避雷针被击中的概率。
entries.bodyEn:
Lightning is a phenomenon of nature. It contains a huge amount of raw power, and this lightning rod is able to harness that power.

Stacking steel fences on the port at the top of the rod increases the changes that lightning hits it during rain or thunder. The chance of a strike can be increased further by widening the rod into a net at its top.

When the steel pole is struck, the huge amounts of energy created are stored in the base of the lightning rod and then slowly distributed to the energy connections at the sides.

entries.body:
借助红石线圈的灵活性与真空管的信号分流能力，复杂红石电路可集成至 逻辑电路中。逻辑单元作为专用设备，可插入逻辑电路模块运行。

硬件规格：总计可容纳 10 个电路模块，配备 8 个内置寄存器 供任意电路调用。
接口要求：若需对接彩色红石系统，需在侧面安装  红石接口连接器。
运行机制：当连接的接口状态变更时，逻辑单元会遍历所有电路并执行 10 次运算。若电路将寄存器设为输出，计算结果会保留在寄存器中，供后续电路作为输入使用 —— 同一接口可同时用于信号输入与输出。
entries.bodyEn:
With the versatility of Redstone Wires and shunting from Vacuum Tubes, complex redstone can be compacted into Logic Circuits.

The Logic Unit is the specialty machine in which logic circuits are slotted to be used.

It has enough space for a total of 10 circuits, and features a full 8 inbuilt registers, usable for any circuit.

For a logic unit to interface with the colored redstone systems, it needs to have a Redstone Interface Connector attached to its side.

Every time any of the attached connectors change their state, the logic unit cycles through its circuits and performs all 10 operations.

If a circuit uses a register as an output, the resulting value is kept in the register and may be used by later circuit as an input.

The same interface connector used to input can be used as an output as well.

entries.body:
随着多方块机械日益复杂，监控其运行状态变得棘手。虽然  比较器信号  能显示内部物品数量，但只有机器接口可提供详尽状态评估并输出红石信号。

将机器接口放置在多方块机械的红石控制面，打开 GUI 界面即可设置多种触发信号的条件：
点击 “添加条件” 按钮新增规则行，首按钮用于删除条件，次按钮可配置输出信号颜色。
随后两个下拉菜单，分别用于选择检测类型如（“机器运行状态”、“物品输入”、“流体输出” 等）与具体条件。

多数检测支持“比较器输出”，信号强度会根据存储的物品、流体或能量比例调整，也包含 “75% 满载”、“空” 等布尔型条件。一旦满足预设条件，机器接口会通过已配置的颜色通道，向连接的 红石接口连接器 输出对应信号。

此外，接口还能接收外部红石信号并传输至机械，信号颜色可在 GUI 右下角设置。这使得  逻辑单元 可分析机械信号并反馈控制指令，实现自动化启停！
entries.bodyEn:
With the increasing complexity of multiblock machinery, keeping track of their needs becomes quite complex.

While comparator signals can provide some insight into the amount of items inside, only the Machine Interface can provide a more detailed evaluation and send redstone signals.

When placed against the redstone control surface of a multiblock, opening the GUI will allow setting up a variety of conditions by which to output a signal.

Press the "Add Condition" button to add a new row. Within that row, the first button serves to delete it again, the second one is for configuring the signal color to output on.

This is followed by two dropdown menus, one for selecting the type of check (such as "Machine Active", "Item Input", "Fluid Output") and one for selecting the condition.

Most checks support "Comparator Output" for a signal strength that is scaled to the items/fluid/energy stored. There also exists various from true or false options, such as "75% Filled" or "Empty".

As soon as a condition is matched, the Machine Interface will output the relevant signal on the configured color-channel to any attached Redstone Interface Connector.

In addition to sending, the Machine Interface can also receive a redstone signal and output it to the connected machine. The signal color for that is configured in the bottom right of the GUI.

This allows for use of the Logic Unit to evaluate the signals coming from the machine and then send one back to enable or disable it!

Metal Barrels are identical to their wooden counterparts, other than the material of their construction.

Metal barrels may store hot fluids as well as gasses, and their automatic output can be disabled by a redstone signal.

entries.body:
金属冲压机可用于一些金属的自动化成型。它用一个高压活塞将模具压到金属锭上，将其成型为金属板材，金属杆或其他金属元件。
结构如上图所示，用工程师锤敲击活塞来完成搭建。能量从上方输入，物品通过传送带，沿着其显示方向输入输出。下方中部的方块用于红石控制，使用工程师螺丝刀右击来反转配置。

若想正常工作，需要在活塞上加装一个模具。这些模具可以在工程师装配台使用蓝图制作。

模具的制作方式如上图所示，每次合成剪线钳会消耗一点耐久。手持模具右击多方块结构以放入。

“金属冲压模具：压缩包”和“金属冲压模具：解压包”可用于将4个或9个相同物品压缩成相应的储存形式，也可解压。它们可以用来将锭制作成块，或自动制作简单的方块，比如砂岩。
entries.bodyEn:
The Metal Press is an automated way of shaping metal. It uses a high pressure piston to press plates, rods, or other metal components using molds.

The machine is created as shown above by using an Engineer's Hammer on the piston.

Power is input through the plug on the top of the piston, and items through the conveyors in the direction of movement.

The lower middle block is the redstone control port, rightclicking it with an Engineer's Screwdriver allows you to invert the redstone control.

To actually work, the metal press requires a mold to be attached to the piston. These molds are created in the Engineer's Workbench using the blueprint displayed above.

Molds are crafted as shown above, with the wirecutter taking some damage for every crafting operation. They are then inserted into the metal press by right-clicking the multiblock with a mold in hand.

The packing and unpacking molds can be used to compress 4 or 9 of the same item into their relevant storage form, as well as unpack them again. This can be utilized to store ingots as blocks, or automatically create simple blocks like Sandstone.

entries.body:
搅拌机是一个多方块结构，可以用来将固体溶解在流体中，将它们混合在一起。结构建立如上所示，用工程师锤右击中央金属板块形成。

这台机器最常见的用途是混合制造液态混凝土，或用水和各种配料制造药水。

流体通过电源底部的端口输入到搅拌机中。物品可以通过在后面的两个舱口输入。前端的流体孔作为流体输出。

在前面的控制面板上通入红石信号将停止机器的工作，可以用工程师螺丝刀来反转。
entries.bodyEn:
The Mixer is a multiblock structure that dissolves solids in fluids, mixing them together. The structure is built as shown above and formed by using the Engineer's Hammer on the central sheetmetal block.

The most common uses for this machine are the mixing of Liquid Concrete, or the creation of Liquid Potions from water and their various ingredients.

Fluids are input into the mixer through the port at the bottom of its powersupply. Items can be input via the two hatches at the back. The fluid port at the front serves as fluid output.

Applying a redstone signal to the control panel at the front will halt the machine's process, this behavior can be inverted by use of the Engineer's Screwdriver.

entries.body:
管道阀是一类结合红石与机械原理的装置，用于控制 流体管道内的流体流向。阀门表面中央的箭头标识了流体通行方向，逆向流动将被阻断。

基础运作：阀门仅允许流体按箭头方向通过，若流体逆向冲击，阀门会自动截断通路。

红石控制：当接入红石信号（如连接  红石连接器 或拉杆），阀门将完全关闭，瞬间阻断所有流体流动。

安装特性：阀门可直接与红石接收装置贴合安装，方便通过外部信号实现自动化控制。
entries.bodyEn:
Pipe valves are redsto- mechanical devices that control fluid flow to runs of pipe.

Valves will not accept flow against their orientation, marked by the arrow on the central valve segment.

When a redstone signal is applied, the valve mechanism in the pipe will shut off all flow across the pump.

Pipe valves will connect to redstone acceptors such as connectors or levers, allowing them to be placed against the valve face.

entries.body:
当长距离能量传输仍依赖  高压线缆时，信息却能实现无线传输。 广播塔  可发射红石信号并被其他塔接收。
工作条件：
两台塔需调至相同频率且处于有效范围内才能互联。
周围高于塔体的建筑或地形会大幅削弱信号覆盖，最佳选址为开阔场地或山顶、建筑顶部。

结构组成
组装后的塔身电路箱顶部有三个接口：
左边接口：能量输入口，运行时每秒消耗  Flux/t；
中间接口：信号收发口，需通过  红石接口连接器 连接；
右边接口：远程控制口，通过输入对应颜色的红石信号，可从16个预设频率中切换。

交互界面
频率调节：滑块可 在 128 - 384 kHz范围内设置频率，下方16个彩色按钮用于保存常用频率，可通过右接口的颜色信号快速切换。
状态显示：右下角实时显示同频范围内的其他塔，下方字段标注当前覆盖半径（单位：米）。
entries.bodyEn:
While transferring energy over long distances must rely on high-voltage wiring to bridge long distances, information can be transmitted wirelessly.

A radio tower can broadcast redstone signals to be received by other towers.

For two towers to interact, they need to be tuned to the same frequency and must be within range of each other.

The range of any radio tower is greatly hindered by any surrounding structures or terrain that are higher than itself. For optimal range, towers should be placed in open fields or atop mountains or buildings.

Structure:
An assembled tower features three connection ports on top of its main circuitry box:

The left port is for inputting energy. The radio tower will consume  Flux/t to operate.

The central port is for the signals being sent and received, via a redstone interface connector.

The right port is for controlling the tower remotely, selecting one of its 16 saved frequencies by inputting a matching coloured signal through another redstone interface connector.

Interface:
The tower's interface features a slider to set its frequency, within a range from 128 to 384 kHz.

Below this are 16 coloured buttons with which to save a selected frequency, to quickly change the tower over to it.

These same saved frequencies can only be triggered by a coloured redstone signal to the redstone control port, as explained before.

A display on the lower right shows other towers within range and on the same frequency. The field below indicates the tower's range in meters.

entries.body: 刀片刺网是一种带有锋利金属片的金属丝。它将减缓并切割任何试图通过它的实体。刀片刺网只能用剪线钳移除，任何其他破坏的尝试都会伤害玩家。此外，一个LV电线可以连接到带电的刀片刺网增加额外的伤害。
entries.bodyEn: Razorwire is a wire with sharpened pieces of metal attached. It will slow and cut any entity that tries to move through it. Razorwire can only be removed with Wirecutters, any other attempts will damage the player. Additionally, LV wires can be connected to electrify the razorwire for extra damage.

entries.body:
状态单元是专为  红石线路设计的组件，它能存储输入信号值，并持续输出该值，直至被重置。以往需要多个比较器方块甚至活塞才能实现的信号存储功能，如今仅凭单个  电子管  即可完成。

使用工程师螺丝刀右键点击状态存储单元，可打开配置界面，设置“写入”、“重置”和“输出”的信号颜色：
写入（Set）：该颜色信号会被存储在单元中，直至被重置。
重置（Reset）：接收此颜色信号时，单元将清空数据，允许重新写入。
输出（Output）：单元通过该颜色通道输出存储的信号值。

若将 写入 与 重置 信号设为同一颜色，状态存储单元将变为切换模式：每次接收到该颜色的脉冲信号，单元会在输出信号与关闭输出之间切换，实现便捷的自动化控制。
entries.bodyEn:
A state cell is a component for use with Redstone Wires. They store an input value and will then output that same value until they are reset.

Where previously, such setups required multiple comparator blocks or even pistons, it's now possible to store the value in a single electron tube.

Using the Engineer's Screwdriver on the state cell opens the screen to configure its Set, Reset and Output signal colours.

Set: A signal of this colour is stored in the state cell until it is reset.
Reset: A signal of this colour resets the state cell, allowing it to be set again.
Output: This is the signal colour the cell is outputting its value on.

When the Set and Reset signals are configured to the same colour, the state cell will work as a toggle system, where every time a pulse of that colour is received, the cell switches between having an output or having none.

entries.body:
在处理多个红石线路网络时，单独连接每种颜色的线路往往会占用大量空间。红石接线板 解决了这一难题，它支持将一个网络的信号中继到另一个网络，且能在传输过程中自由重映射信号颜色。

单向传输：信号仅按单一方向流动(面对接线板时，从左至右传输);
反向功能：每个信号通道均配备模拟反向器，可将输入信号反向后输出至目标网络。

使用工程师螺丝刀右键点击接线板即可打开配置界面：
点击左侧“输入端口”连接电缆;
点击右侧“输出端口”完成信号路由。
可通过输出面板上的红色“反向（invert）”按钮切换信号极性（仅对已连接的输出通道生效）。借助接线板，复杂的红石网络布线得以化繁为简，实现高效自动化控制。
entries.bodyEn:
When working with multiple redstone wire networks, connecting individual colours to each other can end up requiring a lot of space.

The redstone switchboard alleviates this issue by allowing any signals from one network to be relayed to another one, with colours being freely remapped on the way.

Signals only pass in one direction; left -> right when standing in front of the switchboard.

Additionally, the switchboard features analog inverters for all signals, allowing the output network to be sent the inverse of the input signal.

To configure the switchboard, use an Engineer's Screwdriver to open the interface. Click any of the input sockets to start connecting a cable there, then click an output socket to finalize the connection.

Optionally, toggle the red "invert" button on any of the output panels on or off - though note that inversion only has an effect if there is a connection going to that output.

entries.body:
红石计时器是一款利用石英晶体振荡原理，以固定间隔输出红石信号的装置。无论是自动化流水线的节奏控制，还是定时触发机关，它都能发挥关键作用。

使用工程师螺丝刀右键点击计时器，可进入配置界面：
信号间隔：自由调整信号输出的时间间隔，满足不同场景的定时需求；
颜色设置：自定义输出信号的颜色，便于与其他红石设备精准对接。
此外，计时器支持 控制信号模式：启用后，仅当接收到高电平控制信号时，才会开始按设定间隔输出信号，为复杂自动化系统提供更灵活的启停控制。
entries.bodyEn:
The timer is a redstone device that uses an oscillating quartz crystal to output a signal at regular intervals.

Using the Engineer's Screwdriver on the timer allows configuring its interval and its output signal colour.

Additionally, the timer can be set to require a control signal, at which point it will not run without that signal being high.

entries.body:
炼油厂是一个复杂的多方块结构，可以将一种或两种流体提炼成另一种流体。最常见的应用是制作生物柴油。
右击中间一层的重型工程块来形成结构。
流体由两个在任何一边的端口输入，由前面的橙色标记的端口输出。桶也可以用于与炼油厂的储罐进行交互。
在前面的控制面板上通入红石信号将停止机器的工作，可以用工程师螺丝刀来反转。
大多数精炼过程都需要添加催化剂的参与。催化剂不会被消耗，但没有它，精炼就无法进行。

为了生产生物柴油，需要等量的植物油和乙醇，同时使用硝酸盐粉作为催化剂。
entries.bodyEn:
Many processes necessitate the addition of a catalyst. The refinery passes its input fluids through a mixer and a catalyst at the same time, producing novel outputs from one or two inputs.

To form the machine, construct it as shown and rightclick the Heavy Engineering Block on the middle layer.

Fluids are input through the two ports on either side of the block and output through the orange marked port at the front. Using buckets to interact with the refinery's tanks is also possible.

Applying a redstone signal to the control panel at the front will halt the machine's process, this behavior can be inverted by use of the Engineer's Screwdriver.

Most refinery processes require the addition of a catalyst to enable the reaction. This catalyst is not consumed, but the process will not work without it. Catalysts cannot, and need not, be input automatically.

The most important fluids made with the refinery are Biodiesel, and Phenolic Resin.

entries.body:
木制储物箱 它的功能与箱子类似，可容纳多达27组物品，并根据存放量输出比较器信号。与普通箱子不同的是，木制储物箱能够密封，确保在拾取时箱内物品不会掉落。
使用工程师锤长按右键点击储物箱即可将其密封，之后破坏箱子就能完整拾取。这也意味着，与潜影盒不同，储物箱不会被活塞推动破坏。
打开储物箱界面时，可编辑顶部名称，修改后的名称会在后续查看箱子时显示。

强化储物箱采用钢材加固框架，能够抵御爆炸带来的毁灭性伤害。因此，即便在爆炸附近，加固储物箱也不会破裂，箱内物品也不会掉落。
entries.bodyEn:
Wooden Storage Crates are similar to a chest in function, storing up to 27 stacks of material and providing a comparator signal based on their fill.

Unlike chests, they can be sealed up to keep all the material stored within a crate when picking it up.
Using an Engineer's Hammer on a crate for an extended duration will seal it up, after which it can be broken to pick it up.

This does mean that unlike Shulker Boxes, storage crates cannot be broken by pistons.

When opening a crate's interface, its name at the top can be edited, and the edited name will appear when looking at the block afterward.

Reinforced Storage Crates are framed with steel, allowing them to resist the otherwise devastating dangers posed by explosions.

Due to this, they will not break or drop their items when explosions happen near enough to otherwise destroy them.

Both types of crates, as well as shulker boxes, can be placed on a storage shelf for easier access to their items.

entries.body:
锯木厂是一种把木头切成整齐堆放的木板的机器。该机器分两个阶段运行，首先剥离原木的树皮，然后使用锯片来将去皮原木切开。

这两个步骤都会生成锯末，通过机器前端的端口收集和输出。这些锯末随后可以被加工成纸。

该机器的建立方法如第一页所示，用工程师锤在中央金属板块右击以形成。
在前面的控制面板上通入红石信号将停止机器的工作，可以用工程师螺丝刀来反转。

想要准备工作，你需要制作锯片并右击后面的槽以放入。Shift右击以拿出锯片。
没有锯片的机器只会生产去皮原木而不会将它们切开。这可比手动去皮快多了。
锯片使用时会被磨损，一段时间后可能需要更换。
entries.bodyEn:
The sawmill is a machine assembly which cuts wooden logs into neatly stacked planks.

The machine operates in two stages: first, the log is stripped, then the stripped law is cut apart using a sawblade.

Both steps of the process create sawdust, which is collected and output through the port at the front of the machine.

That sawdust can later be processed into paper or other useful materials, such as Fiberboard.

The machine is built as shown on the first page and formed by using an Engineer's Hammer on the central sheetmetal block.

Applying a redstone signal to the control panel at the front will stop the machine, this behavior can be inverted by the Engineer's Screwdriver.

To be ready for processing, you will need to craft a sawblade and insert it into the slot on the back by right-clicking. Sneak and right-click to take the sawblade out again.

Trying to remove the sawblade while in operation will cause injury. To ensure the machine is not in operation, disable the machine with redstone while the machine is empty.

Running logs through the machine without a sawblade will create stripped logs that will not be cut apart. This process is much quicker than stripping them manually.

The sawblade will be damaged while it's in use and may need to be replaced after a while.

entries.body:
储物箱收纳架可帮助工坊整理物品，支持放置多个  储物箱 、强化储物箱甚至潜影盒。

将储物箱或潜影盒右键点击收纳架即可放置，潜行状态下空手右键点击储物箱或潜影盒可取下。收纳架界面可访问各区块内容，每层收纳架独立对应一个界面。点击界面右下角按钮可切换收纳架近侧与远侧的箱子。

 自动化功能 
货架支持传送带自动存取(漏斗可以输入)，可根据位置和方向访问整排线箱：

放置在货架正面或背面时，可从前向后存取同一纵向的2个箱子；
放置在侧面时，可从左向右存取同一横排的4个箱子；
放置在顶部时，可从上到下存取同一竖列的3个箱子。

任何自动存取操作均从该方向的第一个箱子开始。
entries.bodyEn:
The storage shelf helps with organization in the workshop, allowing multiple crates, reinforced crates and even shulker boxes to be stored on it.

Crates are added to the shelf by right-clicking them onto empty spaces, and can be removed again by sneaking and right-clicking with an empty hand.

The contents of the blocks can be accessed through the shelf's interface, with each level of the shelf having a separate one. Pressing the button in the bottom right of the interface switches between the crates on the close side and the far side of the shelf.

Automation

The shelf supports automatic insertion and extraction, with a full line of crates being accessed based on position and side.

This means that when putting a hopper against the front or back of the shelf, it will insert into two crates; when put against the side, it will insert into the row of four crates; and from the top into a column of three crates.

Any automatic insertion or extraction always begins with the first crate in that line.

entries.body:
筒仓为大量同种类型的物品提供了空间，这使得它们非常适合大量储存种子、矿渣或圆石。它们有41472件物品的空间，相当于24个箱子的容量。
物品必须通过顶部输入并从底部提取。对底部方块应用红石信号将使其自动输出。
连接到底部中心块的比较器将发出与筒仓的满度成比例的红石信号。将比较器附加到最上面的层之一，会产生与比较器的高度成比例的信号。例如，一个附在筒仓第三层的比较器不会发出任何信号，直到筒仓是2/6满，如果筒仓是半满或更多，信号强度为15。
entries.bodyEn:
Silos offer space for a lot of items of the same type, making them excellent for mass storage of seeds, slag or cobblestone. They have space for 41472 items, equaling the capacity of 24 chests.

The structure can be constructed out of any sheetmetal, it is not limited to using iron.

Items can be input through the top grate, or through the bottom port. Items must be extracted from the bottom port.

Applying a redstone signal to the bottom block will make it output automatically.

A comparator attached to the bottom center block will it emit a redstone signal proportional the fill of the silo.

Attaching the comparator to one of the top 6 layers results in a signal proportional to the height of the comparator.

For example, a comparator attached to the third layer of a silo would not emit any signal until the tank is 2/6 full and have a signal strength of 15 if the silo is half full or more.

entries.body: 呜哇 ——！当工厂内发生异常时，需以高于重型机械噪音的响亮信号警示工人。警报器对附近村民的影响类似铃铛，会促使他们返回住所。安装与连接：可固定在墙壁或  杆 顶部，并通过  红石线圈连接控制信号；参数配置：使用工程师螺丝刀点击警报器可打开界面：自定义触发信号的颜色；选择三种音效模式：警笛、汽笛或蜂鸣。
entries.bodyEn:
When things go wrong in a factory, the workers must be notified with a loud warning signal, audible over the noise of the heavy machinery.

The warning siren affects nearby villagers like a bell, sending them to their homes.

Sirens can be placed against walls or on top of posts, and connected with redstone wires.

Using an Engineer's Screwdriver on a siren brings up the interface to configure its signal colour. Additionally, a warning siren can be set to produce one of three different sounds: siren, klaxon or buzzer.

entries.body:
物品分配器是一个按筛选后的路径重新分发物品的方块。放置物品分配器并右击它来打开界面，它显示6种不同的颜色和方向的筛选器。

当一个物品进入分配器时，它将被分配到一个匹配该物品的筛选器的输出口，如果没有找到匹配的筛选器，它将被分配到一个没有筛选器的输出口。如果分配器不能处理该物品，它将不允许该物品进入。
物品也不能被输出到它被输入的那一边。

每个筛选器上面的按钮可以用来更深入地调整筛选器的工作规则：
筛选器：标签，如果物品的标签与指定的物品匹配，筛选器便使其通过。这个筛选器可以用于筛选不同模组添加的同种金属锭。
筛选器：NBT数据选项可以根据物品上的附加数据筛选，比如说附魔效果。
筛选器：耐久选项可以使筛选器忽略工具或武器的耐久值。
entries.bodyEn:
The Item Router is designed to parcel and sort items into inventories such as chests, machines, and conveyors.

Items inserted into the router will be output from matching configured sides or open sides in that order.

Items can be inserted from any side, and will be output from one of the other five sides, or will disallow input if they cannot be sorted.

Routers will extract from routers and inventories they are connected to when they are extracted from themselves.

Colors match to a cardinal direction and a set of filters the router will sort with.

The buttons above each filter can be used to further adjust how the filter works:

Tag-based filtering allows items through the filter if they match a tag of the specified item. The specific tag can be selected with the scroll-wheel. This can be used to filter ingots, ores or other items with similar properties together.

The Damage filter option allows the filter to ignore the damage value of a tool or weapon.

The Components filter option allows respecting additional, special properties of the item, such as enchantments or color.

entries.body:
工业压榨机是一种多方块结构，利用一个大活塞将有机材料中的汁或油压榨出来。结构如上面所示，并使用工程师锤在有工程块的一侧右击中央木桶形成。
物品可以通过蓝色点标记的后面的两个舱口输入到挤压机。带有橙色圆点的舱口作为物品输出，它下面的方块输出流体。
在前面的控制面板上通入红石信号将停止机器的工作，可以用工程师螺丝刀来反转。

下面的列表显示了可以被榨成植物油的各种物品，以及它们的产量。
entries.bodyEn:
The Squeezer is a multiblock structure that presses juice or oil out of organic materials with a large piston. The structure is built as shown above and formed by using the Engineer's Hammer on the central wooden barrel, on the side of the redstone port.

Items can be input into the Squeezer via the two hatches at the back that are marked with blue dots. The hatch with the orange dot serves as an item output and the block below it to output fluids.

Applying a redstone signal to the control panel at the front will halt the machine's process, this behavior can be inverted by use of the Engineer's Screwdriver.

The following list shows various items that can be squeezed into plant oil, and the amount they produce.

entries.body: 条帘 由一根横杆与  坚韧布料 制成的帘板组合而成，悬挂使用。它既能遮挡门口或传送带开口处的视线，又不会阻碍物品与生物通行。红石交互：当物品或生物穿过条帘时，会触发红石信号；使用 工程师螺丝刀 右键点击条帘，可切换为更强的信号输出模式。染色功能：与皮革盔甲的染色方式相同，可随心定制条帘色彩。
entries.bodyEn:
Strip Curtains are a bar with panels of Tough Fabric mounted to them and hung down.

Curtains can be used to block sight through doorways or conveyor openings without obstructing items or creatures.

When an item or creature passes through them, they will emit a redstone signal. Rightclick them with an Engineer's Screwdriver to enable strong signals.

They can be dyed in the same way leather armor can.

entries.body:
储罐是一个多方块结构，为大量的流体提供了空间。它可以储存多达 512 桶的任何流体，这些流体可以用管道通过顶部或底部的方块输入。流体只能从底部中心方块中提取。
将红石信号用于底部中心方块将使储罐自动输出，放置在那里的比较器将发出与其满度相关的红石信号。将比较器附加到上面的层之一，可以产生与比较器的高度成比例的信号。例如，一个附在第二层的比较器，在储罐 1/4 满之前不会发出任何信号，如果储罐是半满或更多，则信号强度为 15。
entries.bodyEn:
The Tank is a multiblock that provides space for large amounts of fluid.

It will store up to 512 buckets of any fluid, which can be piped in via the top or bottom port.

The structure can be constructed out of any sheetmetal, it is not limited to using iron.

Fluids can only be extracted from the bottom center block.

Applying a redstone signal to the bottom center block will make the tank output automatically, a comparator placed there will emit a redstone signal proportional to how full the tank is.

Attaching the comparator to one of the top 4 layers results in a signal proportional to the height of the comparator.

For example, a comparator attached to the second layer of a tank would not emit any signal until the tank is 1/4 full and have a signal strength of 15 if the tank is half full or more.

entries.body:
特斯拉线圈最初是一种无线能量传输的概念。然而，由于它潜在的高损失率和它在6米半径内烤焦每一个生物的相当有趣的特性，它很快就变成了一个工程师梦中的家园防御。

这台机器的维护成本很高，被动消耗256Flux，加上每次施加伤害时额外的512Flux。
线圈是禁用的，除非提供红石信号。用工程师螺丝刀右击它将反转此行为。
除了伤害之外，震击还会产生一个持续的负面效果：“晕眩”，阻止实体传送。
潜行右击点击线圈将切换线圈的高和低功率模式。为了能够安全地这样做线圈必须关闭。它默认处于高功率模式。当线圈是在低功率模式，它将使用通常一半的能源，只有一半的范围。

如果你穿着全套法拉第服，低功率模式下的线圈不会伤害你，但仍然会向你射出闪电。这套衣服还可以保护你免受未绝缘电线的伤害。线圈在高功率模式下使用特殊技术能使它们的放电更致命，并将导致衣服熔化，从而增加对你的伤害和衣服的附加伤害。

荧光灯管放置在强高频电场中会发光。这样的频率可由任何特斯拉线圈产生，所以将荧光灯管放置在特斯拉线圈附近会使它发光。这个距离是你被闪电击中的距离的1.5倍。它们可以在工程师装配台上着色，用工程师锤按住Shift右击旋转它们。
entries.bodyEn:
The Tesla Coil started as a concept of wireless energy transfer. However, due to its potentially high loss rates and its rather interesting property of frying every living being in a 6 meter radius, it was quickly converted into an Engineer's dream of home defense.

The upkeep cost of the coil is high, clocking in at 256 Flux of passive consumption plus an additional 512 every time it applies damage.

The coil is disabled unless supplied with a redstone signal. Rightclicking it with an Engineer's Screwdriver will invert this behavior.

In addition to damage, shocks will also apply a lingering debuff, "Stunned", preventing creatures from teleporting.

Rightclicking the coil with an Engineer's Screwdriver while sneaking will toggle the coil between high- and low-power mode. To be able to do so safely the coil has to be turned off.

It is in high-power mode by default. When the coil is in low-power mode it will use half the usual energy and have half the range.

If a creature is wearing a full Faraday suit, a coil in low-power mode won't shock it, but still shoot lightning.

Coils in high-power mode use special techniques to make their discharges more lethal and will cause the suit to melt, thereby increasing the damage done those wearing it and damaging the suit.

The suit will also protect those wearing it from uninsulated wiring. 

Fluorescent tubes glow when placed inside a strong high-frequency electric field.

Such a frequency is generated by any tesla coil, so placing a tube near an active tesla coil will cause it to glow. The range is about 1.5 times the range in which you will be hit by lightning.

They can be colored in the engineer's workbench and rotated by sneak + rightclicking them with an Engineer's Hammer.

Tubes can be picked up directly by sneak + rightclicking with an empty hand.

entries.body:
热传导发电机是另一种可用发电方式，它不依靠其他机械部件，而是借助两个温度差之间的梯度发电。
在发电机侧面放置热源和冷源各一，即可根据温差来产生能量。
下表中包括了其他可用作热源或冷源的非流体方块。
entries.bodyEn:
Thermoelectric Generators are another kind of power generation, and work without the use of any mechanical parts. These generators use the temperature gradient between two opposing sources to produce power.

Placing a heat source on one side and a colder source on the opposite side generates energy based on the difference between the two temperatures.

Any fluid will work based on its temperature, along with some other blocks.

Temperature gradients are only used across the generator, not across adjacent sides.

The list below contains non-fluid blocks which can be used as sources of temperature.

entries.body:
变压器  由叠层铁芯缠绕线圈构成，可实现不同电压线路间的转换。
基础型号：变压器能自由转换 低压（LV） 与 中压（MV） ；若需转换至 高压（HV） ，则需使用内置特殊电路的高压变压器。
安装差异：标准变压器结构紧凑，可直接安装在  杆 上，而高压变压器因尺寸限制无法如此安装。
高效特性：高压变压器支持低压与高压的直接转换，减少设备数量，优化电力传输布局。
 详细连接示意图可参考后续页面。
entries.bodyEn:
Transformers are laminated iron cores wrapped in coils of wire that convert between different voltages of wire.

Standard transformers can convert between LV and MV freely, but specialty circuits found in the HV Transformer are needed to convert to HV.

Their compact internals allow standard transformers to be placed on Posts, however HV Transformers cannot be placed this way.

The HV Transformer can step directly between LV and HV as necessary, thus reducing the number of transformers needed.

Connection diagrams can be found on the following pages.

entries.body: 多方块按工程师手册结构搭好后，用工程师锤右键指定方块成形。接线器与电线需匹配电压等级；处理设备接入能量、材料和输出容器。
entries.bodyEn: Build multiblocks and form them with an Engineer's Hammer at the designated block. Match connectors and wires to voltage tiers; supply machines with energy and materials.

entries.body: 这是结构或端口部件。按对应多方块的结构预览放置；端口承担输入/输出时，在成形结构或端口 GUI 中设置方向。
entries.bodyEn: Place this structural/port component according to its multiblock guide. Configure port directions in the formed structure or port GUI.

entries.body: 多方块按工程师手册结构搭好后，用工程师锤右键指定方块成形。接线器与电线需匹配电压等级；处理设备接入能量、材料和输出容器。
entries.bodyEn: Build multiblocks and form them with an Engineer's Hammer at the designated block. Match connectors and wires to voltage tiers; supply machines with energy and materials.

entries.body:
旋转台可以旋转贴着的方块。
拿着工程师锤，同时看向机器的一边，就可以显示它的旋转方向和与目标方向相关的方向。
围绕旋转轴的4边分别设置旋转方向，根据哪边接收红石信号，可进行±90度或180度旋转。

用锤子右击将重新定位，潜行时这样做将循环它的转向方向。
entries.bodyEn:
The Turntable will rotate blocks placed against its front side through various angles.

Holding an Engineer's Hammer while looking at a side of the machine displays its rotating side and the turn direction associated with the targeted side.

The turn direction is set individually for each of the 4 sides around the turning axis, allowing for ±90° or 180° turns, depending on which side receives the redstone signal.

Rightclicking with the Hammer will reorient it, sneaking while doing so will cycle through the Turntable's turn directions.
