entries.bodyEn: Build multiblocks and form them with an Engineer's Hammer at the designated block. Match connectors and wires to voltage tiers; supply machines with energy and materials.

entries.body:
最简单的发电形式并非太阳能或燃煤，而是利用自然力驱动发电机。动能发电机可连接产生轴功率的集成装置，并根据其转动速度产生电力。

后续章节将详细介绍的风车和水车是动能发电机可接受的轴功率来源，且必须在发电机安装后再组装这些装置以实现连接。其他轴功率来源无法与动能发电机配合使用，也无法产生电力。

 风车是一种基础但缓慢的发电方式，其速度取决于前方空间 —— 若气流受阻，输出功率会大幅下降。此外，雨天或暴风雨等天气条件会带来更强风力，使转速提高。

 在风车叶片上覆盖布料可提升风能发电效率，这能增加表面积，进而提高转速和能量输出。风车帆由  坚韧布料 制成，右键点击风车即可安装。

 水车是稳定的轴功率产生装置。由于承受更高应力，水车的构造需要  钢 。其转速取决于流经水轮的水量，水量越大转速越高。单个动能发电机最多可将三个水轮并排安装。
entries.bodyEn:
The simplest form of power generation available is not solar or coal, but using natural forces to excite a generator.

The Kinetic Dynamo connects to integrated methods of producing shaft power and produces electrical power based on how fast they turn.

Windmills and waterwheels, detailed in the following pages, are the sources of shaft power the Kinetic Dynamo will accept, and must be assembled after the dynamo for them to connect.

Other sources of shaft power cannot be used with the kinetic dynamo, and will not produce electrical power.

Windmills are a basic but slow method of generating power. Speed depends on the space in front of it, with its output reducing greatly if the airflow is obscured. Additionally, weather conditions like rain or storms result in stronger winds and higher speeds.

Wind-based power generation can be improved by covering the blades in cloth. Doing so increases the surface area and with it the rotation speed and energy output.
Windmill sails are crafted from tough fabric and applied to the windmill by right clicking it.

Waterwheels are constant method of generating shaft power. Due to the higher stresses involved, waterwheels require steel in their construction.

Rotational speed is based on the amount of water flowing around the wheel, with more water providing a greater speed.

Up to three water wheels can be placed against each other and provide shaft power from a single shaft.

entries.body:
木桶 专为液体存储设计，不易滚动移位，是工业生产和资源管理的可靠帮手。
木桶结构简易，单桶可容纳 12 桶液体，但不可存储气体或高温流体。使用工程师锤右键点击桶身侧面，可进行配置操作。
金属桶 与木桶功能类似，仅材质不同。它具备更强的耐受性，支持存储高温流体与气体，并且可通过 红石信号 控制自动输出功能的开关。
entries.bodyEn:
Wooden Barrels are simple containers that can store up to 12 buckets of liquid, but not gasses or hot fluids.

Right-clicking the vertical sides of the barrel with the Engineer's Hammer will configure them.

Metal Barrels are identical to their wooden counterparts, other than the material of their construction.

Metal barrels may store hot fluids as well as gasses, and their automatic output can be disabled by a redstone signal.

entries.body:
工程师装配台是专为专业工程师打造的工作台。它广泛用于组装工程师蓝图所记载的物品。

多种蓝图均可合成，具体细节参见此处；少数特定蓝图则需在探索世界时发现或从村民处购买。

要在装配台使用蓝图，请将其放入界面左侧槽位，并将所需材料放入中间的六个槽位。

成品可从右侧取出。将鼠标悬停于输出槽位上，可精确查看每件物品所需的材料清单。

装配台的另一项功能是改装与配置更复杂的工具和装置。例如采矿机械钻、重型盾牌或左轮手枪等物品。

当此类物品放入装配台主槽位时，界面将显示新的升级槽位——通过向其中插入对应升级模块，即可完成工具改装。
entries.bodyEn:
The Engineer's Workbench is a professional worktable for the educated engineer. It is widely used to create items described by Engineer's Blueprints.

A wide variety of blueprints can be crafted, as detailed here, whereas a few select ones can only be discovered in the world or bought from villagers.

To use a blueprint in the Workbench, put it in the slot on the left of the GUI and the necessary ingredients in the six slots in the middle.

The resulting items can then be retrieved from the right side. Hovering your mouse over these output slots will inform you exactly which materials are needed for each item.

A secondary function of the Workbench is the modification and configuration of more complex tools and gadgets. The Mining Drill, Heavy Plated Shield or Revolver are examples of such items.

When placed in the main slot of the workbench, it's use becomes that of modifying these tools by inserting applicable upgrades into the new slots that appear.

entries.body:
能量存储需要占用空间，且需要一些重型组件。因此，在每件工具中单独存储大量能量效率低下，还会使工具使用不便。
蓄能背包是一种折中的解决方案，它为所有电动工具提供了一个集中的能量存储装置，方便工具从中获取能量。
背包框架的制作配方见下一页。
 框架制作完成后，必须在  工程师装配台 上进行改造，以便将  蓄能器  安装进去为其供电。
背包可以为你手中的工具以及身上穿戴的盔甲充电。你可以像穿胸甲一样穿戴它，也可以将其与胸甲合成为一体，这样既能获得能量供应，又能得到防护。
请注意，当背包附加在盔甲上时，无法使用  充电站 进行充电。
接下来的几页将详细介绍可以安装在蓄能背包上的升级配件。
 在背包上安装  充电天线  ，你就能在移动中为背包蓄能器充电！只需从  未绝缘电源线 下方走过，天线就会自动连接。
只要你与电源线保持足够近的距离，天线就会弯曲并保持连接状态，从电力网络中缓慢为蓄能器充电。
  感应充电器  可以让蓄能背包为你背包内的所有物品充电，而不仅仅是手中的物品。不过，由于没有使用直接的有线连接，充电速度会慢很多。
  便携式电磁体  是  大型电磁体 的特制版本，它能将附近的物品吸引到使用者身边，方便拾取。得益于改进的电路设计，该升级配件仅在搬运物品时消耗能量。
 顾名思义，  微型特斯拉线圈  与它的  大型版本 类似，是一种能对附近目标释放危险电击的装置。当穿戴者受到攻击时，它就会启动，用电流代替荆棘盔甲进行防御。
由于该线圈安装在背包顶部，因此无法与充电天线同时使用。
entries.bodyEn:
Energy storage takes space and some heavyweight components. As such, storing large amounts of energy in each tool individually is inefficient and makes them awkward to wield.

The Accumulator Backpack acts as a compromise, offering a centralized storage of energy for any powered tools to tap into.

The carrying frame can be constructed with the recipe shown on the following page.

Once the frame has been constructed, it must be modified in an Engineer's Workbench in order to place an Accumulator inside it.

The backpack charges any tools in your hands, as well as any armor you are wearing. You can wear it like a piece of chest armor, or you may craft it with a chestpiece to attach it and gain the benefit of a power-supply as well as protection.

Note that you can not use the Charging Station to charge the pack while it is attached to armor.

The following pages detail the possible upgrades you can attach to the Accumulator Backpack.

By attaching a Charging Antenna to the backpack, you can charge its accumulator on the go! Simply walk underneath an un-insulated powerline to have the antenna connect to it.

While you remain close enough to the wire, the antenna will flex and stay connected, slowly charging the accumulator from the wire network.

The Induction Charger allows the accumulator pack to charge all the items in your inventory instead of just those in your hands. Due to not using a direct wired connection however, this charging is much slower.

The Portable Electromagnet is a specialized version of the larger block, designed to attract nearby items to the user, allowing them to be easily picked up. Thanks to improved circuitry, this upgrade only consumes energy while items are being moved.

As its name may suggest, the Miniaturized Tesla Coil is much like its larger sister, a device that delivers dangerous shocks to nearby targets. It does so in response to the wearer being attacked, thus substituting thorny armor for electricity.

Due to attaching at the top of the backpack, the coil can not be used at the same time as the Charging Antenna.

entries.body:

entries.bodyEn:
Energy storage takes space and some heavyweight components. As such, storing large amounts of energy in each tool individually is inefficient and makes them awkward to wield.

The Accumulator Backpack acts as a compromise, offering a centralized storage of energy for any powered tools to tap into.

The carrying frame can be constructed with the recipe shown on the following page.

Once the frame has been constructed, it must be modified in an Engineer's Workbench in order to place an Accumulator inside it.

The backpack charges any tools in your hands, as well as any armor you are wearing. You can wear it like a piece of chest armor, or you may craft it with a chestpiece to attach it and gain the benefit of a power-supply as well as protection.

Note that you can not use the Charging Station to charge the pack while it is attached to armor.

The following pages detail the possible upgrades you can attach to the Accumulator Backpack.

By attaching a Charging Antenna to the backpack, you can charge its accumulator on the go! Simply walk underneath an un-insulated powerline to have the antenna connect to it.

While you remain close enough to the wire, the antenna will flex and stay connected, slowly charging the accumulator from the wire network.

The Induction Charger allows the accumulator pack to charge all the items in your inventory instead of just those in your hands. Due to not using a direct wired connection however, this charging is much slower.

The Portable Electromagnet is a specialized version of the larger block, designed to attract nearby items to the user, allowing them to be easily picked up. Thanks to improved circuitry, this upgrade only consumes energy while items are being moved.

As its name may suggest, the Miniaturized Tesla Coil is much like its larger sister, a device that delivers dangerous shocks to nearby targets. It does so in response to the wearer being attacked, thus substituting thorny armor for electricity.

Due to attaching at the top of the backpack, the coil can not be used at the same time as the Charging Antenna.

entries.body:
电网包含三类关键设备：接线器用于接入和输出电网，继电器用于将多根导线连接在一起，变压器用于在不同电压等级的导线之间转换电压。

接线器 作为电网的输入/输出端口。通过它们连接的受电设备会将能量传输至电网中。
继电器 不进行能量的输入或输出，它们充当电网的枢纽。

导线线圈 用于连接两个设备：在第一个设备上使用导线线圈，然后在第二个设备上使用同一个线圈。如果方块阻挡了导线路径，连接会断开，两点之间的传输速率取决于它们之间最低等级的导线。

电压规则：
接线器和继电器只能连接与其设计电压相同的导线。

变压器只能连接两根不同电压的导线。

设备只能使用与其设计相匹配的电压。

低压和中压导线可以绝缘，以防止伤害附近的生物。

在接线器上使用“选取方块”功能时按住潜行键，会从你的物品栏中选取与其连接的导线。

传输限制：
接线器有其最大传输功率（ IF/t）。

导线有其最大承载功率，超过则会损坏（ IF/t）。

电网管理：
多个接线器的能量可以通过继电器 合并至单根导线上，从而集中进行远距离传输。

如果合并的接线器过多，导致其 总最大传输速率超过了导线的承载能力，导线将会熔毁。

远距离传输：
只要导线的起点（输入）和终点（输出）正常工作，能量即可传输。
这意味着可以使用高压导线跨越很远的距离，将能量传输给朋友或远处的基地。
entries.bodyEn:
Power grids have three important devices: connectors in- and output to the net, relays attach multiple wires together, and Transformers that convert between different voltages of wire.

Connectors serve as in- and outputs to the electrical grid. Powered devices connected with them will transfer power through the grid.

Relays will not in- or output power, they serve as hubs for the electrical grid.

To connect two devices, use a wire coil on the first one, then use the same coil on the second. Connections will break if a block obstructs the wire.

The transfer rate between two points depends on the lowest tier of wire between them.

Connectors and relays can only take wires of the same voltage that the device was designed for. Transformers will only take two wires of different voltages, and voltages only work with devices designed for them.

Low and medium voltage wires can be insulated to prevent damage to nearby creatures.

Sneaking when using the "Pick Block" function on a connector will pick the connected wire from your inventory.

Connectors have a maximum power they will transmit in IF/t , and wires have a maximum power before they fail  IF/t.

Multiple connectors can unify onto a single wire using relays, centralizing long-range transfer to just a single wire. If enough connectors are unified that the maximum transfer rate exceeds that of the wire, the wire will burn up.

Only the input and output of a wire need be working for the wire to transfer energy, which means that large distances can be bridged with high- voltage wires to transfer energy to friends or far outposts.

电网管理：
多个接线器的能量可以通过继电器 合并至单根导线上，从而集中进行远距离传输。

如果合并的接线器过多，导致其 总最大传输速率超过了导线的承载能力，导线将会熔毁。

只要导线的起点（输入）和终点（输出）正常工作，能量即可传输。
这意味着可以使用高压导线跨越很远的距离，将能量传输给朋友或远处的基地。

entries.body: 这一页包含了所有可以通过正常方法制作的蓝图。其它的蓝图需要在村民处购买或在世界中找到。它们都可以在工程师装配台中用来制作蓝图所设计的物品。
entries.bodyEn:
The following pages feature all the Engineer's Blueprints that can be crafted by normal means. Other specialized Blueprints may need to be acquired from villagers or found in the world.

All of these blueprints, including specialized ones, can be used in an Engineer's Workbench to craft the items they describe.

entries.body:
这个巨大的，便携式的伐木机械锯被设计用来快速处理树木和其他树叶，不然它们可能会挡住一个原始工厂的建筑之路。
使用工程师装配台制作一个锯片，并且装入生物柴油或其它燃料之后，它可以被用来砍伐任何树木，从小的白桦到大的丛林木。
像其它工具一样，伐木机械锯也可以使用工程师装配台进行改装。这些升级影响内部储罐容量和锯片耐久。

如果使用凿石机刀片代替普通的锯片，伐木机械锯可以从地下开采石块，就像精准采集附魔一样。但是，这种钻石边缘的锯片不能再用来砍伐树木。

研磨盘由酚醛树脂灌装铝粉制成。虽然不是很耐用，但这些圆盘非常适合快速切割金属块，但若用在其他材料上则很容易损坏。此外，它还可以像斧头一样用来刮掉铜块上的铜锈或蜡，或给原木去皮。
大型燃料缸增加储罐容量2000mB。

高级润滑系统向锯片添加额外的润滑剂，减少耐久的消耗。

向锯子添加刀片盒子，你就可以携带额外两个锯片。你可以使用按键来进行锯片切换，如果按键绑定已设置。
entries.bodyEn:
This large, portable buzzsaw is designed to make quick work of trees and other pieces of foliage that may stand in the way of a pristine factory.

After using the Engineer's Workbench to place a sawblade in it, and loading it with Biodiesel or another fuel, it can be used to carve through everything from small birches to large jungle trees.

Like many other tools, the buzzsaw can be modified in the Engineer's Workbench. These upgrades affect the size of the internal tank, the number of blades it can store, and the durability of its sawblade.

By replacing the normal saw- blade with a Rockcutter Blade, the buzzsaw can be used to cleanly cut cubes of stone from the ground, much like the Silktouch enchantment. However, the diamond tipped blade is no longer useful in carving through wood or felling trees.

The Grinding Disk is made from fine aluminium grit suspended in Phenolic Resin. While not as durable, these disks are excellent for quickly cutting through metal blocks, but break easily on other materials. Additionally, they can be used to scrape oxidization or wax off copper blocks or strip bark from logs, much like an axe can.

The Large Tank increases the fluid capacity of the buzzsaw by 2000 mb.

The Advanced Lubrication System applies additional lubricant to the sawblade, reducing the speed at which it loses durability.

By attaching the Blade Quiver to the side of the buzzsaw, you can carry two additional sawblades along. You can cycle between the stored blades by  the keybind  if it has been set in the options.

Like many other tools, the buzzsaw can be modified in the Engineer's Workbench. These upgrades affect the size of the internal tank, the number of blades it can store, and the durability of its sawblade.

By replacing the normal saw- blade with a Rockcutter Blade, the buzzsaw can be used to cleanly cut cubes of stone from the ground, much like the Silktouch enchantment. However, the diamond tipped blade is no longer useful in carving through wood or felling trees.

The Grinding Disk is made from fine aluminium grit suspended in Phenolic Resin. While not as durable, these disks are excellent for quickly cutting through metal blocks, but break easily on other materials. Additionally, they can be used to scrape oxidization or wax off copper blocks or strip bark from logs, much like an axe can.

The Large Tank increases the fluid capacity of the buzzsaw by 2000 mb.

The Advanced Lubrication System applies additional lubricant to the sawblade, reducing the speed at which it loses durability.

By attaching the Blade Quiver to the side of the buzzsaw, you can carry two additional sawblades along. You can cycle between the stored blades by  the keybind  if it has been set in the options.

entries.body:
化学喷射器是一种能够将内部储液罐中流体喷射出去的装置。该装置能够装载任何流体或气体，并且，右键就会将其喷洒出去。

它还有点燃流体的功能，当然必须是可燃流体。潜行右键来使用点火装置。

同其它工具一样，化学喷射器可以在工程师装配台中进行改装。这些升级将会影响储罐的大小，喷射的范围以及喷射速度，具体见下页。

大型流体罐能够增加化学喷射器的储量2000mB。
聚焦喷嘴会降低喷射速度但会略微增加喷射范围，让你能够更精准的击中远处目标。
多重流体罐使得化学喷射器最多可以装3种不同的流体。你可以在按键键。
它与大型燃料缸冲突。
entries.bodyEn:
The Chemical Thrower is a device that propels fluids and optionally ignites from its internal tanks.

The device can be loaded with any fluid, liquid or gas, and, on right click, will spray it out.

To toggle the pilot light for the ignition of flammable fluids, sneak and right-click.

Like some other tools, the chemical thrower can be modified in the Engineer's Workbench. These upgrades affect the size of the tank, range and spread and are described on the following pages.

The Large Tank increases the fluid capacity of the Chemical Thrower by 2000 mb.
The Focused Nozzle decreases the spread of fluids sprayed out and also slightly increases their range, allowing you to hit further targets with more precision.
The Multitank allows the Chemthrower to store up to three different Fluids. You can select the active tank by  the keybind  if it has been set in the options.
This upgrade is mutually exclusive to the Large Tank.

entries.body:
储罐是一个多方块结构，为大量的流体提供了空间。它可以储存多达 512 桶的任何流体，这些流体可以用管道通过顶部或底部的方块输入。流体只能从底部中心方块中提取。
将红石信号用于底部中心方块将使储罐自动输出，放置在那里的比较器将发出与其满度相关的红石信号。将比较器附加到上面的层之一，可以产生与比较器的高度成比例的信号。例如，一个附在第二层的比较器，在储罐 1/4 满之前不会发出任何信号，如果储罐是半满或更多，则信号强度为 15。
entries.bodyEn:
The Tank is a multiblock that provides space for large amounts of fluid.

It will store up to 512 buckets of any fluid, which can be piped in via the top or bottom port.

The structure can be constructed out of any sheetmetal, it is not limited to using iron.

Fluids can only be extracted from the bottom center block.

Applying a redstone signal to the bottom center block will make the tank output automatically, a comparator placed there will emit a redstone signal proportional to how full the tank is.

Attaching the comparator to one of the top 4 layers results in a signal proportional to the height of the comparator.

For example, a comparator attached to the second layer of a tank would not emit any signal until the tank is 1/4 full and have a signal strength of 15 if the tank is half full or more.

entries.body:
工程师天钩是一款机动抓取系统，专为钩住电线、麻绳或钢缆而设计。

借助它，工程师可以沿着输电线快速移动，往返于变电站或其他站点之间。

只需在靠近电线时长按右键，您就会被附着在线上。

在线上滑行时可以松开按键，但丢弃天钩或按下潜行键会使您脱离线路。

从高处坠落并抓住电线时的急减速将对使用者造成伤害。

重力足以让您沿着下坡线缆以可观的速度滑行；沿上坡线缆移动时，则可以使用标准移动键。

当天钩到达电线交汇点时，它会尽可能沿着玩家视角的方向继续前进。

安装高扭矩马达后，天钩攀爬上坡线缆将轻松得多，大幅降低坡度对其速度的影响。

在带电电线上滑行对工程师的健康极为危险。绝缘把手消除了这一风险，可防止沿输电线使用天钩时遭受电击。

由下界合金锻造而成的重击钩子，赋予使用者在向敌人俯冲攻击时造成重击的能力。此外，以此方式成功击中敌人时，使用者落地不会受到伤害。
entries.bodyEn:
The Engineer's Skyhook is a motorized grabber system designed to hook onto wires, hemp ropes or steel cables.

With it, engineers can quickly traverse the length of a powerline to move between substations or other sites.

Simply hold the right mouse button while close to a wire and you will be attached to it.

The button can be released while riding the wire, but letting go of the skyhook or sneaking will cause you to dismount.

The sudden deceleration from falling great heights and grabbing onto a wire will cause damage to the user.

Gravity will be sufficient to move along decending wires at a decent speed, the standard movement keys can be used to move along ascending wires.

When the skyhook reaches an intersection it will continue in as close to the direction the player is looking as possible.

By installing a High Toque Motor, the Skyhook has a much easier time climbing up ascending wires, reducing the impact the slope has on its speed.

Riding along live wires can be very dangerous to the engineer's health. The Insulated Grip eliminates that risk, preventing any electric shocks from riding the Skyhook along a powerline.

Forged from Netherite, the Heavy Impact Hooks grant the ability to do greatly increased damage when attacking while falling towards an enemy. Additionally, when performing a successful attack on an enemy this way, the wielder takes no damage from hitting the ground.

entries.body:
工具箱是一款简易便携容器，用于存放工程师的所有必备物品！将鼠标悬停在工具箱物品栏的槽位上，会提示该槽位可接受的物品类型。
“食物”和“任意物品”槽位顾名思义即可理解；“布线”槽位用于存放线圈、接线器、变压器或类似物品。

“工具”槽位可存放任何基础的原版工具或武器，例如镐、剑、铲和弓。无法存放流体容器（如桶或油罐），以防洒出；但可存放其他单一功能工具，如望远镜或指南针。
任何沉浸工程（IE）的工具或武器均可存入工具箱，包括大型电动工具如磁轨炮。护甲类物品（如蓄电池背包）体积过大，无法存放。

潜行并右键点击可将工具箱放置为方块。放置后，右键点击仍可访问其物品栏。再次潜行并右键点击放置的方块，可将其直接收回至使用者物品栏。
entries.bodyEn:
The toolbox is a simple, carried container, used to store all the essentials of an engineer! Hovering over the slots in the toolbox inventory tells you what they will accept.

'Food' and 'Anything' are quite self-explanatory, 'Wiring' slots are for coils, connectors, transformers, or similar items.

'Tools' will store any simple Vanilla tool or weapon, such as picks, swords, shovels, and bows. Cannot store fluid containers such as buckets or jerrycans as they would spill, but it can store other single-purpose tools such as the spyglass or compasses.

Any IE tool or weapon can be stored inside the toolbox, including large electrical tools such as the Railgun. Armor such as the Accumulator Backpack is too large and cannot be stored.

Sneaking and right-clicking allows the toolbox to be placed as a block. While placed, it's inventory can still be accessed with a rightclick. Sneaking and right-clicking again will pick the toolbox up directly to the user.

entries.body:
油罐是一种简易的用于盛放流体的金属容器。它们最多能够存储10桶流体，并能够将流体灌注到机器或倾倒至世界当中。
不过，油罐无法回收流体。

值得一提的是，它们还能够为一些消耗流体的物品比如采矿机械钻进行装填，只需将两者一起合成即可。
entries.bodyEn:
Jerrycans are simple metal containers used to carry fluids. They can store up to 10 buckets and can pour that fluid into the world as well as into machines.

Jerrycans cannot be used to pick up fluids from the world, but can be refilled from tanks such as barrels or large tanks.

Additionally, they can be used to refill fluid-consuming items like the Mining Drill by placing the jerrycan and the tool together in a crafting grid.

entries.body:
最简单的发电形式并非太阳能或燃煤，而是利用自然力驱动发电机。动能发电机可连接产生轴功率的集成装置，并根据其转动速度产生电力。

后续章节将详细介绍的风车和水车是动能发电机可接受的轴功率来源，且必须在发电机安装后再组装这些装置以实现连接。其他轴功率来源无法与动能发电机配合使用，也无法产生电力。

 风车是一种基础但缓慢的发电方式，其速度取决于前方空间 —— 若气流受阻，输出功率会大幅下降。此外，雨天或暴风雨等天气条件会带来更强风力，使转速提高。

 在风车叶片上覆盖布料可提升风能发电效率，这能增加表面积，进而提高转速和能量输出。风车帆由  坚韧布料 制成，右键点击风车即可安装。

 水车是稳定的轴功率产生装置。由于承受更高应力，水车的构造需要  钢 。其转速取决于流经水轮的水量，水量越大转速越高。单个动能发电机最多可将三个水轮并排安装。
entries.bodyEn:
The simplest form of power generation available is not solar or coal, but using natural forces to excite a generator.

The Kinetic Dynamo connects to integrated methods of producing shaft power and produces electrical power based on how fast they turn.

Windmills and waterwheels, detailed in the following pages, are the sources of shaft power the Kinetic Dynamo will accept, and must be assembled after the dynamo for them to connect.

Other sources of shaft power cannot be used with the kinetic dynamo, and will not produce electrical power.

Windmills are a basic but slow method of generating power. Speed depends on the space in front of it, with its output reducing greatly if the airflow is obscured. Additionally, weather conditions like rain or storms result in stronger winds and higher speeds.

Wind-based power generation can be improved by covering the blades in cloth. Doing so increases the surface area and with it the rotation speed and energy output.
Windmill sails are crafted from tough fabric and applied to the windmill by right clicking it.

Waterwheels are constant method of generating shaft power. Due to the higher stresses involved, waterwheels require steel in their construction.

Rotational speed is based on the amount of water flowing around the wheel, with more water providing a greater speed.

Up to three water wheels can be placed against each other and provide shaft power from a single shaft.

后续章节将详细介绍的风车和水车是动能发电机可接受的轴功率来源，且必须在发电机安装后再组装这些装置以实现连接。其他轴功率来源无法与动能发电机配合使用，也无法产生电力。

 风车是一种基础但缓慢的发电方式，其速度取决于前方空间 —— 若气流受阻，输出功率会大幅下降。此外，雨天或暴风雨等天气条件会带来更强风力，使转速提高。

 在风车叶片上覆盖布料可提升风能发电效率，这能增加表面积，进而提高转速和能量输出。风车帆由  坚韧布料 制成，右键点击风车即可安装。

 水车是稳定的轴功率产生装置。由于承受更高应力，水车的构造需要  钢 。其转速取决于流经水轮的水量，水量越大转速越高。单个动能发电机最多可将三个水轮并排安装。
entries.bodyEn:
The simplest form of power generation available is not solar or coal, but using natural forces to excite a generator.

The Kinetic Dynamo connects to integrated methods of producing shaft power and produces electrical power based on how fast they turn.

Windmills and waterwheels, detailed in the following pages, are the sources of shaft power the Kinetic Dynamo will accept, and must be assembled after the dynamo for them to connect.

Other sources of shaft power cannot be used with the kinetic dynamo, and will not produce electrical power.

Windmills are a basic but slow method of generating power. Speed depends on the space in front of it, with its output reducing greatly if the airflow is obscured. Additionally, weather conditions like rain or storms result in stronger winds and higher speeds.

Wind-based power generation can be improved by covering the blades in cloth. Doing so increases the surface area and with it the rotation speed and energy output.
Windmill sails are crafted from tough fabric and applied to the windmill by right clicking it.

Waterwheels are constant method of generating shaft power. Due to the higher stresses involved, waterwheels require steel in their construction.

Rotational speed is based on the amount of water flowing around the wheel, with more water providing a greater speed.

Up to three water wheels can be placed against each other and provide shaft power from a single shaft.

entries.body:
这把手持的柴油动力机械钻是采矿领域的一次卓越进步。通过可更换的钻头和升级，它的性能几乎可以自由调整。想要改造它，只需将其放入工程师装配台。如若机械钻的生物柴油耗尽，可以直接在炼油厂中填满。
机械钻的挖掘区域取决于使用的钻头材质，但你可以潜行放置将挖掘区域限制在单一一个块。你还可以潜行右键单击将机械钻更改为单块模式。

钻头将决定基础采矿等级，速度，范围以及攻击伤害。当你在挖掘方块时，钻头会受到磨损，但它能够在铁砧中被修复。

因为机械钻由内燃机驱动，它无法在水下工作，除非你为它安装了压缩空气罐。然而，当装配这项升级后，它不仅能够在水下工作，水下挖掘所造成的迟缓也会消失不见。

高级润滑系统在正常基础上为机械钻提供了额外的润滑效果，使其运行与挖掘更加快速。

通过为机械钻添加附加螺旋钻，它对于生物和方块的破坏性能得到提升。该项升级最高可叠加3次，每次升级会提供一点额外伤害。

大型燃料缸允许机械钻在内部存储更多燃料，延长再次填充之前你的使用时间。
entries.bodyEn:
The handheld, diesel-powered drill is a big advancement in mining. With exchangeable drill heads and upgrades, its speed and other properties are almost entirely modifiable.

To modify it, place it in an Engineer's Workbench.

The drill runs off of Biodiesel and can be filled directly in the refinery, or filled at other storage such as barrels or large tanks.

The drill digs in an area depending on the drill head used, but can be limited to a single block with sneak or sneak-and rightclick.

The Drill Head determines the base mining level, speed, and size, as well as the attack damage. As you dig blocks, the drill head takes damage, but it can be repaired in an anvil.

As the drill is powered by a combustion engine, it will not run underwater unless it is equipped with the Pressurized Air Tank. With the tank equipped, it will not only run while submerged, but also ignore the slowdown usually experienced when digging.

The Advanced Lubrication System applied additional lubricant to the drill at a regular basis, decreasing the durability loss of the drill head.

By adding Additional Augers to the drill, its destructive potential is increased, increasing its damage against living creatures and allowing it to run and dig faster. The upgrade stacks up to three times.

The drill's powerful action results in it wasting some of the precious mineral in the ground. By using redstone acid to soften the rock first, the drill can dig out much more raw ore from blocks (akin to the Fortune enchantment).

The Large Fuel Tank allows the drill to store more fuel internally, extending the time you can use it before refilling.

entries.body:
轨道炮（或者更准确地说，便携式感应弹射器）是工程学上的一个奇迹。它由两条轨道组成，电流通过这两条轨道来加速弹载，通过这两条轨道来加速抛射物体。
这个过程需要大量能量，但会使各种炮弹加速到极高的速度。
要从你的背包中发射一枚炮弹，点击并按住按钮，直到电量达到99，然后释放。
常见的子弹类型包括：铁棒，钢棒，铝棒以及石墨电极。
然而，你也可以发射更奇特的弹药，例如可以点燃敌人的烈焰棒，可以击中末影人的末地烛，可以增加射程的末影珍珠，可以刺穿目标的锯片和三叉戟。
由于内部储能低，建议与蓄电池背包一起使用轨道炮。
与其它沉浸工具一样，磁轨炮也可以用工程师装配台升级，也可应用皮肤。

附加电容可大幅减少磁轨炮的充能时间。

瞄准镜使得你可以在使用磁轨炮时缩放。潜行使用磁轨炮并用鼠标滚轮来调整缩放距离。
entries.bodyEn:
The Railgun (or more accurately the Portable Induction Catapult) is a marvel of engineering. It consists of two rails through which an electric current flows and accelerates a sled, and by that, a projectile.
The process is energy intensive but will accelerate various projectiles to high speeds.
To launch a projectile from your inventory, click and hold the use button till the charge level reaches 99, then release.

Common projectiles include iron, aluminum and steel rods, as well as graphite electrodes. However, you may also fire more exotic projectiles, such as blaze rods that set targets alight, end and breeze rods which can hit endermen and breezes respectively, ender pearls to increase their range, sawblades that pierce targets, or tridents.

To switch between projectiles, sneak and scroll the mouse wheel or use the keybind  if it has been set in the options.

Due to the low internal energy storage, it is recommended to use the railgun along with a Accumulator Backpack.
As with other IE tools, the railgun can be modified in the Engineer's Workbench and be customized with Shaders.

The Advanced Heatsinks help mitigate the heat buildup during the chargup process, greatly reducing the railgun's charge time.

The Precision Scope allows you to zoom in with the railgun. Use  to use the scope and scroll the mouse wheel to switch between magnification levels.

entries.body:
左轮手枪，一把来自文明时代的优雅武器，可谓是小型机械的智慧结晶。小型仅仅是相对而言，毕竟这把武器填装的是12号弹药。
与采矿机械钻一样，左轮手枪也可以使用工程师装配台来进行升级，详细的信息在下面的页面列出。

请注意，左轮手枪射击会发出巨大的声响，并将吸引在该地区敌对生物的注意！

左轮手枪可以接受不同种类的子弹。要装弹，只要Shift右击，然后把子弹装入即可。

装满的左轮快速装弹器可以在你开完最后一枪之后快速装填它。

瞄准镜允许你使用左轮手枪放大瞄准。按下来使用瞄准镜，滚动鼠标滚轮来在不同放大级别之间切换。
向左轮手枪加入刺刀，即可使其拥有近战能力，伤害和铁剑相等。

扩充弹夹允许在左轮手枪上多装6个子弹。它不会被快速装填器填充。

加强电子管对发射的子弹施加电能。这种电能会持续直到它击中目标（不要问它是如何工作的），然后传递下去。目标会晕眩几分之一秒，他们使用的所有动力装备都会受到轻微的电量损耗。
entries.bodyEn:
The Revolver, a more elegant weapon from a more civilized age, is an achievement of small mechanics.Small being relative here, since this weapon is chambered for 12-gauge.

Similar to the Mining Drill, the Revolver will allow for modification in the Engineer's Workbench, as detailed on the last pages.

Note that firing the revolver is quite noisy, and will attract the attention of hostile mobs in the area!

There are different types of ammunition the Revolver will accept. To load it, sneak + rightclick the weapon, then place cartridges into the slots.

A loaded Speedloader in your inventory will be used to refill the revolver after you've fired your last shot.

The Precision Scope allows you to zoom in with the revolver. Use  to use the scope and scroll the mouse wheel to switch between magnification levels.
By attaching a Bayonet to the revolver, you outfit it with close-quarter-combat capabilities, allowing for melee damage as powerful as an Iron Sword.

The Extended Magazine allows loading 6 more cartridges into the revolver. This magazine does not get refilled by a speedloader.

The Amplifying Electron Tubes apply an electric shock to fired projectiles. This shock persists till it hits the target (don't ask how it works) and is passed on. The target will be stunned for a fraction of a second and all powered equipment they may be using will suffer a slight discharge.

entries.body:
木桶 专为液体存储设计，不易滚动移位，是工业生产和资源管理的可靠帮手。
木桶结构简易，单桶可容纳 12 桶液体，但不可存储气体或高温流体。使用工程师锤右键点击桶身侧面，可进行配置操作。
金属桶 与木桶功能类似，仅材质不同。它具备更强的耐受性，支持存储高温流体与气体，并且可通过 红石信号 控制自动输出功能的开关。
entries.bodyEn:
Wooden Barrels are simple containers that can store up to 12 buckets of liquid, but not gasses or hot fluids.

Right-clicking the vertical sides of the barrel with the Engineer's Hammer will configure them.

Metal Barrels are identical to their wooden counterparts, other than the material of their construction.

Metal barrels may store hot fluids as well as gasses, and their automatic output can be disabled by a redstone signal.

entries.body:
木桶 专为液体存储设计，不易滚动移位，是工业生产和资源管理的可靠帮手。
木桶结构简易，单桶可容纳 12 桶液体，但不可存储气体或高温流体。使用工程师锤右键点击桶身侧面，可进行配置操作。
金属桶 与木桶功能类似，仅材质不同。它具备更强的耐受性，支持存储高温流体与气体，并且可通过 红石信号 控制自动输出功能的开关。

entries.body:
木制储物箱 它的功能与箱子类似，可容纳多达27组物品，并根据存放量输出比较器信号。与普通箱子不同的是，木制储物箱能够密封，确保在拾取时箱内物品不会掉落。
使用工程师锤长按右键点击储物箱即可将其密封，之后破坏箱子就能完整拾取。这也意味着，与潜影盒不同，储物箱不会被活塞推动破坏。
打开储物箱界面时，可编辑顶部名称，修改后的名称会在后续查看箱子时显示。

强化储物箱采用钢材加固框架，能够抵御爆炸带来的毁灭性伤害。因此，即便在爆炸附近，加固储物箱也不会破裂，箱内物品也不会掉落。
entries.bodyEn:
Wooden Storage Crates are similar to a chest in function, storing up to 27 stacks of material and providing a comparator signal based on their fill.

Unlike chests, they can be sealed up to keep all the material stored within a crate when picking it up.
Using an Engineer's Hammer on a crate for an extended duration will seal it up, after which it can be broken to pick it up.

This does mean that unlike Shulker Boxes, storage crates cannot be broken by pistons.

When opening a crate's interface, its name at the top can be edited, and the edited name will appear when looking at the block afterward.

Reinforced Storage Crates are framed with steel, allowing them to resist the otherwise devastating dangers posed by explosions.

Due to this, they will not break or drop their items when explosions happen near enough to otherwise destroy them.

Both types of crates, as well as shulker boxes, can be placed on a storage shelf for easier access to their items.

entries.body: 处理设备按 GUI 接入能量与物品，物品/能量激光中继器需用激光扳手建立连接。
entries.bodyEn: Supply machines with energy and items. Link item or energy laser relays with the laser wrench.

entries.body: 在激光射线上放置待转化物品或方块，给再构机供能并触发。按配方选择镜片；不要挡住目标与发射器之间的路径。
entries.bodyEn: Place the target item or block in the beam, supply power and trigger the reconstructor. Use the required lens and keep the beam path clear.

entries.body:
充能台是一个用来充能水晶和其他物品的东西。首先，把需要充能的物品右击放置在充能台上面，之后在充能台四个方向相距两格的位置摆放上物品展示台，最后再在物品展示台上摆放上四个焦黑石英。下一页给出了一张说明图要激活这个仪式，那么每一个物品展示台都需要供应大量的CF能量，之后它们才能正常运转来给物品充能。

物品展示台的布局

我想所有MOD都得来个注魔祭坛

物品展示台也可以用来做很多其他的事情！翻到耗能方块查询更多信息！
entries.bodyEn:
The Empowerer is a mid-tier block that can be used to empower crystals and other items. To use it, items that should be empowered can be right-clicked onto the Empowerer, and empowering items need to be placed on Display Stands that are two blocks away, like seen in the picture on the next page. To then activate the process, every Display Stand needs to be powered with a lot of CF that is then drained to empower the item on the Empowerer.

The placement of the Display Stands

Because every mod needs an Infusion Altar

The Display Stand can also be used for other things! See the Blocks that use CF section for more info about it!

entries.body:
方块破坏器能够破坏它前方的方块。它可以朝任意方向摆放。当手拿红石火把右键单击它时，它将在接受红石信号停用和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间切换。

方块放置器能够在它前方放置方块。它可以朝向任意方向摆放。当手拿红石火把右键单击它时，它将在接受红石信号停用和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间切换。

流体成型器放置你供应给它的液体。每消耗1000mB的液体来放置一个液体方块。当手拿红石火把右键单击它时，它将在接受红石信号停用和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间之间切换。

流体吸收器从它前方收集1000mB的液体，即一桶。当手拿红石火把右键单击它时，它将在接受红石信号停用和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间切换。
entries.bodyEn:
The Breaker breaks blocks in front of it. It can be oriented in every direction. When right-clicking it with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses.

The Placer places blocks in front of it. It can be oriented in every direction. When right-clicking it with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses.

The Fluid Placer places liquids you supply it with. It needs 1000mB to place one block. When right-clicking it with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses. A Comparator will mesaure its Fluid Amount.

The Fluid Collector will collect 1000mB of liquids in front of it, that's a filled bucket. When right-clicking it with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses. A Comparator will mesaure its Fluid Amount.

entries.body:
幻灵接口是一种简单的把物品容器链接到一起的工具，它有个很大的优点：幻灵接口不只是把两个容器连在一起，而且还能模拟它连接到的容器,这意味着你可以通过把东西放入幻灵接口和从其中抽出来与物品容器交互。幻灵接口的默认最大识别范围为个方块，你可以使用幻灵增幅器来增大这个范围。要将幻灵接口链接到物品容器，只需要使用幻灵连接器右键点击容器，再右键单击幻灵接口即可。

重要说明：需要强调的是幻灵接口不应该被当做无线传输设备。举个例子，当你没有足够的位置放置电缆时，或者你希望你的房间看起来美观，而不是堆满一堆方块或者电缆时，这时候才推荐使用幻灵接口。它不应被当做短距传输的超立方体。

默认情况下幻灵接口可以传输物品，就像第一页写的那样。

这个幻灵流体接口的行为很像普通的幻灵接口，但是仅对存储流体的容器方块有效。当给予一个红石信号，它可以被设置为自动输出。但是需要小心这个过程，因为它在某种情况下可能导致无限的循环和延迟。

这个幻灵能量接口的行为很像普通的幻灵接口，但是它仅能传输CF能量，这意味着它不能连接发电机和打粉机。

这个幻灵增幅器，就像第一页解释的那样，作用是增大幻灵接口的工作范围，只需要放置在幻灵接口的上面就能工作。幻灵接口上方增幅器的最大的放置数量为3.
entries.bodyEn:
Phantomfaces are a simple way to connect inventories together, they have a very important twist however: Instead of just connecting two inventories, a Phantomface simulates the inventory it is connected to, meaning you can put items into and pull out of the Phantomface itself. A Phantomface has a default range of  blocks, but it can be upgraded with a Phantom Booster. Phantomfaces are connected by right-clicking an inventory with a Phantom Connector and then right-clicking the Phantomface.

Important Information:It should be noted that the Phantomface is not supposed to be used as a wireless transport system. The Phantomface should be used when, for example, wanting to input items into a machine that doesn't have enough space for the amount of cables you need around it, or when you want it to look nice in a room without needing any cables or other blocks around it. It's not a short-range Tesseract.

The default Phantomface works for items, like described on the first page.

The Phantom Liquiface acts exactly like the normal Phantomface, but it works for liquid containing blocks.

The Phantom Energyface acts exactly like the normal Phantomface, but it works for CF, meaning you can connect it to things like Generators and Crushers.

The Phantom Booster, as explained on the first page, ups the range of Phantomfaces by being placed on top of them. The maximum amount above one Phantomface is 3.

entries.zh: 幻灵方块破坏器与放置器
entries.body: 幻灵方块破坏器与放置器有着和幻灵接口相同的工作原理，不过它们的作用是远距离的破坏以及放置方块。其默认最大识别范围为格方块。欲使其连接并破坏一个方块，你需要按照幻灵接口章节中描述的方法去操作。当它前方是空气方块时，仅仅只会机械地放置方块，然后又破坏掉方块。当手拿红石火把右键单击它时，它会在接受红石信号停用和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间切换。
entries.bodyEn: Phantom Breakers and Placers work similarly to the normal Phantomfaces, except that they are used to break and place blocks from a distance. Their default range is  Blocks. To connect them to blocks to break, do as described in the Phantomface Chapter. When connecting them to air spaces, just place a block, store it and then break it again. When right-clicking it with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses.

entries.body: ESD是一种工作方式类似于漏斗的方块，但是它的功能比漏斗多的多。你可以选择从方块的哪一面来输入和输出，而且还可以精确地配置进行输入输出的格子的范围！为了获得关于ESD的更多准确信息，你可以将鼠标悬浮在它的GUI的元素上！它们能够判定一个物品栏最初的格子数量，不过并不适合变化格子数的物品栏。当相连的物品栏格子数量发生了变化，比如说物品接口时就无法识别多出的格子，所以你可以在ESD的GUI里面把数值设大一些，来避免有格子被忽略了。
entries.bodyEn: The ESD is like a Hopper with a lot more functionality: You can choose the sides to input and output and you can precisely configure the range of slots. For more information, hover over the elements in their GUI. They will determine the amount of slots an inventory has initially, however it won't adapt when the inventory changes. When connecting an inventory whose slot amount can change, like the Item Interface, you can set the slot amount to a big number in the ESD's GUI to avoid slots being ignored.

entries.body: 经验固化器可以把玩家的经验值转变成固态经验，而手拿固态经验右键单击又可以让存储在里面的经验值回到玩家身上。（Shift右击可以使用一组！）除此之外，你还可以把经验固化机调节为固化模式，这样它能够拾起任何掉落在地面上的经验球，并将其转换成固态经验。固态经验有时也会从怪物身上掉落。
entries.bodyEn: The Experience Solidifer uses the player's experience and turns it into Solidified Experience which can later be used by right-clicking (or sneak-right-clicking to use a full stack!) to get the experience back. Additionally, you can put Solidified Experience into the solidifier, and it will pick up any XP Orbs that are on the ground and turn them into Solidified Experience, provided they weren't created by it. Solidified Experience is also sometimes dropped from mobs.

entries.body:
温室玻璃是加快你的植物生长的一种非常有效的方式！当它被放置在植物上方的任意位置，只要它与植物之间没有方块阻挡，而且玻璃可以接受到阳光，它就可以显著地加快植物生长！当然，一定要是白天才行。想想看，这是显而易见的的。

温室气体
entries.bodyEn:
Greenhouse Glass is a very effective way to speed up the growth of your plants! When placed anywhere above the plant, as long as there are no blocks below obstructing the path, and there is sunlight above the glass, it will significantly speed up the growth of the plant! It obviously has to be daytime, too. Thought that was obvious.

Greenhouse Gas

entries.body: 自动饲育机是人工饲喂动物的好帮手。把它放在畜栏中间，并且给它提供一些小麦，种子或胡萝卜（这取决于你想喂什么动物），然后等着就行了。它将会自动饲喂动物，如果周围的动物太多，它也会自动关闭以防止大量动物造成卡顿。绿色和平组织批准使用
entries.bodyEn: The Feeder is a good alternative to a manual animal farm. Place it in the middle of an animal pen and supply it with some wheat, seeds or carrots, depending on the animal you want to feed, and just wait. It will automatically feed the animals and if there are enough animals near it, it will shut off on its own to prevent lag or animal overflow. Greenpeace approves

entries.body:
咖啡机用于制造一种类似于药水，可以给予玩家几种附加效果的咖啡。为了使用它，你需要空杯子和咖啡豆。在野外可以发现咖啡豆，你可以在耕地上种植它。咖啡机需要CF/t的能源供给，每制作一杯咖啡需要mB的水。如果你想知道每种加入咖啡的物品都有什么用，翻到后几面的咖啡机配方，然后把鼠标悬停在物品的上方即可。

为了能让咖啡有实际的药水效果接下来的几页给出了详细说明。加入的东西越多，那么提供的药水等级也会越高。药水的最高等级取决于最多能放入的物品数量。放置顺序说明：举个例子，当你想要给你的咖啡加点牛奶（翻到最后一页可以了解它详细的的工作原理）你必须要按照一定的物品栏编号顺序放置物品，才能冲泡出你想要的咖啡。

这是一个示例配方，制作一杯拥有抗火Ⅰ, 0:20和速度Ⅰ, 2:30效果的咖啡。

牛奶对于咖啡来说也很重要：它能为所有的药水效果提供2分钟延时，但会降低一个药水等级。如果原本的药水等级就是1，那么牛奶会移除这个效果。

如果你看到了这一页，说明你要么安装了HarvestCraft，要么你在看lang文件。这些东西是为素食主义者准备的牛奶的替代品。
entries.bodyEn:
The Coffee Maker is a block used to make Coffee, a potion-like item that gives the user several buffs. To use the coffee maker, you need a Empty Cup,  Coffee Beans, which can be found in the wild, harvested and planted on farmland again,  CF/t and mB of Water per cup brewed. On the coffee maker recipe pages at the back, to see what the item does, just hover over the Cup of Coffee.

To actually give your coffee some buffs, put some of the items shown on the later pages into the slots on the right. The more slots are filled up with one item, the higher the Amplifier of the effect will be. The Maximum Amplifier is the max amount of items to be put into one coffee. Order matters: When using, for example, Milk (to see what it does exactly, go to a later page), you are going to have to plan the items out inside the numbered slots in such a way that it brews the coffee you want.

This is an example of a recipe making a coffee containing Fire Resistance 1 for 0:20 and Speed 1 for 2:30.

Milk is an important item when brewing coffee: It adds 2 minutes to all effects of items in slots with lower numbers while removing 1 amplifier. When the amplifier of an effect is 1, however, it will remove the effect.

The fact that you're reading this means that you either have HarvestCraft installed, or that you're looking at the lang file. This does the same thing as Milk, but for veggie guys.

entries.body: 磨粉机可把每种矿物，锭和宝石转变成对应的粉末，功率为CF/t。当你把矿物放入时，它们会被转变成双倍的粉末。两仓磨粉机基本上也是如此，然而它能一次粉碎2个矿石。在接下来几面，你将会看到一些使用到磨粉机的额外的实用配方。He's my crush
entries.bodyEn: The Crusher turns every ore, ingot and gem into its corresponding dust using  CF/t. When you put in Ores however, they will yield 2 pieces of dust. The Double Crusher basically does the same, however it can crush two ores at a time. On the following pages, you can see some additional useful recipes for inside the crusher. He's my crush

entries.body: 岩浆工厂可消耗CF来制造岩浆。每产生一个岩浆方块需要消耗CF。岩浆工厂上方的空当四周必须被4个岩浆工厂外墙包围，否则岩浆工厂不会工作。右击岩浆工厂可以显示当前环境下它是否能工作。Lava, for a fact.                 ory
entries.bodyEn: The Lava Factory can produce blocks of lava given  CF/block. The Block above it has to be surrounded with 4 Casing Blocks, otherwise it won't be able to produce Lava. Right-Clicking on the Lava Factory will show you if it's able to produce Lava in its current setup. Lava, for a fact.                 ory

entries.body:
充能站把它储能槽中的能量充入使用CF的物品之中。

释能站从存储有CF的物品中释放出能量，并将能量储存在它的储能槽中。
entries.bodyEn:
The Energizer charges items that hold CF using its energy supply.

The Enervator discharges items that hold CF and stores the energy in its energy supply.

entries.body: 煤炭发电机利用任何可以作为原版熔炉燃料的物品产生功率为CF/t的CF能量。注意，它只会在产生的能量有处可去的时候消耗燃料。
entries.bodyEn: The Coal Generator generates  CF/t through the use of everything that can be put into a furnace. Note that it only starts burning something up if the buffer isn't already full of power. It will stop generating when powered by Redstone. Additionally, using a Comparator will yield the percentage of energy stored.

entries.body: 热能发电机是一个发电功率为CF/t的机器。它需要与至少个岩浆方块直接接触才能产生能量。岩浆与顶部接触视为无效。但是使用它的时候你要留个心眼，它有时会摧毁一些与它接触的岩浆方块！
entries.bodyEn: The Heat Collector is a block that produces  CF/t. To do that, it needs to be surrounded with at least  Lava Blocks directly around it on any side except the top one. But watch out, it sometimes destroys some of these Lava Blocks!

entries.body:
那些在野外随处可见的油菜可以制成各种各样的东西！你可以油菜提炼菜籽油或原油并以此产出CF。首先你需要用油菜压榨机将一定量，油菜提炼为菜籽油。压榨机本身的能耗是CF/t。然后，用发酵桶可将菜籽油转化为原油。最终产出的原油可在原油发电机中当作燃料。产出能量速率能够在GUI中看到，不过，它还可以被升级来产出更多能量！

一开始，你可以使用发酵桶将菜籽油转换为精致菜籽油。如果你还不满意它的产电量，把精致菜籽油放置在地上，然后丢进一个晶化油菜籽就能变成晶化油。如果这还不满意，再丢进去一个充能油菜籽就能变成充能油！

发酵桶也能够被比较器检测，输出的信号强弱取决于输出槽容积的百分比。

如果你打掉了原油发电机，里面的液体也会得到保留。如果你想清空它，只需要放置在合成栏合成一次，所有的液体就会被清除。原油发电机收到红石信号也会停止工作。
entries.bodyEn:
Using Canola, you can make a simple, yet effective power generation system from natural resources. To do this, first find some Canola Plants in the wild and plant them on your farm. The Canola you get out of them can be used in a Canola Press to make Canola Oil. This can be used in an Oil Generator. It displays the amount of power it generates in its GUI, however, it can be upgraded further to yield more power than that!

For starters, you can use a Fermenting Barrel to convert the Canola Oil into Refined Canola Oil. If you're still not satisfied with the power that generates, place the refined canola oil on the ground and throw in a Crystallized Canola Seed to make Crystallized Oil.  If that isn't enough for you either, make an Empowered Canola Seed and toss that into some Crystallized Oil to get Empowered Oil!

The Fermenting Barrel can have a Comparator attached to it which will result in the Redstone strength being equivalent to the percentage of the output tank.

If you break the Oil Generator, it will keep the liquid inside. Place it in the crafting grid to empty it out. It will stop generating when powered by Redstone. Additionally, using a Comparator will yield the percentage of energy stored.

entries.body:
咀叶发电机可以利用周围放置的树叶产生CF能量。它会在发电过程中摧毁这些树叶，每块树叶可以发出CF。你可以右击它以查看它已经储存了多少CF能量。它可以作用于周围格方块的范围。

嘎嘣脆
entries.bodyEn:
The Leaf Generator can generate CF just by being placed alongside some Leaves. It will destroy the leaves, generating  CF per leaf broken in the process. By right-clicking the generator, you can see how much CF it has stored. It has a range of  blocks.

Munchy

entries.body:
长距离方块破坏器工作起来就像一个普通的方块破坏器，但是它可以破坏面前至多格的方块。每破坏一个方块它会消耗CF。当手拿红石火把右键单击它时，它会在接受红石信号时停用和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间切换。图为正在破坏第层墙壁

顺序打破
entries.bodyEn:
The Long-Range Breaker works like a normal Breaker, but it can break up to  blocks in front of it. Per block broken, it uses  CF. When right-clicking it with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses. Breaking the th wall

Sequence Breaking

entries.body:
能量激光中继器是一台能够无线传输CF的设备，这只需要把它用中继器扳手右击连接并生成网络即可。把产能机器或接收能量的机器放置在中继器旁，即可让它从网络中的其它中继器输出或接收能量。在能量传输过程中会存在轻微的能量损失，但是完全不用担心。因为损失的计算是以每次传输衡量的，所以不必担心两台机器间有多少个中继器，损失始终都是一样的。

这里有三种能量激光中继器。它们每tick传输的最大能量各不相同。能量上限分别为，，和CF。同样的，不同的中继器能量损失也不相同。混合互联不同等级的中继器是可行的，然而能量传输的最低上限和最高上限会受到两个中继器的影响。除此之外，能量激光中继器不能够被幻灵接口相连。
entries.bodyEn:
The Energy Laser Relay is a block that can wirelessly transfer CF. When placing a Power Generator or Receiver next to the relay, it can receive Power from any other relay in the network and send power to any other relay as well. During an energy transfer, they have a slight Energy Loss, but nothing to worry about, especially because it's per transfer, so it doesn't matter how many Lasers are inbetween two machines, the loss will always be the same amount.

There are three tiers of Energy Laser Relay. They have different maximum amounts of energy to be transferred through them in one tick. The energy caps are, in order, , , and . Additionally, the energy loss is a bit higher every tier. Interconnecting different tiers is possible, however the lowest cap and highest loss of the two relays connected to the blocks involved in the transfer is considered. Additionally, Energy Laser Relays can not be connected by Phantomfaces.

entries.body:
垂直挖矿机可以用来自动挖掘方块。它有两种模式：它可以选择只挖掘矿石或挖掘任何方块。每挖掘一个方块，它都会消耗CF。挖掘的物品会被存储到内部缓存中，右击即可取出。默认挖掘半径为格，但是就像幻灵接口一样，在其上方放置幻灵增幅器，最大可以扩大它的挖掘半径到3格。

（任意颜色手钻都可以合成）I dig it
entries.bodyEn:
The Vertical Digger can be used to automatically mine blocks from the world. It has two modes: It can either only mine ores or mine everything. When mining a block, it uses about  CF. Mined items get stored in an internal buffer that can be accessed through right-clicking. Its default radius is , but much like Phantomfaces, the Digger's range can be upgraded by placing 3 or less Phantom Boosters above it.

(Works with any colored Drill) I dig it

entries.body:
烟花发射器最适合新年佳节！在放置后供应一些CF能量，它就会向附近射出一些随机生成的烟花。每次喷射都会消耗CF能量。你可以右击这个机器来精准设置烟花的类型或者频率。除此之外还有一大堆其它选项以供选择。只需要打开GUI就能查看到每个选项。这可是一个又酷又棒的烟火表演。

这是一条很少有人知道的东西，想要合成烟花，只需要将火药和纸合成即可。
entries.bodyEn:
The Firework Box is a perfect thing for New Year's! When placed down and supplied with some CF, it will shoot out some randomly generated Fireworks around it. For each shot, it uses  CF. You can right-click the block to be able to precisely configure the types of Fireworks you want to get and how often you get them, along with a bunch of other options. Just play around in the GUI to find out what every setting does. This is a great way to set up cool looking Firework displays.

This is a rarely known fact, but to craft a Firework Rocket, just put together a Gunpowder and a piece of Paper.

entries.body: 如果你还不知道什么是幻灵接口，请先阅读幻灵接口条目。幻灵红石接口是用来传输红石信号的幻灵接口。但和一般的幻灵接口不一样，它“只在一个方向上工作”。换句话说，它只对相连的方块提供红石信号，它不会对那些周围的其他方块工作。
entries.bodyEn: If you don't know what Phantomfaces are, check the Phantomfaces Entry first. The Phantom Redstoneface can be used to transmit redstone signals. This one, however, works differently to the other Phantomfaces as it only works in one direction. What this means is that the connected block has to provide redstone power for redstone next to the Redstoneface to become powered. It does not work the other way around.

entries.body: 在开始之前需要着重一点：物品激光中继器比能量激光中继器和流体激光中继器要复杂得多。不过这东西可是一个极具效率的物品传输和管理工具。只需要将物品激光中继器和能够存储或者操纵物品的方块相接，它就会智能的“知道”每个格子需要什么。单独这么一个功能没啥用，不过物品传输接口能够对这些物品进行交互。可以去产看相关章节了解详情。
entries.bodyEn: Before we start: The Item Laser Relay system is more complicated than its Fluid and Energy counterpart, however, it is an extremely powerful way to manage and transport your items. When connecting an Item Laser Relay to any block that stores or handles items, it will basically "know about" the slots they have and what items are in them. That alone isn't particularly useful, however the Item Interface can interact with those items. Check out its chapter to find out how.

entries.body:
物品传输接口是一种能够交互物品激光中继器网络的东西。一个网络只“知道”相连的容器的所有物品和格子。而物品传输接口能够直接交互这些物品。物品传输接口的工作原理差不多就是把自己伪装成包含每个相连容器的格子的超大箱子。

这也意味着你可以使用漏斗或者其他传输设备向物品传输接口传输东西，就像箱子那样，能够接收物品或者从激光中继器网络中抽出物品。想要连接入网络中，只需要在物品激光中继器旁边摆一个物品传输接口就行。
entries.bodyEn:
The Item Interface is the way to interact with an Item Laser Relay network. On its own, such a network will just "know about" all of the items and slots that connected containers have. The Item Interface, however, can be used to directly interact with these items. The way the Item Interface works is that it basically pretends to be a very large chest containing every slot of every container that is connected.

What this means is that you can use a Hopper or any other item transport mechanic on the Item Interface and it will function like a chest, being able to accept items and have items pulled out of it. But instead of any items being stored inside of the Item Interface they will go to and be pulled from the Laser Relay network. To actually connect an Item Interface to a network, just place an Item Laser Relay next to one.

entries.body:
很快你就发现了，你需要白名单或者黑名单相关物品。高级物品激光中继器就可以做到，当右击打开GUI的时候，可以配置白名单或者黑名单。列表有两侧，进站就是指“物品尝试进入中继器所连接的容器”。出站就是指“物品尝试从中继器所连接的容器中抽出”。

这不单单作用于网络中的存储容器，还能够作用于物品传输接口，也意味着你能够制作一个只允许抽出特殊物品的存储系统。
entries.bodyEn:
Soon you will find that sometimes you will need to white- and blocklist what you actaully want to go into a container. The Advanced Item Laser Relay is able to do just that. When right-clicking, you can configure a Allowlist or Blocklist inside of the GUI. This list has two sides, however. The INBOUND side basically means "things that are trying to go into the container the Relay is attached to", while OUTBOUND means "things that are trying to exit the attached container".

This doesn't only work on storage containers in the network, but also for Item Interfaces, meaning that you are able to set up a storage system and only pull out specific items in certain places.

entries.body: 漏斗型物品传输接口很像普通的传输接口，这也意味着你能够直接像普通的传输接口一样紧贴物品激光中继器就行。不过普通的物品传输接口需要主动抽入抽出，漏斗型物品传输接口能够主动抽入抽出物品，就像普通的漏斗那样，只不过是把物品存储在网络当中了。
entries.bodyEn: The Hopping Item Interface works the same as a normal Item Interface, meaning that you can connect them to an Item Laser Relay network by placing one next to it. However, whereas you need to pipe items into the normal Item Interface, the Hopping Item Interface will pull and push items on its own. It has every functionality that the Hopper has, but instead of storing items in an internal inventory, it stores them in the network.

entries.body: 玩家接口和幻灵接口工作方式相似，但玩家接口连接的是玩家而非方块，并且连接会在玩家放置它之后建立。当向其输入物品时，物品会进入玩家的物品栏。还有，当向其输入CF能量时，它会为玩家物品栏中的物品充能。它具有格方块的效应范围，以及，你可以通过在其顶部放置3个幻灵增幅器来扩大范围。
entries.bodyEn: The Player Interface works in a similar way to the Phantomface, except it is connected to a player instead of a block, and the connection is established by placing it down. When inputting items, they will move to the player's inventory. Also, when inputting CF, it will charge the items in the player's inventory. It has a default range of  blocks, however, it can be expanded by placing up to 3 Phantom Boosters on top of it.

entries.body:
物品展示台是一种可将各种物品或方块展示出来的方块。只需要将待展示方块或物品右击放上去，这个方块或物品就会悬浮在展示台上方。再次右击可将其取下。除此以外，某些物品可令展示台发挥特殊效果，但这个功能需要消耗CF，阅读下一页可获得详细信息。

吹叶器以及高级吹叶器在展示架上时可以缓慢清理掉附近的草丛和树叶。药水指环在展示架上时也能发挥效果。普通版本只能将药水效果给予附近的一个生物，但高级版本可在大范围内给予任何生物以指定药水效果，但需要消耗大量CF。
entries.bodyEn:
The Display Stand is a block that can, for one, display any item or block by right-clicking with it onto the display stand. It will then be floating around on top. To take it out of there again, just right-click with an empty hand. The other feature, however, is that some items can be put onto it, having special effects. This, however, will require the stand to get CF. Read more on the next page.

The Leaf Blower and Advanced Leaf Blower can be placed onto the display stand, resulting in the grass and leaves around it to be blown away. Potion Rings can be placed onto the display stand. The normal version will give the specified potion effect to only one living entity in a small area, while the advanced version will give a potion effect to all living entities in a big area while using up a significant amount of CF.

entries.body:
震波吸收器在供应CF能量后，能够保护周围至少个方块的区域免受各类爆炸的破坏，无论是恶魂，TNT还是爬行者发生的爆炸。保护一个方块需要消耗CF。

鸣谢：这个不错的创意来自玩家praetoras。感谢他的建议。What's a fourth wall..?
entries.bodyEn:
The Shock Absorber is a block that, when supplied with CF, it will protect an area of up to  blocks around it from any type of Explosion, be it ghasts, TNT or creepers. Every block that is protected will result in a loss of  CF.

Credit where credit is due: Or something like that. Anyways, this thing was thought up and suggested to me by praetoras. Thanks for that brilliant idea! What's a fourth wall..?

entries.body:
充能台是一个用来充能水晶和其他物品的东西。首先，把需要充能的物品右击放置在充能台上面，之后在充能台四个方向相距两格的位置摆放上物品展示台，最后再在物品展示台上摆放上四个焦黑石英。下一页给出了一张说明图要激活这个仪式，那么每一个物品展示台都需要供应大量的CF能量，之后它们才能正常运转来给物品充能。

物品展示台的布局

我想所有MOD都得来个注魔祭坛

物品展示台也可以用来做很多其他的事情！翻到耗能方块查询更多信息！
entries.bodyEn:
The Empowerer is a mid-tier block that can be used to empower crystals and other items. To use it, items that should be empowered can be right-clicked onto the Empowerer, and empowering items need to be placed on Display Stands that are two blocks away, like seen in the picture on the next page. To then activate the process, every Display Stand needs to be powered with a lot of CF that is then drained to empower the item on the Empowerer.

The placement of the Display Stands

Because every mod needs an Infusion Altar

The Display Stand can also be used for other things! See the Blocks that use CF section for more info about it!

entries.body: 流体激光中继器工作方式颇有点像普通的激光中继器，但是和物品激光中继器和能量激光中继器又有些不同，它只能把流体从一个储罐传输到另一个储罐。流体激光中继器不能连接幻灵接口。注意当它们被调节为仅相邻方块模式时，他们会主动抽取相连容器的流体。
entries.bodyEn: The Fluid Laser Relays work much in the same way that normal Laser Relays do, however the thing that makes the Fluid Laser Relay different from the Energy Laser Relay, however, is that it transfers fluids from internal tanks of blocks into other blocks. Fluid Laser Relays can not be connected by Phantomfaces. Note that when they are toggled to Only out of adjacent Blocks mode, they will actively pull fluids out of containers around them.

entries.body: 生物反应器使用多种多样的种子，食物或者作物来产生CF！使用方式很简单，只需要在它的GUI里面放上这些东西。不过你很快就会发现，这东西产能并不是很多。实际上是这样的，你放置的种子，食物或者作物种类越多，它的产能就越多。
entries.bodyEn: The Bio Reactor uses all types of seeds, foodstuffs and plants to generate CF! To do this, just place the items in its GUI. If you try this out, you will notice that it doesn't generate that much power by default. However, the more different kinds of plants, seeds and foodstuffs it has, the more power it will generate!

entries.body:
农场是一个能够种植并收获诸如小麦，马铃薯，胡萝卜或者其他作物的机器。它的GUI左侧的格子是用来放置种子的，而它右侧的格子则能够存储收获的作物。它能够耕种机器前方9x9区域的范围。每次操作会消耗不同的能量。my fam

能够耕种基础的作物，比如小麦，马铃薯，油菜，亚麻或者其他东西。地面会被自动耕种。

如果要种植仙人掌，需要提前铺好沙子。仙人掌高于两格时候会被收割进农场中。

如果要种植地狱疣，需要提前铺好灵魂沙。

如果要种植甘蔗，沙子和水源需要提前布设好。收割方式也和仙人掌差不多。

如果要种植西瓜或者南瓜，最好有交错式的空间布局，以便作物生长。

如果要种植Extra Utilities 2的末影百合。需要铺好末地石，草方块或者泥土。

如果要种植Extra Utilities 2的红兰花，需要铺好红石矿石。
entries.bodyEn:
The Farmer is a block that can, once placed in the world, plant and harvest different types of crops and other plants which can all be seen on the following pages. The left side of its GUI is reserved for seeds and other things that should be planted, while the right side will contain the harvested goods. It will farm in a 9x9 area in front of it. It uses varying amounts of CF per operation. my fam

Farming basic crops crops like Wheat, Potatoes, Canola, Flax and so on. Ground will be tilled by the Farmer itself.

Farming Cactus. Sand needs to be laid out for it to be planted. Cactus higher than 2 blocks will have the top broken off and placed inside of the Farmer.

Farming Nether Wart. Soul Sand needs to be laid out for it to be planted.

Farming Sugar Cane. Sand and water need to be laid out for it to be planted. Harvested in the same way as Cactus.

Farming Melons and Pumpkins. There will be checkerboarded air spaces left out inbetween the seeds for them to grow.

Farming Ender Lillies from Extra Utilities 2. They need to be placed on End Stone, Grass or Dirt.

Farming Red Orchids from Extra Utilities 2. They need to be placed on Redstone Ore.

entries.body: 两仓熔炉工作方式和熔炉一样，但是，它可以以CF/t的功率一次烧制2个物品。
entries.bodyEn: The Powered Furnace works like a furnace, however, it uses  CF/t and can smelt two items at a time.

entries.body:
激光中继器存在很多变种，但是都拥有相似的功能。使用中继器扳手能够将一个激光中继器和其他中继器相连。只需要右击第一个中继器后再右击另一个即可连接。连接没有上限，你可以称呼它为网络或者系统。这样的网络系统没有预定的终点或者起点。

每一个激光中继器都能够用多种方式和其他的中继器交互。但是连接两个激光中继器却有一些限制条件。首先两个相互连接的激光中继器至多只能相距个方块远。除此之外，两个激光中继器的类型必须相同。继续浏览这章的其他条目查看不同类型的激光中继器！

用中继器扳手悬停在中继器上面能够看到很多有用的信息，比如能量流配置或者优先级。除此之外，尝试连接两个已经连接激光中继器能够使其断开连接。
entries.bodyEn:
Laser Relays exist in different variants, however, they all have the same basic functionality. A Laser Relay can be connected to one ore more other laser relays using a Laser Wrench. This can be achieved by right-clicking the first relay and then right-clicking the second one. There can be an infinite number of interconnected Laser Relays, making what is called a Network or System. Such a network will have no predefined starting or end point, but instead,

every Laser Relay has access to interact with all of the other ones in different ways. Connecting two Laser Relays has some restrictions, however. First of all, two connected Laser Relays must be at most  blocks apart from each other. Additionally, two Laser Relays of a different type cannot be connected to one another. View the other items in this chapter to find out more about different types of Laser Relays!

Hovering over Laser Relays with the Laser Wrench will also bring up useful information like the energy flow configuration or the priority configuration. Additionally, linking two already connected Laser Relays will cause them to disconnect.

entries.body:
原子再构机常用制作水晶，而水晶则是实用拓展模组最基础的原料。当提供能量之后，它就能发出激光，当激光击中一些方块时，它会把周围能够转换的方块都转换了。每发射一束激光消耗CF，但是额外的消耗量取决于转换的方块。

这里有好几种透镜，它们都可以贴附在原子再构器上，但是并不是所有的透镜的功能都那么讨人喜欢。查看“再构机的透镜”章节查询更多重要信息。当使用红石火把右击原子再构机，可以在接收红石信号停止工作和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间之间切换。

需要注意的是，下面列出的合成表都没有透镜相关的说明因为合成它们不需要任何透镜。我想这应该是显而易见的吧。

当你合成很多物品时，你也许会想找到一种方式来自动化这个过程。这里提供了一个非常简单的方式：在原子再构机的对面放置精准自动投掷器（可以在“所有物品和搜索”条目找到它）接下来，在合适的位置放置物品吸收器，并且设置好白名单。接下来你只需要在投掷器里面丢进原料，就能在吸收器里面得到你想要的东西。

分子转化剂
entries.bodyEn:
The Atomic Reconstructor is used to craft Crystals, which are the main crafting ingredient in most items from Actually Additions. Upon being supplied with power, it shoots out a Laser. It will convert all surrounding items and blocks along the beam's path, provided they can be converted, until it hits a block.

When shooting a laser, it uses 1000 CF, but additional rates vary depending on the conversion. There are various Lenses that can be attached to the Reconstructor that don't all follow the default behavior of the Reconstructor and are able to do some neat things. See the Reconstruction section in the booklet for more information.

When right-clicking the Reconstructor with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses. It should be noted that any recipes listed without information about Lenses don't use one. I thought that was obvious.

When you have crafted a couple of items, you might want to find a way to automate this. There is a very simple way to do accomplish this: Place the Atomic Reconstructor down facing into a Precision Dropper (to find it, look it up in the All Items Entry!). Next, place a Ranged Collector in the area that has the converted items set as a allowlist. Now you can just chuck your raw materials into the Dropper to convert them!

Molecular Transformilator

entries.body: 原子再构机默认功能仅仅是转换一些方块。当使用透镜之后功能就有所改变。当你手持透镜右击原子再构机就可以贴附上透镜。空手右击可以取下来。他们消耗的能量各不相同。不同的透镜都拥有不同的功能和特性，你可以查看这一章内容来获取更多信息。 除此之外，这些透镜还有一些其他有用的合成。
entries.bodyEn: The Atomic Reconstructor, by default, can only convert some blocks. This can be changed, however, with Lenses. They can be attached to the Reconstructor via right-clicking with them in hand. To remove them, right-click with an empty hand. They all use a different amount of power and will only activate once they have it. Lenses have lots of different features and uses, as you can see in this chapter. However, there are also some other useful recipes too.

entries.body: 物品收集器工作起来就像一个漏斗，但是它有收集周围的掉落物的能力，它能收集周围格范围内的掉落物。它内置有物品过滤功能，可以设置白名单或者黑名单。但是它一个缺点：它不能自动输出它收集的物品。
entries.bodyEn: The Ranged Collector works much like a hopper, in that it collects items around it, having the power, however, to pick up items that are in an area of  blocks around it. It has a filter that can be set to white- or blocklist. This comes with a disadvantage, however: It doesn't auto-output its items.

entries.body: 电池盒是一个存储能量的好东西。你首先需要右击一下电池盒来使用能量。接下来它就能够存储能量。如果你将电池设置为了释能模式（通过shift右击或者红石脉冲），那么它会尝试将接受的能量平均分配到毗邻的15个 电池盒中。
entries.bodyEn: The Battery Box is a great way to store your power. However, for it to be able to use power, you have to right-click a Battery onto it. It will then be able to store energy on the battery itself. If you set the battery to discharge mode via sneak-right-clicking it or by applying a redstone pulse to the Battery Box, it will try to spread the power it receives equally to up to 15 adjacent Battery Boxes.

entries.body: 物品过滤器可在高级物品激光中继器，ESD和物品吸收器中使用，以扩充它们的白名单大小。只需要右击打开过滤器，放入想过滤的物品，这个过滤器就被标记好了。之后它就可以放置在任何需要过滤名单的机器里面使用了。鼠标悬停在GUI里面的白名单按钮上！
entries.bodyEn: The Item Filter can be used in Advanced Item Laser Relays, ESDs and Ranged Collectors to enlargen the size of their whitelist. This can be done by right-clicking with the filter in hand and placing items to be filtered inside of it. The filter can then be placed into any allowlist slot in the desired machine. For more information on this, hover over the allowlist buttons in the GUIs of allowlistable machines!

entries.body: 电池是个储存并携带CF能量的好方案。它们可以在充能站中充电并在释能站中放电。当手持它时，可以通过Shift右击来转换至释能模式。这一意味着它能够被物品栏的其他东西充能。
entries.bodyEn: Batteries are a good way to store CF to move around. They can be charged in an Energizer and discharged in an Enervator. When holding them in hand, they can be sneak-right-clicked to put them into discharge mode. This means that they will charge any other items in your inventory.

entries.body:
手钻用起来就像一把镐或者锹一样。它使用CF来破坏方块。它可以在充能站中被充能，你还可以通过把它拿在手上按住Shift右键单击来升级。有大量的升级可用，这里是其中一部分的解释：范围采掘升级增大手钻开掘的范围的大小。方块放置升级，在你手持它右键单击后，它就会记录下它所在的快捷栏格子。在将它放入手钻后，你就可以通过拿着手钻右键单击把那个格子的方块放置在地上。

需要注意的是，急迫, 范围采集和时运需要逐等级安装才能正常工作。这意味着你如果想要给你的手钻急迫Ⅲ的效果，你需要先安装急迫Ⅰ和急迫Ⅱ才可以。

手钻也可以被染料成Minecraft的16种颜色。但是，这只是装饰性的，除了让它看起来不同，对它不会有任何其他的效果。
entries.bodyEn:
The Drill works like a Pickaxe and a Shovel. It uses CF per block. It can be charged in an Energizer and upgraded by sneak-right-clicking with it in your hand. There are a lot of upgrades, but here is an explanation of some of them: The Mining Upgrades enlarge the hole which the Drill digs. The Placement Upgrade, after you right-click it in any slot of your hotbar, will make the Drill able to place a block from that slot by right-clicking.

It should be noted that, in fact, the Speed, Mining and Fortune Upgrades need their previous tiers to be installed for them to work. This means that, if you want Speed III in the Drill, it needs Speed II and Speed I inside it as well.

The Drill can also be dyed in Minecraft's 16 colors. It's only cosmetic and won't have any effect other than it looking different, however.

entries.body: 传送法杖，当在充能站中充能后，只需右击，就可以把你传送到屏幕中央十字准星所指的地方。当你的十字准星对着一个方块时，它会把你传送到那个方块的位置，但是，如果你的十字准星没有指着一个方块，准星所对着的方向的仰角就不能超过5°，否则传送将会失败。
entries.bodyEn: The Teleport Staff, when charged in an Energizer, can be right-clicked to teleport you to where you're looking. When you are looking at a block, it will teleport you there, however, when you aren't looking at a block, you can only be looking upwards up to 5 degrees, otherwise the teleport will fail.

entries.body:
原子再构机常用制作水晶，而水晶则是实用拓展模组最基础的原料。当提供能量之后，它就能发出激光，当激光击中一些方块时，它会把周围能够转换的方块都转换了。每发射一束激光消耗CF，但是额外的消耗量取决于转换的方块。

这里有好几种透镜，它们都可以贴附在原子再构器上，但是并不是所有的透镜的功能都那么讨人喜欢。查看“再构机的透镜”章节查询更多重要信息。当使用红石火把右击原子再构机，可以在接收红石信号停止工作和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间之间切换。

需要注意的是，下面列出的合成表都没有透镜相关的说明因为合成它们不需要任何透镜。我想这应该是显而易见的吧。

当你合成很多物品时，你也许会想找到一种方式来自动化这个过程。这里提供了一个非常简单的方式：在原子再构机的对面放置精准自动投掷器（可以在“所有物品和搜索”条目找到它）接下来，在合适的位置放置物品吸收器，并且设置好白名单。接下来你只需要在投掷器里面丢进原料，就能在吸收器里面得到你想要的东西。

分子转化剂
entries.bodyEn:
The Atomic Reconstructor is used to craft Crystals, which are the main crafting ingredient in most items from Actually Additions. Upon being supplied with power, it shoots out a Laser. It will convert all surrounding items and blocks along the beam's path, provided they can be converted, until it hits a block.

When shooting a laser, it uses 1000 CF, but additional rates vary depending on the conversion. There are various Lenses that can be attached to the Reconstructor that don't all follow the default behavior of the Reconstructor and are able to do some neat things. See the Reconstruction section in the booklet for more information.

When right-clicking the Reconstructor with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses. It should be noted that any recipes listed without information about Lenses don't use one. I thought that was obvious.

When you have crafted a couple of items, you might want to find a way to automate this. There is a very simple way to do accomplish this: Place the Atomic Reconstructor down facing into a Precision Dropper (to find it, look it up in the All Items Entry!). Next, place a Ranged Collector in the area that has the converted items set as a allowlist. Now you can just chuck your raw materials into the Dropper to convert them!

Molecular Transformilator

entries.body: 电池是个储存并携带CF能量的好方案。它们可以在充能站中充电并在释能站中放电。当手持它时，可以通过Shift右击来转换至释能模式。这一意味着它能够被物品栏的其他东西充能。
entries.bodyEn: Batteries are a good way to store CF to move around. They can be charged in an Energizer and discharged in an Enervator. When holding them in hand, they can be sneak-right-clicked to put them into discharge mode. This means that they will charge any other items in your inventory.

entries.body: 生物反应器使用多种多样的种子，食物或者作物来产生CF！使用方式很简单，只需要在它的GUI里面放上这些东西。不过你很快就会发现，这东西产能并不是很多。实际上是这样的，你放置的种子，食物或者作物种类越多，它的产能就越多。
entries.bodyEn: The Bio Reactor uses all types of seeds, foodstuffs and plants to generate CF! To do this, just place the items in its GUI. If you try this out, you will notice that it doesn't generate that much power by default. However, the more different kinds of plants, seeds and foodstuffs it has, the more power it will generate!

entries.body:
方块破坏器能够破坏它前方的方块。它可以朝任意方向摆放。当手拿红石火把右键单击它时，它将在接受红石信号停用和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间切换。

方块放置器能够在它前方放置方块。它可以朝向任意方向摆放。当手拿红石火把右键单击它时，它将在接受红石信号停用和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间切换。

流体成型器放置你供应给它的液体。每消耗1000mB的液体来放置一个液体方块。当手拿红石火把右键单击它时，它将在接受红石信号停用和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间之间切换。

流体吸收器从它前方收集1000mB的液体，即一桶。当手拿红石火把右键单击它时，它将在接受红石信号停用和接收红石脉冲工作两种模式之间切换。
entries.bodyEn:
The Breaker breaks blocks in front of it. It can be oriented in every direction. When right-clicking it with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses.

The Placer places blocks in front of it. It can be oriented in every direction. When right-clicking it with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses.

The Fluid Placer places liquids you supply it with. It needs 1000mB to place one block. When right-clicking it with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses. A Comparator will mesaure its Fluid Amount.

The Fluid Collector will collect 1000mB of liquids in front of it, that's a filled bucket. When right-clicking it with a Redstone Torch in hand, it will change between a mode where it gets deactivated by Redstone and a mode where it responds to pulses. A Comparator will mesaure its Fluid Amount.

entries.body:
那些在野外随处可见的油菜可以制成各种各样的东西！你可以油菜提炼菜籽油或原油并以此产出CF。首先你需要用油菜压榨机将一定量，油菜提炼为菜籽油。压榨机本身的能耗是CF/t。然后，用发酵桶可将菜籽油转化为原油。最终产出的原油可在原油发电机中当作燃料。产出能量速率能够在GUI中看到，不过，它还可以被升级来产出更多能量！

一开始，你可以使用发酵桶将菜籽油转换为精致菜籽油。如果你还不满意它的产电量，把精致菜籽油放置在地上，然后丢进一个晶化油菜籽就能变成晶化油。如果这还不满意，再丢进去一个充能油菜籽就能变成充能油！

发酵桶也能够被比较器检测，输出的信号强弱取决于输出槽容积的百分比。

如果你打掉了原油发电机，里面的液体也会得到保留。如果你想清空它，只需要放置在合成栏合成一次，所有的液体就会被清除。原油发电机收到红石信号也会停止工作。
entries.bodyEn:
Using Canola, you can make a simple, yet effective power generation system from natural resources. To do this, first find some Canola Plants in the wild and plant them on your farm. The Canola you get out of them can be used in a Canola Press to make Canola Oil. This can be used in an Oil Generator. It displays the amount of power it generates in its GUI, however, it can be upgraded further to yield more power than that!

For starters, you can use a Fermenting Barrel to convert the Canola Oil into Refined Canola Oil. If you're still not satisfied with the power that generates, place the refined canola oil on the ground and throw in a Crystallized Canola Seed to make Crystallized Oil.  If that isn't enough for you either, make an Empowered Canola Seed and toss that into some Crystallized Oil to get Empowered Oil!

The Fermenting Barrel can have a Comparator attached to it which will result in the Redstone strength being equivalent to the percentage of the output tank.

If you break the Oil Generator, it will keep the liquid inside. Place it in the crafting grid to empty it out. It will stop generating when powered by Redstone. Additionally, using a Comparator will yield the percentage of energy stored.

entries.body: 煤炭发电机利用任何可以作为原版熔炉燃料的物品产生功率为CF/t的CF能量。注意，它只会在产生的能量有处可去的时候消耗燃料。
entries.bodyEn: The Coal Generator generates  CF/t through the use of everything that can be put into a furnace. Note that it only starts burning something up if the buffer isn't already full of power. It will stop generating when powered by Redstone. Additionally, using a Comparator will yield the percentage of energy stored.

entries.body:
咖啡机用于制造一种类似于药水，可以给予玩家几种附加效果的咖啡。为了使用它，你需要空杯子和咖啡豆。在野外可以发现咖啡豆，你可以在耕地上种植它。咖啡机需要CF/t的能源供给，每制作一杯咖啡需要mB的水。如果你想知道每种加入咖啡的物品都有什么用，翻到后几面的咖啡机配方，然后把鼠标悬停在物品的上方即可。

为了能让咖啡有实际的药水效果接下来的几页给出了详细说明。加入的东西越多，那么提供的药水等级也会越高。药水的最高等级取决于最多能放入的物品数量。放置顺序说明：举个例子，当你想要给你的咖啡加点牛奶（翻到最后一页可以了解它详细的的工作原理）你必须要按照一定的物品栏编号顺序放置物品，才能冲泡出你想要的咖啡。

这是一个示例配方，制作一杯拥有抗火Ⅰ, 0:20和速度Ⅰ, 2:30效果的咖啡。

牛奶对于咖啡来说也很重要：它能为所有的药水效果提供2分钟延时，但会降低一个药水等级。如果原本的药水等级就是1，那么牛奶会移除这个效果。

如果你看到了这一页，说明你要么安装了HarvestCraft，要么你在看lang文件。这些东西是为素食主义者准备的牛奶的替代品。
entries.bodyEn:
The Coffee Maker is a block used to make Coffee, a potion-like item that gives the user several buffs. To use the coffee maker, you need a Empty Cup,  Coffee Beans, which can be found in the wild, harvested and planted on farmland again,  CF/t and mB of Water per cup brewed. On the coffee maker recipe pages at the back, to see what the item does, just hover over the Cup of Coffee.

To actually give your coffee some buffs, put some of the items shown on the later pages into the slots on the right. The more slots are filled up with one item, the higher the Amplifier of the effect will be. The Maximum Amplifier is the max amount of items to be put into one coffee. Order matters: When using, for example, Milk (to see what it does exactly, go to a later page), you are going to have to plan the items out inside the numbered slots in such a way that it brews the coffee you want.

This is an example of a recipe making a coffee containing Fire Resistance 1 for 0:20 and Speed 1 for 2:30.

Milk is an important item when brewing coffee: It adds 2 minutes to all effects of items in slots with lower numbers while removing 1 amplifier. When the amplifier of an effect is 1, however, it will remove the effect.

The fact that you're reading this means that you either have HarvestCraft installed, or that you're looking at the lang file. This does the same thing as Milk, but for veggie guys.

entries.body: 磨粉机可把每种矿物，锭和宝石转变成对应的粉末，功率为CF/t。当你把矿物放入时，它们会被转变成双倍的粉末。两仓磨粉机基本上也是如此，然而它能一次粉碎2个矿石。在接下来几面，你将会看到一些使用到磨粉机的额外的实用配方。He's my crush
entries.bodyEn: The Crusher turns every ore, ingot and gem into its corresponding dust using  CF/t. When you put in Ores however, they will yield 2 pieces of dust. The Double Crusher basically does the same, however it can crush two ores at a time. On the following pages, you can see some additional useful recipes for inside the crusher. He's my crush

entries.body:
物品展示台是一种可将各种物品或方块展示出来的方块。只需要将待展示方块或物品右击放上去，这个方块或物品就会悬浮在展示台上方。再次右击可将其取下。除此以外，某些物品可令展示台发挥特殊效果，但这个功能需要消耗CF，阅读下一页可获得详细信息。

吹叶器以及高级吹叶器在展示架上时可以缓慢清理掉附近的草丛和树叶。药水指环在展示架上时也能发挥效果。普通版本只能将药水效果给予附近的一个生物，但高级版本可在大范围内给予任何生物以指定药水效果，但需要消耗大量CF。
entries.bodyEn:
The Display Stand is a block that can, for one, display any item or block by right-clicking with it onto the display stand. It will then be floating around on top. To take it out of there again, just right-click with an empty hand. The other feature, however, is that some items can be put onto it, having special effects. This, however, will require the stand to get CF. Read more on the next page.

The Leaf Blower and Advanced Leaf Blower can be placed onto the display stand, resulting in the grass and leaves around it to be blown away. Potion Rings can be placed onto the display stand. The normal version will give the specified potion effect to only one living entity in a small area, while the advanced version will give a potion effect to all living entities in a big area while using up a significant amount of CF.

充能台是一个用来充能水晶和其他物品的东西。首先，把需要充能的物品右击放置在充能台上面，之后在充能台四个方向相距两格的位置摆放上物品展示台，最后再在物品展示台上摆放上四个焦黑石英。下一页给出了一张说明图要激活这个仪式，那么每一个物品展示台都需要供应大量的CF能量，之后它们才能正常运转来给物品充能。

物品展示台的布局

我想所有MOD都得来个注魔祭坛

物品展示台也可以用来做很多其他的事情！翻到耗能方块查询更多信息！
entries.bodyEn:
The Empowerer is a mid-tier block that can be used to empower crystals and other items. To use it, items that should be empowered can be right-clicked onto the Empowerer, and empowering items need to be placed on Display Stands that are two blocks away, like seen in the picture on the next page. To then activate the process, every Display Stand needs to be powered with a lot of CF that is then drained to empower the item on the Empowerer.

The placement of the Display Stands

Because every mod needs an Infusion Altar

The Display Stand can also be used for other things! See the Blocks that use CF section for more info about it!
