entries.body:
高级方块放置器是初级方块放置器的升级版。

过滤器限定了何种方块可以作为放置的基础。比如，过滤石头，则放置器只能将方块等放置到石头上。过滤效果也会受到方向设置的影响；方向设定为“下”，其余与先前一致，则其只会放置到石头的顶面上。
entries.bodyEn:
The Advanced Block Placer is an upgraded version of the Simple Block Placer.

Use the filters to specify which blocks can be placed on. For example, filtering stone will only allow the placer to place on stone blocks. This filter also respects the direction setting, if set to 'down' it will only place on TOP of stone blocks.

entries.body: 设备通过 GUI 配置工作目标、过滤和红石行为。凝胶资源转化需把正确方块放在凝胶作用位置；进阶设备按界面要求接入能量与流体。
entries.bodyEn: Configure work targets, filters and redstone in the GUI. Goo transformations require valid blocks in its working positions; advanced devices may also need power or fluid.

entries.body:
初级投物器会将物品投出到世界中。

方向按钮用于改变投出的方向，默认为“下”，和普通的投掷器类似。需要注意，投物器所面对的位置即是投出的位置。

界面中的数量按钮用于设置投出的物品数量。

默认为 1，即每次投出 1 个物品；增加该数后会同时投出更多物品。

设置为 64 时，投物器会一次投出整组。

注意：设置为 64 并不意味着要存在 64 个物品，而是有则投之。

“拾取延时”按钮控制投出物品可被拾起前的延时。

Minecraft 中投出物品后，默认需要等待一段时间才可捡起。此按钮即控制这一延时的长短。

默认为 0，所有物品均可立即捡起。
entries.bodyEn:
The Simple Dropper is designed to drop items into the world.

The direction button changes the direction in which items are dropped - by default this is 'downwards' like a normal dropper. Keep in mind that it'll drop in the block space that the dropper is facing.

The number button on this screen controls the stack size thats dropped.

By default this is 1, meaning 1 item at a time will be dropped, but increasing it will mean more items will be dropped at a time.

When set to 64, it'll drop an entire stack at once.

Note: When set to 64, it doesn't NEED to have 64 items to drop, it'll just drop as many as it has.

The 'pickup delay' button on this screen controls the pickup delay applied to the items dropped.

By default in minecraft, when you drop an item on the ground, theres a short period of time before you can pick it up again. This button controls that delay for items dropped by the dropper.

The default is 0, meaning items can be picked up immediately.

entries.body:
高级流体收集器由初级流体收集器升级而来，能够从更大的区域内收集流体，且可以过滤收集何种流体。

向过滤槽中放入流体桶，即可过滤该流体。
entries.bodyEn:
Building on the Simple Fluid Collector, the Advanced Fluid Collector can collect fluids from a larger area, and offers the ability to filter upon which fluids are collected.

Simply place a bucket of the appropriate fluid in the filter slots to filter which fluids can be picked up.

entries.body:
悖论机器即是时间操纵技术的新一代产物！

它能够保存世界中一块区域的“快照”，也即记录你按下按钮那一刻该区域的实体和方块。

它还能回溯时间，让区域回到快照中的状态。

首先，放置机器并指定其作业区域，方式与大多数高级机器一致。

然后，在需保存的区域中放置任意矿石方块或任意实体。

最后，按下机器界面中的“保存区域快照”按钮。

机器的运作需要大量能量和时间流体。在清空区域中有关方块和实体后启动机器，清走的方块和实体便会重新出现！

注意：界面中有按钮可调整回溯仅“实体”、仅“方块”，或“方块和实体”。

不过从实际功能上来说，悖论机器并没有将实体和方块回溯到先前的某个时间点。

它更类似于从某个平行宇宙里拉来了那些实体，遵循的是那个宇宙的时间流，回溯到的是那边的过去。科技真是奇妙！

也就是说，复原得到的实体和快照里的实体不一定会完全一致。

警告！！！

过度使用此机器可能导致时空连续体的损坏，有可能出现悖论等副作用！机器会监测悖论能量的累积，并显示于界面中。

请酌情使用。

他们真该把警告印在咒语前面。
entries.bodyEn:
The paradox machine is the next evolution in Time Manipulation Technology!

It allows you to take a 'snapshot' of an area of the world, recording the entities and blocks that exist at the moment you click the button.

This machine can rewind time to the point where those things existed.

First, place the machine in the world, and designate an area of effect like with most advanced machines.

Second, place any Blocks (Raw Ores only!) or Entities (Zombies, cows, etc) into the area of effect that you'd like to save.

Finally, click the 'snapshot' button in the machine's UI.

Now, the machine will need a significant amount of both Power and Time Fluid.  After clearing the area of blocks or entities, activate the machine. The blocks and entities you've cleared will be restored!

Note: A button on the UI allows you to toggle between Entities Only, Blocks Only, or both.

Now, technically speaking, the Paradox Machine doesn't exactly revert to entities and blocks from a previous point in time.

Its more like it is grabbing that entity from a parallel universe at a prior point in its own time stream. Its all very technical!

What this means is the entities may not be EXACTLY identical to the one you snapshot.

WARNING!!!

Overuse of this machine can lead to some corruption of the space time continuum.  A dangerous side effect known as the Paradox can appear after extended use! The machine will track the buildup of paradox energy, and represent it on the UI.

User Discretion is Advised.

They should really print the warning before the spell.

entries.body:
高级流体放置器由初级流体放置器升级而来。

它能在更大的区域内放置流体。和高级方块放置器类似，它的过滤槽也能选定何种方块上可以放置流体。
entries.bodyEn:
The Advanced Fluid Placer builds upon the Simple Fluid Placer

It can place fluids in a larger area, and much like its partner, the Advanced Placer, the filter slots allow you to specify which blocks to place fluids on.

entries.body: 核源铁头盔的形制接近古代的战士头盔，能够提供基础的防护。它的防御力略强于铁头盔，且可经由升级和能力提升防护功能。
entries.bodyEn: The Ferricore Helmet offers basic protection with a style reminiscent of ancient warriors. It provides slightly better defense than iron helmets and has the potential to be upgraded with unique abilities to enhance its protective qualities.

entries.body:
高级传送枪的运作需要传送流体。制造这种流体只需往多态流体中投入传送流体催化剂。

需注意，在末地之外的不稳定传送流体会立即分解殆尽！

制作不稳定流体所需的催化剂。

而后需用虚空辉凝胶及以上品质的凝胶稳定流体。稳定后的流体可在末地外长时间存在。
entries.bodyEn:
Portal fluid is required to fuel the advanced portal gun.  Start by dropping a Portal Fluid Catalyst into a block of Polymorphic Fluid.

Note that the unstable version will immediately break down anywhere outside of the end!

The catalyst needed to create the unstable fluid.

Void Shimmer goo (or higher) can then be used to stabilize the fluid. Stabilized fluid can exist outside of the end.

entries.body: 虚空辉凝胶会将钻石块转化为粗苍穹晶矿簇。挖掘即可获得苍穹晶。
entries.bodyEn: Transformed by VoidShimmer Goo, a Diamond Block becomes a Raw Celestigem Block. Mine this block to get Celestigem.

entries.body:
由烈焰金斧升级而来，此斧使用 FE，容量为 10,000FE。可用便携发电器维持能量充足。

苍穹晶斧的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Advancing from Blazegold Axe, this axe harnesses Forge Energy, featuring a 10,000 FE storage. Maintain power levels with a Pocket Generator.

Celestigem Axe Crafting

entries.body: 苍穹晶靴子以 FE 为能源，最多可容纳 10,000FE。为保持状态最优，可以通过便携发电器维持能量水平。
entries.bodyEn: Celestigem Boots are powered by Forge Energy with a total capacity of 10,000 FE. For optimal performance, maintain charge via a Pocket Generator.

entries.body:
蚀空合金镐尖斧是最顶尖的组合工具，同时具有镐、斧、锹的功能，强大到堪称可畏。

可由蚀空合金镐、斧、锹在锻造台中制作，也可由苍穹晶镐尖斧在锻造台中升级而来。这两种方法均会保留已有的升级。
entries.bodyEn:
The Eclipse Alloy Paxel represents the pinnacle of tool integration, combining the functionality of a pickaxe, axe, and shovel into a single formidable tool.

Craft it either by combining an Eclipse Alloy Pickaxe, Axe, and Shovel in a smithing table, or upgrade a Celestigem Paxel using the smithing table. Both methods preserve any installed upgrades.

entries.body: 在烈焰蕾凝胶旁放置原初煤炭块即可制造出烈焰烬质。其燃烧温度和效率均高于原初煤炭，每刻产能速度也更快。
entries.bodyEn: Blaze Ember is crafted by placing a block of Primal Coal next to a Blazebloom Goo. It burns hotter and more efficiently than its predecessor, generating even more RF/T.

entries.body:
震地升级能够唤出地震的力量。激活时，此升级会制造出一道冲击波，击退附近实体。

此能力需要激活才可使用，因此需要分配键位。
entries.bodyEn:
Unleash seismic force with the Ground Stomp upgrade. When activated, this upgrade creates a shockwave that knocks back nearby entities.

This is an activated ability, so you'll need to assign a hotkey to use it.

entries.body: 喷溅升级可以加强远程攻击。此升级会让箭矢击中时产生喷溅药水效果，从而令药水扩散到周围。
entries.bodyEn: Enhance your ranged attacks with the Splash upgrade. This upgrade converts arrow impacts into splash effects, spreading the impact over a wider area.

entries.body: 烈焰金靴子对足部的防护能力较强，且自带“熔岩修补”能力。只需投入熔岩源即能修复如初。
entries.bodyEn: Blazegold Boots provide enhanced foot protection and come with the Lava Repair ability. To fully repair these boots, drop them into a lava source block.

entries.body:
比核源铁镐速度更快，还拥有“熔岩修补”——投入熔岩时能够修复自身。

烈焰金镐的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Faster than the Ferricore Pickaxe and includes 'Lava Repair'—repairs itself when dropped into lava.

Blazegold Pickaxe Crafting

entries.body:
蚀空合金斧能以极高效率砍伐树木，能量上限也抬高许多。

它正是为极其劳累的伐木作业而造的。

蚀空合金斧的配方
entries.bodyEn:
This Eclipse Alloy Axe excels in woodcutting with high efficiency and increased energy storage.

It's engineered for enduring the most demanding lumber tasks.

Eclipse Alloy Axe Crafting

entries.body:
在搬运大量材料的作业效率上，蚀空合金锹凭借庞大的能量容量立于顶点，无工具能出其之右。

此锹足以胜任最艰苦的挖掘工作。

蚀空合金锹的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Eclipse Alloy Shovel is unmatched in moving large amounts of material efficiently with its enhanced energy capacity.

Ideal for handling the toughest digging challenges.

Eclipse Alloy Shovel Crafting

entries.body: 追踪箭矢升级能增强弓箭的精确度。此升级射出的弹射物会主动追踪附近目标，百发百中。
entries.bodyEn: Enhance your precision with the Homing upgrade. Projectiles modified with this upgrade will seek out nearby targets, ensuring your shots never miss.

entries.body: 多态催化剂是将水转变为多态流体的关键原材料。它能重整水的分子结构，令其接纳其他元素并与之成键。如此产出的流体便可以用作模组中多种特化流体的基底。
entries.bodyEn: The Polymorphic Catalyst is a key ingredient used to transform water into Polymorphic Fluid. It enables the molecular restructuring of water to accept and bond with other elemental properties, making it foundational for producing various specialized fluids within the mod.

entries.body: 核源铁锭由粗核源铁烧炼而来，粗矿又是由粗核源铁矿簇掉落而来。这些铸锭的耐用性和强度均得到了提升，可以看做普通铁的上位替代品。
entries.bodyEn: Ferricore Ingots are obtained by smelting Raw Ferricore, which is mined from Raw Ferricore Blocks. These ingots are enhanced for durability and strength, serving as a superior alternative to ordinary iron.

entries.body: 核源铁护腿的设计兼顾了舒适性和防御力，其耐久度较高，亦可通过升级加快移动速度。
entries.bodyEn: Designed for both comfort and protection, Ferricore Leggings provide enhanced durability and the option for further upgrades to increase your movement speed.

entries.body:
由坚固的核源铁造成，此锹很适合挖掘泥土、沙子和沙砾。它的表现略强于铁锹，也能加装各种升级，获得多种能力。

核源铁锹的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Crafted from durable Ferricore, this shovel is ideal for digging through dirt, sand, and gravel. It offers improved performance over iron shovels and can be upgraded with various abilities.

Ferricore Shovel Crafting

entries.body:
矿石透视升级能助你发现隐藏的宝藏。这一强大升级能让你透过固体方块视物，从而发掘出深藏于岩层之中的高价值矿石。

此升级可替代矿石扫描升级，激活方式则与之相同。
entries.bodyEn:
Discover hidden riches with the Ore X-Ray upgrade. This powerful tool allows you to see through solid blocks, revealing valuable ores hidden away in the stone.

This upgrade replaces the ore scanner upgrade, and is activated in the same way.

entries.body: 烈焰金头盔的防御能力在核源铁头盔之上，亦有独特的“熔岩修补”能力。将此头盔投入熔岩源即可完全修复。
entries.bodyEn: The Blazegold Helmet offers superior protection compared to its Ferricore predecessor, enhanced with the unique Lava Repair ability. Drop this item into a lava source block to fully repair it.

entries.body: 苍穹晶头盔的耐久度以 FE 为基石，最多能存储 10,000FE。便携发电器可保其能量充足。
entries.bodyEn: The Celestigem Helmet harnesses Forge Energy for durability, storing up to 10,000 FE. Keep it charged using a Pocket Generator.

entries.body:
意识摧毁升级能够禁用目标生物的 AI。受影响的生物会永远失去意识，其脑部将被时间锁定，它也不会再自主行动。

此能力需要激活才可使用，因此需在工具设定界面中绑定键位。
entries.bodyEn:
The Mental Obliteration upgrade disables the artificial intelligence of the targeted mob. The mob will forever be completely brainless, taking no further action, due to a complete time lock on it's brain.

This is an activated ability, and must be bound to a hotkey in the tool settings menu.

entries.body: 苍穹晶是挖掘粗苍穹晶矿簇的掉落物。这些宝石的性质独特，是高级神秘装置的理想材料；从储能设备到传送设施，制造和搭建它们都需要苍穹晶的参与。
entries.bodyEn: Celestigems are obtained by mining Raw Celestigem Blocks. These gems possess unique properties ideal for high-tier mystical applications, including storing energy and facilitating teleportation abilities.

entries.body:
烈焰金剑的升级版本，此剑使用 FE 而非耐久度。它最多能装下 10,000FE，推荐配备便携发电器保证能量供应。

苍穹晶剑的配方
entries.bodyEn:
An upgrade to Blazegold Sword, this sword uses Forge Energy instead of durability. It holds 10,000 FE, best kept charged with a Pocket Generator.

Celestigem Sword Crafting

entries.body:
为烈焰金镐加上了 FE 存储功能，此工具最多可容纳 10,000FE。长时间使用时，需配用便携发电器充能。

苍穹晶镐的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Enhancing the Blazegold Pickaxe with Forge Energy storage, this tool holds up to 10,000 FE. For continuous use, charge with a Pocket Generator.

Celestigem Pickaxe Crafting

entries.body:
高级传送枪拓展了普通传送枪的功能，加入了一个收藏菜单。按下键位可打开菜单，默认为 V。

可在菜单中收藏位置，即保存玩家当前所处的位置。而后在其他地方发射一次，便会打开通向已保存位置的传送门。

此物品接受多个收藏项，可以重命名，如有需要也可移除。此外，“保持菜单开启”选项可以让菜单保持在打开状态，或是禁用以让菜单仅在按住键位时出现。

使用时必须灌入传送流体，右击流体源即可。也可使用流体罐。
entries.bodyEn:
The Advanced Portal Gun enhances the functionality of the standard portal gun by adding a favorites menu. Activate the menu with the default hotkey 'v'.

In the menu, you can add locations, allowing you to save the position where your player is standing. Fire a projectile that opens a portal to the saved location from anywhere.

You can hold multiple favorites, edit their names, and remove them as needed. Additionally, you can toggle the 'Stay Open' option to control whether the menu stays open or requires you to hold the hotkey.

You must fill the gun with Portal Fluid, by right clicking on a source block, or using a Fluid Canister.

entries.body: 药箭升级能为你的箭矢带来一丝魔法。此升级可让箭矢带有药水效果，以此给予目标效果。
entries.bodyEn: Add a magical touch to your arrows with the Potion Arrow upgrade. This upgrade allows arrows to carry potion effects, inflicting additional effects on targets.

entries.body:
蚀空合金弓即是远程武器的顶点，能量储备充足，可供长时间使用。

此弓有 4 个药水罐槽，发射出的箭矢因此可携带多种效果。

蚀空合金弓的配方
entries.bodyEn:
The Eclipse Alloy Bow embodies the ultimate in ranged weaponry, providing vast energy reserves for prolonged use.

It features 4 slots for Potion Canisters, enhancing arrows with various effects. Potion Canister

Eclipse Alloy Bow Crafting

entries.body:
疾跑速度升级能强化你的疾跑能力。此升级会大幅加快你疾跑的速度，长途旅行便不再费时。

可以加装于核源铁护腿，更高品质护腿的疾跑速度也更快。设置界面中有滑块可供调整。
entries.bodyEn:
Boost your sprinting capabilities with the Run Speed upgrade. This enhancement significantly increases your running speed, allowing you to traverse large distances in less time.

Can be installed on Ferricore level leggings, but higher tier leggings can allow for faster run speeds. A slider is available in the settings screen to adjust it.

entries.body:
灭火升级能助你抵御各种火焰危害。这一便捷升级能够自动扑灭玩家身上的火焰，可令你免遭烈焰人突然出现之苦。

注意：此升级在能再次灭火前有冷却时间。盔甲的品质越高，冷却时间也越短。
entries.bodyEn:
Protect yourself from fiery danger with the Extinguish upgrade. This handy upgrade automatically extinguishes fire on the player, ensuring safety from sudden blazes.

Note: There is a cooldown before it can extinguish you again. This cooldown is shorter at higher tiers of armor.

entries.body:
死亡召回图腾会在一次致命错误后给你第二次机会。放在物品栏中后，它会在死亡时激活，并绑定至你死亡的位置。

手持激活图腾长按右键即可传送到死亡点。图腾使用后会消失。
entries.bodyEn:
The Totem of Death Recall provides a second chance after a fatal mistake. Keep it in your inventory, and it will automatically activate on death, binding itself to the position you died at.

Hold Right-click the activated totem to teleport back to your death point. The totem is consumed upon use.

entries.body: 这双高等级靴子最多可以存储 500,000FE，灵活性出众，缓冲能力也超群。配备便携发电器充能，即可保持最优状态。
entries.bodyEn: These advanced boots store up to 500,000 FE, providing excellent mobility and energy absorption. Always keep them charged via a Pocket Generator for best results.

entries.body:
烈焰燃液是可观的能量源。它由未精炼的烈焰燃液加工而来，未精炼的此类燃液则由向多态流体中投入烈焰烬质制成。将所得的混合物放置在烈焰蕾凝胶即可进行精炼。

烈焰燃液作为燃料较为高效，可用在燃液发电器中产生能量。
entries.bodyEn:
Refined Blaze Ember Fuel is a potent source of energy. It is produced by processing Unrefined Blaze Ember Fuel, which is obtained by dropping Blaze Ember into Polymorphic Fluid. Place this mixture beside a Blazebloom Goo block to refine it.

Refined Blaze Ember Fuel is an efficient fuel, and can be used to generate energy in the Fuel Generator.

entries.body:
烈焰推进手杖是四处走动的绝佳方式！其中内置有“空气推进”能力。

右击可激活此能力（也可再工具设定界面中自定义键位），并向面朝的方向将你自己发射出去。

更高品质手杖的功能更强，工具设置界面中有滑块可供调整此能力。

手持此手杖时不会受到摔落伤害。千万记住是拿在手里！

此工具也自带“熔岩修补”能力，投入熔岩源即可修复。
entries.bodyEn:
The Blazejet Wand is a great way to get around! It comes with the air burst ability built in.

Activate this ability using right click (or customize it in the tool settings screen) to blast you in the direction you're facing.

Higher tiers of this wand allow you to go even further, which you can configure with a slider in the tool settings screen.

While holding this in your hand, you won't take any fall damage. But ensure its in your hand!

This tool comes with the lava repair ability, so drop it in a lava source block to repair it.

entries.body:
时间水晶的制备并不简单；但在历经种种困难之后，获得的水晶仅凭自身就能影响时间！制造这种水晶分为多步，会在后页大致说明。

首先，用暗影脉凝胶将紫水晶母岩转换为时间水晶母岩。

时间水晶母岩必须从 Minecraft 的主世界、下界、末地这三个维度中吸取时间能量。

在主世界中放置时间水晶母岩，并等待一段时间。它会开始吸收主世界的时间能量，同时会显现出蓝色的粒子。母岩变色之后，就可以进行下一步了。

此时需要将母岩搬运到下界，但破坏方块也意味着毁坏母岩，就算使用精准采集也无法避免。你可能需要其他能跨越维度的搬运手段。母岩处于下界后即会开始吸收下界的时间能量，显现为橙色的粒子。母岩变色之后就可以再次搬运了。

最后，将母岩移动到末地。它会在此处吸收末地的时间能量，显现为绿色的粒子。上述步骤完成后，母岩会变为绿色，晶芽也会开始渐渐形成。

时间晶芽的每次生长都会消耗一部分时间能量。千万小心，不要在晶芽完全长成前破坏它们，否则就完全没有产物了！

母岩中的时间能量终究会耗尽。此时需要再次将其移动到主世界中，从头开始上述步骤。注意：耗尽时间能量后，母岩上的晶芽便不再生长。而且，如果仅移动母岩，附着在其上的晶芽也会碎裂。推荐同时移动所有水晶和母岩。

已有报告称，持有这些水晶会导致不同寻常的时间扭曲现象。务必留心。
entries.bodyEn:
Time Crystals are no trivial task to create, but they are very worth while as they have the power to affect time itself!  Creating them is a multi step process that will be outlined in the following pages.

First, use Shadowpulse Goo to convert a budding Amethyst block into a Budding Time Crystal block.

The Budding Time Crystal block must absorb time energy from each of Minecraft's 3 dimensions: The Overworld, The Nether, and The End.

Place the Budding Time Crystal block in The Overworld for some time. It will begin absorbing Overworld Time Energy, which you'll be able to see as blue particle effects. Once the block changes color, its ready for the next step.

You'll need to move the block into The Nether at this point, however you cannot break the block without shattering it - Even with Silk touch! You'll need to find Some Other Way to move it across dimensions.  Once in the nether, it will absorb Nether Time Energy, which will appear as orange particle effects. Once the block changes color, its ready to move again.

Finally, move the block into The End. Here, it will absord End Time Energy, visualized as Green particle effects. Once complete, the block will turn green, and Time Crystal Buds will begin to appear.

Each time a time crystal bud sprouts, it consumes some of the time energy. Ensure you don't break the time crystal buds until they've fully grown, or you will destroy them, receiving nothing in return!

Eventually, all of the time energy in the budding time crystal will be consumed.  At this point, you'll need to move it back to the Overworld and begin the charging process from the start. Note: While out of charge, the buds will not grow any longer. In addition, if you move JUST the Budding Time Crystal, the buds themselves will shatter. Its recommended to move the Crystal and its buds All Together.

Some people have reported unusual time distortions while carrying these around.  You should be cautious.

entries.body:
核源铁锄升级而来，挥舞速度更快，且拥有“熔岩修补”。用其耕犁泥土等可将其变为烈焰蕾壤；这种土壤助农作物生长的能力更强，还具有自动收获功能——其上植物会自动掉落资源。

收获到的物品很快就会消失。需使用物品拾取器高效收集掉落物。

烈焰金锄的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Improves upon the Ferricore Hoe with quicker action and 'Lava Repair'. Tilling creates Blazebloom soil, which boosts crop growth even more, and enables auto-harvesting - causing plants to drop their resources automatically.

Harvested items quickly despawn. Use the Item Collector to gather drops efficiently.

Blazegold Hoe Crafting

entries.body:
苍穹晶镐尖斧融合了镐、斧、锹的能力。它由上述工具合成而来，也会继承它们的升级；可谓功能繁多，且有额外用途。

在锻造台中组合苍穹晶镐、斧、锹即可获得。先前加装的升级会保留到镐尖斧中。
entries.bodyEn:
The Celestigem Paxel combines the capabilities of a pickaxe, axe, and shovel. Crafted with the respective tools, it inherits their upgrades, offering versatility and extended utility.

Craft it by combining a Celestigem Pickaxe, Axe, and Shovel in a smithing table. Any installed upgrades on the tools will carry over to the paxel.

entries.body:
抵消摔落升级能避免意外摔落造成伤害。此升级会完全吸收摔落伤害，着陆时便不再有受伤之虞。

注意：缓冲摔落需要消耗能量。抵消的伤害越多，消耗的能量也越多。苍穹晶靴子可没有那么多能量……
entries.bodyEn:
Protect yourself from accidental falls with the Negate Fall Damage upgrade. This upgrade absorbs all fall damage, ensuring your safe landing.

Note: It uses energy to soften your fall. The more damage it blocks, the more energy it uses. Celestigem boots don't have a ton of energy....

entries.body:
时间水晶真是好用！不过，随身携带有时也会产生些意料之外的副作用。而且在进一步研究后，它可能会打开时间修改学领域的大门，也许还能助你直接修改时间。

加装此升级后，它便会保护你免受玩弄时间所致的奇怪效果！
entries.bodyEn:
Time Crystals are amazing! However, they can sometimes have unintended side effects from carrying them around. Furthermore, they may lead to time altering fields and abilities after further research.

Equipping this upgrade will protection you from any strange effects from playing around with time!

entries.body:
多态化形手杖利用了烈焰金蕴含的惰性能量，以激活多态流体，并将生物转换成另一种生物！

只需对敌对生物激活手杖，它就将变成另一种敌对生物。对友好生物的效果一致。

构造如此简单的法杖不能保证转换结果可控，也无法相互转换敌对和友好生物。即便如此，你也认为这杆手杖可以升级，从而能完成这些任务！
entries.bodyEn:
The polymorphic wand uses the latent energy available in Blazegold to activate the Polymorphic Fluid, randomly changing mobs from one form to another!

Simply activate the wand on a hostile entity, and it'll convert randomly into another hostile entity. The same can happen with peaceful entities.

With this simple form of the wand, it is not possible to guarantee which mob you will get, nor is is possible to swap hostile and friendly mobs with each other. You suspect the wand can be upgraded to allow for these features, however!

entries.body: 此工具可以复制机器的设置。Shift 右击机器即可复制其设置，再右击另一个机器可以粘贴。对空气点击会打开菜单界面，其中能选择复制何种设置。
entries.bodyEn: This tool allows for the copying of machine settings. Shift-right click on a Machine to copy its settings, then right click on another machine to paste them. Click in the air to open a menu and select specific settings to copy.

entries.body:
蚀空合金镐的耐久度极其深厚，其储能能力也极为强大，可以近乎完美地挖掘最坚固的方块。

此镐支持各式高级挖掘能力。

蚀空合金镐的配方
entries.bodyEn:
The Eclipse Alloy Pickaxe combines immense durability with powerful energy storage, making it perfect for harvesting even the toughest materials.

It is capable of supporting high-level mining enhancements.

Eclipse Alloy Pickaxe Crafting

entries.body:
一忘皆空升级能让敌人思绪混乱。看向敌人并用键位激活此能力后，它便会立即遗忘你！

而且，它只有在一会后才能再以你为目标。此能力有冷却时间。
entries.bodyEn:
Confuse your foes with the Stupefy upgrade. When looking at an enemy and activating this ability with a hotkey, they will immediately forget about you!.

Furthermore, they won't be able to target you again for a few moments. This ability has a cooldown!

entries.body:
时间手杖可随身携带，能够利用时间水晶的时间修改能力。

需注意，使用此手杖前应先提供 FE 和时间流体。

右击任何按刻运行的方块即可，熔炉等机器、小麦等农作物均在此列。第一次点击会让方块以两倍速运转。再次点击变为 4 倍，三次变为 8 倍，最高可达 #time_wand.time_wand_max_multiplier# 倍！

每次加速都会消耗 FE 和时间流体，加速越多消耗越大。

速度提升效果会持续 30 秒。
entries.bodyEn:
The Time Wand is a portable way to take advantage of the time altering abilities of Time Crystals

Do note, to use this wand you'll need to charge it with both Forge Energy and Time Fluid

Simply right click on any block that ticks - this includes machines like Furnaces, and crops like Wheat. At first, it will cause the block to run twice as fast. Click again to double it to 4x, then 8x, all the way up to #time_wand.time_wand_max_multiplier#x speed!

Each acceleration will consume both Forge Energy and Time Fluid based on how fast the speed increase is.

This speed increase will last for 30 seconds.

entries.body:
挖掘速度比核源铁锹更快。“熔岩修补”可让其在熔岩中修复自身。

烈焰金锹的配方
entries.bodyEn:
This shovel digs faster than the Ferricore Shovel. It repairs itself when dropped into lava via 'Lava Repair'.

Blazegold Shovel Crafting

entries.body:
烈焰蕾凝胶能将金块转化为粗烈焰金矿簇。挖掘它会掉落粗烈焰金，这种材料可以烧炼为烈焰金锭。

破坏粗烈焰金矿簇时会掉落粗烈焰金
entries.bodyEn:
A Gold Block transformed by Blazebloom Goo becomes a Raw Blazegold Block. Mining this block yields Raw Blazegold items, which are smelted into Blazegold Ingots.

Raw Blazegold drops when you break the Raw Blazegold Block

entries.body:
便携发电器是一种便携式的能量源，是随时随地保持耗能设备能量供应充足的完美设备。对依赖 FE 的冒险者至关重要。

手持点击打开界面，再放入煤炭、特化煤炭一类的燃料即可！

更高品质燃料的燃烧时间更长，燃烧温度也更高，即高品质燃料的每刻产能也更多。便携发电器也接受燃料罐。
entries.bodyEn:
The Pocket Generator is a portable energy source, perfect for keeping energy-dependent tools and armor charged while on the go. Essential for adventurers relying on Forge Energy.

Open the UI by clicking it, and insert fuel in the form of coal or upgraded coals from this mod!

Higher tier fuels burn hotter and longer, so you'll get more forge energy / tick if you use higher tier fuels.  You can also use the Fuel Canister.

entries.body:
暗影脉凝胶会将下界合金块转化成粗蚀空合金矿簇。挖掘它会掉落粗蚀空合金，这种材料可以烧炼为蚀空合金锭。

破坏粗蚀空合金矿簇时会掉落粗蚀空合金
entries.bodyEn:
When a Netherite Block is transformed by Shadowpulse Goo, it becomes a Raw Eclipse Alloy Block. Mine this block to obtain Raw Eclipse Alloy items, which can be smelted into Eclipse Alloy Ingots.

Raw Eclipse Alloy drops when you break the Raw Eclipse Alloy Block

entries.body: 这副护腿正是为顶尖耐力而生，它能容纳高达 500,000FE 的能量。可以选用便携发电器保持能量水平和实际效能。
entries.bodyEn: Crafted for ultimate endurance, these leggings are powered by 500,000 FE of Forge Energy. Use a Pocket Generator to maintain their power levels and functionality.

entries.body: 核源铁胸甲能比普通的铁胸甲更耐用，也能提供更为坚固的防御。它还可接受特殊升级，进一步提升防御能力。
entries.bodyEn: Offering robust protection, the Ferricore Chestplate is crafted to endure more than standard iron armor. It’s also eligible for special upgrades, enhancing its defensive capabilities.

entries.body:
生物捕捉器是能捕捉和释放实体的新颖工具。对着实体掷出即可捕捉该实体，捕捉后再掷出即可释放。

也可以放到某些过滤器中，用以过滤特定类型的实体，比如蓝色的绵羊。
entries.bodyEn:
The Creature Catcher is an innovative tool for capturing and releasing entities. Simply throw it at an entity to capture it, and toss it again to release the captured entity.

You can also use it in some filters to filter very specific types of entities, such as only filtering blue sheep.

entries.body: 在虚空辉凝胶旁放置烈焰烬质块即可获得虚炎煤炭。这种煤炭拥有神秘的性质，其能量产出也因此强于其前体。
entries.bodyEn: Voidflame Coal is obtained by placing a block of Blaze Ember next to a VoidShimmer Goo. This coal variant has mystical properties, enhancing its energy output.

entries.body: 烈焰金护腿灵活性与防御性并重。将这副护腿投入熔岩源，其上“熔岩修补”能力便可令自身恢复如初。
entries.bodyEn: Blazegold Leggings offer superior mobility and protection. Utilize the Lava Repair ability by dropping these leggings into a lava source block for full repair.

entries.body: 滞留升级能够扩大药水的作用范围。此升级能让弓射出的药箭留下滞留型药水云，对环境和敌人造成长时间的伤害。
entries.bodyEn: Amplify your area of effect with the Lingering upgrade. This upgrade causes your bow's potions to leave a lingering effect, prolonging their impact on the environment and enemies.

entries.body:
比核源铁弓更强劲。拥有“熔岩修补”。

它还有 2 个槽位用于存放药水罐。

烈焰金弓的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Stronger than the Ferricore Bow. Features 'Lava Repair'.

In addition, it has 2 slots for Potion Canister

Blazegold Bow Crafting

entries.body: 生物扫描升级需激活使用，适用于核源铁及以上的剑。激活后，附近的敌人会散发出粒子；这些粒子隔着方块也能看见。
entries.bodyEn: The Mob Scanner upgrade is an activated ability, and can be installed on swords starting at Ferricore. When you activate this ability, nearby enemies will appear with particles that you can see through blocks.

entries.body:
由烈焰金锹锻造而来，此锹以 FE 为运作能源。其中足够存下 10,000FE，便携发电器可让其能量充足。

苍穹晶锹的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Building upon Blazegold Shovel, this shovel operates on Forge Energy. Equipped with a 10,000 FE capacity, keep it powered using a Pocket Generator.

Celestigem Shovel Crafting

entries.body: 烈焰金锭是烧炼粗烈焰金的产物，粗烈焰金又是挖掘粗烈焰金矿簇的掉落物。合成带有魔法性质的物品离不开这些铸锭。
entries.bodyEn: Blazegold Ingots are derived from smelting Raw Blazegold, harvested from Raw Blazegold Blocks. These ingots are essential for crafting items imbued with magical properties.

entries.body:
重锤升级能够拓展你的采掘能力。这一强力升级可以单次破坏多个方块，以此提升挖掘工作的速度和效率。

加装于烈焰金镐时，可按照 3x3 挖掘。苍穹晶则可按照 5x5，蚀空合金为 7x7。点击设置界面中此升级的按钮可以切换模式。
entries.bodyEn:
Expand your mining capabilities with the Hammer upgrade. This powerful tool upgrade allows you to break multiple blocks at once, making mining faster and more efficient.

On the blazegold pickaxe, it will mine 3x3. Celestigem allows you to upgrade to 5x5, and eclipse alloy pickaxes can do 7x7. Click on the upgrade button in the UI to toggle modes.

entries.body:
游泳速度升级可让你在水体里的行动变得格外敏捷。此能力会大幅提升游泳速度，水下探索也因此速度加快。

更高品质盔甲的游泳速度也更快。设置界面中有滑块可供调整。
entries.bodyEn:
Navigate waters with unprecedented agility with the Swim Speed upgrade. This enhancement significantly increases your swimming speed, allowing for quicker underwater exploration.

Higher tiered armor allows for even faster traversal, with a slider in the settings menu.

entries.body:
右击药水罐可打开其界面，其中会接受药水瓶。放入的药水会装入罐内的储罐。

可以把药水罐放到弓中，该弓发射出的箭矢便会携带药水效果。

弓若要使用药水罐，其上应预先加装相应的升级。

药水罐也应放入弓设置界面中相应的槽位。
entries.bodyEn:
The Potion Canister can be right-clicked to open a UI where you can insert potion bottles. These will fill the canister's internal fluid holder.

This canister can be slotted into bows, and the potion effects will apply to the arrows you shoot.

Ensure that the bow has the appropriate upgrade(s) installed to take advantage of this canister.

Ensure that the canister is slotted into the appropriate slot within the bow's tool settings.

entries.body:
核源铁锄是开垦与耕种的绝佳工具。它接受多种升级。

用于开垦泥土时，核源铁锄会将其转变为原初浆壤。这种土壤不会被踩坏，可保证其上农作物完好无损。这些农作物的生长速度也略有加快。

核源铁锄的配方
entries.bodyEn:
This Ferricore Hoe provides an excellent tool for preparing and maintaining farmland. It is eligible for various upgrades.

When used to till dirt, the Ferricore Hoe converts it into Primogel Soil. Primogel Soil offers the benefit of being trample-proof, ensuring that your crops remain undisturbed. Crops also grow just a little bit faster

Ferricore Hoe Crafting

entries.body:
此升级会给予周围所有活体“发光”效果，所有怪物和动物都一样！

此能力需要激活才可使用，且能完全替代生物扫描升级。
entries.bodyEn:
This upgrade will apply the 'glowing' effect to all nearby living entities - mobs and passive animals alike!

This is an activated ability, and replaces the Mob Scanner.

entries.body: 蚀空合金头盔是盔甲科技的巅峰，容量极大，足有 500,000FE。维持最佳状态即要注意维持供能，推荐使用便携发电器。
entries.bodyEn: The Eclipse Alloy Helmet is the pinnacle of armor technology, using Forge Energy with a large capacity of 500,000 FE. Remember to keep it charged, ideally with a Pocket Generator, to utilize its full potential.

entries.body:
劈砍比核源铁斧更有力。拥有“熔岩修补”，会在熔岩中自动修复自身。

烈焰金斧的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Cuts faster than the Ferricore Axe. It possesses 'Lava Repair', automatically repairing itself in lava.

Blazegold Axe Crafting

entries.body:
地震升级能够唤起自然的伟力。此升级能令你周围的地面震颤，延缓附近所有敌人的行动。

此能力需用键位激活，可在工具设置界面中绑定键位。
entries.bodyEn:
Unleash the force of nature with the Earthquake upgrade. This upgrade causes a powerful tremor around you, slowing all nearby enemies.

It must be activated with a bound hotkey configured in the tool settings menu

entries.body:
烧灼清创升级是提高自身幸存概率的不二之选。此升级能让你在受到伤害后快速恢复生命值，它会借用战斗所生的热量来烧灼封闭创口。

右击可激活此能力；它会立即治疗你，并消耗一些耐久度。需注意，此能力使用之后会进入冷却。
entries.bodyEn:
Boost your survival chances with the Cauterize Wounds upgrade. This upgrade gives you the ability to heal rapidly after taking damage, using the heat of battle to seal wounds.

Activate this ability by right clicking - it will instantly heal you, and use some durability. Note there is a cooldown period before you can use it again.

entries.body:
蚀空合金锄是农业科技的一件革命性发明，能把土壤变成极为肥沃的耕地。

它支持最高等级的农垦升级，可将农作物的产量抬至最高，达到效率的极致。

蚀空合金锄的配方
entries.bodyEn:
The Eclipse Alloy Hoe is a revolution in agricultural technology, capable of turning earth into highly fertile soil.

It supports the most advanced farming upgrades, maximizing crop yield and efficiency.

Eclipse Alloy Hoe Crafting

entries.body:
穿墙升级可令你穿过墙壁与障碍。激活即可消去自身的实体，以此无视所有物理障碍，地面除外。

激活时就可穿透墙壁。某些方块依然无法穿过，比如基岩，以及那些整合包作者指定的方块。
entries.bodyEn:
The Phase upgrade allows you to pass through walls and obstacles. Activate it to become ethereal, ignoring all physical barriers except the floor.

This allows you to walk through walls while active. Some blocks may still be solid, such as bedrock and any blocks mod pack makers specify.

entries.body: 这套顶级的胸甲能存下 500,000FE，保护能力登峰造极。为维持最高防御效率，务必时刻配备便携发电器。
entries.bodyEn: This top-tier chestplate utilizes 500,000 FE of Forge Energy, offering unprecedented protection. Recharge it regularly with a Pocket Generator to ensure maximum efficiency.

entries.body: 步伐辅助升级可让你毫不费力就走上完整方块，不必再费心跳跃。跋涉无需停息，步伐不再受阻。
entries.bodyEn: The Step Height upgrade allows you to effortlessly step up full blocks without jumping. Navigate terrain smoothly and maintain your pace without interruption.

entries.body: 苍穹晶胸甲的各项功能均以 FE 为基础，它最多能承载 10,000FE。推荐使用便携发电器作为辅助能源。
entries.bodyEn: The Celestigem Chestplate uses Forge Energy for its functionality, equipped with a 10,000 FE capacity. It's ideal to use a Pocket Generator for keeping it continuously charged.

entries.body:
苍穹晶弓超乎烈焰金弓之上，不再使用耐久度，而是换用 FE。它最多能容纳 10,000FE，足够长时间使用。

此弓有 3 个“药水罐槽”，可供附加状态效果。放入药水罐即可加强箭矢。

苍穹晶弓的配方
entries.bodyEn:
The Celestigem Bow surpasses Blazegold Bow, utilizing Forge Energy instead of durability. It can hold up to 10,000 FE, ideal for long use without wear.

This bow features 3 'Potion Canister slots', allowing for customized effects. Load it with a Potion Canisters for enhanced arrows.

Celestigem Bow Crafting

entries.body:
时间流体是一种多用途流体，可以驱动各种能影响时间的物品与方块。它近乎透明，似乎并不完全存在于这条时间流。

向多态流体中投入一枚时间水晶即可制成这种流体。
entries.bodyEn:
Time Fluid is a multi-purpose fluid powering all time altering Items and Blocks. It doesn't seem to be entirely part of this timesteam, as it is nearly transparent.

It is created by dropping a Time Crystal into a pool of Polymorphic Fluid.

entries.body:
烟熏升级能提升你的厨艺造诣。生物所有的掉落物都会自动被烟熏！比如牛肉会变为牛排。

需消耗耐久度。
entries.bodyEn:
Enhance your culinary capabilities with the Smoker upgrade. Any drops from mobs will be smoked automatically! Beef will be turned into Steak.

Uses some durability.

entries.body: 夜视升级能让你在暗处找到方向。此升级会给予永久性夜视，周遭环境永远亮如白昼。
entries.bodyEn: Navigate the dark with ease using the Night Vision upgrade. This upgrade grants permanent night vision, illuminating your surroundings at all times.

entries.body:
核源铁镐耐久度和效率并重，在能力上略强于铁镐。它接受各种能力，可以此增强其挖掘功能。

核源铁镐的配方
entries.bodyEn:
The Ferricore Pickaxe combines durability with efficiency, slightly outperforming iron. It can be upgraded with abilities to enhance mining capabilities.

Ferricore Pickaxe Crafting

entries.body:
瞬间破坏升级是挖掘作业的速通途径。在时间水晶的协助下，加装有此升级的工具能够瞬间破坏方块，获取资源需耗费的时间也因此大幅缩短。

注意：能耗会因方块硬度的上升而大幅上涨。破坏黑曜石的耗能比破坏石头要多出许多。
entries.bodyEn:
Speed through your mining tasks with the Insta-Break upgrade. Equipped tools can instantly break blocks, thanks to the addition of Time Crystals, drastically reducing the time it takes to gather materials.

Note: Energy use significantly increases based on the hardness of the block. Obsidian costs far more energy to instantly break than stone does.

entries.body:
虚炎燃液由未精炼的虚炎燃液加工而来。首先，向烈焰烬质中投入虚炎煤炭。然后，令所得流体与虚空辉凝胶接触，进行精炼。此燃液的能量产出高于前代燃液，每刻产能速度和总产能都得到了大幅提升。

虚炎燃液是一种高效的燃料，可在燃液发电器中用于产生能量。
entries.bodyEn:
Refined Voidflame Fuel is crafted by enhancing Unrefined Voidflame Fuel. Start by dropping Voidflame Coal into Refined Blaze Ember Fuel. Then, expose this fluid to a VoidShimmer Goo block for refinement. This fuel variant is noted for its superior energy output compared to previous tier fuels, significantly boosting FE/T and total FE generation.

Refined Voidflame Fuel is an efficient fuel, and can be used to generate energy in the Fuel Generator.

entries.body: 矿石采掘升级无需激活，适用于核源铁及以上的镐。它会自动挖掘所有相连的矿石，相当于只对矿石有效的全自动“连锁挖掘”。
entries.bodyEn: The Ore Miner upgrade is a passive ability which can go onto pickaxes starting at Ferricore. It automatically mines ore blocks connected to the one you mine, sort of like a 'vein miner' but only for ores, and automatic.

entries.body:
警告！！

悖论是过度使用悖论机器导致的一种时空不稳定现象。

其尺寸在出现时较小，但会随时间不断增长。尺寸越大，其吸引能力就越强。

悖论会吸收其影响范围内所有方块、物品，以及实体。被吸收的事物无法再取回！它们的去向无人知晓。

我们只知道它吸收的越多就长得越快！

好在它的尺寸似乎有一个上限。

目前我们对悖论所知不多。科学家们唯一能确定的，是时间水晶可以停止悖论。

往悖论里扔一片应该就行了。

相信随着研究的不断深入，我们能解明更多秘密。
entries.bodyEn:
Warning!!

The paradox is an unstable spacetime event brought on by overuse of the Paradox Machine.

The paradox starts out small, but over time will grow larger. The larger it grows, the more it will be able to consume.

The paradox will absorb any blocks, items, or entities in its area of effect. Once they've been consumed, theres no getting them back! Where did they go? No one really knows.

The only thing we do know, is that the more it consumes, the faster it grows!

Luckily there seems to be a limit to its size.

At this time very little is known about The Paradox. The only thing scientists have been able to determine so far, is that it can be sealed shut by feeding it a Time Crystal.

Tossing one in should do the trick.

There will likely be more to come as studies advance.

entries.body:
勇度哨箭升级能让箭矢自行搜寻目标，并依次对多个敌人造成伤害。极其适合群体控制。

此能力需要激活才可使用。激活后，下一次发射的箭矢会依次击中多个生物，最多能击中 10 个！
entries.bodyEn:
The Yondu Arrow upgrade enables your arrows to seek out targets, chaining damage across multiple enemies. Ideal for crowd control.

This is an activated ability. Once activated, the next arrow you fire will chain from one mob to the next, up to 10 times!

entries.body:
核源铁弓，以坚韧的核源铁锻成，以其较高的耐久度强化了普通弓的能力，还可加装各式升级。

此弓的工具设置界面中有一个特殊的药水罐槽，可赋予箭矢多种药水效果。放入药水罐即可。

核源铁弓的配方
entries.bodyEn:
The Ferricore Bow, crafted from robust Ferricore, enhances standard bow functionalities with increased durability and the ability to be upgraded with various abilities.

This bow includes a special Potion Canister slot in the tool settings UI, allowing you to enhance arrows with various potion effects. Insert a Potion Canister to apply effects.

Ferricore Bow Crafting

entries.body:
跳跃提升升级能让你跳得更高。此升级会增加你的跳跃高度，跨越障碍、攀爬高峰便不是难事。

可以加装于核源铁靴子，更高品质靴子的跳跃高度也更高。设置界面中有滑块可供调整。
entries.bodyEn:
Leap higher with the Jump Boost upgrade. This enhancement increases your jumping height, making it easier to overcome obstacles and reach elevated areas.

Can be installed on Ferricore level boots, but higher tier boots can allow for higher jumps. A slider is available in the settings screen to adjust it.

entries.body: 核源铁扳手功能繁多，能够旋转方块和连接替换器。是建筑师们搭屋建楼，技师们优化设计的必备良方。
entries.bodyEn: The Ferricore Wrench is a versatile tool used to rotate blocks and link Swappers. A must-have for builders and technicians looking to optimize their constructions.

entries.body:
此能力无需激活，它使得你更难被发现。生物无法再轻易意识到你的存在，你在被察觉前可以靠得更近。

高品质盔甲的能力效果也越好。
entries.bodyEn:
This passive ability will make you harder to detect. Mobs won't be able to detect you as easily, and you can get closer to them before they start to agro on you.

Higher tiers of armor will make this ability even more effective.

entries.body:
原初浆凝胶吞噬铁块后，即会将其转化为粗核源铁矿簇。破坏矿簇会掉落粗核源铁，并进一步烧炼为核源铁锭。

破坏粗核源铁矿簇时会掉落粗核源铁
entries.bodyEn:
When an Iron Block is consumed by Primogel Goo, it transforms into a Raw Ferricore Block. Mine this block to obtain Raw Ferricore items, which can be smelted into Ferricore Ingots.

Raw Ferricore drops when you break the Raw Ferricore Block

entries.body: 传送枪是一种开创性的设备，能够制造传送门。左击发射的弹射物会产生蓝色传送门，右击则会产生橙色传送门。踏入其一便会出现在另一端，玩家和物品都可穿越。
entries.bodyEn: The Portal Gun is a revolutionary device that enables the creation of portals. Left click to fire a projectile creating a blue portal, and right click for an orange portal. Step through one to emerge from the other, applicable to both players and items.

entries.body:
由烈焰金锄升级而来，苍穹晶使用 FE，而非耐久度。此锄能开垦出虚空辉壤。

如果锄上加装有“掉落物传送”能力，且已绑定至某容器，则开垦出的耕地会将自动收获的产物存入其中。

苍穹晶锄的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Upgraded from Blazegold Hoe, Celestigem tools have Forge Energy instead of durability. This hoe creates Voidshimmer soil.

If the hoe has 'teleport drops' ability, and is bound to an inventory, the soil will teleport the autoharvested blocks to that inventory.

Celestigem Hoe Crafting

entries.body:
核源铁剑是一柄坚韧的近战武器，略强于穿透的铁剑。它由核源铁制成；这种材料不只带来了更高的伤害，也为进一步升级、增强战斗表现打下了基础。

核源铁剑的配方
entries.bodyEn:
The Ferricore Sword is a robust melee weapon slightly superior to traditional iron swords. Crafted from Ferricore, it not only provides enhanced damage but also offers the potential for further upgrades with special abilities, enhancing its utility in combat scenarios.

Here is how you can craft the Ferricore Sword:

entries.body:
烧炼升级能够瞬间烧炼物品。加装于工具时，此升级可使其直接烧炼矿石的掉落物。

需消耗耐久度。
entries.bodyEn:
Instantly smelt items with the Smelter upgrade. Applied to tools, this upgrade allows you to directly obtain smelted products from mined ores.

Uses some durability.

entries.body:
蚀空合金剑是 Just Dire Things 中格斗科技的顶峰，能量储备量大，且支持最高级的升级。

此剑由蚀空合金铸造而成；作为最高品质的工具，它的伤害和耐久度都超乎寻常，足以承接最为致命的进攻性能力。

蚀空合金剑的配方
entries.bodyEn:
The Eclipse Alloy Sword is the pinnacle of combat technology in Just Dire Things, featuring a large energy capacity capable of supporting the most advanced upgrades.

Forged from Eclipse Alloy, this end-tier tool offers exceptional damage and durability, and is ideal for the most lethal offensive abilities.

Eclipse Alloy Sword Crafting

entries.body: 烈焰金胸甲不只防御能力超众，还拥有“熔岩修补”能力。将此胸甲投入熔岩源即可完全修复。
entries.bodyEn: The Blazegold Chestplate not only provides enhanced defense but also features the Lava Repair ability. Drop this chestplate into a lava source block to fully repair it.

entries.body:
掉落物传送升级能确保你搜刮的战利品完好无损。这一新颖升级会将掉落物直接传送到绑定的容器中。

手持工具 Shift 右击箱子等容器即可绑定。此后，矿石、生物等产生的掉落物就会直接传送到那里面！
entries.bodyEn:
Ensure your loot is safe with the Drop Teleport upgrade. This innovative upgrade teleports dropped items directly into a bound inventory.

Shift right click the tool on an inventory, like a chest, to bind it. Now, any drops from ores or mobs will teleport directly there!

entries.body: 蚀空合金锭由粗蚀空合金烧炼而来，它的耐久度和强度无可比拟。这种粗矿又是挖掘粗蚀空合金矿簇的产品。最终产出的铸锭是最为强大、最为耐用的物品的原材料和最佳材料。
entries.bodyEn: Eclipse Alloy Ingots, obtained by smelting Raw Eclipse Alloy, offer unmatched durability and strength. They are derived from mining Raw Eclipse Alloy Blocks, providing the ultimate material for crafting the most powerful and durable items.

entries.body: 多态流体是一种多用途的流体基质，是制作其他流体的重要原料。向水中投入多态催化剂即可制造这种流体。它能与多种资源反应为各类特化燃液，是制作燃液的必备材料。
entries.bodyEn: Polymorphic Fluid is a versatile base fluid essential for crafting other fluids. Create this fluid by dropping a Polymorphic Catalyst into water. It undergoes unique reactions with various resources to form specialized fuels, serving as a critical component in the fuel crafting process.

entries.body: 苍穹晶护腿的能量存储上限足有 10,000FE，其耐久度因此超出寻常。随身携带便携发电器，即可保持能量充沛。
entries.bodyEn: Celestigem Leggings utilize Forge Energy, boasting a 10,000 FE capacity for enhanced durability. Charge them on the go with a Pocket Generator.

entries.body:
高级多态化形手杖是多态化形手杖的高级版。已有的“随机多态化形”能力依然可用，在此之上，它还新加入了“定向多态化形”能力！

对生物 Shift 右击，即可将其类型存入手杖；再对其他生物使用，就能自动把它们变成所设定的生物！

手杖无法保存某些生物（可通过标签编辑）。

推荐将这两个能力绑定到不同的鼠标或键盘键位上。
entries.bodyEn:
The advanced polymorphic wand is an upgrade to the Polymorphic Wand. The existing 'random polymorph' ability still exists, but a new ability, 'targetted polymorph' is now available!

Simply shift-right click on any mob to save that type of mob to the wand, then activate the targeted polymorph ability to convert any mob to that type automatically!

Some mobs cannot be saved to the wand (You can edit these with Tags).

It is recommended to set the two abilities to different clicks or hotkeys.

entries.body:
蚀空门径手杖立于所有魔法工具的顶点，它的力量无物可比。

在虚空瞬移法杖的能力之上，还可以使用“蚀空门径”能力。手持右击方块后，该方块周围和后方的所有方块都会暂时消失！

一段时间后那些方块会恢复原样。箱子等方块实体不会受影响。

可在设置界面中调整此能力的作用范围。
entries.bodyEn:
The Eclipsegate Wand represents the pinnacle of magical tool development, featuring unparalleled powers.

In addition to the Voidshift Wand abilities, you can activate the Eclipse Gate ability. Simply right click on a block, and all blocks around and behind it disappear temporarily!

After a few moments the original blocks will return as they were. Block Entities like chests are not affected.

The setting screen lets you adjust the range of this ability.

entries.body:
飞行升级能让你不受限制地飞翔。此升级可令你在生存模式下自由飞行，与创造模式无二。

在空中维持飞行需要消耗 FE，千万不要把能量耗尽了！
entries.bodyEn:
Gain the power of unrestricted flight with the Flight upgrade. This upgrade allows you to fly freely in survival mode, much like in creative mode.

It does use forge energy to keep you aloft, so don't run out!

entries.body: 核源铁靴子专为冒险者为造，防御力和耐久度均略胜于铁靴子。它在升级后会获得多种能力，例如“跳跃提升”。
entries.bodyEn: The Ferricore Boots are crafted for adventurers, providing slightly more protection and durability than iron boots. They can be upgraded to offer enhanced abilities like increased jumping.

entries.body:
核源铁斧不只优于砍伐效率，亦是精良的武器。它的耐久度和砍伐速度均超出铁斧，还可用升级进一步增强。

核源铁斧的配方
entries.bodyEn:
The Ferricore Axe is not only efficient at chopping wood but also effective as a weapon. It surpasses the iron axe in both durability and cutting speed and can be further enhanced with upgrades.

Ferricore Axe Crafting

entries.body: 除叶升级需激活使用。右击树叶即可激活，所有邻接的树叶也会被破坏。
entries.bodyEn: The leaf breaker upgrade is an activated ability. Simply right click on a leaves block to activate it, and all adjacent leaf blocks will also be broken.

entries.body:
蚀空燃液的原料是未精炼的蚀空燃液。第一步需向虚炎燃液中投入蚀空烬质。再在暗影脉凝胶旁边倒出所得流体即可。这种燃液的品质最高，每刻产能速度和总产能也最高，是高级机器与设施的理想能源物质。

蚀空燃液是一种高效的燃料，可在燃液发电器中用于产生能量。
entries.bodyEn:
To produce Refined Eclipse Ember Fuel, begin with Unrefined Eclipse Ember Fuel. This initial stage is made by dropping Eclipse Ember into Refined Voidflame Fuel. Place the resulting fluid next to a Shadowpulse Goo block for the final refinement. This top-tier fuel offers the highest FE/T and total FE output, ideal for powering advanced machinery and systems.

Refined Eclipse Ember Fuel is an efficient fuel, and can be used to generate energy in the Fuel Generator.

entries.body:
无懈可击升级能让你暂时进入无敌状态。此能力的激活需要分配键位。激活后，你在短时间内能完全免疫所有来源的伤害。

注意：能力再次可用前的冷却时间很长，激活能力需消耗耐久度。
entries.bodyEn:
Gain temporary invincibility with the Invulnerability upgrade. You'll need to assign a hotkey to this ability, and activate it with the hotkey.  Once done, you'll be completely immune from all damage for a short time.

Note: There is a long cooldown before you can use it again, and it uses some durability to activate.

entries.body: 原初煤炭是初等形态的特化煤炭，在原初浆凝胶旁放置煤炭块即可获得。其燃烧时间略长于普通煤炭，在各类发电器中的每刻产能速度也更快。
entries.bodyEn: Primal Coal is the initial stage of specialized coal obtained by placing a coal block next to a Primogel Goo. It lasts significantly longer than normal coal, and will generate more FE/T when used in generators or the pocket generator.

entries.body:
熔岩免疫升级可使你免受熔岩的炙烤。此升级能让你完全免疫熔岩伤害。

免疫熔岩的伤害需要消耗 FE，千万不要把能量耗尽了！
entries.bodyEn:
Protect yourself from the scorching heat of lava with the Lava Immunity upgrade. This upgrade grants complete immunity to lava damage.

It does use forge energy to keep you aloft, so don't run out!

entries.body:
流体罐可以存储最多 8 桶液体。右击可倒出或装起流体，与铁桶类似。

Shift 右击可选择自动填充至物品栏内其他流体容器与否。共有三种选项：“无”，仅限“JustDireThings”的物品，“所有”（自动填充所有流体容器，所有模组的均可）。
entries.bodyEn:
The Fluid Canister can hold up to 8 buckets of liquid. Right-click to place or pick up liquids, similar to a bucket.

Shift right-click to enable auto-filling of other fluid containers in your inventory. There are three settings: 'None', Just Dire Things items only, and 'ALL' (fills all fluid holders, including from other mods).

entries.body: 矿石扫描升级需激活使用，适用于核源铁及以上的镐。激活后，附近的矿石会散发出粒子；这些粒子隔着方块也能看见，但不同矿石不会进行区分。
entries.bodyEn: The Ore Scanner upgrade is an activated ability, and can be installed on pickaxes starting at Ferricore. When you activate this ability, nearby ores will appear with particles that you can see through blocks, but there is no differentiator between which ores are which.

entries.body:
燃料罐是存储与运输大量燃料的好方法。

手持右击打开界面。Shift 右击燃料放入其中（也可拿起燃料放入槽位）。煤炭、木材等等，所有燃料都可以，但熔岩桶除外。

提示文本会显示已存储的燃料量。将燃料罐放入熔炉和发电器等机器里，机器便会消耗罐中的燃料。如此操作，烧炼单个矿石的时候就不会浪费一整块煤炭了！

注意：放进去的物品无法再取出！

放入本模组的燃料时也会传入其倍率属性，并与罐中已有的燃料取平均。在便携发电器和煤炭发电器中使用时，其提示文本会显示最终的倍率。
entries.bodyEn:
The Fuel Canister is essential for storing and transporting large quantities of fuel.

Right click the item to open the UI. Insert fuel by shift clicking (or picking up the fuel and clicking it into the UI). Any fuel will work, such as coal, wood, etc, but not lava buckets.

The tooltip will tell you how much fuel you've stored. The fuel canister can then be placed into machines such as furnaces and generators, and it will consume fuel from the canister. This is a good way to ensure you don't waste a full piece of coal to smelt 1 ore!

Note: theres no way to get the items back out!

Inserting the fuel from this mod will also transfer its fuel multipler attribute, and will average it with the existing fuel in the canister. The tooltip on the canister will tell you the multiplier you'll get, if you use the canister in a Pocket Generator or Generator.

entries.body: 垂直清扫升级无需激活，适用于核源铁及以上的锹。当破坏受重力影响的方块（比如沙砾和沙子），其上方所有同受重力影响的方块均会自动被破坏。挖矿时再也不必担心沙砾塌方了！
entries.bodyEn: The sky sweeper is a passive ability installed on Ferricore shovels, and above. When you break a block with gravity (like gravel or sand), any matching blocks above that one will also be broken automatically.  No more falling gravel while mining!

entries.body:
虚空瞬移手杖由烈焰推进手杖进阶而来，它能利用维度能量完成更为复杂的操作。

全新的“虚空瞬移”能力可让你传送到你所看的位置——当然，不能超出距离上限。

可在工具设置界面中选择激活用自定义键位或鼠标按键。我个人喜欢右击触发“空气推进”，“虚空瞬移”放在左键上。

也可在此缩短距离上限，或是打开与关闭目标玩家渲染。
entries.bodyEn:
Advancing from the Blazejet Wand, the Voidshift Wand utilizes dimensional energies for more complex operations.

The new void shift ability lets you teleport wherever you're looking - up to a certain distance

Access the tool settings screen to customize the hotkey or mouse button needed to activate it. I personally like air burst on right click, and void shift on left click.

You can also shorten the max distance traveled, and toggle on or off the player rendering.

entries.body: 鞘翅升级能带你翱翔天际。此升级会为盔甲加装鞘翅，摔落时即可启用飞行功能。
entries.bodyEn: Soar through the skies with the Elytra upgrade. This upgrade equips your armor with elytra wings, enabling flight when falling.

entries.body:
伐木升级无需激活，适用于核源铁及以上的斧。破坏木质方块时，它可让所有相连的同类木质方块同时被破坏。

一挥便可砍倒整棵树！

注意：砍伐整树的耗时略长于破坏单个方块！
entries.bodyEn:
Treefeller is a passive ability that goes on Ferricore Axes and above. When you break a piece of wood, it will break any adjacent matching wood blocks at the same time.

Chop down those trees in a single swing!

Note: Chopping down an entire tree at once takes a bit longer than a single block!

entries.body:
行走速度升级让你有如足下生风。此升级很适合探索和农垦，就算不疾跑，也能增加步行速度。

可以加装于核源铁护腿，更高品质护腿的行走速度也更快。设置界面中有滑块可供调整。
entries.bodyEn:
Enhance your walking pace with the Walk Speed upgrade. Ideal for exploring or farming, this upgrade makes your movement more efficient without sprinting.

Can be installed on Ferricore level leggings, but higher tier leggings can allow for faster walk speeds. A slider is available in the settings screen to adjust it.

entries.body:
伤害比核源铁剑更高。拥有“熔岩修补”，会在投入熔岩后修复自身。

烈焰金剑的配方
entries.bodyEn:
Enhanced damage over the Ferricore Sword. Features 'Lava Repair' for full repair when dropped into lava.

Blazegold Sword Crafting

entries.body: 割草升级需激活使用，适用于核源铁及以上的锹。激活后，附近的所有草和花都会被剪下，并在地上留下物品。
entries.bodyEn: The Lawn Mower upgrade is an activated ability which can be installed on shovels starting at ferricore. When you activate it, all nearby grass and flowers will be cut down, and their items will be dropped on the ground.

entries.body: 控制器、收集器和作业垫按其连接与工作范围布置，GUI 中配置目标和模块。基因瓶先取得对应样本，再用于相关设备；具体机器配方从 JEI 查看。
entries.bodyEn: Place controllers, collectors and pads within their required connections and work areas. Configure targets and modules in their GUI; gene vials require matching samples.

entries.zh: 移动垫、攻击垫与控制器
entries.body:
移动垫按朝向推动实体，不同等级改变速度。攻击垫接电后伤害接触实体，用工具先选择控制器，再绑定攻击垫，在控制器配置攻击类型、附魔模块与击杀模式。

抢夺、亡灵或节肢模块各有目标与作用，不能只放在普通箱子里生效。收集器另行处理掉落物和经验。
entries.bodyEn: Movement pads move entities in their facing direction. Powered Attack Pads are linked to a controller for damage, enchantment modules and kill settings. Collect drops separately.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 收集器、虚空过滤与基因瓶
entries.body:
收集器在配置半径内收集掉落物和经验，连接输出并设置过滤。虚空模块会销毁匹配物品，先确认过滤规则。

孢子与萌芽用于把兼容泥土变成相应生成土地。基因样本瓶记录目标数据，按 JEI 与脉冲核心、绿宝石等材料合成对应刷怪蛋；被禁止捕捉的实体不能取样。
entries.bodyEn: Configure collector range/output and void filters. Spores/sprouts change compatible soil. Gene samples are ingredients for supported spawn-egg recipes; blacklisted entities cannot be sampled.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.bodyEn: Place this structural/port component according to its multiblock guide. Configure port directions in the formed structure or port GUI.

entries.zh: 存储扫描器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
给存储扫描器供电，在 GUI 调整半径并点击 Scan 扫描。把需要访问的库存保留在列表里；可按名称搜索物品，@minecraft 等前缀按模组 ID 筛选。

自动化设置
扫描到库存后，区分普通浏览与标为 Routable 的库存。可路由库存参与自动插入/取出和对应模块视图，列表中还能调整顺序、移除库存。

故障排查
新放箱子没有出现先重新扫描；若启用了要求的 XNet 集成，范围由 XNet 接入关系控制。远程访问需把存储控制模块绑定到扫描器，再装入平板扫描器；扫描器并不把箱内物品搬进自身。
entries.bodyEn:
The Storage Scanner scans nearby inventories and shows their contents in one GUI. You can search, request items, and insert items back into connected inventories.

Use the radius slider and Scan button to find inventories. With XNet integration configured as required, scanner range is controlled by XNet connections instead.

The search box filters by item name. Prefix a term with @ to filter by mod id, such as @minecraft or @rftoolsstorage.

Inventories can be moved, removed, marked routable, and sorted. Routable inventories are used for automated insert/extract behavior and starred module views.

For remote use, link a Storage Control Module to the scanner and install it in a Tablet Scanner.

entries.zh: 存储控制模块：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
把存储控制模块绑定到目标存储扫描器，然后装进平板扫描器等支持该模块的设备。模块决定远程界面访问哪一台扫描器，不是装入后自动搜索全世界库存。

故障排查
远程列表不正确时，重新核对绑定坐标和目标扫描器、扫描器电量及其已登记的库存。星标或可路由视图只展示符合对应规则的内容。
entries.bodyEn:
Storage Control and Dump modules are Screen modules that work through a linked Storage Scanner. Sneak right-click a scanner with the module to set its target.

The Storage Control Module watches up to nine item filters and can count all inventories or only starred/routable inventories.

The Dump Module pushes matching player inventory items into the linked scanner network. It can use common item tags for broader matching.

entries.zh: 平板扫描器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
先在平板管理界面安装并选择已绑定的存储控制模块。普通右键打开远程扫描器界面，潜行＋右键打开平板管理界面。远程操作按当前设置消耗平板中的 FE；可访问库存来自目标扫描器的配置。

故障排查
平板有电但没有库存时检查模块是否绑定、扫描器是否可用、库存是否完成扫描及登记。平板是访问工具，不会凭空增加存储容量。
entries.bodyEn:
A Tablet Scanner is a tablet state used for remote access to a linked Storage Scanner.

Link a Storage Control Module to a Storage Scanner, put that module in a tablet, and select it. Right-click opens the remote scanner GUI.

Sneak right-click opens the tablet management GUI instead. Remote use consumes FE from the tablet according to the scanner tablet cost.

entries.zh: 模块化存储器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
在模块化存储器的模块槽放入存储模块，再向主库存放物品。实际容量由模块等级决定；界面切换可见库存大小不等于扩容。

管理与搬迁
使用 GUI 的搜索、排序和压缩整理库存。物品保存在存储模块内，更换或移动模块前确认其内容；不要把拿走模块误认为物品丢失。

故障排查
放不进物品时先查模块是否安装、容量和剩余可用槽。存储器不是加工机，自动合成要另接合成设备。
entries.bodyEn:
Modular Storage is a searchable storage block. Insert a Storage Module to define how many stacks it can hold.

The block stores items in the module, so the module can keep its contents when moved. Higher tier modules unlock larger inventories.

Use the GUI to search, sort, compact, and cycle through visible inventory sizes. The module slot controls the actual storage capacity.

entries.zh: 存储模块（1级）：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
存储模块插入模块化存储器后提供可用库存。等级决定容量，物品随模块保存，因此模块本身就是需要妥善保管的存储介质。

故障排查
更换模块后内容改变，先查看取出的旧模块，而不是重做一台存储器。整理库存和切换可见界面不改变模块等级。
entries.bodyEn:
Storage Modules are the actual item storage for Modular Storage. Tier 1 holds 100 stacks, Tier 2 holds 200, Tier 3 holds 300, and Tier 4 holds 500.

Upgrading with shaped NBT recipes preserves the module contents. Keep backups before moving valuable modules between systems.

entries.zh: 环境控制器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
给环境控制器供 FE，在左侧模块槽放入需要的效果模块。当前界面提供七个模块槽；装入更多效果会增加能耗。

配置步骤
顶部滑块设置半径，下方输入最低与最高 Y 高度。目标过滤决定作用于哪些玩家、敌对或被动生物；玩家黑白名单与全体生物模式不同。最后设置红石启用条件并检查电量。

故障排查
范围内没有效果时，先查目标过滤和高度，再查模块是否安装、红石条件与供电。增大作用范围和同时启用多个模块都可能增加负载，不要把扩范围当作修复过滤错误的方法。
entries.bodyEn:
The Environmental Controller can be used to 'infuse' an area with various effects. Up to Seven Effects can be supported at the same time, but this increases power usage.

The Controller's GUI

The UI has several elements of note. 

On the left are seven Module Slots, where active modules are inserted. 

Along the top is a slider to specify the machine's radius of operation, and below are boxes for the minimum and maximum Y levels. 

Below this is the filter, where you can name players to either receive or be immune from the modules' effects. The filter has seven modes: All mobs and players, Blacklist Players, Whitelist Players, Passive Mobs, Hostile Mobs, or Hostile And Passive Mobs. 

Lastly, we have a button for Redstone Control (On to activate, Off to activate, or Ignored) and a power meter at the bottom left.

entries.zh: 自动合成机（三阶）：操作与配置
entries.body:
配置步骤
给自动合成器供 FE，把要执行的配方写入配方槽，在输入库存提供材料。为配方设置结果留在内部、送到输出，或仅保留供下一配方使用的中间产物。

多步合成
按先后顺序安排配方：前面的步骤产出后面的原料，再把最终产物送出。检查容器物品等副产物的去向，避免内部槽位被桶或多余中间产物占满。

故障排查
有材料却不运行时核对配方模式、槽位保留、红石条件与输出空间。JEI 的配方转移只帮助填写配方，不会自动补料或决定中间产物保留方式。
entries.bodyEn:
The Crafter can be used to automatically craft blocks and items. The top tier version supports up to 8 different recipes

There are 26 input slots (for ingredients) and 4 output slots

It is possible to Remember the contents of the slots with the R button. That way an input or output slot can only contain that specific item. Use the F button to forget this again

Infusing this machine reduces the power usage

The crafter supports the Filter Module

entries.zh: 物质传输器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
物质传送器是出发端，物质接收器是目的端。分别放置设备并供电，再用拨号设备选择接收器并建立目的地。进入传送器前确认界面中的目标。

故障排查
传送失败时查两端电量、目的地是否可用、拨号结果及权限。只摆一个传送器不会自动为它生成接收位置。
entries.bodyEn:
The Matter Transmitter is a device that can teleport players to any other Matter Receiver. Use the Dialing Device to dial a matter transmitter to a receiver.

Infusing this machine causes reduced power consumption and increased teleportation speed

entries.zh: 物质接收器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
把物质接收器放在安全的落脚点，供电并配置名称及访问权限。它是传送目的地，出发端需要通过拨号设备选择这台接收器。

故障排查
目标列表找不到它时检查供电、名称、权限和所在维度的可访问状态。确认上方和周边有安全空间；修改目的地后重新检查出发端的拨号。
entries.bodyEn:
The Matter Receiver is where a player can teleport too from a Matter Transmitter. Use the Dialing Device to dial a matter transmitter to this receiver.

Infusing this machine causes reduced power consumption

Note that it is very important that the Matter Receiver has enough power. If not the player risks bad effects when teleporting

entries.zh: 传送控制器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
打开拨号设备，选择出发端传送器和目标接收器，核对名称、位置与权限后执行拨号。它配置路线，不是直接代替两端设备完成传送。

故障排查
某一端未出现在列表中时，分别检查该设备的电量、可见性和范围规则。改名、拆迁或换接收器后应重新拨号。
entries.bodyEn:
With the Dialing Device you can link a Matter Transmitter to a Matter Receiver. Note that the Matter Transmitter has to be nearby but the Matter Receiver can be very far away (even in another dimension)

Infusing this machine reduces power usage

To dial you first have to select a Matter Transmitter. If there is only one nearby then it will be automatically selected. After that you have to select a Matter Receiver (in the bottom list) and chose either 'Dial' or 'Dial Once'. With 'Dial Once' the connection will be interrupted as soon as someone teleports

entries.body:
操作步骤
在屏幕内安装对应显示模块，再由屏幕控制器给屏幕网络供电。每个模块单独决定显示文字、能量、库存或其他内容。

配置步骤
需要读取外部机器的模块先绑定读取目标，按模块设置调整字体、位置、格式和显示条件。多个屏幕组合时检查控制器覆盖与连接关系。

故障排查
空白屏幕先查供电和模块，有标题无数据再查模块绑定目标。显示器读取数据，不会自动操作被显示的机器。
entries.bodyEn:
The Screen is a versatile block that can display all kinds of information. This depends on the modules you have installed. The Screen needs power that is remotely supplied by a nearby Screen Controller

Right click with an empty hand to open the Screen user interface

In the GUI you can install modules (or you can install them by right clicking the module on the screen)

Many modules (like the energy module) need a target to work on. To set that target you must first sneak right click the module on the machine you want to monitor

When the module is installed in the Screen there are also various display options that you can set by opening the specific module GUI (accessed through the normal Screen GUI)

In that GUI you can also enable 'full bright' mode and by using the wrench you can change the size and transparency of the screen

entries.zh: 屏幕控制器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
屏幕控制器负责为相应屏幕提供运行能量。放置后供 FE，并确认屏幕位于控制器可以管理的连接范围内。

故障排查
屏幕无内容先分别核对控制器电量、屏幕是否接入、模块是否安装。增加控制器容量不能修复错误的模块目标或格式。
entries.bodyEn:
With the Screen Controller you can power nearby screens. Using the 'Scan' button in the GUI you can connect to all screens in a 32x32x32 radius.

Infusing this machine will increase this range

Place the controller within range, supply FE, and press Scan. Re-scan after adding, removing, or moving screens.

The default scan area is 32x32x32 blocks around the controller. Infusing the controller increases this range.

entries.zh: 能量单元（低）：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
能量单元存 FE，在各面配置输入、输出或禁用，再连接对应发电和用电线路。观察储量变化和实际输入输出，区分电池容量与每刻传输上限。

故障排查
有电但不供电时查输出面和下游接收面；一直存不住电先看网络负载。单元等级、接口设置和线缆能力都可能限制传输。
entries.bodyEn:
Powercells store massive amounts of power. They can be placed either individually, or they can be placed next to one another to form a multiblock structure. Powercells will automatically distribute RF between themselves and their neighbors, and will join up into a multiblock regardless of tier.

Powercells have no UI, but can be configured to input, output, or ignore power by hitting the desired side with a smart wrench in Wrench Mode. Blue is input, Yellow is output, and a blank side is neither.

By default, the Powercell (low) can hold 500,000RF each.

By default, the Powercell (Medium) can hold 4,000,000RF each.

By default, the Powercell (high) can hold 20,000,000RF each. That's a lot of RF!

entries.zh: 维度标记卡：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
能量单元卡用于连接支持的跨空间能量单元。先在目标单元建立卡片的链接信息，再把相同链接的卡装到需要加入该组的单元。

故障排查
卡片有链接不等于设备所有面都已设置输出。逐个检查成员、储量和面配置；普通单机储电设备不一定支持这类网络卡。
entries.bodyEn:
This card links Dimensional Cells together. A new card starts unlinked. Insert it into a Dimensional Cell to create or copy a link.

Use the linked card on other Dimensional Cells to join them to the same remote storage network.

entries.zh: 维度能量单元（基础）：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
空间能量单元按卡片链接组成远程供能系统。先建立相同网络，再分别设置各地单元的输入输出面。

远端没电时把问题分成两段：源单元是否获得能量，以及目标单元是否已加入相同链接并正确输出。存量和传输上限按当前等级、配置与界面显示判断。
entries.bodyEn:
The Dimensional Cell is multi-dimensional power storage. Like a Powercell, it stores and transfers FE, but linked cells can share power without touching.

Dimensional Cells are linked with a Powercell Card. Insert an unlinked card to create a link, or copy an existing cell link to another card.

The GUI has card slots for linking/copying, a charge slot for FE items, a network storage bar, side mode buttons, and a Stats button for inserted/extracted FE.

None, In, and Out set all sides to ignore, receive, or transmit FE. Individual sides can also be changed with a Smart Wrench: blue input, yellow output, blank disabled.

There is a drawback to Dimensional Cells, however; when set to Output Mode, there is a small cost to drawing RF from remote cells. It's not a lot, usually just a few percent, but it adds up. Luckily, Dimensional Cells can be Infused to reduce this cost.

The lowest tier of Dimensional Cell holds 250,000 RF, and can input or output up to 1,250 RF/Tick. This speed can be boosted via Infusion.

The medium tier of Dimensional Cell holds 1,000,000 RF, and can input or output up to 5,000 RF/Tick. This speed can be boosted via Infusion.

The top tier of Dimensional Cell holds 4,000,000 RF, and can input or output up to 20,000 RF/Tick. This speed can be boosted via Infusion.

entries.bodyEn:
The Storage Scanner scans nearby inventories and shows their contents in one GUI. You can search, request items, and insert items back into connected inventories.

Use the radius slider and Scan button to find inventories. With XNet integration configured as required, scanner range is controlled by XNet connections instead.

The search box filters by item name. Prefix a term with @ to filter by mod id, such as @minecraft or @rftoolsstorage.

Inventories can be moved, removed, marked routable, and sorted. Routable inventories are used for automated insert/extract behavior and starred module views.

For remote use, link a Storage Control Module to the scanner and install it in a Tablet Scanner.

The Screen is a versatile block that can display all kinds of information. This depends on the modules you have installed. The Screen needs power that is remotely supplied by a nearby Screen Controller

Right click with an empty hand to open the Screen user interface

In the GUI you can install modules (or you can install them by right clicking the module on the screen)

Many modules (like the energy module) need a target to work on. To set that target you must first sneak right click the module on the machine you want to monitor

When the module is installed in the Screen there are also various display options that you can set by opening the specific module GUI (accessed through the normal Screen GUI)

In that GUI you can also enable 'full bright' mode and by using the wrench you can change the size and transparency of the screen

entries.bodyEn:
The Environmental Controller can be used to 'infuse' an area with various effects. Up to Seven Effects can be supported at the same time, but this increases power usage.

The Controller's GUI

The UI has several elements of note. 

On the left are seven Module Slots, where active modules are inserted. 

Along the top is a slider to specify the machine's radius of operation, and below are boxes for the minimum and maximum Y levels. 

Below this is the filter, where you can name players to either receive or be immune from the modules' effects. The filter has seven modes: All mobs and players, Blacklist Players, Whitelist Players, Passive Mobs, Hostile Mobs, or Hostile And Passive Mobs. 

Lastly, we have a button for Redstone Control (On to activate, Off to activate, or Ignored) and a power meter at the bottom left.

This module gives Speed I to all valid targets within range. 

uses: 0.001 RF / Tick (Per block in range)

This module gives Regeneration I to all valid targets within range. 

uses: 0.0015 RF / Tick (Per block in range)

This module will halve any fall damage suffered by all valid targets within range. 

uses: 0.001 RF / Tick (Per block in range)

This module gives the Glowing effect to all valid targets within range. 

uses: 0.001 RF / Tick (Per block in range)

This module gives Haste I to all valid targets within range.

This module gives Night Vision to all valid targets within range. 

uses: 0.001 RF / Tick (Per block in range)

This module gives Saturation to all valid targets within range. 

uses: 0.001 RF / Tick (Per block in range)

This module gives Luck to all valid targets within range.

entries.body:
配置步骤
给自动合成器供 FE，把要执行的配方写入配方槽，在输入库存提供材料。为配方设置结果留在内部、送到输出，或仅保留供下一配方使用的中间产物。

多步合成
按先后顺序安排配方：前面的步骤产出后面的原料，再把最终产物送出。检查容器物品等副产物的去向，避免内部槽位被桶或多余中间产物占满。

故障排查
有材料却不运行时核对配方模式、槽位保留、红石条件与输出空间。JEI 的配方转移只帮助填写配方，不会自动补料或决定中间产物保留方式。
entries.bodyEn:
The Crafter can be used to automatically craft blocks and items. The top tier version supports up to 8 different recipes

There are 26 input slots (for ingredients) and 4 output slots

It is possible to Remember the contents of the slots with the R button. That way an input or output slot can only contain that specific item. Use the F button to forget this again

Infusing this machine reduces the power usage

The crafter supports the Filter Module

entries.bodyEn:
The Matter Receiver is where a player can teleport too from a Matter Transmitter. Use the Dialing Device to dial a matter transmitter to this receiver.

Infusing this machine causes reduced power consumption

entries.bodyEn:
The Dimensional Cell is multi-dimensional power storage. Like a Powercell, it stores and transfers FE, but linked cells can share power without touching.

Dimensional Cells are linked with a Powercell Card. Insert an unlinked card to create a link, or copy an existing cell link to another card.

The GUI has card slots for linking/copying, a charge slot for FE items, a network storage bar, side mode buttons, and a Stats button for inserted/extracted FE.

None, In, and Out set all sides to ignore, receive, or transmit FE. Individual sides can also be changed with a Smart Wrench: blue input, yellow output, blank disabled.

There is a drawback to Dimensional Cells, however; when set to Output Mode, there is a small cost to drawing RF from remote cells. It's not a lot, usually just a few percent, but it adds up. Luckily, Dimensional Cells can be Infused to reduce this cost.

The lowest tier of Dimensional Cell holds 250,000 RF, and can input or output up to 1,250 RF/Tick. This speed can be boosted via Infusion.

The medium tier of Dimensional Cell holds 1,000,000 RF, and can input or output up to 5,000 RF/Tick. This speed can be boosted via Infusion.

The top tier of Dimensional Cell holds 4,000,000 RF, and can input or output up to 20,000 RF/Tick. This speed can be boosted via Infusion.

entries.body:
操作步骤
能量单元存 FE，在各面配置输入、输出或禁用，再连接对应发电和用电线路。观察储量变化和实际输入输出，区分电池容量与每刻传输上限。

故障排查
有电但不供电时查输出面和下游接收面；一直存不住电先看网络负载。单元等级、接口设置和线缆能力都可能限制传输。
entries.bodyEn:
Powercells store massive amounts of power. They can be placed either individually, or they can be placed next to one another to form a multiblock structure. Powercells will automatically distribute RF between themselves and their neighbors, and will join up into a multiblock regardless of tier.

Powercells have no UI, but can be configured to input, output, or ignore power by hitting the desired side with a smart wrench in Wrench Mode. Blue is input, Yellow is output, and a blank side is neither.

By default, the Powercell (low) can hold 500,000RF each.

By default, the Powercell (Medium) can hold 4,000,000RF each.

By default, the Powercell (high) can hold 20,000,000RF each. That's a lot of RF!

entries.bodyEn:
