entries.body:
本mod的主要目的就是构建一个可控制的自动化网络。通多使用逻辑线缆来实现。试着用10根这样的逻辑线缆来搭建一个网络吧~

下一步需要做一些变量卡和变量转换器。 变量卡用来存储网络数据的引用。变量装换器为可以放置在逻辑线缆上的元件制作元素，以便读取和写入这些数据。
entries.bodyEn:
The main goal of this mod is for building control networks for automation. This is done using Logic Cables. Try making a network with ten of those cables.

The next step will be to craft some Variable Cards and Variable Transformers. Variable Cards are used to store references to values in the network. Variable Transformers are crafting elements for components that can be placed on Logic Cables for reading and writing these values.

entries.body: 为变量卡创建特定数据的一种方法是,通过读取器读取它的数据。去做一些基础读取器吧。然后, 再做一个显示面板,他能够方便的显示变量卡的数据。
entries.bodyEn: One of the methods for binding Variable Cards to certain values, is by reading in values from Readers. Let’s start by crafting some basic readers. After that, craft a Display Panel, which is useful for displaying the values of Variable Cards.

entries.body:
举个简单的例子, 我们来读取一个红石的数据并将它显示出来

接下来, 右击打开红石读取器的GUI, 将变量卡插入Integer 红石数据设置面, 来把目标的红石数据绑定到变量卡上。

下一步, 做一个红石输出器 并让他输出一个最大的红石数据
entries.bodyEn:
As a simple example, let’s try reading in a redstone value and displaying it.

After that, right-click on the Redstone Reader to open the gui, after which you have to insert a Variable Card into the Integer Redstone Value aspect, to bind the target’s redstone value to that Variable Card.

As a next step, craft a Redstone Writer and let it write a maximal integer redstone value that was read by a Redstone Reader.

entries.body:
当读取器上显示的数据可用时,开始将特定的数据与其他的数据通过运算符连接，事情将会变得有趣起来。所有的运算符可以在逻辑编程器中找到。

首先你需要做一个逻辑编程器, 它同时拥有物品和方块两种存在形式。打开GUI可在列表中查看所有的运算符.

接下来，搜索Integer运算符,点击它。它将会打开一个需要你输入数字的窗口。输入你想要的数字后, 插入一个空白的变量卡来绑定你刚才设置的Integer。设置完后，重复此运算来设置另一个不同的Integer变量卡。

最后,搜索Addition运算符并打开它。他会让你添加两个数字。插入2张Integer 变量卡到这些插槽内, 将它绑定到一张新的变量卡上。
entries.bodyEn:
While displaying values that originate from readers can be useful, things get really interesting when you start combining certain values with other values using Operators. All Operators can be found in the Logic Programmer.

Start by crafting a Logic Programmer, which exists in both item and block-form. Open its gui to see the list of all operators.

Next, search for the Integer operator, and click on it. This will open a window in which you should type a number. When you have done this, insert an empty Variable Card to bind that Integer to the Variable Card. When you’re done, do that once more for another Integer.

Finally, search for the Addition operator and open it. This allows you to add two Numbers. Insert your two Integer Variable Cards into these slots, and bind it to a new Variable Card.

entries.body:
现在你已经熟悉了基础的逻辑部件,我们来看一看更多高级的网络元件:  复制器 和 代理器。

你肯定记得, 逻辑编程器能让你创建变量的静态数据, 你可以通过动态数据评测创建更多复杂的变量。

复制器是用来将动态数据转换成静态数据的。插入动态 变量卡 到 复制器顶部的插槽内。每个插入左槽的变量卡 , 将会复制顶槽变量卡当前的数据。

代理器能让你为变量添加一个额外的间接级别。例如你目前有一个逻辑程序需要一个静态数据。如果在将来的某个时候, 你想改变这个数据, 你得重写你的程序, 除非那个数据是动态的, 在这种情况下你只需要在代理器升级这个数据。

本教程,制作复制器和代理器变量卡.
entries.bodyEn:
Now that you are familiar with basic logic, we can have a look at the more advanced network components: the Materializer and the Proxy.

As you may remember, the Logic Programmer allows you to create variables with static values, or you can create more complex variables based on dynamic value evaluation.

The Materializer can be used for converting a dynamic value to a static one. This can be done by inserting the dynamic Variable Card in the top slot of the Materializer. Every Variable Card that is inserted into the left slot, will be set with the value the top variable has at that moment.

The Proxy allows you to add an extra level of indirection for your variables. You may for example have a logic program that requires a static value in there. If at any point in the future, you want to change that value, you would have to rewrite your program, unless that value was proxied, in which case you would simply have to update the value in the Proxy.

For this tutorial, create materialized and proxied Variable Cards.

entries.body:
通过学习最近的教程你可能注意到了, 逻辑编程器的功能不仅仅是相加加数字。该教程中, 我们将研究更先进的数据结构和链状运算符。

让我们创建一个静态Integer列表 1, 10 和 100, 并让它在显示面板可视化。

物品也是这个mod中数据的类型之一。 让我们做一张静态物品 变量卡,它能自动检索出该物品在mod中的名称,让它在显示面板显示出来吧。

记住你只能用变量卡箱 来储存引用的变量。
entries.bodyEn:
As you may have noticed during the last tutorial, the Logic Programmer allows you to do way more than just adding numbers. In this tutorial, we’ll look into the more advanced datastructures and chaining of operators.

Let’s start by creating a static List of the Integers 1, 10 and 100, and visualize it in a Display Panel.

Items are one of the possible value types in this mod. Let’s make a static Item Variable Card, dynamically retrieve the mod name from that item, and visualize it in a Display Panel.

Remember that you’ll have to use a Variable Store to store your referenced variable.

entries.body:
第一步，打开逻辑编程器,创建一个新的静态运算符, 在列表中点击Operator打开它的界面，并输入Arithmetic addition,并写入变量卡，接下来做两张Integer的变量。找到Apply运算符, 把第一个Integer应用到运算符上, 会得到一个新的带有输入数据和一个输入空位的运算符。接下来,再次使用Apply运算符去绑定新创建的运算符的后一个输入空位。最后,用显示面板来可视化您动态调用的加法。

接下来，运用运算符,这里还有许多其他高级的运算符运算。 我们现在将研究使用列表上的运算符,更具体的说，Filter运算符需要用到一个List和一个Predicate (只有一个输入位和一个Boolean 输出数据的运算符)。首先创建一个List Integers 1, 10 and 100。然后, 存储Relational Equals 运算符 到变量中。然后, 将该运算符应用到Integer 10。 然后, 通过运算符 with 你的List和应用的运算符来使用Filter 。 这将通过在指定的运算符上应用它们来过滤掉List中返回False的所有项目，在这种情况下，这意味着所有不等于10的元素将从列表中移除。将它在显示面板中可视化。

运算符有很多其他的操作, 例如组合Predicates，翻转和2运算符和0参数，以及Lists的更多操作。
entries.bodyEn:
As a first step, go to the Logic Programmer, and create a new static Operator, by starting to type Arithmetic Addition Operator in the autocomplete dropdown-list and clicking it, and write it to a Variable Card. After that, create two Integer variables. Next, find the Apply operator, and apply the first Integer to the Operator, which will bind the first input argument of the addition Operator to that Integer, and will output a new Operator with one remaining input argument. Next, use the Apply operator again to bind the final input argument of the newly created Operator. Finally, use a Display Panel to visualize your dynamically invoked addition.

Next to applying Operators, there are a lot of other advanced Operator operations. We’ll now look into using Operators on Lists, more specifically the Filter Operator that takes a List and a Predicate (an Operator with one input argument and a Boolean output value). Start by creating a List of the Integers 1, 10 and 100. Next, store the Relational Equals Operator in a variable. Next, apply this operator on the Integer 10. Next, use the Filter Operator with your List and the applied Operator. This will filter away all the items from the List that return False by applying them on the given operator, which in this case means that all elements that are not equal to 10 will be removed from the list. Visualize the result in a Display Panel.

There are plenty of other operations on Operators, such as combining Predicates, flipping Operator arguments, and more operations on Lists.

entries.body: 本最终教程部分包含几个非常微不足道的挑战，以表明您了解动态联合的基础知识。每个挑战中不会有提示，所以祝你好运！
entries.bodyEn: This final tutorial section contains several non-trivial challenges to show that you understand the basics of Integrated Dynamics. No further information will be given for each challenge, so good luck!

entries.body: 你偶尔会遇到高大的蓝色树木。这样的树叫做 门瑞欧树, 并有一些非常有趣的属性。其一, 叶子会发光。这是由照明的浆果导致的，它非常的好吃！其二, 色质特别的原木包含大量的树脂，可用于制作这个MOD中的大部分内容。
entries.bodyEn: You may occasionally encounter tall blue trees. Such trees are called Menril Trees, and have some very interesting properties. First, the leaves give off light. This is caused by the illuminating berries, which are also very tasty! Secondly, the nice-looking wood of the tree contains a lot of resin, which can be used for crafting most of the things in this mod.

entries.body: 门瑞欧树 很难找到。幸运的是, 本mod为此增加了一个生物群系, 门勒格林 ，它是门瑞欧树茁壮生长的群系. 大量的门瑞欧树在这个生物群中引发了一些事情使得该群系看起来很蓝,这是因为树木中的门瑞欧树脂被释放到了环境中。
entries.bodyEn: Menril Trees are unfortunately quite hard to find. Luckily, there is one biome, the Meneglin Biome in which these trees thrive. The large amount of Menril Trees causes some things in this biome to become blue, which is because of the Menril Resin that is given off by these trees to the environment.

entries.body:
干燥方块和物品可以用洪干池完成。例如，当您希望让您的门瑞欧树脂干燥成门瑞欧结晶时，这可能是有用的。

无论如何，不要注入热流体！
entries.bodyEn:
Drying out blocks and items can be done using the Drying Basin. This can for instance be useful when you want to let your Menril Resin dry into Crystallized Menril.

Whatever you do, don’t insert hot fluids!

entries.body: 动态联合 网络是一切自动化系统的基础。 网络有相互连接的逻辑线缆构成，一些部件可以直接安置在上面。 这些电缆应使用扳手进行管理。Shift+右击一个线缆或者部件将其拆卸, 而常规右键单击将与其他电缆断开连接。
entries.bodyEn: Integrated Dynamics networks are the basis of any good automation system. A network consists of a collection of connected Logic Cables and parts can be placed on them. These cables should be managed using a Wrench. Shift+right-clicking a cable or part will remove it, while a regular right-click will disconnect it from other cables.

entries.body:
变量卡是这个MOD中逻辑传输的主要模式。变量包含对具有某个数据类型的某个数据的引用。

每个变量卡都有一个独有的ID，用于在内部网络中逻辑评测。 当网络出现错误时，这些ID将显示给玩家以帮助调试。 为了增强其可用性，可以使用注释器来给变量卡附上标签，这样可以让玩家看到标签而不是ID。
entries.bodyEn:
Variable Cards are the primary mode of logic transport in this mod. A variable contains a reference to a certain Value with a certain Value Type.

Each Variable Card has a unique ID, which is used internally in networks for Logic Evaluation. When an error occurs in the network, these ID’s will be shown to the player to help with debugging. For better usability, a label can be given to Variable Cards using a Labeler, which will allow players to see the label instead of the ID’s.

entries.body: 一些动态变量根据其他变量进行评测，其中可以访问这些引用的变量必须可行。表示添加两个其他变量的动态变量必须能够在评测时访问这两个其他变量。访问这些其他变量必须在与正在评测动态变量的网络相同的网络中进行，这可以通过将其他变量卡放入变量卡箱来完成。网络中可存在多个变量卡箱。 这些其他变量也可以引用某些变量，这些变量也应该存在于同一个网络中。
entries.bodyEn: Some dynamic variables are evaluated based on other variables, where access to those referenced variables must be possible. A dynamic variable representing the addition of two other variables must be able to access those two other variables when it is evaluated. Access to those other variables must be possible within the same network as where the dynamic variable is being evaluated, which can be done by placing the other variable cards in a Variable Store. Multiple Variable Stores can be present in a network. Those other variables may also reference certain variables, which should also be present in that same network.

entries.body:
有些时候,您的逻辑网络将会需要跨越很长的距离。虽然常规线缆可以解决问题,但是长距离放置线缆并不是非常方便。

单向连接器可以使您用无线的方式长距离连接网络。通过在一个网络上放置第一个连接器,并在另一个网络上放置另一个连接器来实现。这两个连接器必须处于同一直线上(既两个连接器的坐标值X,Y,Z之中的2个值相等),且距离小于或等于512的方块。当链接有效时,连接器将显示为有效状态。
entries.bodyEn:
Sometimes, your logic networks will span large distances. While regular cables will do the trick, it may not be very convenient to place cables across a long distance.

Mono-Directional Connectors allow you to connect networks wirelessly over a long distance. This can be done by placing a first connector on one network, and a second connector on another network. These two connectors must be in a straight line to each other, with a distance less than or equal to 512 blocks. The connectors will appear active when a valid connection has been made.

entries.body:
虽然单向连接器对于单个方向上的长距离链接很有用,但是在某些情况下还是有所限制。

例如,您可能想使用单个连接器将多个网络链接起来,或者与其他维度的网络通信。对于这些情况,您可以使用全向连接器。

这些连接器在首次制作时将产生一个唯一的分组ID,标识可连接网络的分组。每个连接器组在放置在世界中的时候会散发出独有的彩色粒子,分组ID可以在道具信息中看到,或者右键单击放置下来的连接器。通过使用分组内的现有的连接器制作新的连接器,可以将其他连接器添加到组中。

也可以通过两种方式更改现有连接器组. 在制作工作台中单独制作会将其分配给没有其他成员的新组, 将二个放在一起合成时第一个的分组将复制给第二个.
entries.bodyEn:
While Mono-Directional connectors are useful for long-distance connections in a single direction, in some cases this might be a bit too limited.

You may for example want to connect more than two networks together using a single connector or connect with networks in other dimensions. For these cases, you can use the Omni-Directional connectors.

These connectors will have a unique group id when first crafted, which identifies the group in which networks can be connected. Each connector group has a unique color of particles when placed in the world, the group id can be seen in the item tooltip or by right-clicking on the connector when placed. Additional connectors can be added to a group by crafting a new one using an existing connector within a group.

You can also change the group of existing connectors in two ways. Crafting one alone in a crafting table will assign it to a new group with no other members, and crafting two together will copy the first one's group to the second one.

entries.body:
复制动态变量卡当前时刻的静态数据。必须插入动态变量卡，并且必须插入一个新的空变量卡，这将使其具有动态变量卡的当前值作为静态值。

在您想要记录某个动态和变量卡数据的情况下，或者当您不再需要动态评测变量卡的情况下，这将非常有用。

变量卡可在复制器旁用管道输入和输出。
entries.bodyEn:
In order to make a dynamic Variable Card static, a Materializer can be used. The dynamic Variable Card must be inserted, and a new empty Variable Card must be inserted, which will cause it to contain the current value of the dynamic Variable Card as a static value.

This can be useful in situations where you want to log the values of a certain dynamic Variable Card, or when you don’t need the dynamic evaluation of a Variable Card anymore.

Variable Cards can be piped in and out the Materializer.

entries.body:
代理器可以用来动态地引用某个变量卡。它允许您插入变量卡，并写入一个新的变量卡，它将动态地获取代理中存在的变量卡的值。

这在您具有变量卡链的情况下非常有用，但您仍然可以手动更改一个数据。然后，您可以代理该变量，这将允许它随时与另一个变量交换。

正如复制器，变量卡可以管道输入和输出。
entries.bodyEn:
A Proxy can be used to make a dynamic reference to a certain Variable Card. It allows you to insert a Variable Card in the top slot, and write a new Variable Card, which will dynamically take the value of the Variable Card that is present in the proxy. Note that the referenced (or any other) Variable Card must remain in the top slot for the proxy to work.

This is useful in situations where you have a chain of Variable Cards, but you still would like to be able to change one value manually. You could then proxy that variable, which will allow it to be swapped with another variable at any time.

Just as with the Materializer, Variable Cards can be piped in and out of it.

entries.body:
动态联合网络可以配置为消耗能量。为此，您可以将能量电池连接到网络，为其添加能量存储容量。

应用红石信号将使能量的自动出口模式到所有设置面。

当这个电池在你的包裹中时, 自动输出模式可以使用Shift+右键激活. 激活后,这个电池会尝试输出能量到你双手中的物品.
entries.bodyEn:
Integrated Dynamics networks can be configured to consume energy. For this, you can attach Energy Batteries to the network to add energy storage capacity for it.

Applying a redstone signal will enable auto-export mode of energy to all sides.

When this battery is held in your inventory, auto-supply mode can be enabled by shift+right clicking. When enabled, this battery will automatically try to fill the items you are holding in your two hands with energy.

entries.body: 使用烘干池进行烘干会需要一些时间.如果你想要烘干变得更快,或者你想能烘干更多的东西,你应该使用电动烘干池,它需要消耗能量来运行.
entries.bodyEn: Drying with the Drying Basin can take a while. If you want things to go faster, or if you want to be able to dry more things, you can use the Mechanical Drying Basin, which requires energy to run.

entries.body:
创建动态变量卡的另一种方法是通过在一个或多个变量卡上应用运算符来生成新的变量卡。一个运算符的一个例子是添加了两个number，形成一个新的number。

逻辑编程器包含大量的运算符的集合。它还允许您为所有数据类型创建静态和变量卡。 选择运算符后，应在预期的输入插槽中插入有效变量卡。 最后，应在输出插槽中插入另一个变量卡。如果运算符有效，则会将新的动态变量写入卡中。 请记住，引用的变量卡必须存在于运算符将被评测的同一网络中的变量卡箱中。
entries.bodyEn:
Another method for creating dynamic variable cards, is by applying an Operator on one or more Variable Cards to produce a new Variable Card. An example of an Operator is the addition of two Numbers, resulting in a new Number.

The Logic Programmer contains a large collection of Operators. It also allows you to create static Variable Cards for all Value Types. After selecting an Operator, valid Variable Cards should be inserted in the expected input slots. Finally, another Variable Card should be inserted in the output slot. If the Operator is valid, a new dynamic variable will be written to the card. Remember that the referenced Variable Cards have to be present in a Variable Store in the same network where the Operator will be evaluated.

entries.body:
输入口(蓝色)将试图从一个目标中抽取物品传输到同一网络的接口(白色)。

输出口(橙色)将试图从同一网络的接口(白色)向一个目标推送物品,同一网络下,物品将始终从左往右传输。

你可以向你的网络添加多个接口，并分配优先级以指定首先应填充/清空哪些。

此外，您还可以添加多个输入口和输出口，具有相同的优先级。

谨记，如果你安装了自动合成的模组，诸如集成合成学，你能够在输出口使用合成设定。这将使一种原料因为缺乏而无法输出时进行自动合成。
entries.bodyEn:
Importers (blue) always try to pull from a target, to Interfaces (white) in the same network.

Exporters (orange) always try to push to a target, from Interfaces (white) in the same network. Items in this case will always transfer from left to right.

You could add multiple interfaces to your network, and assign priorities to specify which should be filled/emptied first.

If you want to specify what ingredients can go through an interface, you can use a filtering interface. This can be useful if you for example want to lock inventories to only contain certain items.

Using Integrated Dynamics variables, you have to specify what items should be moved. If you want to keep it simple, and just move everything, simply use a blank Variable Card.

entries.body: 任何有经验的Minecraft玩家都知道，点击次数当然是越少越省事。你可以使用玩家模拟器来大大简化那些繁琐的点击行为。它可以自动模拟手或手持物品进行点击。你可以在高级属性内更改点击的位置。
entries.bodyEn: Any experienced Minecrafter knows that the less you have to click, the better. With the Player Simulator, you can automate away a large part of this tedious clicking. It allows you to automate clicking with any hand and item. Advanced properties allow you to change things like click positions and so on.

entries.body: 与物品输入口和物品输出口类似，物品拾取口和物品投掷口分别可以从世界上捡起物品并输入完了或者从网络中提取物品扔到世界上。此外，它们也能与潜影箱这样带库存的掉落物进行交互。
entries.bodyEn: Simular to Item Importers and Item Exporters, World Item Importers and World Item Exporters can respectively pick up items from the world into your item network and place items into the world from your item network. Furthermore, these can also be used to interact with dropped items that have inventories, such as Shulker Boxes.

entries.body: 做一个包含石头这个物品值的变量卡。将其放入方块破坏口使它只能破坏石头。也要对其属性进行修改，看看是否能进行精准采集石头，避免挖成圆石。
entries.bodyEn: Make a Variable Card containing a reference to the Stone item value. Place this inside a World Block Importer to break only Stone blocks. Also have a look at the various aspect properties to see if you can manage to silk touch the Stone to avoid receiving just Cobblestone.

entries.body: 尝试用方块放置口创建一个只能放置原木的系统。使用矿物词典值运算符来检索所有矿物词典为logWood的物品。
entries.bodyEn: Try creating a system using the World Block Exporter that only places wooden logs. Do this using the Tag Values operator to retrieve a list of all items in the logs tag.

entries.body: 厌倦了长时间的点击？不如试试用玩家模拟器代替？先合成一个玩家模拟器并放入含有钻石剑的变量卡，这样它会自动从网络中抽取一把钻石剑进行攻击。
entries.bodyEn: All this clicking and such can be quite boring, why not let a Player Simulator do it for you? Start by crafting one, and insert a Variable Card containing a Diamond Sword to let it attack autonomously using Diamond Swords from your item network.

entries.zh: 变量卡、逻辑编程器与变量存储器
entries.body:
读取器生成的是数据引用变量卡，逻辑编程器生成常量或运算结果。把运算所依赖的卡放进同一网络可访问的变量存储器，输出器才可求值。

卡上写着变量 ID 不等于已保存一份固定数值。代理保持引用接口，实体化器可按功能把动态值转为固定结果；红字错误先检查类型、依赖卡和网络连通。
entries.bodyEn: Reader cards reference live data. Store dependency cards in a network-accessible variable store so operators/writers can evaluate them. IDs are references, not automatically frozen values.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 动态隧道：接口与输入输出器
entries.body:
接口把相邻库存、流体或能量暴露给逻辑网络，输入器把外部资源收入网络，输出器从网络送往相邻目标。向相应操作槽插入正确类型变量卡。

布尔卡通常控制开关，物品/列表/谓词限制对象，整数限制数量。属性页还有通道、优先级、精确数量和轮询；要求“恰好数量”时，数量不足会完全不传输。
entries.bodyEn: Interfaces expose resources; importers pull into the network and exporters push to targets. Use cards of the expected type and check channels, priority, exact-amount and round-robin properties.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
合成接口保存所支持的配方/变量数据，并把材料交给相邻合成设备。存储终端用于浏览网络资源，合成终端用于发起已登记的配方。

原料与成品都需要连接到同一逻辑网络。任务等待时检查配方是否登记、依赖是否可求值、目标机器输入是否满，以及成品是否回流。
entries.bodyEn: Register crafting recipes/variables in compatible interfaces. Connect ingredients, processing machine and result return to the same network; terminals only expose registered resources and crafts.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body: 用逻辑编程器写入变量卡。读取器提供变量，写入器/接口使用变量决定动作；线缆把整个逻辑网络连接起来。
entries.bodyEn: Program variable cards with the logic programmer. Readers expose values and writers/interfaces act on them through a connected cable network.

entries.body:
洪干池
干燥方块和物品可以用洪干池完成。例如，当您希望让您的门瑞欧树脂干燥成门瑞欧结晶时，这可能是有用的。

无论如何，不要注入热流体！
entries.bodyEn:
Drying Basin
Drying out blocks and items can be done using the Drying Basin. This can for instance be useful when you want to let your Menril Resin dry into Crystallized Menril.

Whatever you do, don’t insert hot fluids!

entries.body:
能量电池
动态联合网络可以配置为消耗能量。为此，您可以将能量电池连接到网络，为其添加能量存储容量。

应用红石信号将使能量的自动出口模式到所有设置面。

当这个电池在你的包裹中时, 自动输出模式可以使用Shift+右键激活. 激活后,这个电池会尝试输出能量到你双手中的物品.
entries.bodyEn:
Energy Battery
Integrated Dynamics networks can be configured to consume energy. For this, you can attach Energy Batteries to the network to add energy storage capacity for it.

Applying a redstone signal will enable auto-export mode of energy to all sides.

When this battery is held in your inventory, auto-supply mode can be enabled by shift+right clicking. When enabled, this battery will automatically try to fill the items you are holding in your two hands with energy.

entries.body:
读取器生成的是数据引用变量卡，逻辑编程器生成常量或运算结果。把运算所依赖的卡放进同一网络可访问的变量存储器，输出器才可求值。

卡上写着变量 ID 不等于已保存一份固定数值。代理保持引用接口，实体化器可按功能把动态值转为固定结果；红字错误先检查类型、依赖卡和网络连通。
entries.bodyEn: Reader cards reference live data. Store dependency cards in a network-accessible variable store so operators/writers can evaluate them. IDs are references, not automatically frozen values.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
电动烘干池
使用烘干池进行烘干会需要一些时间.如果你想要烘干变得更快,或者你想能烘干更多的东西,你应该使用电动烘干池,它需要消耗能量来运行.
entries.bodyEn:
Mechanical Drying Basin
Drying with the Drying Basin can take a while. If you want things to go faster, or if you want to be able to dry more things, you can use the Mechanical Drying Basin, which requires energy to run.

entries.body:
接口把相邻库存、流体或能量暴露给逻辑网络，输入器把外部资源收入网络，输出器从网络送往相邻目标。向相应操作槽插入正确类型变量卡。

布尔卡通常控制开关，物品/列表/谓词限制对象，整数限制数量。属性页还有通道、优先级、精确数量和轮询；要求“恰好数量”时，数量不足会完全不传输。
entries.bodyEn: Interfaces expose resources; importers pull into the network and exporters push to targets. Use cards of the expected type and check channels, priority, exact-amount and round-robin properties.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
准备
把管理器、来源箱与目标箱用物流线连通，用标签枪把来源标为 a、目标标为 b。标签是程序中引用库存的名称，拼写必须与程序一致。

程序
NAME "箱子搬运"
EVERY 20 TICKS DO
  INPUT FROM a
  OUTPUT TO b
END

运行机制
INPUT 记录本轮可以从哪里取物，单独写它不会把物品搬进管理器内部缓存。OUTPUT 才执行从当前输入集合到目标的传输。编辑并保存后查看管理器报错和运行状态；不需要另给这个物品搬运程序添加 FE。

故障排查
先查网络连通、a/b 标签和保存状态，再查目标空间。不要只写 INPUT 然后等待管理器里出现物品。
entries.bodyEn:
Installed reference program:

NAME "A simple program"

EVERY 20 TICKS DO
    -- on their own, input statements do nothing
    -- there is no item buffer
    INPUT FROM a

    -- all the magic happens here
    OUTPUT TO b
END

entries.body:
工作机制
同一次触发内，前面的 INPUT 选择会继续有效；执行一次 OUTPUT 不会自动清空输入集合。第二段输出如果不清理，就可能把第一批来源也纳入。

操作步骤
两个独立搬运步骤之间写 FORGET，或用 FORGET a 清除指定输入。它忘记的是本轮的来源选择，不会删除箱内物品。

示例
EVERY 20 TICKS DO
  INPUT FROM a
  OUTPUT 1 TO b
  FORGET
  INPUT FROM c
  OUTPUT TO d
END

故障排查
发现 d 里出现 a 的物品时先查输入集合是否清理，再查标签是否误绑。
entries.bodyEn:
Installed reference program:

NAME "Forget"

EVERY 20 TICKS DO
    INPUT FROM a
    OUTPUT 1 to b

    INPUT FROM c
    OUTPUT TO d -- the "a" input is still active!!!
END

EVERY 20 TICKS DO
    INPUT FROM a
    OUTPUT 1 to b

    FORGET a
    -- or just
    FORGET

    INPUT FROM c
    OUTPUT TO d -- only the "c" input is active :D
END

entries.body:
操作步骤
标签确定目标方块，SIDE 进一步确定通过哪一面访问，SLOTS 指定槽位。机器能从 GUI 手动取放，不代表所有自动化面都开放同一槽位。

安装版示例
EVERY 20 TICKS DO
  INPUT FROM a TOP, WEST SIDE SLOTS 0,1,3-4,7-9,21
  OUTPUT TO a BOTTOM SIDE SLOTS 2
END

故障排查
用容器检查器查看目标暴露的槽位与资源，再逐段缩小到一个面、一个槽。槽位编号依设备接口而定，不能照搬另一个模组机器的编号。
entries.bodyEn:
Installed reference program:

name "Slots and sides"

every 20 ticks do
    input from a top, west side slots 0,1,3-4,7-9,21
    output to a bottom side slots 2
end

entries.body:
工作机制
普通 INPUT 默认处理物品。流体、能量及其他资源需要正确的资源类型前缀，不能用物品搬运语句替代流体操作。

流体示例
EVERY 20 TICKS DO
  INPUT fluid:: FROM a
  OUTPUT fluid:: TO b
END

过滤
fluid::water 选择水；完整资源标识还可写成 sfm:fluid:*:water。物品名可能匹配多个模组，需要精确限定时写出模组 ID。当前安装版模板的资源类型列表由运行时生成，不把模板内占位符当成可运行语句。

故障排查
先用检查器确认容器暴露的是物品、流体还是其他资源，再检查输入输出类型与机器面配置。
entries.bodyEn:
Installed reference program:

NAME "Fluids and other resource types"

EVERY 20 TICKS DO
    -- the default resource type is sfm:item
    INPUT stone FROM a
    -- is the same as
    INPUT sfm:item:*:stone FROM a

    -- so if you want to move all fluids, you gotta do
    INPUT fluid:: from a
    OUTPUT fluid:: to b
    -- this expands to INPUT sfm:fluid:*:* FROM a

    -- these are equivalent
    INPUT fluid::water FROM a
    INPUT sfm:fluid:*:water FROM a

    INPUT iron_ingot FROM a
    INPUT sfm:item:*:iron_ingot FROM a

    -- older versions used to default to "minecraft" for items
    INPUT iron_ingot FROM a
    INPUT sfm:item:minecraft:iron_ingot FROM a
    -- this is no longer the case, since there isn't usually name conflicts
    -- if there are, you can just manually specify the mod id if you care
    INPUT totally_not_minecraft:iron_ingot FROM a
END

-- the following resource types are supported
-- (this example is generated so it's always up to date)
EVERY 20 TICKS DO
    See the generated resource type list in the running editor.
END

entries.body:
配置步骤
INPUT 1 FROM a 限制本次选择数量；OUTPUT 5 TO b 限制本次输出。RETAIN 设置需要保留的数量，EACH 进一步决定限制是对每种匹配资源或每个目标分别计算。

安装版例句
INPUT 5 RETAIN 3 stone FROM a
INPUT 5 EACH *ingot FROM a
OUTPUT 1 TO EACH b

这些是不同用法示例，写入程序时仍需放在触发块中，并配套正确的 INPUT / OUTPUT。先确定你要的是每个目标一件，还是所有目标合计一件。

故障排查
只移动少量或一直不补货时，检查库存是否已触及保留量、通配匹配了几种物品、标签是否绑定多个目标。
entries.bodyEn:
Installed reference program:

name "Limits"

every 20 ticks do

    -- This is hard to explain since there's so many variations
    -- This is more a collection of samples than a coherent program
    -- Guess what you think each statement does, try them out on your own!

    INPUT FROM a
    INPUT 1 FROM a
    INPUT stone FROM a
    INPUT 3 stone FROM a
    INPUT 5 RETAIN 3 stone FROM a
    INPUT 5 *ingot FROM a
    INPUT 5 EACH *ingot FROM a
    INPUT 5 RETAIN 1 EACH *ingot FROM a

    -- quantity and retention can both be expanded with the EACH keyword
    -- this only makes sense if your resource id is a pattern
    INPUT 5 EACH RETAIN 3 EACH *ingot* FROM a

    OUTPUT TO b

    INPUT 1 "redstone" FROM EACH a
    OUTPUT 1 TO EACH b

    OUTPUT 5 TO b
    OUTPUT 5 stone TO b
    OUTPUT RETAIN 1 coal TO furnace BOTTOM SIDE
    OUTPUT 8 EACH *ingot* to b
    OUTPUT RETAIN 8 EACH *ingot* to b
    OUTPUT 8 EACH retain 8 EACH *ingot* to b

end

entries.body:
操作步骤
用标签枪给真实库存或机器设置标签，程序用同样名称引用。网络工具用于查看线路和连接；容器检查器用于确认面、槽位及资源接口。

故障排查
报找不到标签时检查拼写与绑定；有标签但传输失败时检查连接、资源类型、面、过滤和容量。管理器内编辑文本后要保存并检查编译信息，屏幕上看到新文字不代表正在运行的程序已经更新。

按键
下方动作都以当前设置为准；未分配的功能先到控制设置绑定。程序编辑快捷键只在相应管理器界面生效。
entries.bodyEn:
Installed reference program:

NAME "A simple program"

EVERY 20 TICKS DO
    -- on their own, input statements do nothing
    -- there is no item buffer
    INPUT FROM a

    -- all the magic happens here
    OUTPUT TO b
END

资源类型、侧面和数量都可限制；流体、能量、化学品不是普通物品名字。查看编译错误和运行日志，修正不存在标签、无效资源名或无接收空间。
entries.bodyEn: Label targets, connect cables and write INPUT/OUTPUT statements inside timed triggers. Compile and run the program; check resource types, sides, quantities and log errors.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
操作步骤
潜行＋右键节点或连接器设为起点，再右键另一端建立连接。当前内置手册给出的基础连接距离为 8 格；超距时需要适用的连接器链路。绿色高亮表示当前选中端。

输入与输出
在节点对应侧放入物品、流体、能量或红石卡，分别设置 Extract / Insert 与频道。抽取和插入端须能通过同一链路、同一频道找到彼此；面对库存的侧面才是实际交互面。

故障排查
有连线但不传输时，按“节点连通 → 卡片资源类型 → 频道 → Extract/Insert → 库存面与空间”检查。过滤、数量限制、红石控制和超频各自独立；光有节点和连线不会自行传送物品。
entries.bodyEn:
Sneak-right-click a node or connector to choose the starting point, then right-click the other endpoint. The installed guide specifies an 8-block basic link range. The selected endpoint is green.

Install the correct resource cards on the interacting sides and configure Extract/Insert and channel. For a connected but idle network, check link, card type, channel, transfer mode, inventory face and space, then filters, limits and redstone. Bare nodes and links do not transfer items without cards.

entries.body: 节点用激光扳手连接；在节点的对应面插入物品、流体、能量或红石卡，设置输入/输出、频道与过滤。传输双方的资源类型和频道必须匹配。
entries.bodyEn: Link nodes with the laser wrench. Insert resource cards on the correct faces and configure direction, channels and filters. Both endpoints must match.

entries.body:
多个激光节点可由激光扳手互相直接连接，但连接长度不得超过 8 格。

激光连接器是造价较便宜的中介装置，专用于中继节点，可由此构建互相联通的激光网络。

连接两个节点的连接器
entries.bodyEn:
Multiple Laser Nodes can be connected directly to each other using the Laser Wrench, however the maximum range is 8 blocks.

Laser Connectors can act as a cheaper intermediary point between nodes, allowing you to build a network of interconnected inventories.

Connector between 2 nodes

entries.body:
高级激光连接器和激光连接器功能一致，可以连接至最远 8 格内的基础连接器和节点。

但是，它们只能与一个高级连接器相连，形成连接器对。对内高级连接器的连接范围没有距离上限⸺甚至能跨越维度！

两个互相连接的高级连接器

如果某个高级连接器已经处于对中，再试图连接至另一个高级连接器，则原来的连接会断开，同时形成新链接。

手持激光扳手看向高级连接器时，它会显示相连的高级连接器的坐标。

显示相连的高级连接器的坐标

高级激光连接器不会加载区块，这一任务需要靠你去完成！未加载区块内的节点不会运作。
entries.bodyEn:
Advanced Laser Connectors work just like Laser Connectors, connecting to other (basic) connectors and nodes up to 8 blocks away.

They can only be connected to one other Advanced Connector, however, forming a pair.  The connection range from one advanced connector to its partner is infinite - including across dimensions!

Two Advanced Connectors linked to each other

If an Advanced Connector already has a partner, and you attempt to pair it with a new partner, the original connection will be broken to form the new connection.

When looking at the block with the Laser Wrench in your hand, you'll see the coordindates of the partner block.

Showing the coordinates of the partner connector

Advanced Laser Connectors do NOT chunk load for you. You are responsible for handling all chunk loading on your own! Nodes in unloaded chunks will not operate.

entries.body:
激光节点能与毗邻方块交互，是本模组中最为重要的方块。

诸如物品卡的各式物流卡可以让节点传输物品、流体、能量或红石信号。

与箱子交互的节点

节点的每个侧面都有接受物流卡的 3x3 方格。右击节点侧面以打开其界面。

可以用界面上方的按钮切换活动面，以免想调整的面不方便右击。

下页截图中的节点正与其西侧箱子交互。

装有物流卡的节点界面

节点能同时与不同侧面的存储空间交互。

在两个箱子之间的节点

节点可用激光扳手相互连接，从而连接相距较远的存储空间。节点间连接最大长度为 8 格。

若节点间距大于该距离，推荐选用激光连接器连接两者。

相连的两个激光节点
entries.bodyEn:
The Laser Node is the most important block in LaserIO as it allows interaction with adjacent blocks.

By using Cards such as the Item Card, you can interact with the adjacent block to transfer Items, Fluids, Energy, or Redstone.

Node interacting with Chest

Each side of a node has a 3x3 grid of inventory slots that accept Cards. Right click a node's side to open it's UI.

Use the buttons along the top to change which side you're working on, in case the side you want to modify isn't easily accessible.

The adjacent screenshot shows a node interacting with an inventory on it's west side.

Node UI with Card

Nodes can interact with multiple adjacent inventories at the same time.

Node between 2 chests

Nodes can be connected together using the Laser Wrench, allowing connections between distant inventories.  The maximum range between connections is 8 blocks.

If your nodes are father apart, it is recommended to use Laser Connectors.

Two Nodes Connected

entries.body:
逻辑芯片是本模组最重要的合成原料。

它是唯一仅用原版材料就可合成的物品，其余物品的合成均会直接或间接地使用到逻辑芯片。
entries.bodyEn:
Logic Chips are the primary crafting ingredient in LaserIO.

They are the only item crafted with 'vanilla' materials, and all subsequent items use a chip in one way or another.

entries.body:
能量限制仅在能量卡中可用。该值决定毗邻储能方块可操作能量的占比。

该值共有两种理解方式，存储和输入模式下是输入百分比，提取模式下是提取百分比。

输入/存储限制

默认情况下，该值为 100%。该值表示将目标能量槽填充至多少百分比。

例如：若对应能量槽能保有 1,000,000FE，将该值设为 50%，节点仅会将其填充至 500,000FE。

默认值（100%）会将其充满。

提取限制

默认情况下，该值为 0%。该值表示在目标能量槽中余下多少百分比。

例如：若对应能量槽能保有 1,000,000FE，将该值设为 50%，节点会提取至槽内仅余 500,000FE，并且不会再提取。

默认值（0%）会提出所有能量。
entries.bodyEn:
Limit % only exists on Energy Cards. Limit % specifies the percentage of FE to operate with on the adjacent energy accepting block.

There are two different metrics, Insert % for Stock/Insert mode, and Extract % for extract mode.

Insert/Stock Limit

By default, the limit% is set to 100%.  Specifies how much to fill up the specified energy block.

For example: If the block can hold 1,000,000 FE, and you specify 50%, it will only fill up to 500,000FE.

The default (100%) will fill it up completely.

Extract Limit

By default, the limit% is set to 0%. Specifies how much to leave behind in the specified energy block.

For example: If the block can hold 1,000,000 FE, and you specify 50%, it will extract until the block has 500,000fe remaining, and will not extract any more.

The default (0%) will extract all energy.

entries.body:
物流卡存储器能摧枯拉朽地解决各式各样的物品栏问题！好吧，至少能很好地解决本模组的这类问题⋯⋯合成物流卡存储器，再手持右击打开界面即可。本界面内物流卡的最大堆叠数为 64，但仅有 NBT 一致的会堆叠。（提示：可将物流卡合成为自身来重设 NBT。）

可在存储器内直接编辑物流卡配置⸺右击物流卡即可（和节点内操作一致）。

注意：若某物流卡处堆叠有多于 1 张卡，则过滤器槽和超频器槽会被禁用，以防复制物品。#BlameSoaryn

潜行时手持存储器右击，即可让其自动装载玩家物品栏内的物流卡！自动装载功能打开后，存储器会发出紫色光效，就好像被附魔了一样。再次潜行右击可关闭该功能。在打开节点界面时，若物品栏内有存储器，则存储器中的物流卡也会一并显示。

注意：过滤器和超频器现在也可存入存储器了！只有无数据的过滤器会自动存入存储器。将其合成为自身可清除其中数据。

带有数据的过滤器仍可以手动放入存储器。
entries.bodyEn:
The card holder is the solution to all your inventory woes! At least, the ones caused by this mod....Simply craft a Card Holder and right click it to open up the UI. Cards placed in this UI can stack up to 64, provided their NBT data matches. (Reminder: You can craft cards by themselves to reset their NBT)

Cards can be modified from within the holder - by right clicking on a cardstack (Just like in a laser node).

NOTE: If the stacksize of the card is larger than 1, it will disable the Filter and Overclocker slots to prevent item duping. #BlameSoaryn

By holding shift and right clicking the Card holder, it will start automatically pulling cards out of your inventory! You can tell this is activated because the card holder starts to glow as if it were enchanted. Shift-right click again to toggle it off. If you have the card holder in your inventory when you open a node, you'll see its cards displayed

NOTE: Filters and Overclockers can now be stored in the card holder!  Filters will only be automatically added to the card holder if they have no stored data. Craft them by themselves to clear any saved data.

Filters with stored data can still be manually added to the card holder.

entries.body:
物品卡用于在箱子、熔炉等存储空间之间传输物品。

超频器相关数值详见下页。

物品/tick 数值（最大值）与超频器数量关系：

- 0 超频器：8 物品/20t

- 1 超频器：16 物品/15t

- 2 超频器：32 物品/10t

- 3 超频器：48 物品/5t

- 4 超频器：64 物品/1t

Item Cards are used to send items between inventories, such as chests and furnaces.

Overclocker values are documented on the following page.

entries.body:
红石卡用于在整个 LaserIO 网络中传输红石信号。

红石卡有专属的“红石频道”设置，与其他物流卡的频道相互独立。

红石卡有两个模式：

输入处于输入模式时，红石卡会接受红石粉、拉杆、按钮等外界红石信号，并在卡内设置的红石频道上传输该信号。

输出处于输出模式时，红石卡会向红石粉、红石灯、红石中继器等外界方块传出信号。

输出模式可调整信号的强弱。弱信号模式下，仅节点毗邻的方块会被充能，和红石粉类似。

强信号模式下，与节点毗邻的方块能进一步给它的毗邻方块充能，和拉杆类似。

所有物流卡都有一个“红石模式”设置，默认为“忽略”，也即该卡会一直运行。

若设为“低”，则该卡仅会在其红石频道内无信号时工作。（红石频道按钮在红石控制按钮右侧。）

若设为“高”，则该卡仅会在其红石频道内有信号时工作。
entries.bodyEn:
Redstone cards are used to transmit redstone signals across the entire LaserIO network.

Redstone cards have a dedicated 'redstone channel', separate from the channels that other cards use.

Redstone cards have 2 modes:

Input Input mode will accept a redstone signal from something like redstone dust, a lever, or a button, and transmit it across the network on the redstone channel configured on the card.

Output Output will emit a redstone signal to blocks like redstone dust, lamp, or repeaters.

Output mode has a toggle for Weak vs Strong. In weak mode, only directly adjacent blocks like redstone will get the signal, similar to how redstone dust works.

In strong mode the redstone signal can transmit through an adjacent block and affect the block on the other side, like how levers work.

All cards have a redstone mode toggle, which defaults to ignored, meaning the cards will always operate.

If set to low, the cards will only function when there is NOT a redstone signal on the redstone channel (the channel button is to the right of the redstone toggle).

On redstone high mode, the cards will only operate when there IS a redstone signal on the redstone channel.

entries.body:
基础过滤器用于限制存储空间内允许存在何种物品。

过滤器内的槽是“幽灵槽”，它们不实际存放物品，只存放物品的信息。

若装有 JEI，你可以直接从 JEI 物品列表内将对应物品拖至“幽灵槽”内。左击后拖出即可。
entries.bodyEn:
The basic filter can be used to limit what items are allowed in an inventory.

These slots are 'ghost slots', which means they do not REALLY hold items, just an image of an item.

If JEI is installed, you may drag items from JEI into these 'ghost slots'. Simply left click and drag out of JEI into the filter UI.

entries.body:
计数过滤器可设置给定数量的物品，在不同模式的物流卡中效用不同。

具体数量可为 1 到 4096 间任意整数。左击增加，右击减少。按住 Shift 或 Ctrl 会分别以 10 或 64 的倍数进行调整。

若计数过滤器处于存储卡中，其会尝试在对应存储空间内保有给定数量的资源。例如，放入设为 64 个圆石的计数过滤器，即可在箱子内保有 64 个圆石。

若计数过滤器处于输入卡中，其会限制提取卡向其输入物品的数量。

若计数过滤器处于提取卡中，其会在存储空间中余下给定数量的物品。例如，放入设为 8 个圆石的过滤器，即可将对应箱子内所有物品取出，并保留 8 个圆石。

计数过滤器没有白名单与黑名单按钮；黑名单对计数过滤器来讲没有意义，所有计数过滤器都是“白名单模式”。JEI 相关操作与基础过滤器一致。
entries.bodyEn:
The Count Filter can designate a specified number of items, and plays a different role based on the card's mode.

Stack sizes of items can go from 1 to 4096. Left click will increase the stack size, while right click will decrease it. Holding shift or control will modify this amount by 10 or 64 respectively.

If a counting filter is used in a stocker mode card, it will try to keep the specified amount of resources in stock. For example, keeping 64 cobblestone in a chest is done by using a Counting Filter with 64 cobblestone.

If a counting filter is used in an Inserter card, it will limit how many items are allowed to be sent to that inventory by extractor cards.

If a counting filter is used in a extractor mode card, it will leave the designated number of items behind. For example, if you set an extract card with a filter of 8 cobblestone, it will pull out all but the last 8 cobblestone from a chest.

Counting filters do not have an Allow vs Deny button - as Deny mode would not make any sense for a counting filter. All counting filters are 'Allow mode'.  JEI Interaction works the same as it does in a Basic Filter.

entries.body: 模组过滤器用于按照槽内物品的来源模组进行过滤。例如，若在过滤器槽内放入激光扳手，则所有 LaserIO 的物品和方块都会匹配。
entries.bodyEn: The mod filter will sort based on what mod an item/block comes from. For example, if you place a Laser Wrench in the filter, all LaserIO items and blocks will match that filter.

entries.body:
标签过滤器用于按照资源的标签进行过滤。

标签是 Minecraft 为相似资源分组的一种方式。例如，在右侧可见铁锭有标签“forge:ingots”。金锭、铜锭、锌锭等也都有这个标签。

此标签过滤器能将所有的锭直接过滤至同一存储空间！

标签过滤器界面

首先，在右上角的槽位中放入一个物品。该物品的所有标签会显示为蓝色。点击想要过滤的标签，按下“+”按钮即可。按住 Shift 再按“+”按钮能把所有标签全部加入过滤列表。

选中某标签并按“-”按钮，可移除该过滤标签。

也可以按住 Shift 点击来加入或移出。

“X”按钮会清空整个列表。

该列表是“或”列表，也即只要有一个标签符合，该物品就能通过过滤。

标签过滤器不支持匹配 NBT，因为没有必要。
entries.bodyEn:
The tag filter allows a player to filter by tags on resources.

Tags are a way for Minecraft to group similar resources. For example, on the right we can see that an Iron Ingot has the 'forge:ingots' tag. So too does gold, copper, tin, etc.

The tag filter would allow you to sort on all ingots with a single entry!

Tag UI

First, start by placing an item in the slot on the top right. A list of tags on this item will appear in blue. Click on the tag you want added, and press the + button. Holding shift and pressing the + button will add all tags to the list.

To remove a tag from the list, select it and press the - button.

Alternatively you can shift-click to automatically add/remove the tag.

The X button will clear the entire list.

The list is treated as an 'or' list - meaning an item that matches any one of the tags on the list will be filtered.

Tag Filters do not support NBT comparisons, as that would not make any sense.

entries.body:
激光扳手主要用于连接不同节点和连接器。

可先 Shift 右击节点或连接器将其设置为基点，再右击另一方块构建连接。

连接的最大距离为 8 格。

当前选中的方块高亮为绿色。
entries.bodyEn:
The Laser Wrench is primarily used to connect multiple Blocks together.

Nodes and Connectors can be connected by Shift-RightClicking to select a block, and then right clicking another block to form a connecion.

The max connection range is 8 blocks.

The currently selected block is highlighted green.

entries.body:
节点超频器是较为复杂的元件。

每个节点每面同一刻仅能运行 1 张物流卡。

若节点某面有 3 张提取模式物流卡，同一游戏刻内只有第一张物流卡会运行，而第二张仅会在第一张卡什么都不做的情况下运行。

未装有节点超频器

每个节点超频器允许节点某面同一刻多运行 1 张物流卡。节点一面最多能装 8 个节点超频器，使得 9 张物流卡能同时运行。

输入卡不需要超频器就能运行，只有提取卡和存储卡需要超频器。

装有两个节点超频器
entries.bodyEn:
Node Overclockers are a more complex component.

Each Node can only operate on 1 card per side per tick.

If there are 3 extractor cards in the side of a node, only the first one will operate during a game tick, and the second will only operate if the first fails to do anything.

There are zero Node Overclockers installed

Each Node Overclocker installed on the side of a Node allows that side to operate on more cards per tick. A total of 8 Node Overclockers can be installed, allowing all 9 nodes to be operated on.

Inserter cards do NOT need overclockers to function, ONLY Extractor and Stocker cards need them.

There are two Node Overclockers installed

entries.body:
物流卡超频器可加快单张物流卡的运行速度。

例如，物品卡仅能每 20 刻（1 秒）提取最多 8 个物品，但装入 4 个超频器就能达到每刻 64 个物品的传输速度！!

详细数值参见物流卡章节。
entries.bodyEn:
Card Overclockers allow individual cards to operate more quickly.

For example, Item Cards can only extract at most 8 items every 20 ticks (1 second). With 4 overclockers installed they can reach 64 items per 1 tick!

See the Cards section for more details on how each card is affected by overclockers.

entries.body:
化学品卡用于在通用机械（Mekanism）的储罐等存储空间之间传输化学品。这些卡只在安装有通用机械的情况下可用。

超频器相关数值详见下页。

mB/tick 数值（最大值）与超频器数量关系：

- 0 超频器：15,000mB/20t

- 1 超频器：60,000mB/15t

- 2 超频器：120,000mB/10t

- 3 超频器：180,000mB/5t

- 4 超频器：240,000mB/1t
entries.bodyEn:
Chemical Cards are used to send Chemicals between inventories, such as Mekanism Tanks.  These cards are only available if Mekanism is installed.

Overclocker values are documented on the following page.

MB/T values (max) for Overclockers:

- 0 Overclockers: 15,000mb/20t

- 1 Overclocker:  60,000mb/15t

- 2 Overclockers: 120,000mb/10t

- 3 Overclockers: 180,000mb/5t

- 4 Overclockers: 240,000mb/1t

entries.body:
物流卡复制器可在物流卡间“复制粘贴”各项设置！在激光节点界面中，用鼠标拿起物流卡复制器，再左击物流卡，即可复制设置。

右击物流卡可粘贴设置。

粘贴时，它会自行从可用的物流卡存储器中取出，或向其中放入超频器和过滤器。它不会从玩家的物品栏中取用物品。

如果缺少某种必需物品，则粘贴会失败，而不是粘贴一部分设置。
entries.bodyEn:
The Card Cloner can be used to 'copy and paste' card settings from one card to another! From within a Laser Node screen, pickup the Card Cloner (on your cursor) and left click on a card to copy its settings.

Right click on a card to paste the stored settings.

When pasting, Overclockers and Filters will be automatically taken (or placed back) inside the currently available Card Holder. These items will not be pulled out of the player's inventory.

If any of the necessary items are missing, the paste will fail. It will NOT partially paste the settings.

entries.body:
NBT 过滤器的界面和功能均与标签过滤器类似。

在右上角槽位中放置物品，可显示该物品的所有 NBT 标签。添加（操作与标签过滤器一致）至列表后，拥有这些标签的物品均会纳入过滤范围，不论标签的具体值是什么。

NBT 过滤器界面

例如，所有附魔物品均带有“魔咒”标签，对应抢夺、锋利等魔咒。将“魔咒”标签加入列表后，过滤器会滤出所有附魔物品。

附魔剑和未附魔的剑会进入不同的存储空间，不论其上具体带有什么魔咒。

所有其他功能均与标签过滤器一致，更多信息课参见该条目。
entries.bodyEn:
The NBT filter has a very similar UI and functionality as the Tag Filter.

Placing an item in the top right slot will show you all nbt tag labels on that item. Adding them to the list (in the same way you do with the tag filter) will filter items that contain those tags, regardless of the values those tags are assigned.

NBT UI

For example, all enchanted items have an 'Enchantments' tag, which specifies things like Looting, sharpness, etc. If you add the 'enchantments' tag to this list, the filter will filter out all enchanted items.

Enchanted swords can go in one inventory, and non-enchanted to another. Regardless of which enchantments are applied.

All other functionality is identical to the Tag Filter, see that entry for more information.

entries.body:
工作流程
给控制器供 FE，通过连接器和网线接入来源、目标库存。打开控制器，新建频道，先选物品、流体、能量或逻辑类型，再把需要的连接器加入这个频道。连接到网线不等于已经加入传输频道。

配置步骤
在频道内选择来源连接器，设为抽取；目标连接器设为插入。每个端点分别设置交互侧、优先级、过滤和传输条件。先用单一来源与单一目标确认方向，再增加其他机器。

故障排查
控制器看不到机器时检查线缆颜色、连接器是否贴住机器与网络连通；能看到却不传输时检查频道是否启用、端点是否加入、资源类型、过滤和目标接收面。
entries.bodyEn:
The Controller is the heart of an XNet network. It edits channels and decides how items, fluids, energy, or redstone move through connected blocks.

Add a channel, choose its type, then add connectors to that channel. Every connector can have its own side, priority, filters, and transfer settings.

entries.zh: 红色连接器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
把连接器贴在要交互的机器或库存上，再用相容的网络线连接控制器。连接器本身只提供网络接入，资源如何传输由控制器里的频道决定。

普通与高级
高级连接器提供更多端点配置能力，包括从指定侧与目标交互。需要从不便接线的一面抽取时，先检查该端点是否支持选择交互侧。

故障排查
机器面有严格输入输出限制时，应选择它真正开放的物品、流体或能量面。更换连接器不会绕过机器内部的配方、侧面或红石条件。
entries.bodyEn:
Use a Connector to attach a cable network to a block or machine. Open the Connector to name it and control whether it is enabled.

Advanced Connectors support higher internal energy capacity and more demanding setups. They are configured in the same way as normal connectors.

Routing Connectors are for routing networks. Use them with routing cables when linking networks through Routers or Wireless Routers.

entries.zh: 红色网络线缆：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
使用相同网络的线缆与连接器连成连续路径。普通网络线用于控制器和机器端点；路由线及路由连接器用于路由器之间的路由网络，两者用途不同。

注意事项
不同颜色帮助隔离相邻网络。线缆不是传统管道，没有需要沿途逐格移动的物品缓存；实际传输由频道端点配置执行。故障时从控制器沿线检查断点、颜色和连接器。
entries.bodyEn:
Colored cables form local networks. Red, green, blue, and yellow cables do not connect to each other, even when placed next to each other.

Routing cables are different: they are used by Routers and Wireless Routers to link multiple controller networks together.

entries.body:
操作步骤
伪装板用于遮盖网络连接，保留线路的功能。按物品提示选择伪装外观并应用到支持的位置，维护时使用对应工具检查隐藏的连接器与线缆。

故障排查
伪装外观并不表示它变成了普通实心方块，也不修复网络断点。拆改线路前先确认被遮挡的是哪一段网络，避免将相邻的不同网络混接。
entries.bodyEn:
Facades hide XNet cables by mimicking another block. Use the facade item on a block to copy it, then place it over an XNet cable.

Connectors can also be hidden with facades. Breaking the facade reveals or restores the cable setup behind it.

entries.zh: 红石代理器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
红石代理把红石信号操作交给 XNet 频道。先将代理接入控制器网络，再在逻辑或相应端点设置中选择读取、输出的方向及条件。

故障排查
频道读到信号却未控制目标时，检查代理面对的方块、输出方向、频道条件，以及目标机器自身的红石模式。不要把红石读写误当作能量或物品传输。
entries.bodyEn:
The Redstone Proxy is a helper block for redstone interaction. Use it where an XNet setup needs a simple redstone-facing block.

The update variant also sends neighbor updates. Use it when nearby redstone should be notified immediately.

entries.body:
工作流程
路由器用于在不同控制器网络之间共享频道。用路由线与路由连接器构成路由网络，然后在路由器 GUI 中发布需要共享的本地频道，并让另一端消费该频道。

配置步骤
核对两端频道类型和发布名称，再分别检查各自控制器的本地抽取、插入端点。路由器共享频道，不会替你自动把所有机器加入频道。

故障排查
本地能传、跨网络不能传时，先查路由网络连接，再查发布/消费关系和名称。普通网线接通不代表路由网络也已经成立。
entries.bodyEn:
The Router connects multiple XNet controller networks. Attach it to a routing cable network, then publish or consume channels from the linked controllers.

Use routing cables and routing connectors for the router network. Normal colored cables stay local to one controller network.

entries.zh: 无线路由器：操作与配置
entries.body:
操作步骤
在无线路由器上方安装天线；天线等级决定可用传输范围。无线端仍与本地路由网络配合，通过路由器界面发布或消费频道。

故障排查
分别检查两端天线、距离、路由器供电和本地路由连接，再检查频道类型、名称与共享方向。无线链路只连接网络，机器端点的侧面和过滤仍由各自控制器管理。
entries.bodyEn:
The Wireless Router can connect two separate Controller networks together.

Place an antenna on top of the router. The tier of that antenna determines the wireless range.

Wireless routers work with routing networks. Use routing cables and connectors on the local side, then publish or consume channels through the router GUI.

entries.body:
操作步骤
把天线与无线路由器组成对应结构，不同天线等级提供不同范围。使用碟形或更高级天线时按当前模组手册核对组成与朝向。

故障排查
天线不是独立的物品传输器，必须配合无线路由器和已经配置的路由频道。不要只在远处放天线而省略本地路由网络。
entries.bodyEn:
A Wireless Router needs an antenna on top. A normal antenna gives short range, an antenna base improves it, and an antenna dish allows unlimited range.

Higher antenna tiers cost more RF per channel. Check the item tooltip for the configured range and RF/t cost.

entries.body: 供能控制器通过线缆和连接器接到机器。在控制器 GUI 创建资源频道，为每个连接器配置输入/输出、优先级、过滤与传输条件。
entries.bodyEn: Cable powered controllers through connectors to machines. Create resource channels in the controller GUI and configure endpoint direction, priority, filters and conditions.

entries.zh: XNet 控制器、连接器与频道
entries.body:
控制器供电，连接器贴住目标机器，再用兼容网线连起来。GUI 每个频道先选择物品、流体、能量或逻辑类型，再为端点设抽取/插入。

物品频道设置过滤、数量和优先级；高级连接器支持更多侧面能力。路由器用于连接/共享逻辑网络，不能代替控制器给一个空频道自动制定规则。
entries.bodyEn: Power the controller and wire connectors on machines. Set each channel’s resource type and endpoint roles, then filters/rates. Advanced connectors add capabilities; routers do not create transfer rules.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
操作步骤
把连接器贴在要交互的机器或库存上，再用相容的网络线连接控制器。连接器本身只提供网络接入，资源如何传输由控制器里的频道决定。

普通与高级
高级连接器提供更多端点配置能力，包括从指定侧与目标交互。需要从不便接线的一面抽取时，先检查该端点是否支持选择交互侧。

故障排查
机器面有严格输入输出限制时，应选择它真正开放的物品、流体或能量面。更换连接器不会绕过机器内部的配方、侧面或红石条件。
entries.bodyEn:
Use a Connector to attach a cable network to a block or machine. Open the Connector to name it and control whether it is enabled.

Advanced Connectors support higher internal energy capacity and more demanding setups. They are configured in the same way as normal connectors.

Routing Connectors are for routing networks. Use them with routing cables when linking networks through Routers or Wireless Routers.
