entries.zh: 路由器：模块配置、顺序与目标
entries.body:
操作步骤
右键打开路由器，把拉取、发送、放置等模块依次装入模块槽。模块从左到右执行；通常先把物品拉入一格缓存，再用后面的发送模块移出。路由器升级与模块自身参数分开设置。

模块配置
在 GUI 悬停已安装模块，按配置键或鼠标中键即可编辑，不必拆出。方向、过滤黑白名单、数量与红石控制属于各模块的配置。需要远程目标的模块，按该模块提示进行绑定，不能只填一个方向就认为已绑定远处库存。

故障排查
缓存为空先看前面的拉取模块、来源库存和过滤；缓存有物品但送不走，查发送目标、接收面、空间和模块过滤。低耗模式空闲后降低检查频率；红石设为“从不”时速度升级也不会让它工作。
entries.bodyEn:
Install modules in execution order: typically pull into the single buffer slot, then send out with a later module. Router upgrades and module parameters are separate.

Hover an installed module and use the configure key or middle-click to edit direction, filters, quantities and redstone behavior. Remote modules need the binding described by their own tooltips.

For an empty buffer, inspect the pull module and source filter. For a blocked buffer, inspect the sender, destination side, space and filter. Eco mode slows idle checks; a router set to Never ignores speed upgrades.

entries.body: 把模块按顺序装入路由器，模块用自身 GUI 配置方向、目标与过滤。路由器缓冲槽保存正在处理的物品；发送/接收模块需正确绑定目标。
entries.bodyEn: Install modules in execution order and configure their direction, targets and filters. The router buffer holds the current item. Bind sender and receiver targets correctly.

entries.body:
模块化路由器是本系统的核心。它负责执行所有插入其中的模块，以各种方式移动物品、方块和流体。

装有数个模块和升级的模块化路由器 GUI

模块化路由器有一格栏位的缓存区，可以存放一组物品。该缓存区和正常物品栏一样开放，因此可以通过漏斗和其他模组的运输系统与其进行互动。此外，对着路由器放置的比较器将会测量栏位的空满程度。

模块化路由器有九个栏位用于安装模块。每当路由器运行一次（每秒 1 至 10 次，取决于速度升级），它就会从左到右轮流执行每个模块。你可以在GUI中将鼠标悬浮在模块上方按[对应按键（见键位设置）]或鼠标中键就能配置安装的模块，无需将它们移除。

模块化路由器有五个栏位用于安装升级。升级会以多种方式增强路由器的功能；比如说，每个放入的速度升级都会时路由器刻来的更快，而每个堆叠升级都可使其每次操作处理更多物品。

模块化路由器在如何响应红石输入方面具有一定的灵活性，这是通过右上角的按钮控制的：

- 默认：总是运行，忽视红石信号

- 只在无红石信号时运行

- 只在有红石信号时运行

- 从不运行

- 当接收红石脉冲（任何强度高于先前的信号）时运行一次。

本着环境友好的精神，路由器有一个选项，可以让路由器待机一段时间后自动放慢速度。当低耗模式开启时，如果路由器在上5 秒钟都没有可做的事，它就会放慢速度，每5 秒只运行一次（无视速度升级）。然而，当它有可做的事时，就会回到正常的工作速度。

这主要是为了繁忙的服务器设计，用于节省 CPU 周期，但是，对于任何很少运行并且快速传输物品没有那么重要的路由器来说，这可能是一种很好的选择（比如一个有着真空模块定期收集羊毛的绵羊牧场）。
entries.bodyEn:
The Modular Router is the core of the routing system. It is responsible for executing all the modules plugged into it; moving items, blocks and fluids around in various ways.

An Modular Router GUI with several modules and upgrades installed

The Modular Router has a one-slot buffer, able to hold up to stack of items. This buffer is exposed as a normal inventory, so it can be interacted with via Hoppers and other mod piping systems.In addition, a Comparator placed against the router will measure the slot's fullness as expected.

The Modular Router has nine slots for modules. Each time the router runs (between 1 and 10 times per second depending on Speed Upgrades), it will execute each module in turn, from left to right.You can configure installed modules without removing them from the router by pressing [the configured key] while hovering over it, or Middle-Clicking the module in the GUI.

The Modular Router has five slots for upgrades. Upgrades enhance the router's functionality in various ways; for example, each inserted Speed Upgrade makes the router tick a little faster, while each Stack Upgrade allows it to handle more items in each operation.

The Modular Router has some flexibility over how it responds to redstone input, controlled by the top-right button:

- Default: always run, regardless of redstone signal

- Only run when there is no redstone signal

- Only run when there is a redstone signal

- Never run

- Run once when a redstone pulse is received (any signal higher than previously).

In the spirit of being environmentally-friendly, the router has an option to automatically slow down if it's been idle for a while.When Eco Mode is enabled, if the router has done no work in the last 5 seconds then it will slow down and only tick once every 5 seconds (regardless of Speed Upgrades). However, as soon as it does any work, it will return to normal tick speed.

This is primarily intended for busy servers, to save on CPU cycles, but it's potentially nice-to-have for any router that only runs rarely and where rapid item transfer isn't that important (e.g. a sheep farm where you might have a Vacuum Module gathering sheared wool periodically).

entries.body: 该拓展只能被添加至真空模块中。它可以使真空模块无视掉落物品的正常拾取延迟⸺玩家投掷的物品有 40 刻的延迟，其它手段投掷的物品有 10 刻的延迟（例如绵羊剪毛）⸺立刻拾取任何检测到的物品。最多可以添加一个快速拾取拓展。
entries.bodyEn: This augment can only be added to the Vacuum Module. It allows the Vacuum Module to ignore the normal pickup delay on dropped items - 40 ticks for items dropped by players, and 10 ticks for items dropped by other means (e.g. sheep shearing) - and pick up items as soon as it sees them.A max of one Fast Pickup Augment can be added.

entries.body: 该拓展只能被添加至挤出模块 2 型中。添加后，任何由模块挤出的假方块都会有对应方块的特性，例如黑曜石难以被破坏、荧石会发光，以及红石块会发出红石信号。
entries.bodyEn: This augment can only be added to the Extruder Module Mk2.When present, any fake blocks extruded by the module take on the properties of the faked block, e.g. Obsidian is hard to break, Glowstone emits light, and Redstone Blocks emit a redstone signal.

entries.body: 该拓展只能被添加至投掷器和投掷模块中。它可以堆叠；每添加一个拓展，投掷的物品就会增加 10 刻（0.5 秒）的拾取延迟。例如，这对防止玩家意外捡起附近的掉落物品来说非常有用。
entries.bodyEn: This augment can only be added to the Dropper and Flinger modules.It can be stacked; each augment added will increase the pickup delay on dropped/flung items by 10 ticks (0.5 sec). This can be useful if you don't want players accidentally picking up nearby dropped items, for example.

entries.body: 该拓展只能被添加至挤出 1 型和挤出 2 型模块中。它可以堆叠；每个拓展都会增加模块挤出方块时推动实体的推力。
entries.bodyEn: This augment can only be added to the Extruder Mk1 and Extruder Mk2 modules.It can be stacked; each augment increases the force that entities are shoved when the module extrudes a block.

entries.body: 该拓展只能被添加至有范围的模块中（发送1 型 / 2 型、抽取1 型 / 2 型、挤出1 型 / 2 型、流体 2 型、真空）。它可以堆叠；每个拓展都会降低一格模块的范围。此拓展可能只适合与真空模块一起使用，以便控制模块检测物品的范围。
entries.bodyEn: This augment can be added to any module which has a range (Sender Mk1 / Mk2, Puller Mk1 / Mk2, Extruder Mk1 / Mk2, Fluid Mk2, Vacuum).It can be stacked; each augment will reduce the range of the module by one block.This is probably only useful in conjunction with the Vacuum Module, to control the range it scans for items.

entries.body: 该拓展只能被添加至有范围的模块中（发送1 型 / 2 型、抽取1 型 / 2 型、挤出1 型 / 2 型、流体 2 型、真空）。它可以堆叠；每个拓展都会增加一格模块的范围。
entries.bodyEn: This augment can be added to any module which has a range (Sender Mk1 / Mk2, Puller Mk1 / Mk2, Extruder Mk1 / Mk2, Fluid Mk2, Vacuum).It can be stacked; each augment will increase the range of the module by one block.

entries.body: 该拓展可以被添加至任意模块。通常情况下，模块会在路由器运行时运行，不需要其他条件。然而，如果将此拓展添加到模块中，就可使模块定义自己的红石行为；模块的 GUI 中会添加一个额外的按钮用于控制红石行为。
entries.bodyEn: This augment can be added to any module.Normally, modules are run when the router runs, no questions asked. However, if this augment is added to a module, that module can define its own redstone behaviour; an extra button is added to the module's GUI to control this.

entries.body:
该拓展可以精确控制从容器或路由器缓存区中输入或输出的物品量。当模块安装调节拓展时，你会看到其 GUI 中有额外的数字文本框供你配置限度。此限度在特定的模块上有着不同的解释：

- 对于发送1 型 / 2 型 / 3 型模块和玩家模块（输入模式）来说，只有当容器中该物品的数量小于配置的数字时，模块才会向容器发送物品。

- 对于抽取1 型 / 2 型和玩家模块（提取模式）来说，只有当容器中的该物品的数量大于配置的数字时，模块才会从容器中抽取物品。

- 对于投掷器、投掷、放置和销毁模块来说，只有当路由器缓存区的物品数量大于配置的数字时模块才会运作。

- 对于破坏和真空模块来说，只有当路由器缓存区的物品数量小于配置的数字时模块才会运作。

- 对于流体1 型 / 2 型模块来说，限度可以是目标储罐容量的百分比，或以 mB 为单位的绝对含量（在 GUI 中可选），而不是物品数量。当抽取流体时，只有当目标中流体多于配置的量时模块才会运作；当输出流体时，只有当目标中流体少于配置的量时模块才会运作。
entries.bodyEn:
This augment allows for precise control over how many items may be sent to or pulled from an inventory, or the router's buffer.When a module has a Regulator Augment, you will see an extra numeric textfield in its GUI where you can configure a limit. This limit is interpreted differently depending on the particular module:

- For the Sender Mk1 / Mk2 / Mk3 Modules and Player Module (in insert mode), the modules will only send an item to the inventory if there are fewer than the configured number of that item already in the inventory.

- For the Puller Mk1 / Mk2 and Player Module (in extract mode), the modules will only pull an item from the inventory if there are more than the configured number of that item in the inventory.

- For the Dropper, Flinger, Placer & Void Modules, the modules will only run if there are more than the configured number of that item in the router's buffer.

- For the Breaker & Vacuum Modules, the modules will only run if there are fewer than the configured number of that item in the router's buffer.

- For the Fluid Mk1 / Mk2 modules, the limit can be a percentage of the target tank's capacity or an absolute amount in mB (selectable in the GUI) rather than a number of items. When pulling fluid, the module will only run if there is more fluid in the target than the configured amount; when pushing fluid, it will only run if there is less fluid than the configured amount.

entries.body:
该模块可以被添加至任何可以处理物品（与方块、流体或能量相对）的模块中。向模块中添加堆叠拓展可以增加模块每游戏能够处理的物品数量；每个堆叠拓展可使物品数量翻倍，最大上限为物品的自然堆叠大小（大多数物品为 64）。

如果路由器同时安装了堆叠升级，模块中的堆叠拓展会覆盖它；比如说，如果路由器有 6 个堆叠升级，而模块有 2 个堆叠拓展，模块每游戏刻只会处理 4 个物品，而不是 64 个。
entries.bodyEn:
This module can be added to any module which handles items (as opposed to blocks, fluids or energy).Adding Stack Augments to a module increases the number of items it can process per tick; each Stack Augment doubles the number of items, up to a maximum of the item's natural stack size (64 for most items).

If the router also has Stack Upgrades installed, the module's Stack Augments will override that; e.g. if a router has 6 Stack Upgrades, and a module has 2 Stack Augments, the module will process 4 items per tick, not 64.

entries.body:
该拓展只能被添加至真空模块中。添加该拓展后，真空模块将会吸收经验球，而不是物品。经验球将会以每瓶 7 经验的倍率（摔碎附魔之瓶得到的平均经验值）转化为附魔之瓶。

取决于安装的其他模组，该拓展也有可能将经验球转化为经验流体。这需要路由器的缓存区或相邻处有一个流体储罐。在后一种情况下，请确保真空模块 GUI 中的输出按钮为开启状态。
entries.bodyEn:
This augment can only be added to a Vacuum Module.When this augment is added, the Vacuum Module will absorb experience orbs instead of items. The orbs will be converted into Bottles o' Enchanting at the rate of 7XP per bottle (which is the average amount of XP gained by breaking a Bottle o' Enchanting).

Depending on what other mods are installed, it might also be possible to convert orbs into XP fluids. This requires that either a fluid-containing tank is in the router's buffer, or adjacent to the router. In the latter case, ensure that the Eject button is enabled in the Vacuum Module's GUI.

entries.body:
智能过滤器可以代替常规物品放入模块的过滤器栏位中。和直接匹配物品不同，过滤器有特殊的匹配功能。比方说，批量物品过滤器可以高效的匹配 54 种不同的物品，且其物品可以直接从现有容器中配置。

安装在抽取模块 2 型中的批量物品过滤器
entries.bodyEn:
Smart Filters can be inserted into a module's filter slots in place of regular items.  Instead of just trying to match against the item directly, filters have special matching functionality.For example, the Bulk Item Filter can efficiently match against up to 54 different items, and its items can be configured from an existing inventory.

Bulk Item Filter installed in a Puller Mk2 Module

entries.body:
该过滤器可以按物品的各种杂项整型属性匹配物品。目前支持的检测有：

- 流体容器物品（桶、储罐⋯⋯）的流体储量百分比。

- 能量容器物品（电池、电力工具⋯⋯）的能量储量百分比。

- 物品上魔咒的最高魔咒等级（可以用于过滤附魔物品，比如从刷怪塔中来的物品）。

- 物品（工具、武器）的耐久度与最大耐久度百分比。

- 可食用物品的食物营养价值，恢复多少半个鸡腿的数量（例如牛排的值为 8）。

没有检测属性的物品，返回值将会永远为 -1，比如一块圆石的耐久度值为 -1。这与 0 返回值不同，因为有着小于 1% 耐久度的工具会返回 0 这个值。该过滤器非常适合自动抽取损坏或没电的物品，进行修复/充电，等等。
entries.bodyEn:
This filter allows for matching of items by various miscellaneous integer properties of the item. The current inspections supported are:

- For fluid container items (buckets, tanks...), the fluid level as a percentage.

- For energy container items (batteries, powered tools...), the energy level as a percentage.

- The highest enchantment level of enchantments on the item (can be used to filter out enchanted items, e.g. from a mob farm)

- The durability of items (tools, weapons) as a percentage of the max durability.

- For edible items, the food value as the number of half-shanks restored (e.g. steak has a value of 8).

For items which don't have the inspected property at all, the returned value will always be -1, e.g. a piece of Cobblestone has a durability value of -1. This is distinct from a 0 return, since a tool with <1% durability remaining would return a value of 0.This filter can be useful to automatically pull out damaged or discharged items for repair/recharging, etc.

entries.body:
该过滤器可以按物品属于的模组匹配物品。每个过滤器最多可以添加 6 个模组。

- 右击过滤器以打开其GUI（也可以对安装在模块中的过滤器按鼠标中键 / [对应按键（见键位设置）] ）。

- 将任意物品放入GUI左上角的物品栏位中。物品的模组名称将会显示在右方。点击“+”按钮将其添加至下方的模组列表中。

- 点击条目旁的红色“X”按钮将模组从列表中移除。原版物品也可以被添加，它们的“模组”名称将会显示为Minecraft。
entries.bodyEn:
This filter allows for matching of items by the mod they belong to. Up to 6 mods can be added per installed filter.

- Right-click the filter to open its GUI (or middle-click / press [the configured key] on a filter which is installed in a module).

- Drop any item into the item slot in the top-left corner of the GUI. The item's mod name will be displayed to the right. Click the + button to add it to the mod list below.

- Click the red X button beside an entry to remove that mod from the list.Vanilla items can be added too, and their "mod" will be shown as Minecraft.

entries.body:
该过滤器可以用正则表达式匹配物品和方块，和物品的注册名进行比对。正则表达式非常强大，但需要花一些时间进行学习才能解锁其全部潜力。不过，基础的正则表达式运用并不是很困难。有许多网站都有关于正则表达式的教程信息，例如RegexOne。

因为物品过滤是完全在服务器中进行的，因此无法确保物品的显示文本是什么。因此，所有过滤都会按照物品的内部注册名进行比对。你可以通过按F3+H开启高级提示框来查看其注册名。请注意，匹配只会比对冒号后的部分。

右击过滤器，或对安装在模块中的过滤器按鼠标中键 / [对应按键（见键位设置）]来打开模块GUI。

- 在顶部的文本框中输入正则表达式，然后按回车键或点击绿色的“+”按钮。假设语法正确，你的正则表达式将会添加到列表中。一个过滤器中最多有 6 个条目。

- 点击任意正则表达式旁的红色“X”将其从列表中移除。

- 匹配不区分大小写。

正则表达式'ore'会匹配所有注册名中含有'ore'的物品（"iron_ore"、"gold_ore"、"redstone_ore"）。不幸的是，它也会匹配"drill_core"，你可以通过使用正则表达式_ore来避免这种情况。想要更精确，你可以使用_ore$，这可以确保字符串"_ore"在物品注册名的结尾。

配置一个玩家模块让它从玩家的主物品栏中提取物品，并在模块中放一个含有_ore的正则过滤器。这可以用于提取任何来自你物品栏中的矿石，无论你身在何地，并将它们放到矿石处理系统中；如果你在离你基底很远的地方采矿，并且你想要让采掘的矿物立即送回家，这会很方便。
entries.bodyEn:
This filter allows for matching of blocks and items with a regular expression, against the item's registry name. Regular expressions are very powerful, but take some learning to unlock their full potential. However, basic regex usage isn't too difficult. There are many websites with tutorial information on regular expressions, e.g. RegexOne.

Because item filtering is done purely on the server, it can't know for sure what an item's displayed text is.  Therefore, all filtering matches are made against the item's internal registry name. You can find this registry name by toggling on advanced tooltip display with F3+H.Note that matching is done against only the part of the registry name after the colon.

To open the module GUI, right-click the filter, or middle-click / press [the configured key] on a filter which is installed in a module.

- Type your regex into the textfield at the top, and hit Return or click the green + button. Your regex will be added to the list, assuming its syntax is valid. You can have up to 6 entries in one filter.

- Click the red X next to any regex to remove it from the list.

- Matches are case-insensitive.

A regex of 'ore' will match any items with 'ore' in their registry name ("iron_ore", "gold_ore", "redstone_ore"). Unfortunately, it will also match "drill_core", but you can avoid this by using a regex of _ore. To be even more specific, you could use _ore$, which also ensures that the string "_ore" is at the end of the item's registry name.

Configure a Player Module to extract from the player's main inventory, and put a regex filter containing _ore in the module. This can be used to extract any ores from your inventory, regardless of where you are, into your ore processing system; very handy if you're mining far from your base and you want ores that you've mined to be sent home immediately.

entries.body:
拓展和升级相似，但用于模块而不是模块化路由器。每个模块都有可以安装 4 个拓展的栏位（一些拓展可以堆叠）。拓展可以各种方式增强或拓展模块的功能。

一个带有 6 个范围扩大拓展和经验真空拓展的真空模块
entries.bodyEn:
Augments are like upgrades but are inserted into a module rather than a Modular Router. Each module has slots for 4 augments (some augments can be stacked). Augments enhance or extend a module's functionality in various ways.

A Vacuum Module with 6 Range Up augments and an XP Vacuum augment

entries.body:
该模块会尝试破坏与路由器模块配置方向相邻的方块。它可以破坏大多数方块，但任何硬度为不可破坏（比如原版的基岩或末地传送门）的方块不可以被破坏，流体方块也无法被破坏。方块破坏后，如果可行，其主要掉落物会被自动放进路由器的物品缓存区。

破坏模块可以由任意类型的镐（包括模组中的镐）合成而得，但用于合成模块的镐决定了模块的采集等级。比如你用一把铁镐合成了破坏模块，它就无法破坏黑曜石。此外，镐上的任何魔咒都会在模块中生效（精准采集和时运有特殊用途）。

默认状态下破坏模块过滤器会对预期掉落的物品生效，而不是方块本身。比如过滤石头不会在破坏石头时起效，除非模块开启了精准采集。在此情况下，你应该过滤圆石。你可以在模块 GUI 中设置按方块匹配；这对区分不掉落任何东西的方块很有用，比如冰和浮冰。
entries.bodyEn:
This module tries to break a block, adjacent to the Router in the module's configured direction.Most blocks are breakable, although anything with an unbreakable hardness (e.g. vanilla Bedrock or End Portal) can not be broken, nor can any fluid blocks. If the block is broken, its primary drop(s) will be automatically inserted into the item router's buffer, if possible.

The Breaker Module can be crafted with any type of pickaxe (including modded pickaxes), but the pickaxe used to craft the module determines its harvest level.  E.g. if you create a Breaker Module with an Iron Pickaxe, it will not be able to break Obsidian.Additionally, any enchantments on the pickaxe used will be noted in the module (Silk Touch and Fortune are of particular use).

By default the Breaker Module filter works on items that would be dropped, rather than on the block itself. E.g. filtering on Stone would not work to break Stone, unless the module has Silk Touch enabled. In this case, you should filter on Cobblestone.You can set the module to match by the block via the module GUI; this can be useful to distinguish between blocks that both drop nothing, e.g. Ice and Packed Ice.

entries.body:
默认状态下，路由器每 20 服务器刻运行一次，或者说每秒执行一次。每个路由器刻，所有安装的模块都会按顺序执行，从左到右。如果你需要一个运行更快的路由器，请添加速度升级；每个速度升级都会减少 2 服务器刻的刻间隔，最低可达每 2 服务器刻运行一次（或者说每秒运行 10 次）。

基准刻速率、每次升级增加的路由器刻以及硬下限刻速率都可以在模块配置中配置（config/modularrouters-common.toml）。出于性能原因，可能时应该优先考虑堆叠升级而不是速度升级；明智地使用速度升级，并且仅在绝对需要最大物品传输速率的情况下使用。请善待服务器(tm)。
entries.bodyEn:
By default, a router ticks every 20 server ticks, or once per second. On each tick, every installed module is executed in order, left to right.If you need a router to run faster than this, add Speed Upgrades; each Speed Upgrade reduces the tick interval by 2 server ticks, down to a minimum of every 2 server ticks (or 10 times per second).

The base tick rate, tick increase per upgrade, and hard minimum tick rate are all configurable in the module's config (config/modularrouters-common.toml).For performance reasons, Stack Upgrades should be preferred over Speed Upgrades where possible; use Speed Upgrades judiciously and only where absolutely required for maximum item transfer rate.Be Kind To Your Server (tm).

entries.body:
这个强大的模块表现得像一个假玩家，可以对周围的方块或实体使用路由器缓存区中的物品。有三种模式可在 GUI 右边的控制进行选择。以下页面详细描述了每种模式。

此模式会用路由器缓存区中的物品执行右击操作，和玩家执行是一样的。其中的逻辑与玩家点击是相同的，比如用打火石右击门会打开门，而不是点火。目标方块（如果有的话）取决于路由器的朝向、模块方向和朝向上方/下方/水平模块设置。

此模式会用路由器缓存区中的物品对附近的一个实体执行右击操作。例如，你可以使用此模式为牛挤奶，或为绵羊剪毛。这会导致物品掉落在地面上，比如用路由器缓存区中多于一个的桶点击牛时。

此模式会用路由器缓存区中的物品对附近的一个一个实体执行左击操作，对其进行攻击。与其他模式不同，此模式默认会消耗Forge 能量。注：虽然速度升级在这里会很有用，但是依然会有武器冷却，因此过量的速度升级只会浪费能量和武器耐久度。

执行模块大约有 4 格的距离，和真正的玩家相似。该模块也可以配置成朝向上方或下方（默认为水平)。朝向上方对于在路由器旁或上方的完整方块上种植东西是非常方便，而朝向下方在你想要直接指向路由器周围而非远处的地面时很有用。
entries.bodyEn:
This powerful module acts like a fake player which can use an item in the router's buffer, against nearby blocks or entities. There are three modes, which can be selected via the controls on the right of the GUI. Each mode is detailed in the following pages.

This mode performs a right-click with the item in the router's buffer, just as if a player had done so. The logic used is the same as for player clicks, e.g. right-clicking a Flint and Steel on a door will open the door, not start a fire.The targeted block (if any) depends on the router's facing, module direction, and also the Look Above/Below/Level module setting.

This mode performs a right-click with the item in the router's buffer on a nearby entity. You could use this to milk a cow for example, or shear a sheep.This can result in items being dropped on the ground, e.g. if a cow is clicked with a stack of more than one bucket in the router's buffer.

This mode performs a left-click with the item in the router's buffer on a nearby entity, attacking it. This mode costs Forge Energy by default, unlike other modules.Note: while Speed Upgrades can be useful here, weapon cooldowns do apply, so excessive Speed Upgrades will just end up wasting energy and weapon durability.

The Activator has a range of about 4 blocks, similar to what an actual player has. The module can also be configured to look Above or Below (default is Level).Above is particularly handy for planting things on top of a solid block beside or above the router, while Below is useful when you want to target the ground directly adjacent to the router, rather than a more distant block.

entries.body: 创造模块是一种无法合成的特殊模块，会无中生有，产生物品进入路由器的缓存区。它将模块的过滤器作为物品列表，每路由器刻都会以轮询的方式遍历过滤器中的物品。它不会受任何其它过滤器设置的影响（白名单/黑名单，NBT 匹配⋯⋯）。
entries.bodyEn: The Creative Module is a special uncraftable module which simply inserts items, from out of nowhere, into the router's buffer.It uses the module's filter as an item list, and on each tick moves to the next item in the filter in round-robin fashion. It doesn't care about any other filter settings (whitelist/blacklist, match NBT...).

entries.body: 该模块不会操纵物品，而是检测路由器缓存区中的特定物品。如果缓存区中的物品与模块的过滤器相匹配，它就会使路由器在配置方向发出红石信号。信号等级（默认：15）和信号充能方式（默认：弱）可以通过模块 GUI 调整。
entries.bodyEn: This module doesn't actually manipulate items, but instead detects specific items in the router's buffer. If the buffer contents are matched by the module's filter, it will make the router emit a redstone signal in the configured direction.The signal level (default: 15) and signal type (default: weak) can be adjusted via the module GUI.

entries.body:
这是发送模块 2 型的拓展版本，可以向多个目标发送物品。潜行右击容器将其加入分配模块，再次潜行右击容器将其移除。分配模块最多可以向8个目标分配物品。

通过 GUI 右侧的控制可以控制分配策略：

- 轮询⸺轮回为每个容器分配，尽可能地平均

- 随机⸺随机选取其中一个目标

- 最近⸺总是填充最近且有空位的目标

- 最远⸺总是填充总是填充最远且有空位的目标。
entries.bodyEn:
This is an extended version of the Sender Module Mk2, which can send items to multiple targets. Sneak-right-click an inventory to add it to the Distributor Module, and Sneak-right-click the inventory again to remove it.The Distributor Module can distribute to up to 8 targets.

A little extra control over distribution strategy is available via the GUI control on the right:

- Round Robin - distribute to each inventory in turn, as evenly as possible

- Random - pick one of the targets at random

- Nearest - always fill the closest target with space for the item

- Furthest - always fill the furthest target with space for the item

entries.body: 该模块会试着从路由器缓存区投掷物品，将其变为世界中的物品实体。此掉落物会在以模块的配置方向与路由器相邻的位置。物品实体放置时速度为零，和为物品增加烦人的随机速度的原版投掷器不同。
entries.bodyEn: This module tries to drop an item from the router's buffer as an item entity in the world. The drop will be adjacent to the router in the module's configured direction. The item entity will be placed with a zero velocity, unlike the vanilla Dropper which adds an irritating random velocity to the item.

entries.body:
该模块很像能量输出和分配模块的结合，因为它可为至多 8 个附近的能量接收方块无线分配 FE（Forge 能量）。潜行右击一个方块将其添加至能量分配模块，再次潜行右击方块将其移除。

和能量输出模块相似，该模块会从路由器的内部能量缓存区（如果安装了任何能量升级）或路由器物品缓存区中的承载能量的物品中提取能量。优先使用内部能量缓存区。
entries.bodyEn:
This module is like a combination of an Energy Output and a Distributor Module, in that it can wirelessly distribute FE (Forge Energy) to up to 8 nearby energy-accepting blocks.Sneak-right-click a block to add it to the Energy Distributor Module, and Sneak-right-click the block again to remove it.

Like the Energy Output Module, this module can extract energy from either the router's internal energy buffer (if any Energy Upgrades are installed) or from an energy-containing item in the router's item buffer. The internal energy buffer is used by preference.

entries.body: 该模块会试图从路由器中向其配置方向相邻的能量接收方块输出 FE（Forge 能量）。该模块会从路由器的内部能量缓存区（如果安装了任何能量升级）或路由器物品缓存区中的承载能量的物品中提取能量。优先使用内部能量缓存区。
entries.bodyEn: This module attempts to output FE (Forge Energy) from the Router to an adjacent energy-receiving block, in its configured direction. The module can extract energy from either the router's internal energy buffer (if any Energy Upgrades are installed) or from an energy-containing item in the router's item buffer. The internal energy buffer is used by preference.

entries.body:
该模块会向模块配置方向延伸和收回一行方块（来自路由器缓存区）。默认状态下，该模块会在路由器收到红石信号后延伸方块，并在路由器没有信号时收回它们，但是可以向模块添加红石增强来自定义其行为。

使用该模块，可以建造大型的延伸桥和门（如果你曾使用过来自 1.7.10 Tinker's Mechworks 模组的造桥器，你会对这个功能很熟悉）。

- 也看看伪装升级，它对隐藏路由器很有用。

- 默认范围（既可以放置的方块数量）为 12 个，最高可以被范围扩大拓展增加至 24 个。

- 如果你在其方块延伸时改变了模块的方向，路由器可能会有一点困惑。在这种情况下，破坏并重放路由器会有帮助。

- 如果你在方块延伸时破坏了路由器，它不会记住这事，因此你需要手动移除这些方块。

- 如果你有多个安装挤出模块的路由器（例如用于较宽的门或桥），你也许会发现同步升级在保证它们在同一游戏刻运行很有用。

- 挤出模块（和放置模块一样）也可以在耕地上种植作物种子，在相邻的丛林原木上种植可可豆。

需要注意的是用于此模块的破坏模块会将其采集等级（和魔咒）转移到该模块上。因此，比如你想让你的挤出模块破坏黑曜石，请确保使用钻石镐合成的破坏模块！
entries.bodyEn:
This module extends and withdraws a row of blocks (from the router's buffer) in the module's configured direction.By default, the module extends blocks when the router has a redstone signal, and withdraws them when the router has no signal, but a Redstone Enhancement can be added to the module to customise this behaviour.

Using this module, it's possible to build large extending bridges and doorways. (If you ever used the Tinker's Drawbridge from the Tinker's Mechworks mod in 1.7.10, the functionality will be familiar).

- See also the Camouflage Upgrade, which may be useful to hide the router.

- The default range (i.e. number of blocks which can be placed) is 12, but this can be increased up to 24 with Range Up Augments.

- If you change the module's direction while it has blocks extended, you may get the router a little confused. In this case, breaking and replacing the router will help.

- If you break the router while blocks are extended, it won't remember that, and you'll need to manually remove those blocks.

- If you have multiple routers together with Extruder Modules installed (e.g. for a wide door or bridge), you may find the Sync Upgrade useful to ensure they all run on the same tick.

- The Extruder (like the Placer) can also plant crop seeds on farmland, and cocoa beans on an adjacent jungle log.

It is important to note that the Breaker Module used to craft this module will transfer its harvest level (and enchantments) to this module. So if you want your Extruder Module to be able to break Obsidian, for example, make sure you use a Breaker Module crafted with a Diamond Pickaxe!

entries.body:
该模块表现和挤出模块 1 型相似，但有几个重要的差别：

- 2 型模块不会从路由器缓存器中放置物品，而是来自模块内定义的模板。

- 此模板会在模块 GUI 右侧出现，有 9 个栏位，并且每个栏位可以放多个物品。放置在模板中的物品为“幽灵”物品。

- 挤出的方块是“虚拟”的⸺一种高效的无中生有，但破坏时不会掉落任何东西，也不能被正常合成。

- 因此，该模块不适合像挤出 1 型一样收获方块，但可以用于放置比 1 型更复杂样式的门/桥等。。

- 挤出 2 型的默认范围为 24 格，可以被范围升级增加至 48 格。
entries.bodyEn:
This module behaves somewhat like the Extruder Module Mk1, but with a few important differences:

- The Mk2 module doesn't place items from the router's buffer, but rather from a template defined within the module itself.

- This template appears on the right-hand side of the module's GUI, has 9 slots, and can have multiple items per slot. Items placed in the template are "ghost" items.

- Blocks extruded are "virtual" - effectively created out of nowhere, but drop nothing when broken and can't be crafted normally.

- Therefore, this module isn't suitable for farming like the Extruder Mk1, but can be used to place doors/bridges etc. with more complex patterns than the Mk1 could.

- The default range for the Extruder Mk2 is 24 blocks, which can be increased to 48 with Range Upgrades.

entries.body:
该模块和投掷器模块行为相似，只不过它会为投掷的物品提供可配置的速度，能够将物品扔出可观的距离。你可以通过模块 GUI 调整物品速度、俯仰和偏转角。

- 俯仰和偏转角按角度计量，相对于基本俯仰和偏转角。

- 如果模块向上或向下弹出，基准俯仰角分别为 +90° 或 -90°。否则，基准俯仰角为 0°。

- 如果模块向上或向下弹出，基准偏转角为路由器面向的方向。否则基准偏转角将从模块朝向中获取。

- 示例：投掷速度 1.0、俯仰/偏转角 0°、水平模块朝向，将会将沿地面将一个物品投掷约7格远。
entries.bodyEn:
This module behaves like the Dropper Module, except that it also imparts a configurable velocity to the dropped item, potentially throwing the item a considerable distance. You can adjust the item's speed, pitch and yaw via the module's GUI.

- Pitch and Yaw are in degrees, relative to a base pitch or yaw.

- If the module ejects Up or Down, the base pitch is +90° or -90°, respectively. Otherwise, the base pitch is 0°.

- If the module ejects Up or Down, the base yaw is the router's facing direction. Otherwise the base yaw is taken from the module's direction.

- Example: a speed of 1.0, pitch/yaw of 0°, and a horizontal module direction, will throw an item along the ground for a distance of about 7 blocks.

entries.body:
虽然路由器不能直接处理流体（它们没有内部储罐），但当缓存区有存储流体物品时可以操控流体。这包括桶和任何其他模组添加的流体容器。

流体模块的 GUI 可以设置传输方向：

- 传输至路由器意味着路由器将会尝试从相邻方块（世界中的流体或承载流体的方块）中提取流体至缓存区的承载流体的物品中。

- 从路由器传出意味着路由器将会尝试从缓存区承载流体的物品中将流体输出至世界；要么将流体倒出，要么将其放入相邻的储罐中。

其 GUI 也可以设置最大传输速率。请注意它将会尝试这个最大值，其仍然会被路由器整体的传输速率限制，也就是每秒 1 桶，以及外部流体或流体容器的传输速率。流体模块过滤栏位只能接受容纳流体的物品，并且会按照容纳的流体过滤，而不是容器物品。

添加速度升级不会使传输流体更快，只会让其更加频繁。带有 9 个速度升级的路由器依然只能每秒传输 1 桶，只不过会以小数量更频繁地传输。想要增加其总体的传输速率，需添加流体传输升级。如果路由器盛装了任何危险的流体，比如熔岩桶，请非常小心的修改流体模块设置。如果你搞错了，路由器可不会犹豫将熔岩倒在你身上⋯⋯

请注意，如果缓存区内有一个流体容器，你也可以将路由器与其他模组的流体管道连接，并将流体输入或输出路由器；流体将会被直接导入/导出容器物品。你不需要安装流体模块来干这个；只有你想要主动输出或输入流体时需要流体模块。
entries.bodyEn:
While Routers can't handle fluids directly (they don't have an internal tank), they can manipulate fluids if there is a (single) fluid container item in the buffer. This includes buckets and any fluid containers added by other mods.

The Fluid Module's GUI allows the transfer direction to be set:

- Transfer To Router means the router will try to pull fluids from an adjacent block (either a fluid in the world or a fluid-holding block) into a fluid-holding item in the buffer.

- Transfer From Router means the router will try to push fluids from a fluid-holding item in the buffer to the world; either pouring fluid out, or putting fluid into an adjacent tank.

The GUI also allows the maximum transfer rate to be set. Note this is the maximum that will be attempted, and is still limited by the Router's overall transfer rate, which is 1 bucket per second, and the transfer rate of the external fluid or fluid container.The Fluid Module's filter slots will only accept fluid-containing items, and will filter by the contained fluid, not by the container item.

Adding Speed Upgrades will not transfer fluids any faster, only more often. A Router with 9 speed upgrades will still only transfer 1 bucket per second, just more often and in smaller quantities. To increase the overall transfer rate, add Fluid Transfer Upgrades.Be very careful tinkering with Fluid Module settings if the router holds any dangerous fluids, such as a lava bucket. The router will not hesitate to pour lava over you if you get it wrong...

Note that you can also connect fluid pipes from other mods to a router, if the buffer has a fluid container in it, and pump fluids in and out of the router; fluids will be directed to/from the container item.You don't need a Fluid Module installed to do this; Fluid Modules are only required if you want to actively push or pull fluids.

entries.body:
和流体模块 1 型相似，该模块可以将流体传输至或传输出路由器，如果缓存区有一个承载流体的物品。然而，该模块也可以将远处的方块作为目标，最多 12 格远（有范围扩大拓展时最多可达 24 格）。

用该模块潜行右击任意方块将其设置为目标。请注意目标方块并不一定需要是流体储罐；如果你在设置模块目标后破坏该方块，模块可以将一桶流体倒入世界中的那个位置。
entries.bodyEn:
Like the Fluid Module Mk1, this module can transfer fluids into or out of the router, if it has a fluid-containing item in the buffer. However, this module can also target more distant locations, up to 12 blocks away (up to 24 with Range Up Augments).

Sneak-right-click any block with the module to set its target.Note that the target block does not necessarily need to be a fluid tank; if you break the block after setting the module target, the module will be able to empty a bucket of fluid into the world at that location.

entries.body:
该模块会尝试从路由器缓存区取出物品以放置方块，放在路由器模块的配置方向相邻的位置。

- 如果物品不是一个方块或目标空间被阻挡，就不会发生任何事。

- 遵循普通 Minecraft 的放置规则；比如甘蔗只能放置在临水的沙子/泥土上。

- 流体方块，以及如高草丛一类的可替换方块，将会被替换。

- 放置模块可以在耕地上种植种子，在相邻丛林原木上放置可可豆。
entries.bodyEn:
This module tries to place an item from the router's buffer as a block, adjacent to the router in the module's configured direction.

- If the item isn't a block or the destination block space is obstructed, nothing will be done.

- Normal Minecraft placement rules are followed; e.g. sugar cane can only be placed next to water on sand/dirt.

- Fluid blocks will be replaced, as will replaceable blocks such as tall grass.

- The Placer module can plant seeds on farmland, and cocoa beans on an adjacent jungle log.

entries.body:
该模块会尝试将物品在路由器和玩家物品栏之间传输。该玩家可以在任何维度的任何地方，因此这是一个非常强大的模块。该模块可以对玩家输入或输出物品；你可以在模块的 GUI 中进行设置。

模块可以对玩家的 36 栏位主物品栏、4 栏位盔甲物品栏、副手栏或者末影物品栏（由原版末影箱显示）进行操作。你也可以在模块 GUI 中进行设置。当然，提取/输入的物品可以通过模块被过滤。

一个优秀的模块使用案例为从玩家物品栏中提取矿石/圆石/泥土等物品，并将其发送至玩家基地中的主存储系统。加上一点小设计，就可以建立一个用于自动替换盔甲套装的系统（加上来自另一个模组的无线红石，也许还可以在野外实现⋯⋯）。

玩家模块与一位特定的玩家对应；物品提示会显示所有者。它设置为最初合成该模块的玩家，但可以手持模块潜行右击来覆盖。如果你通过其它手段（创造、JEI 作弊模式⋯⋯）获得了该模块，你也许也需要这么做。

将安全升级和该模块合并使用也许是在有不信任玩家服务器中的明智之举；你不会希望一个恶意玩家窃取这个模块⋯⋯
entries.bodyEn:
This module tries to transfer items between the router and a player's own inventory. The player can be anywhere in any dimension, making this a rather powerful module.The module can transfer items either from or to the player; you can set this in the module's GUI.

The module can operate on either the player's main 36-slot inventory, their 4-slot armor inventory, their offhand slot, or their Ender inventory (as shown by vanilla Ender Chests). This can also be set in the module's GUI.Extracted/inserted items can, of course, be filtered by the module.

A good use-case for this module would be to extract ores/cobblestone/dirt etc. from the player's inventory, and send it on to the player's main storage system in their base. With a little design, it should be possible to build a system to auto-swap your armor sets (maybe even in the field, with some wireless redstone from another mod...)

The Player Module is keyed to a specific player; the item tooltip shows the owner. This is set to the player who initially crafted the module, but can be overridden by holding the module and sneak-right-clicking it. You might also need to do this if you obtained the module by other means (creative, JEI cheat mode...).

Using a Security Upgrade in conjunction with this module is probably wise on servers where you don't trust the players; you don't want a hostile player stealing this module...

entries.body: 该模块会尝试抽取来自其配置方向相邻的容器中的第一个可抽取物品，放进路由器的缓存区。如果缓存区已满或不存在可以与物品栏中物品堆叠的物品，就不会抽取任何东西。
entries.bodyEn: This module tries to pull the first eligible item from the adjacent inventory in its configured direction into the router's buffer. If the buffer is full or contains something that stacks with nothing in the inventory, nothing will be pulled.

entries.body:
此模块与抽取 1 型行为相似，但可以从非相邻的容器中抽取物品。容器最远可以达到 12 格（有范围扩大拓展时最多可以达 24）；不需要清除连线处的障碍物。

- 用抽取模块 2 型潜行右击方块以选择目标容器。你将会收到一条确认信息。

- 当手持设定目标的抽取 2 型时，目标方块将会被高亮显示。
entries.bodyEn:
This behaves like the Puller Mk1, but can pull items from non-adjacent inventories.The inventory can be up to 12 blocks away (up to 24 with Range Augments); clear line of sight is not required.

- To select the target inventory, Sneak-Right-click the block with the Puller Mk2 module in hand. You will get a confirmation message.

- While holding a Puller Mk2 with a target set, the targeted block will be highlighted.

entries.body:
该模块会尝试从路由器缓存区发送物品至与模块配置方向相邻的容器中：

- 目标容器最多可以离 8 格远（有范围扩大拓展时最多可以有 16 格远）

- 目标容器必须沿 X、Y 或 Z 轴与路由器成直线。

- 路由器必须清除与目标连线间的障碍物；不能是不透明方块，但玻璃、栅栏、铁栏杆等方块可以。
entries.bodyEn:
This module tries to send an item from the router's buffer to an inventory in the module's configured direction:

- The target inventory can be up to 8 blocks away (up to 16 with Range Up Augments)

- The target inventory must be directly along the X, Y, or Z axis.

- The router must have clear line of sight to the target; no opaque blocks, but blocks such as glass, fences, iron bars etc. are OK.

entries.body:
该模块和发送模块 1 型行为相似，但是有更为强大的容器连接能力：

- 目标容器可以达 24 格远（有范围扩大拓展时可达 48 格）。

- 不需要清除连线上的障碍物。

- 用发送模块 2 型潜行右击目标容器，将其选中。你会收到一条确认信息。

- 当手持设定目标的发送 2 型时，目标方块将会被高亮显示。
entries.bodyEn:
This module behaves like a Sender Module Mk1, but has more powerful inventory targeting capabilities:

- The target inventory can be up to 24 blocks away (up to 48 with Range Augments).

- Clear line of sight is not required.

- To select the target inventory, Sneak-Right-click the target with the Sender Mk2 module in hand. You will get a confirmation message.

- While holding a Sender Mk2 with a target set, the targeted block will be highlighted.

entries.body: 这个最高阶的发送模块运作方式和发送 2 型非常相似，但是可以不受限制地向（任何维度的）任何容器发送物品！注：目标容器必须被区块加载；模块化路由器不会为你做这件事。
entries.bodyEn: This top-end sender module operates very much like the Sender Mk2, but can send to any inventory (in any dimension) with no restrictions!Note: the target inventory must be chunk-loaded;  will not do this for you.

entries.body:
该模块会在路由器周围 13x13x13 的立方区域内扫描掉落的物品（即每个方向 6 格远），如果可行，就将它们吸入路由器的缓存区中。通过范围扩大拓展可以将最大范围增加到 25x25x25（每个方向 12 格），或通过范围缩小拓展将范围减少到只有 3x3x3。

如果模块的配置方向为所有方向（默认状态下），扫描的区域将以路由器为中心。如果模块有配置过的方向，区域将会以该方向偏离 6 格，同时每安装一个范围扩大拓展就会再多一格，每安装一个范围缩小拓展就会再少一格。比如，方向为上方时，模块将只会扫描其正上方的一块区域。
entries.bodyEn:
This module scans for dropped items in a 13x13x13 cubic area around the router (i.e. up to 6 blocks in each direction), and absorbs them into the router's buffer, if possible.The range can be increased up to 25x25x25 (12 blocks in each direction) with Range Up Augments, or shrunk to just 3x3x3 with Range Down Augments.

The scanned area is centered on the router if the module's configured direction is All (the default).If the module has an actual direction configured, the area is offset in that direction by 6 blocks, plus one for each Range Up Augment installed, minus one for each Range Down Augment installed.E.g. with a direction of UP, the module will only scan an area directly above the router.

entries.body: 这个危险的模块会永久地销毁路由器缓存区的物品！强烈建议用白名单过滤器来配置这个模块以防止宝贵物品被意外删除⋯⋯
entries.bodyEn: This dangerous module permanently destroys items in the router's buffer! It is strongly recommended to configure this module with a whitelist filter to prevent accidental deletion of valuable items...

entries.body: 该升级可使路由器完全免疫爆炸伤害，也不会被boss级生物摧毁。
entries.bodyEn: This upgrade makes the router fully immune to explosion damage, and also to being destroyed by boss mobs.

entries.body: 该升级可以让路由器伪装成其它方块。用模块潜行+右击一个方块，将该方块记录在伪装升级中。将升级放入路由器后，路由器将会变成记录方块的样子。注：手持模块化路由器将会高亮显示周围任何的伪装路由器。
entries.bodyEn: This upgrade allows you to disguise the router as another block. Sneak+Right-click the module against a block to record that block on the camouflage upgrade. When inserted into a router, that router will take on the appearance of the recorded block.Note: holding a Modular Router will highlight any nearby camouflaged Routers.

entries.body:
该升级给予了路由器一个内置的能量缓存区。每个升级都会增加缓存区大小 50,000 FE ，传输速率 1,000 FE 每路由器刻（数值在模组配置中可调）。有几个场景能量升级会很有用，后续页面将会详细说明。

能量输出和能量分配模块都可以主动从路由器的缓存区输出能量至相邻或周围的方块。有了这些模块，你可以建造一个有着有限的无线能量传输能力的能量单元。

默认情况下，路由器模块不需要任何能量来运行，攻击模式下的执行模块除外。然而，能耗是可调的，并且你游玩的模组包中其它模块也有可能消耗能量；所有消耗能量的模块都在其物品提示下方列出了能耗数字。

任何路由器缓存区中承载能量的物品都可以将路由器内置缓存区的能量传输至自身，反之也可以。当承载能量的物品在物品缓存区中时，路由器 GUI 会在缓存区和能量条之间显示一个可调按钮，用于设置能量传输方向。

需要注意的是提示框中标注的传输速率以 FE 每路由器刻为单位，和 FE/t 不同。路由器刻速率取决于其速度升级；没有速度升级时，每 20 服务器刻为一个路由器刻。因此，总体传输速率可能会低于你预期的数值。
entries.bodyEn:
This upgrade gives the Router an internal energy buffer. Each upgrade increases the buffer size by 50,000 FE and the transfer rate by 1,000 FE per router tick (these figures are adjustable in mod config).There are several scenarios where an Energy Upgrade is useful, detailed in the following pages.

The Energy Output and Energy Distributor modules are both capable of actively pushing energy from the router's buffer to adjacent or nearby blocks.With these modules, you can effectively build an energy cell with limited wireless energy transfer capabilities.

By default, router modules do not cost any energy to run, with the exception of the Activator Module in attack mode. However, energy usage is configurable and it's possible that energy costs may apply to other modules in the pack you're playing; all modules list energy usage numbers in their tooltip where it applies.

Any energy-holding item in the router's buffer can optionally have energy transferred from the router's internal buffer to the item, or vice versa.When an energy-holding item is in the item buffer, the router GUI will show a switchable button between the buffer and the energy bar to set the energy transfer direction.

It is important to note that stated transfer rates on tooltips are in FE per router tick, which is not the same as FE/t. A Router's tick rate depends on its Speed Upgrades; with no Speed Upgrades, a router tick is every 20 server ticks. Therefore, the overall transfer rate may be lower than you might expect.

entries.body: 该升级只会影响流体模块 1 型和流体模块 2 型。它可以增加路由器（各个方向；输入和输出）的总体流体传输速率，由 50mB/刻的基准速率，增加 10mB/刻，最高可达 400mB/刻。因此路由器中最多可放 35 个流体传输升级。
entries.bodyEn: This upgrade only affects the Fluid Module Mk1 and Fluid Module Mk2.It increases the overall fluid transfer rate of the Router (in each direction; in & out of the router) from the base rate of 50mB/tick by 10mB/tick, up to a maximum of 400mB/tick. Therefore the maximum number of Fluid Transfer Upgrades in a router is 35.

entries.body:
该升级可以用于消除模块化路由器产生的声音和粒子效果，并且如果一个吵闹的模块经常在玩家附近运行，这可能会很有用。

- 一个或更多消声器升级将会关闭所有路由器的声效

- 两个或更多还会关闭所有的粒子效果（光束和飞行的物品）

- 三个升级还会关闭路由器的启动动画；路由器方块正面的脉冲贴图请注意，所有声音和粒子效果也可以在模组配置中关闭；该升级只在声音/效果没有关闭的情况下有用。
entries.bodyEn:
This upgrade can be used to suppress sounds and particle effects made by item routers, and can be useful if a noisy module is regularly running in a place where a player often is.

- One or more Muffler Upgrades in a router will disable all audible effects

- Two or more will also disable all particle effects (beams and flying items)

- Three upgrades will also disable the router's active animation; the pulsing texture on the front face of the router blockNote that all sounds and particle effects can also be disabled in the mod config; this upgrade is only useful if sounds/effects have not been disabled.

entries.body:
安全升级有几个重要的功能，详见以下页面。

安装有安全升级的路由器只能被该升级白名单中的玩家打开。该升级不能阻止路由器被破坏；但因为破坏的路由器仍然会保留升级和模块，因此玩家不能窃取或重新配置其中的模块/升级。如果你想要防止路由器被破坏，你也许还要探索其他模组的方块保护功能。

几个模块（放置、破坏、执行）以假玩家的身份运行。默认状态下，这是一个用户名为[Modular Routers]的玩家，但当安全升级安装后，这些模块以升级所有者的身份运行。在具有领地保护的多人服务器上，这比简单地允许[Modular Routers]处理领地要安全得多。

当执行模块处于攻击模式时，它会忽视所有在安全升级白名单中的玩家。这通常是一个避免受苦的好主意，如果你有一个高伤害武器在你的路由器中⋯⋯

- 有一个叫做安全覆盖卡的无法合成物品⸺它可以通过创造模式或 JEI 作弊模式等方式获得。在主手或副手持有此卡的玩家不会受任何安全升级的影响，并且可以访问任何路由器。

你可以用安全升级右击玩家来向升级中添加额外的玩家。你可以用安全升级潜行右击玩家将其移除。每个安全升级最多可以有 6 名额外玩家（因此加上创造者，总共有 7 位），但如果有必要，你可以安装更多的安全升级。
entries.bodyEn:
The Security Upgrade has several important functions, detailed in the following pages.

A Router with a Security Upgrade installed can only be opened by players whitelisted by that upgrade. The upgrade doesn't prevent a router being broken; but since upgrades and modules remain in a broken router, players can't break a router to steal modules/upgrades or reconfigure the router. If you want to prevent a router being broken, you may wish to explore other mods' block protection capabilities.

Several modules (Placer, Breaker, Activator) do their work as a fake player. By default this is a player with the username [Modular Routers], but when a security upgrade is installed, those modules operate as the upgrade's owner. This is much safer on multiplayer servers with claim protection than simply allowing [Modular Routers] to do anything with your claims.

When the Activator Module is in Attack Mode, it will ignore any players whitelisted by a Security Upgrade installed in the Router. This is generally a good idea to avoid pain & suffering if you have a high-damage weapon in your Router...

- There is a non-craftable item called the Security Override Card - this can be obtained in creative mode or by cheating the item in via JEI etc. A player who holds one of these in either hand is not affected by any Security Upgrade, and can access any router.

You can add extra players to a Security Upgrade by right-clicking the player with the upgrade in your main hand.You can remove players from a Security Upgrade by sneak-right-clicking the player.There is a maximum of 6 additional players per Security Upgrade (so 7 in total, including the creator), but you can install more than one Security Upgrade in a router if necessary.

entries.body:
路由器中的模块一次处理单个物品：比如发送模块每路由器刻将会从路由器缓存区中发送一个物品，无论缓存区中有多少个物品。

通过像路由器中添加堆叠升级，可以增加单次处理的物品。每个堆叠升级都能使每个模块处理的物品翻倍，最多可达 64 个物品，或者物品的原生堆叠大小（比如末影珍珠为 16 个）。因此，一个路由器中有效的堆叠升级最多为 6 个。
entries.bodyEn:
Modules in a router operate on a single item at a time: e.g. a Sender Module will send a single item from the router's buffer each router tick, regardless of how many items are in the buffer.

By adding Stack Upgrades to a router, this can be increased. Each Stack Upgrade doubles the number of items that can be processed by each module, up to a maximum of 64, or the item's native stack size (e.g. 16 for Ender Pearls).It therefore follows that 6 is the maximum number of useful Stack Upgrades which can be installed in one router.

entries.body:
该升级用于保证两个或多个路由器同时运行。同步升级有一个 0 至 19 的调整值（既比 20 的基准路由器刻速率少 1）。该调整值可以通过右击打开同步升级的 GUI 进行设置，或潜行右击升级快速设置一个随机值。

任何安装此升级的路由器，且调整值相同，速度升级的安装数量相同，永远会在统一游戏刻运行。实际的调整值不重要；只要在同步的路由器之间，该值是一致的就行。当你有一组安装有挤出模块的路由器，并想要确保所有模块同时延展/收回时非常有用。

高级注释 #1：同步升级的调整值实际上精确指定路由器相对于其刻速率运行的时间。比如默认时路由器每 20 服务器刻运行一次；一个调整值为 15 的同步升级确保路由器总是在其的 15 刻后运行，并且对所有安装有 15 调整值同步升级的路由器适用。而 16 调整值的同步升级永远比 15 调整值的慢 1 刻，至少在所有路由器都有着相同数量的速度升级的情况下⋯⋯

高级注释 #2：由于速度升级会使路由器运作的更频繁，它们会影响同步升级的运作。一个带有 9 个速度升级的路由器每 2 服务器刻（而不是每 20 刻）运作一次。对于该路由器内的同步升级，只需要关注调整值为奇数还是偶数；2（或 4/6/8⋯⋯）刻的延迟和 0 刻延迟等效！一般情况：在考虑速度升级后，调整值是按路由器的实际刻速率计算的。
entries.bodyEn:
This upgrade is used to guarantee that two or more routers run at the same time. The Sync Upgrade has a tuning value of 0 .. 19 (i.e. 1 less than the base router tick rate of 20). This tuning value can be set by right-clicking the Sync Upgrade to open its GUI, or quickly set to a random value by sneak-right-clicking the upgrade.

Any routers with this upgrade installed, with same the tuning value, and with the same number of Speed Upgrades installed, will always run on the same tick. The actual tuning value doesn't matter; only that the value is consistent across the routers you want to synchronise.This is particularly useful if you have a group of routers with Extruder Modules installed, and want to ensure all modules extend/retract at exactly the same time.

Advanced notes #1: the Sync Upgrade's tuning value actually specifies precisely when the router will run relative to its tick rate. E.g. routers tick every 20 server ticks by default; a Sync Upgrade with a tuning upgrade of 15 ensures the router always runs 15 ticks after that, and that applies to all routers with a 15-tuned Sync Upgrade. And a 16-tuned Sync Upgrade always runs 1 tick after a 15-tuned Sync Upgrade, at least for routers with the same number of Speed Upgrades installed...

Advanced notes #2: Because Speed Upgrades make routers tick more frequently, they affect how Sync Upgrades work. A router with 9 Speed Upgrades ticks every 2 server ticks (instead of every 20). For Sync Upgrades in such a router, it only matters whether the tuning value is even or odd; 2 (or 4/6/8...) ticks later is effectively the same as 0 ticks later! General case: the tuning value is calculated modulo the router's actual tick rate after Speed Upgrades are accounted for.

entries.body:
操作步骤
把对应资源管道连接来源与目标。用扳手潜行＋右键来源连接处切换抽取状态；对准不需要的管道连接可断开。抽取由来源端执行，不是在每个目标端都开启抽取。

配置步骤
打开已设为抽取的端点配置，根据升级等级设置速度、过滤、目标和分配方式。升级放在这个抽取端，不是随便插到网络中任意一根管上。基础管道不一定拥有高级过滤功能。

故障排查
不传输先检查来源箭头/抽取状态、管道资源类型和目标接收面；再看来源有无内容、目标空间、过滤及红石模式。来源和目标都设抽取会造成非预期流向，先保留单一来源进行定位。
entries.bodyEn:
Connect the correct resource pipe between source and destination. Sneak-right-click the source connection with the wrench to switch extraction. Unneeded connections can be disconnected.

Configure the extracting endpoint and install its upgrade there. Available speed, filtering and distribution depend on that upgrade. For no transfer, inspect extraction state, pipe type, receiving face, stock, space, filters and redstone. Start with one source rather than enabling extraction everywhere.

entries.body: 把正确资源类型的管道连接到容器，用扳手把来源端切成抽取模式。升级装在抽取端，过滤与速度设置也在抽取端 GUI 中调整。
entries.bodyEn: Connect the correct pipe type and wrench the source connection into extraction mode. Install upgrades and configure filters/speed at the extracting connection.

researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
操作步骤
正面右键存入手持物品；从正面取出时按抽屉交互规则操作。多格抽屉的各格分别占一种物品，容量大不等于可放无限种类。

使用配置工具切换锁定或显示模式，再对目标抽屉应用。锁定可保留空槽原本分配的物品类型，适合自动化补料；显示物品数量与实际容量是两项设置。

自动化接控制器或支持的面。抽屉放不进物品时检查锁定类型、槽位分配及容量。
entries.bodyEn: Open a drawer from its front and use the configuration tool to change locking and display modes. Each compartment stores one item type. Locking can preserve an assigned type when empty. Check locked types, compartment assignments and capacity before debugging connected automation.

entries.zh: 抽屉控制器与链接工具
entries.body:
操作步骤
用链接工具选择控制器，再按工具当前模式把目标抽屉加入控制器。需要框选时先确认工具处于选区模式，并检查所选边界。自动化从控制器或控制器扩展访问已链接的库存。

故障排查
控制器不等于按距离自动吸收所有抽屉：检查是否完成链接、是否仍在允许范围、工具是否误处于解除链接模式。更换控制器后重新核对所属关系，避免同一批抽屉链接错目标。
entries.bodyEn: Select a controller with the Linking Tool, then link the intended drawers using its active mode. Automation accesses linked storage through the controller or its extension. Verify link state, range and whether the tool is in unlink mode after rebuilding a network.

entries.zh: 容量升级、虚空升级与物品溢出
entries.body:
配置步骤
把容量升级装入支持的升级槽，查看抽屉的实际容量变化。虚空升级用于处理已满库存继续输入时的溢出，并不额外保存这部分物品。

故障排查
缩减容量或拆升级前先取出超额物品。自动化产线要区分“输出满而停机”与“溢出被虚空删除”；需要保留的材料不要依赖虚空升级作为缓存。锁定类型、容量与虚空处理分别检查。
entries.bodyEn: Install capacity upgrades in supported slots and inspect the resulting capacity. Void upgrades discard overflow rather than storing it. Remove excess stock before reducing capacity; distinguish a blocked output from overflow deliberately deleted by a void upgrade.

entries.body:
操作步骤
在抽屉安装对应功能升级，设置它交互的方向。抽取升级从指定方向取物，推送升级向外送物，收集升级处理附近可收集的掉落物，三种动作不能互相替代。

故障排查
先核对方向和周围容器的实际接收面，再看锁定物品、过滤和剩余容量。抽屉无法容纳的类型不会因为装了抽取升级就自动腾出新格。
entries.bodyEn: Configure the direction of puller or pusher upgrades. Collector upgrades handle dropped items rather than ordinary inventory extraction. Check facing, receiving side, assigned item types, filters and capacity.

entries.body: 把物品放入抽屉，正面交互存取；控制器统一访问已链接抽屉。配置工具设置锁定、绑定与显示，升级槽放容量、虚空或其他功能升级。
entries.bodyEn: Insert and extract through drawer fronts. A controller accesses linked drawers. Use configuration/linking tools for locking and connections; upgrade slots accept storage and utility upgrades.

entries.zh: 抽屉、控制器与连接工具
entries.body:
抽屉每格保持一种物品，大容量不等于可存无限类型。用连接工具把抽屉绑定到控制器，自动化从控制器访问已连接抽屉。

配置工具锁定类型或调整显示；锁定空抽屉先指定保留类型。检查链接范围和控制器所连接的网络，隔着距离摆放不会自动全接入。
entries.bodyEn: Each drawer slot stores one type. Link drawers to a controller with the linking tool and automate through it. Lock types and verify linking range and network.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
容量升级增加储量，压缩抽屉按兼容配方在块、锭、粒等形式之间显示同一份储量。多种显示形式不是多份独立材料。

虚空类升级会销毁溢出物，安装前确认抽屉类型和过滤；收集、推送、拉取等功能升级还需配置工作面。
entries.bodyEn: Capacity upgrades increase quantity. Compacting forms share one resource pool. Void upgrades destroy overflow; configure the faces of collection/push/pull upgrades.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body: 把物品放入抽屉，正面交互存取；控制器统一访问已链接抽屉。配置工具设置锁定、绑定与显示，升级槽放容量、虚空或其他功能升级。
entries.bodyEn: Insert and extract through drawer fronts. A controller accesses linked drawers. Use configuration/linking tools for locking and connections; upgrade slots accept storage and utility upgrades.

entries.body:
操作步骤
正面右键存入手持物品；从正面取出时按抽屉交互规则操作。多格抽屉的各格分别占一种物品，容量大不等于可放无限种类。

使用配置工具切换锁定或显示模式，再对目标抽屉应用。锁定可保留空槽原本分配的物品类型，适合自动化补料；显示物品数量与实际容量是两项设置。

自动化接控制器或支持的面。抽屉放不进物品时检查锁定类型、槽位分配及容量。
entries.bodyEn: Open a drawer from its front and use the configuration tool to change locking and display modes. Each compartment stores one item type. Locking can preserve an assigned type when empty. Check locked types, compartment assignments and capacity before debugging connected automation.

正面右键存入手持物品；从正面取出时按抽屉交互规则操作。多格抽屉的各格分别占一种物品，容量大不等于可放无限种类。

使用配置工具切换锁定或显示模式，再对目标抽屉应用。锁定可保留空槽原本分配的物品类型，适合自动化补料；显示物品数量与实际容量是两项设置。

自动化接控制器或支持的面。抽屉放不进物品时检查锁定类型、槽位分配及容量。
entries.bodyEn: Open a drawer from its front and use the configuration tool to change locking and display modes. Each compartment stores one item type. Locking can preserve an assigned type when empty. Check locked types, compartment assignments and capacity before debugging connected automation.

抽屉每格保持一种物品，大容量不等于可存无限类型。用连接工具把抽屉绑定到控制器，自动化从控制器访问已连接抽屉。

配置工具锁定类型或调整显示；锁定空抽屉先指定保留类型。检查链接范围和控制器所连接的网络，隔着距离摆放不会自动全接入。
entries.bodyEn: Each drawer slot stores one type. Link drawers to a controller with the linking tool and automate through it. Lock types and verify linking range and network.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
容量升级增加储量，压缩抽屉按兼容配方在块、锭、粒等形式之间显示同一份储量。多种显示形式不是多份独立材料。

entries.bodyEn: Capacity upgrades increase quantity. Compacting forms share one resource pool. Void upgrades destroy overflow; configure the faces of collection/push/pull upgrades.

entries.zh: 精妙存储：控制器与连接器
entries.body:
操作步骤
把控制器接到支持的箱柜网络。连续的存储方块可组成网络；跨过不相邻位置时使用该模组的连接器或存储链接，不要把不同模组控制器混用。

工具操作
手持存储工具，潜行＋滚轮切换到链接模式，右键选择控制器，再对需要绑定的存储链接操作。潜行对空气使用可清除已选控制器并进入解除链接模式，之后对目标解除。

故障排查
先查控制器所属、连接路径与范围，再查升级过滤。显示隐藏、锁定与网络链接是不同工具模式。
entries.bodyEn: Connect the controller to supported storage. Use Storage Connectors or Storage Links where appropriate. Sneak-scroll the Storage Tool into linking mode, select the controller and bind the target link. Sneak-use in air clears the selection and enters unlinking mode. Check network membership, path and range separately from locking and display modes.

entries.zh: 精妙存储：输入口、输出口与过滤
entries.body:
操作步骤
把输入口或输出口接入有效的存储网络，再从这些接口连接外部管道。输入接口负责向网络存物，输出接口负责从网络取物；它们本身不提供一整箱独立容量。

故障排查
接口没反应先检查网络归属和连接，再看管道是抽取还是插入、物品是否符合存储过滤。外部机器只接受指定面时，要连到它允许的一面。
entries.bodyEn: Attach input or output blocks to a valid storage network, then connect external automation. These interfaces access network storage rather than providing their own full inventory. Check network membership, transfer direction and filters.

entries.zh: 精妙存储：打包搬迁与还原
entries.body:
操作步骤
对需要搬迁的存储使用打包胶带，确认已经处于打包状态，再拆下并放到新位置。打包是保留库存搬迁的操作，重新摆放后按界面或提示解包。

故障排查
当前配置可能让容器默认以打包状态掉落，此时胶带提示会显示禁用原因。搬迁后重新核对控制器链接和周围升级交互方向，不要只检查箱内物品还在就认为网络已经恢复。
entries.bodyEn: Pack a container with Packing Tape before moving it, then unpack as prompted after placement. Some configurations make packed drops the default and disable tape use. Recheck controller links and directional automation after relocation.

entries.zh: 精妙存储：压缩、合成与升级过滤
entries.body:
配置步骤
压缩、自动合成和虚空是不同功能升级，分别在自身面板设置允许的物品、配方或过滤。不要因为名称都有“压缩”就认为槽位表示和取出行为完全相同。

故障排查
检查升级是否启用、黑白名单、可用配方、材料及输出空间。拆除影响库存表示或容量的升级前，先按界面要求整理内容；虚空升级删除的溢出物不会保存在隐藏格里。
entries.bodyEn: Configure compacting, compression and void upgrades independently. Their recipe, filter and inventory behaviors differ. Inspect enabled state, filters, ingredients, valid recipes and output space. Follow the GUI requirements before removing upgrades affecting stored contents or capacity.

entries.body: 打开箱柜 GUI 放入物品，升级页安装容量、堆叠和功能升级。需要过滤的升级打开自身配置；通过存储控制器访问连接的箱柜。
entries.bodyEn: Open the storage GUI, insert items and install stack or functional upgrades. Configure filters on the upgrade page. Storage controllers access connected storage.

entries.zh: 高级存储的过滤与加工升级
entries.body:
打开容器的升级栏，插入所需升级后展开对应面板设置。过滤、堆叠、熔炼、自动合成、压缩、补货等模块各有独立开关与目标规则。

堆叠升级增加单格数量，不增加物品类型。加工模块仍需燃料/能源和材料；自动输送要检查来源/目标侧及过滤是否拦截。
entries.bodyEn: Install upgrades and configure their own panels. Stack upgrades increase quantity per slot. Processing and transfer upgrades still need their resources, filters and valid targets.

entries.body:
打开容器的升级栏，插入所需升级后展开对应面板设置。过滤、堆叠、熔炼、自动合成、压缩、补货等模块各有独立开关与目标规则。

堆叠升级增加单格数量，不增加物品类型。加工模块仍需燃料/能源和材料；自动输送要检查来源/目标侧及过滤是否拦截。
entries.bodyEn: Install upgrades and configure their own panels. Stack upgrades increase quantity per slot. Processing and transfer upgrades still need their resources, filters and valid targets.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 精妙背包：打开、放置与升级开关
entries.body:
操作步骤
携带或装备背包后用打开键进入；也可手持右键使用，潜行放置为方块后再打开。背包里的升级槽放功能升级，右侧面板配置每个升级的规则。

升级操作
拾取、磁铁、补货、喂食、压缩与虚空升级各自有启用状态和过滤。快捷开关的 1、2 是“可切换升级”的顺序，不固定代表磁铁或拾取；改装背包后先核对对应关系。

故障排查
按打开键却出现路标或其他界面时，查同键冲突。物品没有自动进入时，查背包是否可访问、升级是否启用、过滤模式与剩余空间；有压缩升级时还要检查压缩规则。把背包放到地上不等于已自动建立对周围库存的物流。
entries.bodyEn:
Carry or equip a backpack and use its open binding, or right-click it in hand. Sneak-place it as a block to open it in the world. Install upgrades and configure their individual panels.

Pickup, magnet, refill, feeding, compression and void upgrades have separate switches and filters. Toggle indices follow the installed switchable upgrades rather than fixed upgrade types. For no pickup, inspect accessibility, enabled state, filters and space. If the open key triggers a waypoint, resolve the conflicting binding.

entries.body: 打开背包 GUI 存物，在升级栏安装拾取、磁铁、补给、压缩或加工升级，再设置各升级的过滤和启用状态。放置后的背包也可按其侧面能力接物流。
entries.bodyEn: Open the backpack, install pickup, magnet, refill, compression or processing upgrades, and configure their filters. Placed backpacks expose supported inventory connections.

entries.zh: 高级背包的拾取、磁铁与补货
entries.body:
打开背包安装升级并设置面板。拾取只处理可进入背包的拾取物，磁铁吸引范围物品，补货把背包中的指定物品补进玩家物品栏。

每种升级的黑白名单独立。虚空、自动喂食、压缩和加工模块都按自身设置工作，先检查过滤、启用状态和资源，避免把需要的掉落物排除或销毁。
entries.bodyEn: Configure pickup, magnet and restock upgrades independently. Other modules retain their own filters, enabled state and resource needs.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body: 把可熔炼原料放入上方槽，按型号提供燃料或 FE。GUI 配置侧面输入/输出、红石控制与增强件；不同增强件改变可加工的配方类型。
entries.bodyEn: Insert smeltable inputs and provide fuel or FE for the furnace type. Configure sides, redstone and augments; augments can change the recipe class.

entries.body:
高阶熔炉按自身等级提高加工能力，燃料或能源模式由其增幅和配置决定。在增幅槽安装支持的增幅，再按模式供能。

熔炼、烟熏和高炉模式接受的原料不同。自动化检查侧面、红石和成品回收，熔炉升级物品按其提示对原炉使用。
entries.bodyEn: Install a compatible augment and supply the corresponding fuel/energy. Smelting, smoking and blasting accept different recipes. Configure sided I/O and use upgrade items as instructed.

熔炼、烟熏和高炉模式接受的原料不同。自动化检查侧面、红石和成品回收，熔炉升级物品按其提示对原炉使用。
entries.bodyEn: Install a compatible augment and supply the corresponding fuel/energy. Smelting, smoking and blasting accept different recipes. Configure sided I/O and use upgrade items as instructed.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
操作步骤
打开 Dank 存入物品；每个槽位能容纳多少由等级决定。槽位锁定保留该槽的物品类型，适合反复收集建材；锁槽不等于把所有物品禁止取出。

拾取与放置
持有 Dank 切换拾取模式，查看提示确认当前是普通、过滤或其他可用模式。放置模式用于直接使用其中所选物品；切换后确认选中槽位与存量再右键使用。普通打开库存与放置模式不是同一个动作。

故障排查
只收部分物品先看拾取模式与锁定槽类型，完全不收再查空间和物品限制。放不出方块时检查当前是否处于放置模式、选中槽位是否为空以及该物品能否放置。
entries.bodyEn:
Store items in the Dank; capacity follows its tier. Lock a slot to preserve its assigned item type. Locking is not the same as forbidding extraction.

Cycle pickup mode while holding the Dank and inspect the tooltip. Construction mode uses the selected stored item directly; check selection and stock before right-clicking. For selective pickup, check filters and locked types; for failed placement, check construction mode, selection and whether the item can be placed.

entries.body: 在容器 GUI 中配置物品槽、锁定和拾取模式。放在对应底座上时可作为外部物流库存；使用前确认当前放置/建造模式。
entries.bodyEn: Configure slots, locks and pickup mode in the GUI. A dock exposes the container to logistics; check the selected placement/building mode.

entries.body: 在容器 GUI 中配置物品槽、锁定和拾取模式。放在对应底座上时可作为外部物流库存；使用前确认当前放置/建造模式。
entries.bodyEn: Configure slots, locks and pickup mode in the GUI. A dock exposes the container to logistics; check the selected placement/building mode.

entries.body: 给相同资源类型的超立方体设置同一频道，在两端 GUI 分别选择发送/接收，再接入管道或电缆。频道访问权限决定其他玩家能否连接。
entries.bodyEn: Assign matching resource endpoints to the same channel, set send/receive modes, and connect pipes or cables. Channel access controls sharing.

entries.body: 给相同资源类型的超立方体设置同一频道，在两端 GUI 分别选择发送/接收，再接入管道或电缆。频道访问权限决定其他玩家能否连接。
entries.bodyEn: Assign matching resource endpoints to the same channel, set send/receive modes, and connect pipes or cables. Channel access controls sharing.

entries.body: 先用纠缠绑定工具选定目标方块，再绑定纠缠方块。物流设备通过纠缠方块访问目标提供的能力；目标必须存在且可用。
entries.bodyEn: Select a target with the binding tool, then bind an entangled block. Logistics access the target capabilities through it while the target remains available.

entries.body: 先用纠缠绑定工具选定目标方块，再绑定纠缠方块。物流设备通过纠缠方块访问目标提供的能力；目标必须存在且可用。
entries.bodyEn: Select a target with the binding tool, then bind an entangled block. Logistics access the target capabilities through it while the target remains available.

entries.body: 放置采矿设备，用模组标记器或 GUI 确定范围，供能并连接输出库存。需要附魔或升级时使用模组对应的处理设备；检查挖掘范围后再启动。
entries.bodyEn: Place the quarry, define its area with markers or its GUI, supply power and attach output storage. Use the matching enchanting/upgrade equipment where required.

entries.body:
按设备类型设置工作范围，标记器用于界定采掘区域，给采掘机供能并连接输出库存。先检查范围投影和机器朝向再启动。

不同采掘机的范围、区块和掉落处理能力不同。附魔转移设备用于给支持机器安装对应效果，按本包可用界面操作；持续采矿需保证输出与加载。

entries.bodyEn: Use fans to move mobs toward a mob masher. Absorption hoppers collect loot and fluid experience. Configure range, filters and redstone activation in their GUIs.

entries.zh: 吸收漏斗、经验罐与经验处理
entries.body:
吸收漏斗收集范围内掉落物与经验，把物品和经验流体分别输出到库存和罐。GUI 调整有效范围及输出方向。

经验排放/取用设备连接兼容经验流体罐。管道类型要匹配，不要把经验流体输出接成物品口。
entries.bodyEn: Collect drops and XP with the Absorption Hopper, then route items and XP fluid separately. Configure range/output and use compatible XP tanks and devices.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 生物扇、尖刺与生成控制
entries.body:
生物扇以红石启用，按朝向推动生物；升级增加对应范围或能力。尖刺等处理面要放在生物实际接触的位置。

生物棉签用于收集目标数据，再按有效配方制成对应饲料。生成土地还受环境与生物条件影响，使用前核对提示和目标类型。
entries.bodyEn: Fans use redstone and orientation to move mobs. Place damaging surfaces in the path. Mob Swabs record targets for supported feed recipes; spawning blocks retain environmental conditions.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
把生物送到粉碎机攻击面，以红石控制其工作。安装对应升级提高伤害或增加抢夺、斩首等效果。

升级只影响粉碎机能力，不负责生成生物；输出掉落和经验需要独立收集设备。

entries.zh: 怪物捣碎器节肢杀手升级
entries.body:
把生物送到粉碎机攻击面，以红石控制其工作。安装对应升级提高伤害或增加抢夺、斩首等效果。

升级只影响粉碎机能力，不负责生成生物；输出掉落和经验需要独立收集设备。
entries.bodyEn: Move mobs to the Masher’s attack face and control it with redstone. Supported upgrades change damage/loot behavior; collection is separate.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body: 收割晶塔放在耕地配套位置，上方准备输出库存，GUI/提示设置工作范围并提供所需工具。其他晶塔按 GUI 装入对应过滤器或功能物品后，在作用范围内工作。
entries.bodyEn: Place the harvester in the farm layout, provide its output inventory and required tool, and set its range. Other pylons use their own filters or functional items to act within range.

entries.body:
把足够持续时间的目标药水效果写入药水过滤器，再将过滤器放入药水塔对应槽。GUI 确认效果已启用和作用对象。

空过滤器不会提供效果，效果时长需要按过滤器提示累计；不同效果要分别准备，不能只摆药水瓶期待自动全体生效。
entries.bodyEn: Charge a potion filter with the required effect duration and install it in the Infusion Pylon. Verify enabled effects and targets. Empty filters provide no effect.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
收割塔按自身范围和工具要求收获作物，给它配置兼容工具并从输出收取。工作面、土壤和种植条件仍需满足。

驱逐/禁制类塔用于控制实体或生成，按界面设置过滤对象和范围。它们与收割塔功能不同，检查目标是否在作用区。
entries.bodyEn: Equip the harvester with compatible tools and configure its work area. Expulsion/interdiction pylons instead control entities/spawns using their own target and range settings.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

空过滤器不会提供效果，效果时长需要按过滤器提示累计；不同效果要分别准备，不能只摆药水瓶期待自动全体生效。
entries.bodyEn: Charge a potion filter with the required effect duration and install it in the Infusion Pylon. Verify enabled effects and targets. Empty filters provide no effect.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body: 合金设备放入兼容材料与所需燃料，按 GUI 配置混合或合金；材料分级器放入待分级材料与催化物。使用装备工作台按蓝图与部件进行制作、修理或替换。
entries.bodyEn: Load alloying machines with compatible materials and fuel. Material graders use material and catalysts. Use the gear workbench and matching blueprints for crafting, repairs and part replacement.

entries.body:
蓝图可重复使用，模板通常只用一次。按蓝图提示用材料制作头部/护甲等部件，再与工具杆等兼容部件组装。蓝图书可储存并代用蓝图。

在制作站可混合材料，普通制作方式则要求对应相同材料。属性由材料、部件、等级和特性共同决定，单换外观不等于换全部属性。
entries.bodyEn: Blueprints are reusable; templates are single-use. Craft parts and assemble compatible gear. The crafting station supports mixed materials; ordinary crafting requires matching materials.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 材料分级、合金与星光充能
entries.body:
材料分级器对材料评定等级，配合接受的催化材料提高材料表现。合金设备把兼容材料组合成新材料，重结晶设备按其晶体配方工作。

星光充能器把相应星光强化施加在材料上。先处理材料，再制作部件；不同设备的催化、环境和数量要求从本机 JEI 逐项确认。
entries.bodyEn: Grade materials with supported catalysts, alloy compatible ingredients and use recrystallization recipes where applicable. Starlight charging modifies supported materials before part crafting.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 修理包、尖端与装备升级
entries.body:
把兼容材料放入修理包，再与损坏装备合成修理。普通装备耐久耗尽后可保持为可修理的损坏物，红卡升级会改变这一破坏行为。

尖端、涂层、握把等通过相应合成安装到兼容装备。检查物品提示的部件类型和特性，不同升级不能任意叠加，范围升级也受是否可叠加限制。
entries.bodyEn: Fill a repair kit with compatible material, then craft it with damaged gear. Add compatible tips/coatings/grips by their recipes. Red-card behavior and upgrade stacking have explicit limits.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
把兼容材料放入修理包，再与损坏装备合成修理。普通装备耐久耗尽后可保持为可修理的损坏物，红卡升级会改变这一破坏行为。

尖端、涂层、握把等通过相应合成安装到兼容装备。检查物品提示的部件类型和特性，不同升级不能任意叠加，范围升级也受是否可叠加限制。
entries.bodyEn: Fill a repair kit with compatible material, then craft it with damaged gear. Add compatible tips/coatings/grips by their recipes. Red-card behavior and upgrade stacking have explicit limits.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
材料分级器对材料评定等级，配合接受的催化材料提高材料表现。合金设备把兼容材料组合成新材料，重结晶设备按其晶体配方工作。

星光充能器把相应星光强化施加在材料上。先处理材料，再制作部件；不同设备的催化、环境和数量要求从本机 JEI 逐项确认。
entries.bodyEn: Grade materials with supported catalysts, alloy compatible ingredients and use recrystallization recipes where applicable. Starlight charging modifies supported materials before part crafting.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
把兼容材料放入修理包，再与损坏装备合成修理。普通装备耐久耗尽后可保持为可修理的损坏物，红卡升级会改变这一破坏行为。

尖端、涂层、握把等通过相应合成安装到兼容装备。检查物品提示的部件类型和特性，不同升级不能任意叠加，范围升级也受是否可叠加限制。
entries.bodyEn: Fill a repair kit with compatible material, then craft it with damaged gear. Add compatible tips/coatings/grips by their recipes. Red-card behavior and upgrade stacking have explicit limits.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 建筑工具：取样、模式与定位
entries.body:
操作步骤
1. 给工具充 FE，把要放的方块放进可用库存。潜行＋右键已有方块进行取样，检查工具显示的选择。
2. 打开设置选择铺面、线、墙等可用模式和参数，观察世界中的放置预览。范围键与菜单可调整工具支持的范围。
3. 对准起点，必要时用定位键锁住预览，再右键执行。执行后解除定位继续下一段。

故障排查
红色或缺失预览时查材料、FE、替换条件及受保护区域。撤销只对工具记录且支持的操作有效；不要把撤销当作任意世界改动的完整备份。设置键带修饰键时必须同时按下，拿着其他物品则不会打开工具菜单。
entries.bodyEn:
Charge the gadget and provide building blocks in an accessible inventory. Sneak-right-click a block to select it. Open settings, choose a mode and range, then inspect the preview. Anchor if needed and right-click to build; release the anchor afterward.

For missing or red previews, check materials, FE, placement rules and protection. Undo only covers supported recorded gadget operations. If settings do not open, hold the gadget and use the full binding including modifiers.

entries.zh: 交换工具：替换方块与匹配范围
entries.body:
操作步骤
给工具充能并准备目标建材；潜行＋右键取样要换成的方块。打开设置选择替换范围与匹配规则，对准原有方块检查预览，再右键执行。

注意事项
替换方块类型与替换的空间范围是两项条件，先确认取样不是旧方块。机器、库存和带方块实体的目标可能受到工具限制；不要假定替换会迁移其内容和全部数据。

故障排查
只替换少量方块时查连接/表面等当前模式、建材数量、FE 与目标限制。需要恢复时使用工具支持的撤销动作，再核对原物品是否已回收。
entries.bodyEn:
Charge the gadget, supply replacement blocks, and sneak-right-click to select the replacement. Choose range and matching rules, inspect the highlighted targets, then right-click.

The selected replacement and target selection are separate settings. Inventories and block entities may be restricted; do not assume their contents and data migrate. For partial replacement, check the selected mode, materials, power and target support. Use supported undo and verify recovered materials.

entries.zh: 复制粘贴工具：角点与材料
entries.body:
操作步骤
在设置中切到复制，按工具提示选择结构两个角点，确认预览包围了完整范围，再切到粘贴。调整偏移、朝向与位置，必要时锁定预览，再执行放置。

输入与输出
复制记录结构布局，生存粘贴仍需要能量和对应材料。模板管理器用于保存、读取或共享工具支持的模板；模板文件不等于已经准备好的建材。

故障排查
不能切换复制/粘贴先确认拿的是复制粘贴工具，并打开本工具的菜单。工具设置、定位和撤销各有独立绑定。缺一层或多一层时重新检查角点是否包含边界，不要靠连点补救错误选区。
entries.bodyEn:
Choose Copy in the settings menu and select the two corners according to the tool prompt. Verify the full bounding region, switch to Paste, then adjust offset, rotation and placement. Anchor the preview if useful.

Survival pasting needs energy and materials. The Template Manager stores or retrieves supported templates; templates do not supply blocks. If the mode cannot be changed, confirm the held gadget and its settings binding. Recheck corner inclusion for missing or extra layers.

entries.zh: 剪切粘贴工具：搬迁前核对选区
entries.body:
操作步骤
选择剪切范围，完整检查两个角点和预览。剪切操作会改动源位置；在目标位置设置偏移与方向，再按工具提示完成粘贴。

注意事项
剪切与复制不同，先确认源结构确实要搬走。对于机器网络，搬迁完成后逐一核对能源连接、物流方向、频道和红石信号；跨模组网络不一定保留对外连接。

故障排查
结构未完整搬入时检查允许处理的方块、选区、能量和目标区域。工具内已有待粘贴数据时先完成或按界面处理，避免用新的选区覆盖正在搬迁的内容。
entries.bodyEn:
Select and inspect both corners before cutting. Cutting changes the source area. Set target position, offset and rotation, then follow the gadget's paste prompt.

After moving machines, verify power connections, logistics directions, channels and redstone; external links may need rebuilding. For incomplete movement, inspect supported blocks, selection, energy and destination. Resolve any pending cut data before starting another operation.

entries.zh: 破坏工具：范围、预览与撤销
entries.body:
操作步骤
手持破坏工具打开设置；当前安装版会打开专用破坏设置窗口。分别设置各方向范围，回到世界核对高亮区域，再执行工具的破坏操作。

注意事项
破坏工具的用途是批量清除，不能当作保证收回全部掉落物的采矿工具。执行前移走要保留的机器、库存及范围边缘的重要方块。撤销是否可用以当前工具数据和配置为准。

故障排查
菜单与建筑工具的圆盘不同是正常的。无法清除时检查 FE、不可破坏方块、领地权限和当前范围；不要通过盲目扩大范围来排错。
entries.bodyEn:
Open settings while holding the Destruction Gadget. The installed version uses a dedicated destruction settings screen. Set directional extents and inspect the world preview before executing.

This is a clearing tool, not a guarantee of mining drops. Remove important machines and inventories from the selected area. Undo availability depends on the tool and configuration. For no effect, check FE, protected or unsupported blocks, permissions and selection size.

entries.body: 在模板管理器中放入复制粘贴工具与模板，使用 GUI 在两者之间保存或读取建筑数据。工具先选定复制区域，粘贴时按预览确认位置并提供需要的材料和能量。
entries.bodyEn: Insert a copy-paste gadget and template into the template manager and use its GUI to save or load build data. Select a source region, then confirm the paste preview with materials and power available.

entries.zh: 建筑、交换、复制与切割工具
entries.body:
给工具充能，打开模式菜单选择形状、范围与是否贴附表面。建筑工具放置所选方块，交换工具替换目标，复制/切割工具按角点选择区域。

确认预览后执行，按模式提供材料或绑定库存。模板保存布局而不是免费材料；撤销功能与可处理方块受工具限制。
entries.bodyEn: Charge the gadget, select its mode/area and inspect the preview. Supply materials or a bound inventory. Templates save layouts, not free blocks; gadget types have distinct actions.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

在设置中切到复制，按工具提示选择结构两个角点，确认预览包围了完整范围，再切到粘贴。调整偏移、朝向与位置，必要时锁定预览，再执行放置。

输入与输出
复制记录结构布局，生存粘贴仍需要能量和对应材料。模板管理器用于保存、读取或共享工具支持的模板；模板文件不等于已经准备好的建材。

故障排查
不能切换复制/粘贴先确认拿的是复制粘贴工具，并打开本工具的菜单。工具设置、定位和撤销各有独立绑定。缺一层或多一层时重新检查角点是否包含边界，不要靠连点补救错误选区。
entries.bodyEn:
Choose Copy in the settings menu and select the two corners according to the tool prompt. Verify the full bounding region, switch to Paste, then adjust offset, rotation and placement. Anchor the preview if useful.

Survival pasting needs energy and materials. The Template Manager stores or retrieves supported templates; templates do not supply blocks. If the mode cannot be changed, confirm the held gadget and its settings binding. Recheck corner inclusion for missing or extra layers.

entries.body: 把捕获的村民放入对应功能方块，再补充该设备要求的床、工作材料或食物。交易、繁殖、农作、刷铁设备使用各自 GUI 设置输入与输出。
entries.bodyEn: Insert a captured villager into the appropriate functional block and supply its required food or materials. Configure trading, breeding, farming and iron production in their GUIs.

entries.zh: 村民方块：交易、繁殖与生产
entries.body:
把村民放进对应功能方块。交易器选择村民交易，自动交易器还要供给付款物品并设置交易；繁殖器需要村民组合与食物。

农场、铁农场、转化器和孵化器按各自 GUI 放入所需村民、材料或幼体。成品从对应输出抽取，缺食物/材料或交易未解锁时不会自动绕过条件。
entries.bodyEn: Insert villagers into the relevant block. Configure trades and payment, or breeding food. Farming, iron production, conversion and incubation have distinct GUI input requirements.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body: 火箭放在发射台上，按型号补充燃料并进入驾驶界面选择目的地。离开发射点前准备匹配的氧气、供能与维生设备；加工设备按 JEI 配方运行。
entries.bodyEn: Place a rocket on its launch pad, fuel it and choose a destination from its cockpit. Prepare compatible oxygen and life-support equipment. Processing machines follow JEI recipes.

entries.zh: 氧气、分离机与供氧设备
entries.body:
水分离机按配方供水与电能，处理其氧气及其他输出。氧气罐用于兼容装备和供氧设备，穿戴完整可用的航天装备并实际补充氧气。

氧气释放机需要能源、氧气和有效密闭空间条件。通过 GUI 检查密闭/范围与储量，普通流体水不能直接当呼吸氧使用。
entries.bodyEn: Power and feed the separator, collect its outputs and fill supported oxygen gear. The distributor needs oxygen, energy and valid room conditions; inspect its GUI status.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 火箭、发射平台与火箭站
entries.body:
先搭有效发射平台并放置火箭，在火箭站等本版本界面准备接受的燃料与升级。乘坐前检查燃料、目标目的地和装备。

火箭升级改变兼容火箭的能力，不同推进/燃料条件按 GUI 与配方匹配。只放一块发射台或拿着空油桶不能完成发射准备。
entries.bodyEn: Build a valid pad, place the rocket and use the installed rocket interface/station to prepare fuel and compatible upgrades. Check fuel, destination and equipment before launch.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 抽油机、精炼与流体供给
entries.body:
手持原油探测器右击方块检查地下是否有油，再让抽油机在有效地点供电运行。精炼机输入原油并供电，将产出的燃料导入容器或储罐。

水泵用于水源采集，不能代替抽油。检查目标资源与输出罐已有物质；燃料必须被目标发动机实际接受。
entries.bodyEn: Right-click a block with an Oil Finder to check for oil. Power the pumpjack at a valid site, then refine oil into fuel. A water pump serves a different source.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 太空设备的电网、储罐与升级站
entries.body:
发电机按类型供燃料，太阳能按日照工作；线缆传能，管道传兼容流体。储能单元与罐提供缓存，等级限制容量和传输。

升级站用于本模组支持的装备/模块组合，在 GUI 确认兼容和能源。背包模块与火箭升级不是任意机器的通用速度升级。
entries.bodyEn: Match generators to fuel, cables to energy and pipes/tanks to fluids. Use the upgrade station only for compatible equipment/module combinations.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.zh: 真空封装机与太空罐头
entries.body:
在真空封装机第一槽放罐、第二槽放食物、第三槽放空玻璃瓶，处理后得到装有食物的罐头与水瓶。

无氧星球上不能直接吃普通食物，罐头解决太空进食。查看罐头提示的营养与饱和度，空罐需要先装入食物。
entries.bodyEn: Place a can, food and an empty glass bottle in the three input slots. The Vacuumator produces canned food and a water bottle. Cans allow eating in oxygen-free environments.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body: 火箭放在发射台上，按型号补充燃料并进入驾驶界面选择目的地。离开发射点前准备匹配的氧气、供能与维生设备；加工设备按 JEI 配方运行。
entries.bodyEn: Place a rocket on its launch pad, fuel it and choose a destination from its cockpit. Prepare compatible oxygen and life-support equipment. Processing machines follow JEI recipes.

entries.body:
水分离机按配方供水与电能，处理其氧气及其他输出。氧气罐用于兼容装备和供氧设备，穿戴完整可用的航天装备并实际补充氧气。

氧气释放机需要能源、氧气和有效密闭空间条件。通过 GUI 检查密闭/范围与储量，普通流体水不能直接当呼吸氧使用。
entries.bodyEn: Power and feed the separator, collect its outputs and fill supported oxygen gear. The distributor needs oxygen, energy and valid room conditions; inspect its GUI status.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
发电机按类型供燃料，太阳能按日照工作；线缆传能，管道传兼容流体。储能单元与罐提供缓存，等级限制容量和传输。

升级站用于本模组支持的装备/模块组合，在 GUI 确认兼容和能源。背包模块与火箭升级不是任意机器的通用速度升级。
entries.bodyEn: Match generators to fuel, cables to energy and pipes/tanks to fluids. Use the upgrade station only for compatible equipment/module combinations.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
手持原油探测器右击方块检查地下是否有油，再让抽油机在有效地点供电运行。精炼机输入原油并供电，将产出的燃料导入容器或储罐。

水泵用于水源采集，不能代替抽油。检查目标资源与输出罐已有物质；燃料必须被目标发动机实际接受。
entries.bodyEn: Right-click a block with an Oil Finder to check for oil. Power the pumpjack at a valid site, then refine oil into fuel. A water pump serves a different source.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
先搭有效发射平台并放置火箭，在火箭站等本版本界面准备接受的燃料与升级。乘坐前检查燃料、目标目的地和装备。

火箭升级改变兼容火箭的能力，不同推进/燃料条件按 GUI 与配方匹配。只放一块发射台或拿着空油桶不能完成发射准备。
entries.bodyEn: Build a valid pad, place the rocket and use the installed rocket interface/station to prepare fuel and compatible upgrades. Check fuel, destination and equipment before launch.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
在真空封装机第一槽放罐、第二槽放食物、第三槽放空玻璃瓶，处理后得到装有食物的罐头与水瓶。

无氧星球上不能直接吃普通食物，罐头解决太空进食。查看罐头提示的营养与饱和度，空罐需要先装入食物。
entries.bodyEn: Place a can, food and an empty glass bottle in the three input slots. The Vacuumator produces canned food and a water bottle. Cans allow eating in oxygen-free environments.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

先搭有效发射平台并放置火箭，在火箭站等本版本界面准备接受的燃料与升级。乘坐前检查燃料、目标目的地和装备。

火箭升级改变兼容火箭的能力，不同推进/燃料条件按 GUI 与配方匹配。只放一块发射台或拿着空油桶不能完成发射准备。
entries.bodyEn: Build a valid pad, place the rocket and use the installed rocket interface/station to prepare fuel and compatible upgrades. Check fuel, destination and equipment before launch.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
手持原油探测器右击方块检查地下是否有油，再让抽油机在有效地点供电运行。精炼机输入原油并供电，将产出的燃料导入容器或储罐。

水泵用于水源采集，不能代替抽油。检查目标资源与输出罐已有物质；燃料必须被目标发动机实际接受。
entries.bodyEn: Right-click a block with an Oil Finder to check for oil. Power the pumpjack at a valid site, then refine oil into fuel. A water pump serves a different source.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
发电机按类型供燃料，太阳能按日照工作；线缆传能，管道传兼容流体。储能单元与罐提供缓存，等级限制容量和传输。

升级站用于本模组支持的装备/模块组合，在 GUI 确认兼容和能源。背包模块与火箭升级不是任意机器的通用速度升级。
entries.bodyEn: Match generators to fuel, cables to energy and pipes/tanks to fluids. Use the upgrade station only for compatible equipment/module combinations.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

entries.body:
在真空封装机第一槽放罐、第二槽放食物、第三槽放空玻璃瓶，处理后得到装有食物的罐头与水瓶。

无氧星球上不能直接吃普通食物，罐头解决太空进食。查看罐头提示的营养与饱和度，空罐需要先装入食物。
entries.bodyEn: Place a can, food and an empty glass bottle in the three input slots. The Vacuumator produces canned food and a water bottle. Cans allow eating in oxygen-free environments.
researchSource: installed mod recipes, language descriptions, tooltips and manuals; see research-rounds.json

key.sneak.when: 下文“潜行＋右键”使用这个潜行键。
key.sneak.whenEn: Used wherever the instructions say sneak + right-click.

key.jei.focusSearch.when: 打开有 JEI 的物品界面。

key.jei.recipeBack.when: 已经打开 JEI 配方页时使用。

key.ftbquests.quests.when: 未分配时可用背包左上角的任务书按钮。
key.ftbquests.quests.whenEn: If unbound, use the quest button in the inventory.

key.ftbultimine.when: 按住后看预览，再破坏起始方块。
key.ftbultimine.whenEn: Hold, inspect the preview, then break the first block.

ftbultimine.change_shape.next.when: 是否需同时按住连锁键，由客户端配置决定。
ftbultimine.change_shape.next.whenEn: Holding Ultimine may be required by the client setting.

ftbultimine.change_shape.prev.when: 是否需同时按住连锁键，由客户端配置决定。
ftbultimine.change_shape.prev.whenEn: Holding Ultimine may be required by the client setting.

key.mekanism.mode.when: 配置器需手持并潜行；其他工具见下文。
key.mekanism.mode.whenEn: Hold and sneak for the Configurator; see the tool instructions.

key.mekanism.module_tweaker.when: 用于已装备且支持模块的 Meka 装备。

key.mekanism.head_mode.when: 穿戴支持此操作的头部装备。

key.mekanism.chest_mode.when: 穿戴支持此操作的胸部装备。

key.mekanism.legs_mode.when: 穿戴支持此操作的腿部装备。

key.mekanism.feet_mode.when: 穿戴支持此操作的足部装备。

key.mekanism.key_boost.when: 需相应装备、可用燃料或能量。
key.mekanism.key_boost.whenEn: Requires compatible gear and fuel or energy.

key.buildinggadgets2.settings_menu.when: 手持或副手持有建筑工具。
key.buildinggadgets2.settings_menu.whenEn: Hold a gadget in either hand.

key.buildinggadgets2.undo.when: 持有工具；仅对该工具支持的操作生效。
key.buildinggadgets2.undo.whenEn: Hold the gadget; only supported actions can be undone.

key.buildinggadgets2.anchor.when: 先对准目标位置，再锁定预览。
key.buildinggadgets2.anchor.whenEn: Aim at the intended position before anchoring.

key.buildinggadgets2.range.when: 持有支持范围设置的工具。
key.buildinggadgets2.range.whenEn: Hold a gadget supporting this setting.

key.modularrouters.configure.when: 路由器 GUI 内悬停模块；也可按鼠标中键。
key.modularrouters.configure.whenEn: Hover a module in the router GUI; middle-click also works.

key.modularrouters.moduleInfo.whenEn: Use in the context described by the module tooltip.

key.sophisticatedbackpacks.open_backpack.whenEn: Carry or equip an accessible backpack.

key.sophisticatedbackpacks.toggle_upgrad.zh: 切换第 1 个可切换升级
key.sophisticatedbackpacks.toggle_upgrad.when: 需要安装支持开关的升级。

key.sophisticatedbackpacks.toggle_upgrad.zh: 切换第 2 个可切换升级
key.sophisticatedbackpacks.toggle_upgrad.when: 序号按可切换升级顺序，不是固定某种升级。
key.sophisticatedbackpacks.toggle_upgrad.whenEn: The index follows switchable upgrades, not a fixed upgrade type.

key.dankstorage.construction.when: 手持 Dank；选择存储物品后再使用。
key.dankstorage.construction.whenEn: Hold a Dank and select a stored item.

key.dankstorage.pickup_mode.when: 持有 Dank，并检查当前提示状态。
key.dankstorage.pickup_mode.whenEn: Hold a Dank and inspect the displayed state.

key.dankstorage.lock_slot.when: 在 Dank 界面中悬停目标槽位。
key.dankstorage.lock_slot.whenEn: Hover the target slot inside the Dank screen.

create.keyinfo.toolmenu.when: 手持已部署蓝图时，按住并用滚轮选择工具。
create.keyinfo.toolmenu.whenEn: Hold a deployed schematic; hold the key and scroll between tools.

create.keyinfo.toolbelt.when: 需要附近有可用工具箱。

justdirethings.key.toolUI.when: 按原手册要求持有工具或穿戴对应装备；未分配时先绑定。
justdirethings.key.toolUI.whenEn: Hold the tool or wear the relevant gear; bind this action if unbound.

justdirethings.key.toggle_tool.when: 用于持有或装备的对应工具；升级自身按键在配置界面管理。
justdirethings.key.toggle_tool.whenEn: Use with the relevant equipped tool; ability-specific bindings are managed in its UI.

key.sfm.container_inspector.activation_k.when: 对准需要查看的库存或机器。
key.sfm.container_inspector.activation_k.whenEn: Inspect the target inventory or machine.

key.sfm.toggle_label_view_key.when: 用于检查机器与库存的标签。
key.sfm.toggle_label_view_key.whenEn: Use to inspect inventory and machine labels.
